title.zh_hans: 以色列新一届议会举行首次会议　议员宣誓就职

summary.zh_hant: 以色列新一屆議會120名議員星期二宣誓就職並舉行首次會議，其中46人首次當選。總理內塔尼亞胡領導的右翼陣營在上月27日選舉中失去多數議席，逾61名議員簽署請願，要求罷免議長奧哈納，並提名卡哈納接任。總統赫爾佐格已授權埃森科特組建新政府，限期28日，可延長14日；在新政府宣誓就職前，內塔尼亞胡繼續擔任看守總理。
summary.en: Israel's new Knesset held its first session on Tuesday, with all 120 members sworn in, 46 of them first-time lawmakers. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc lost its majority in the election on 27 October, and more than 61 lawmakers have signed a petition to remove Speaker Amir Ohana and nominate Matan Kahana as his successor. President Isaac Herzog has tasked Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government, with 28 days, extendable by 14; Netanyahu remains caretaker prime minister until the new government is sworn in.
summary.zh_hans: 以色列新一届议会120名议员星期二宣誓就职并举行首次会议，其中46人首次当选。总理内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼阵营在上月27日选举中失去多数议席，逾61名议员签署请愿，要求罢免议长奥哈纳，并提名卡哈纳接任。总统赫尔佐格已授权埃森科特组建新政府，限期28日，可延长14日；在新政府宣誓就职前，内塔尼亚胡继续担任看守总理。

title.zh_hant: 澤連斯基稱歐洲應參與結束俄烏戰事談判
title.en: Zelenskyy says Europe should take part in talks to end Russia-Ukraine war
title.zh_hans: 泽连斯基称欧洲应参与结束俄乌战事谈判

summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基在丹麥議會發表演說，表示歐洲是烏克蘭主權和安全的保證者之一，應參與旨在結束俄烏戰事的談判。他指出，和平進程若沒有歐洲參與，不可能強大持久，戰後重建亦需要與歐洲合作及融入歐洲。澤連斯基又說，美俄烏三方會談在阿布扎比達成部分共識，政治決定取決於美國和俄羅斯總統。
summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told the Danish parliament that Europe, as one of the guarantors of Ukraine's sovereignty and security, should take part in talks aimed at ending the Russia-Ukraine war. He said a peace process without Europe cannot be strong and lasting, and post-war reconstruction will also require cooperation and integration with Europe. Zelenskyy added that the US-Russia-Ukraine trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi reached partial consensus, with political decisions resting with the US and Russian presidents.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在丹麦议会发表演说，表示欧洲是乌克兰主权和安全的保证者之一，应参与旨在结束俄乌战事的谈判。他指出，和平进程若没有欧洲参与，不可能强大持久，战后重建亦需要与欧洲合作及融入欧洲。泽连斯基又说，美俄乌三方会谈在阿布扎比达成部分共识，政治决定取决于美国和俄罗斯总统。

title.zh_hant: 伊朗外長稱美國對伊朗戰事不可能實現任何目標
title.en: Iranian foreign minister says US war on Iran could achieve no objective
title.zh_hans: 伊朗外长称美国对伊朗战事不可能实现任何目标

summary.zh_hant: 伊朗外長阿拉格齊否認有關伊朗官員雷扎伊與美國副總統萬斯安排會面的報道，稱報道毫無根據。他表示，美國對伊朗發動戰事不可能實現任何目標，唯一解決辦法是以外交手段、使用尊重的語言，以及履行伊朗提出的要求和條件。
summary.en: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi denied reports that Iranian official Mohsen Rezaei had arranged a meeting with US Vice President JD Vance, calling the reports groundless. He said a US war against Iran could not achieve any objective, adding that the only solution is diplomacy, using respectful language and meeting the demands and conditions put forward by Iran.
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗外长阿拉格齐否认有关伊朗官员雷扎伊与美国副总统万斯安排会面的报道，称报道毫无根据。他表示，美国对伊朗发动战事不可能实现任何目标，唯一解决办法以外交手段、使用尊重的语言，以及履行伊朗提出的要求和条件。

title.zh_hant: 美防長指彈劾動議出於個人不滿及政治分歧
title.en: Hegseth says impeachment push driven by personal grievance and political differences
title.zh_hans: 美防长指弹劾动议出于个人不满及政治分歧

summary.zh_hant: 美國國防部長赫格塞思表示，眾議員梅西推動針對他的彈劾，是出於個人不滿及政治分歧，目的是打擊特朗普，形容為政治騷。他指梅西在離任前試圖損害政府及美軍利益，又稱彈劾將向伊朗等國釋放錯誤信號。特朗普已表明支持赫格塞思。
summary.en: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Representative Thomas Massie's push to impeach him stems from personal grievance and political differences, describing it as a political show aimed at Donald Trump. He said Massie was trying to damage the government and the US military before leaving office, adding that impeachment would send the wrong signal to countries including Iran. Trump has expressed support for Hegseth.
summary.zh_hans: 美国国防部长赫格塞思表示，众议员梅西推动针对他的弹劾，是出于个人不满及政治分歧，目的是打击特朗普，形容为政治骚。他指梅西在离任前试图损害政府及美军利益，又称弹劾将向伊朗等国释放错误信号。特朗普已表明支持赫格塞思。

title.zh_hant: 馬來西亞高院批准納吉布居家監禁服完剩餘刑期
title.en: Malaysia's High Court approves house arrest for Najib to serve remainder of sentence
title.zh_hans: 马来西亚高院批准纳吉布居家监禁服完剩余刑期

summary.zh_hant: 馬來西亞高等法院批准前總理納吉布以居家監禁方式，服完剩餘刑期至2028年8月23日。總理府法務部門9月18日宣布有條件特赦，納吉布繳納罰款後可居家服刑，最高元首強調特赦令明確無歧義，應尊重執行。納吉布2020年7月因挪用公款等7項罪名成立，被判監12年，2022年8月聯邦法院終審維持原判。
summary.en: Malaysia's High Court has approved former prime minister Najib Razak serving the remainder of his sentence under house arrest until 23 August 2028. The Prime Minister's Department's legal affairs division announced a conditional pardon on 18 September, allowing Najib to serve his sentence at home after paying a fine, and the King stressed that the pardon order was clear and unambiguous and should be respected and implemented. Najib was convicted in July 2020 on seven charges, including misappropriation of funds, and sentenced to 12 years in prison; the Federal Court upheld the verdict on final appeal in August 2022.
summary.zh_hans: 马来西亚高等法院批准前总理纳吉布以居家监禁方式，服完剩余刑期至2028年8月23日。总理府法务部门9月18日宣布有条件特赦，纳吉布缴纳罚款后可居家服刑，最高元首强调特赦令明确无歧义，应尊重执行。纳吉布2020年7月因挪用公款等7项罪名成立，被判监12年，2022年8月联邦法院终审维持原判。

title.zh_hant: 美卿稱制裁及海上封鎖成效顯著　無必要對伊朗發動大規模軍事行動
title.en: Rubio says sanctions and naval blockade highly effective, no need for large-scale military action against Iran
title.zh_hans: 美卿称制裁及海上封锁成效显著　无必要对伊朗发动大规模军事行动

summary.zh_hant: 美國國務卿魯比奧表示，美國對伊朗的制裁及海上封鎖成效顯著，伊朗政府承受巨大壓力，正與美國討論會面事宜，因此無必要對伊朗發動大規模軍事行動。美國總統特朗普亦表示，過去數天制裁帶來的影響深遠，伊朗已經「沒有收入」，不排除向伊朗提供有限度協助。伊朗駐聯合國大使重申，伊朗政府無意建造核武器。
summary.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said US sanctions and the naval blockade against Iran have proved highly effective, leaving the Iranian government under enormous pressure and in discussions with the United States about a meeting, so there is no need for large-scale military action against Iran. US President Donald Trump also said the sanctions imposed over the past few days have had a far-reaching impact, leaving Iran with "no revenue", and did not rule out providing Iran with limited assistance. Iran's ambassador to the United Nations reiterated that the Iranian government has no intention of building nuclear weapons.
summary.zh_hans: 美国国务卿鲁比奥表示，美国对伊朗的制裁及海上封锁成效显著，伊朗政府承受巨大压力，正与美国讨论会面事宜，因此无必要对伊朗发动大规模军事行动。美国总统特朗普亦表示，过去数天制裁带来的影响深远，伊朗已经「没有收入」，不排除向伊朗提供有限度协助。伊朗驻联合国大使重申，伊朗政府无意建造核武器。

title.zh_hant: 伊朗強烈譴責法國網絡攻擊指控　斥極不負責任及卑劣
title.en: Iran strongly condemns French cyberattack accusation as extremely irresponsible and despicable
title.zh_hans: 伊朗强烈谴责法国网络攻击指控　斥极不负责任及卑劣

summary.zh_hant: 伊朗強烈譴責法國指控伊朗策動網絡攻擊，批評有關指控極不負責任、卑劣及不可接受。法國外長巴羅早前指控伊朗策動網絡攻擊，涉及法國多個政府部門、企業及媒體，巴黎檢察部門已就事件展開調查。伊朗外長阿拉格齊反駁指控毫無根據，強調伊朗致力打擊網絡犯罪。法方又稱，伊朗曾試圖攻擊法國總統馬克龍辦公室及外交部等目標。
summary.en: Iran has strongly condemned France's accusation that it orchestrated cyberattacks, calling the allegation extremely irresponsible, despicable and unacceptable. French Foreign Minister Barrot had accused Iran of carrying out cyberattacks targeting a number of French government departments, businesses and media outlets, and Paris prosecutors have opened an investigation. Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi rejected the accusation as groundless, stressing that Iran is committed to combating cybercrime. The French side also said Iran had attempted to attack targets including the office of President Emmanuel Macron and the foreign ministry.
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗强烈谴责法国指控伊朗策动网络攻击，批评有关指控极不负责任、卑劣及不可接受。法国外长巴罗早前指控伊朗策动网络攻击，涉及法国多个政府部门、企业及媒体，巴黎检察部门已就事件展开调查。伊朗外长阿拉格齐反驳指控毫无根据，强调伊朗致力打击网络犯罪。法方又称，伊朗曾试图攻击法国总统马克龙办公室及外交部等目标。

title.zh_hant: 美俄烏三方首日會談結束　拉夫羅夫稱局勢不明　俄方不會同意再停火
title.en: First day of US-Russia-Ukraine trilateral talks ends as Lavrov says Russia will not agree to another ceasefire while situation unclear
title.zh_hans: 美俄乌三方首日会谈结束　拉夫罗夫称局势不明　俄方不会同意再停火

summary.zh_hant: 美國、俄羅斯和烏克蘭三方代表在阿聯酋阿布扎比舉行的首日會談結束，雙方翌日繼續會談。俄方代表團團長梅丁斯基形容會談具建設性，但仍有大量工作要做。俄羅斯外長拉夫羅夫表示，在局勢不明朗的情況下，俄方不會同意再次停火，又質疑烏克蘭會否遵守停火，認為烏方立場矛盾。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基形容會談「不錯」，但未透露細節，又表示歐洲代表將於下周加入會談，屆時他可能與美國總統特朗普會面。
summary.en: The first day of trilateral talks between the United States, Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi has ended, with the parties due to continue talks the following day. Russian delegation head Vladimir Medinsky described the talks as constructive but said much work remains. Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said Russia would not agree to another ceasefire while the situation remains unclear, questioning whether Ukraine would honour a ceasefire and saying Kyiv's position is contradictory. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the talks as "good" without giving details, adding that European representatives will join next week, when he may meet US President Donald Trump.
summary.zh_hans: 美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰三方代表在阿联酋阿布扎比举行的首日会谈结束，双方翌日继续会谈。俄方代表团团长梅丁斯基形容会谈具建设性，但仍有大量工作要做。俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫表示，在局势不明朗的情况下，俄方不会同意再次停火，又质疑乌克兰会否遵守停火，认为乌方立场矛盾。乌克兰总统泽连斯基形容会谈「不错」，但未透露细节，又表示欧洲代表将于下周加入会谈，届时他可能与美国总统特朗普会面。

title.zh_hant: 美股初段偏軟　道指曾跌逾300點　Nvidia再跌近4%
title.en: US stocks soft in early trading as Dow falls over 300 points at one stage and Nvidia drops nearly 4% again
title.zh_hans: 美股初段偏软　道指曾跌逾300点　Nvidia再跌近4%

summary.zh_hant: 美股初段偏軟。道瓊斯指數開市後曾跌逾300點，其後跌幅收窄，較早時報52208點，跌181點，跌幅0.35%；標普500指數報7510點，跌39點，跌幅0.52%；納斯達克指數報25089點，跌163點，跌幅0.65%。Nvidia未止跌，初段再跌近4%；半導體股份有較大跌幅，美光、希捷科技、Sandisk跌近3%或以上。
summary.en: US stocks were soft in early trading. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell more than 300 points after the open before narrowing its losses to 181 points, or 0.35 per cent, at 52,208; the S&P 500 was at 7,510, down 39 points or 0.52 per cent, and the Nasdaq was at 25,089, down 163 points or 0.65 per cent. Nvidia extended its slide, falling nearly 4 per cent again in early trading; semiconductor shares fell sharply, with Micron, Seagate Technology and Sandisk down about 3 per cent or more.
summary.zh_hans: 美股初段偏软。道琼斯指数开市后曾跌逾300点，其后跌幅收窄，较早时报52208点，跌181点，跌幅0.35%；标普500指数报7510点，跌39点，跌幅0.52%；纳斯达克指数报25089点，跌163点，跌幅0.65%。Nvidia未止跌，初段再跌近4%；半导体股份有较大跌幅，美光、希捷科技、Sandisk跌近3%或以上。

title.zh_hant: 王毅與法國外長通話　願共同履行安理會常任理事國責任
title.en: Wang Yi speaks with French foreign minister, pledging joint fulfilment of UN Security Council permanent member duties
title.zh_hans: 王毅与法国外长通话　愿共同履行安理会常任理事国责任

summary.zh_hant: 中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅應約同法國外長巴羅通電話。王毅表示，雙方應落實兩國元首共識，加強對話合作，夯實政治互信，共同應對各類風險挑戰；中方願意同法方一起履行好安理會常任理事國特殊責任，維護國際社會共同利益。王毅又說，中歐合則兩利、鬥則俱傷，期待歐方同中方相向而行，共同打造穩定、平衡的中歐關鍵貿易伙伴關係，相信法國將為此發揮建設性作用。新華社報道，巴羅表示，法方希望同中方深化戰略互信，加強溝通協調，攜手捍衛多邊主義，願意為推動歐中對話合作發揮積極作用。
summary.en: Wang Yi, a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, spoke by phone with French Foreign Minister Barrot at Barrot's request. Wang said the two sides should implement the consensus reached by their leaders, strengthen dialogue and cooperation, consolidate political trust and jointly address risks and challenges; China is willing to work with France to fulfil their special responsibilities as permanent members of the UN Security Council and safeguard the common interests of the international community. Wang added that China and Europe both gain from cooperation and both lose from confrontation, and he hopes the EU will meet China halfway in building a stable and balanced key trading partnership, believing France can play a constructive role. Xinhua reported that Barrot said France hopes to deepen strategic trust with China, strengthen communication and coordination, jointly defend multilateralism and play an active role in advancing EU-China dialogue and cooperation.
summary.zh_hans: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅应约同法国外长巴罗通电话。王毅表示，双方应落实两国元首共识，加强对话合作，夯实政治互信，共同应对各类风险挑战；中方愿意同法方一起履行好安理会常任理事国特殊责任，维护国际社会共同利益。王毅又说，中欧合则两利、斗则俱伤，期待欧方同中方相向而行，共同打造稳定、平衡的中欧关键贸易伙伴关系，相信法国将为此发挥建设性作用。新华社报道，巴罗表示，法方希望同中方深化战略互信，加强沟通协调，携手捍卫多边主义，愿意为推动欧中对话合作发挥积极作用。

title.zh_hant: 入境處與深圳邊檢總站於香園圍管制站進行APEC安保演練
title.en: Immigration Department and Shenzhen border inspection hold APEC security drill at Heung Yuen Wai Control Point
title.zh_hans: 入境处与深圳边检总站于香园围管制站进行APEC安保演练

summary.zh_hant: 入境處表示，為切實執行APEC會議安保任務，聯同深圳邊檢總站昨日在香園圍管制站開展「APEC安保粵港口岸聯動應急處置演練」。入境處處長郭俊峯率領管制部人員到場，與深圳邊檢總站總站長徐曉偉等領導一同指導今次演練。演練著重提升一線人員維護粵港口岸邊檢安全的意識，以及應對突發事件的即時應變能力。處方表示，演練期間，兩地緊密配合，全面加強在緊急事態中的溝通、協作與默契，為即將舉行的APEC會議做好準備，竭力保障市民的生命財產，堅定維護國家安全。
summary.en: The Immigration Department said that, to carry out security duties for the APEC meeting, it joined the Shenzhen General Station of Exit and Entry Inspection yesterday in a joint emergency response drill for APEC security at Guangdong-Hong Kong ports, held at the Heung Yuen Wai Control Point. Director of Immigration Kwok Chun-fung led officers from the Control Points Division to the scene, where they directed the drill together with leaders including Xu Xiaowei, chief of the Shenzhen General Station. The exercise focused on raising frontline officers' awareness of safeguarding border inspection security at Guangdong-Hong Kong ports and their ability to respond immediately to contingencies. The department said the two sides worked closely throughout the drill, comprehensively strengthening communication, coordination and understanding in emergencies, in preparation for the upcoming APEC meeting, to protect the lives and property of the public and firmly safeguard national security.
summary.zh_hans: 入境处表示，为切实执行APEC会议安保任务，联同深圳边检总站昨日在香园围管制站开展「APEC安保粤港口岸联动应急处置演练」。入境处处长郭俊峯率领管制部人员到场，与深圳边检总站总站长徐晓伟等领导一同指导今次演练。演练着重提升一线人员维护粤港口岸边检安全的意识，以及应对突发事件的即时应变能力。处方表示，演练期间，两地紧密配合，全面加强在紧急事态中的沟通、协作与默契，为即将举行的APEC会议做好准备，竭力保障市民的生命财产，坚定维护国家安全。

title.zh_hant: 美國10月通脹按月升0.4%略高於預期　加息預期升溫
title.en: US October inflation rose 0.4% on the month, slightly above forecasts, lifting rate-hike expectations
title.zh_hans: 美国10月通胀按月升0.4%略高于预期　加息预期升温

summary.zh_hant: 美國10月通脹數據略高於預期，進一步鞏固聯儲局下月加息預期。美國勞工統計局公布，10月消費物價指數按月升0.4%，略高於預期，但升幅低於9月的0.6%；撇除較大波動的食品及能源價格後，上月核心消費物價指數按月升0.3%，亦略高於預期，與9月升幅相同，連續第三個月升0.3%。期內住屋價格按月升0.3%，佔整體按月升幅逾三成；食品價格升0.5%，能源價格升0.7%。勞工統計局今次未有公布按年升幅，因為去年政府停擺期間未有收集2025年10月物價數據，無法計算按年比較數字；聯儲局將於12月9日舉行議息會議，是下次公布通脹數據之前最後一次會議。
summary.en: US October inflation data came in slightly above expectations, further strengthening expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the consumer price index rose 0.4 per cent on the month in October, slightly above forecasts but below September's 0.6 per cent rise; excluding volatile food and energy prices, core CPI rose 0.3 per cent on the month, also slightly above forecasts and matching September's increase, the third consecutive month at 0.3 per cent. Shelter prices rose 0.3 per cent in October, accounting for more than 30 per cent of the monthly increase; food prices rose 0.5 per cent and energy prices rose 0.7 per cent. The Bureau of Labor Statistics did not publish year-on-year rates this time because October 2025 prices were not collected during last year's government shutdown, so no annual comparison can be computed; the Federal Reserve meets on December 9, its last meeting before the next inflation release.
summary.zh_hans: 美国10月通胀数据略高于预期，进一步巩固联储局下月加息预期。美国劳工统计局公布，10月消费物价指数按月升0.4%，略高于预期，但升幅低于9月的0.6%；撇除较大波动的食品及能源价格后，上月核心消费物价指数按月升0.3%，亦略高于预期，与9月升幅相同，连续第三个月升0.3%。期内住屋价格按月升0.3%，占整体按月升幅逾三成；食品价格升0.5%，能源价格升0.7%。劳工统计局今次未有公布按年升幅，因为去年政府停摆期间未有收集2025年10月物价数据，无法计算按年比较数字；联储局将于12月9日举行议息会议，是下次公布通胀数据之前最后一次会议。

title.zh_hant: 三方會談前烏方先與歐美協調立場　關鍵優先事項是停火
title.en: Ukraine coordinates with US and European allies before trilateral talks, with ceasefire the key priority
title.zh_hans: 三方会谈前乌方先与欧美协调立场　关键优先事项是停火

summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯、美國和烏克蘭在阿聯酋阿布扎比舉行三方會談，探討推動烏克蘭危機政治解決的途徑。烏方會前先與美、英、法、德、意大利、北約及歐盟委員會的代表舉行會談，就結束烏克蘭危機、實現持久和平以及對烏安全保障等問題進行協調。烏克蘭代表團團長、對外情報局局長烏梅羅夫在社交平台表示，烏方關鍵優先事項是停止敵對行動，獲得可靠的戰後安全保障，確保烏克蘭經濟恢復與發展，並推進人道主義工作。美國和歐盟委員會會後發表聲明，表示未來任何關於烏克蘭問題的安排都必須尊重烏克蘭主權、領土完整和自主決策，並為烏克蘭提供可信的安全保障。
summary.en: Russia, the United States and Ukraine are holding trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi to explore a political settlement of the Ukraine crisis. Before the talks, the Ukrainian side met representatives of the US, the UK, France, Germany, Italy, NATO and the European Commission to coordinate on ending the crisis, achieving lasting peace and providing security guarantees for Ukraine. Rustem Umerov, head of the Ukrainian delegation and chief of foreign intelligence, said on social media that Ukraine's key priorities are stopping hostilities, obtaining reliable post-war security guarantees, ensuring the recovery and development of Ukraine's economy, and advancing humanitarian work. The United States and the European Commission said in a joint statement afterwards that any future arrangement on Ukraine must respect Ukraine's sovereignty, territorial integrity and self-determination, and provide credible security guarantees for Ukraine.
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯、美国和乌克兰在阿联酋阿布扎比举行三方会谈，探讨推动乌克兰危机政治解决的途径。乌方会前先与美、英、法、德、意大利、北约及欧盟委员会的代表举行会谈，就结束乌克兰危机、实现持久和平以及对乌安全保障等问题进行协调。乌克兰代表团团长、对外情报局局长乌梅罗夫在社交平台表示，乌方关键优先事项是停止敌对行动，获得可靠的战后安全保障，确保乌克兰经济恢复与发展，并推进人道主义工作。美国和欧盟委员会会后发表声明，表示未来任何关于乌克兰问题的安排都必须尊重乌克兰主权、领土完整和自主决策，并为乌克兰提供可信的安全保障。

title.zh_hant: 阿里巴巴擬分拆晶片業務平頭哥在港上市
title.en: Alibaba plans to spin off chip unit T-Head for Hong Kong listing
title.zh_hans: 阿里巴巴拟分拆芯片业务平头哥在港上市

summary.zh_hant: 阿里巴巴擬分拆旗下晶片業務平頭哥在港交所主板獨立上市。公告指，平頭哥9月11日以保密形式向聯交所遞交上市申請，已獲確認可進行建議分拆。阿里巴巴認為，建議分拆在商業上對集團及平頭哥都有利，應可令投資者更妥善評估阿里巴巴保留集團業務的價值，並繼續多元化業務模式；亦可更好反映並提升平頭哥自身價值，提升其獨立形象，有助磋商業務，亦有利獨立進入股本及債務資本市場。平頭哥是內地全棧數據中心晶片供應商，旗下晶片可實現系統級算力解決方案；建議分拆完成後，預期平頭哥將繼續是阿里巴巴子公司。
summary.en: Alibaba plans to spin off its chip business T-Head for a separate listing on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The announcement said T-Head submitted its listing application to the Stock Exchange in confidential form on September 11 and has been confirmed as eligible for the proposed spin-off. Alibaba said the spin-off would be commercially beneficial for both the group and T-Head, allowing investors to better assess the value of Alibaba's retained businesses while continuing to diversify its business model; it would also better reflect and enhance T-Head's own value and independent profile, help it negotiate business and give it independent access to equity and debt capital markets. T-Head is a mainland full-stack data-centre chip supplier whose chips deliver system-level computing solutions; after the spin-off, T-Head is expected to remain an Alibaba subsidiary.
summary.zh_hans: 阿里巴巴拟分拆旗下芯片业务平头哥在港交所主板独立上市。公告指，平头哥9月11日以保密形式向联交所递交上市申请，已获确认可进行建议分拆。阿里巴巴认为，建议分拆在商业上对集团及平头哥都有利，应可令投资者更妥善评估阿里巴巴保留集团业务的价值，并继续多元化业务模式；亦可更好反映并提升平头哥自身价值，提升其独立形象，有助磋商业务，亦有利独立进入股本及债务资本市场。平头哥是内地全栈数据中心芯片供应商，旗下芯片可实现系统级算力解决方案；建议分拆完成后，预期平头哥将继续是阿里巴巴子公司。

title.zh_hant: 食環署首9個月發逾8100張冷氣機滴水通知　較2023年同期增近4倍
title.en: FEHD issued over 8,100 dripping air conditioner notices in first nine months, nearly four times 2023 figure
title.zh_hans: 食环署首9个月发逾8100张冷气机滴水通知　较2023年同期增近4倍

summary.zh_hant: 食物環境衞生署表示，今年繼續以多管齊下方式處理冷氣機滴水問題，結合加強巡查執法、宣傳教育、創新科技及調整行動策略，全港各區已全面部署第三代「冷氣機滴水偵測系統」，具備紅外線夜視及人工智能影像識別功能，可快速準確偵測滴水位置。截至9月30日，署方今年已發出約8100張有關冷氣機滴水的妨擾事故通知，較去年同期及2024年同期分別增加約16%及54%，約為2023年同期的4倍，超過99%接獲通知的住戶已按要求處理滴水問題。署方重點跟進約300個滴水較嚴重地點，包括巴士站、小巴站及行人通道，每星期最少巡查一次，至8月約一半地點已解決或明顯改善，其後再擴展至逾110個較輕微地點，跟進地點總數增至逾400個；另有逾300個私人屋苑參與物業管理業界合作計劃，每年協助跟進平均逾4000宗滴水投訴。
summary.en: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it has continued a multipronged approach to dripping air conditioners this year, combining enhanced inspections and enforcement, publicity and education, innovative technology and adjusted operational strategies, with the third-generation Air-conditioning Water Dripping Inspection System — featuring infrared night vision and AI image recognition — now fully deployed across all districts to detect dripping locations quickly and accurately. As of September 30, the department had issued about 8,100 nuisance notices concerning dripping air conditioners this year, up about 16 per cent and 54 per cent on the same periods last year and in 2024 respectively, and about four times the figure for the same period in 2023; more than 99 per cent of households that received notices have addressed the problem as required. The department focuses on about 300 locations with more serious dripping, including bus stops, minibus stops and pedestrian passages, inspecting each at least once a week; by August, dripping at about half of them had been resolved or significantly improved, and operations were extended to more than 110 less serious locations, taking the total under follow-up to over 400. More than 300 private housing estates take part in a scheme with the property management sector, helping to follow up an average of more than 4,000 dripping complaints a year.
summary.zh_hans: 食物环境衞生署表示，今年继续以多管齐下方式处理冷气机滴水问题，结合加强巡查执法、宣传教育、创新科技及调整行动策略，全港各区已全面部署第三代「冷气机滴水侦测系统」，具备红外线夜视及人工智能影像识别功能，可快速准确侦测滴水位置。截至9月30日，署方今年已发出约8100张有关冷气机滴水的妨扰事故通知，较去年同期及2024年同期分别增加约16%及54%，约为2023年同期的4倍，超过99%接获通知的住户已按要求处理滴水问题。署方重点跟进约300个滴水较严重地点，包括巴士站、小巴站及行人通道，每星期最少巡查一次，至8月约一半地点已解决或明显改善，其后再扩展至逾110个较轻微地点，跟进地点总数增至逾400个；另有逾300个私人屋苑参与物业管理业界合作计划，每年协助跟进平均逾4000宗滴水投诉。

title.zh_hant: 衞生署：75個新冠疫苗接種點足夠應付目前需求
title.en: Health Department says 75 Covid vaccination points enough to meet current demand
title.zh_hans: 衞生署：75个新冠疫苗接种点足够应付目前需求

summary.zh_hant: 衞生署發言人表示，整體接種新冠疫苗初始劑次人士比率超過九成，又指新冠疫苗加強劑接種率計算有別於其他疫苗，需要考慮相關群組人士最近有否感染新冠病毒及其感染日期。發言人說，根據現行接種計劃，優先組別人士若已完成初始劑次，不論過往已接種多少劑疫苗，在接種上一劑疫苗或感染新冠病毒至少180日後，可免費接種加強劑；由於目前未有相關群組人士感染新冠病毒的完整數據，未能計算群組疫苗接種率。發言人亦指，現時採用的mRNA新冠疫苗涉及複雜冷鏈處理及物流程序，在減少浪費疫苗前提下，全港公立醫院專科門診及家庭醫學診所、私家診所、母嬰健康院等75個新冠疫苗接種點已足夠應付目前接種需求。
summary.en: A spokesman for the Department of Health said more than 90 per cent of people have received their initial Covid-19 vaccine doses, adding that the booster uptake rate is calculated differently from other vaccines because it must take into account whether people in the relevant groups were recently infected and the date of infection. Under the current programme, people in priority groups who have completed their initial doses can receive a free booster at least 180 days after their last dose or infection, regardless of how many doses they have had; as complete infection data for these groups is not available, the group vaccination rate cannot be calculated. The spokesman also said the mRNA Covid vaccines in use involve complex cold-chain handling and logistics, and that, while minimising vaccine wastage, the 75 vaccination points across the territory — including specialist outpatient clinics and family medicine clinics at public hospitals, private clinics and maternal and child health centres — are enough to meet current demand.
summary.zh_hans: 衞生署发言人表示，整体接种新冠疫苗初始剂次人士比率超过九成，又指新冠疫苗加强剂接种率计算有别于其他疫苗，需要考虑相关群组人士最近有否感染新冠病毒及其感染日期。发言人说，根据现行接种计划，优先组别人士若已完成初始剂次，不论过往已接种多少剂疫苗，在接种上一剂疫苗或感染新冠病毒至少180日后，可免费接种加强剂；由于目前未有相关群组人士感染新冠病毒的完整数据，未能计算群组疫苗接种率。发言人亦指，现时采用的mRNA新冠疫苗涉及复杂冷链处理及物流程序，在减少浪费疫苗前提下，全港公立医院专科门诊及家庭医学诊所、私家诊所、母婴健康院等75个新冠疫苗接种点已足够应付目前接种需求。

title.zh_hant: 日本自衛隊員強闖中國駐日使館案　檢方求判監18個月
title.en: Prosecutors seek 18-month jail term for Japanese serviceman who forced his way into Chinese embassy
title.zh_hans: 日本自卫队员强闯中国驻日使馆案　检方求判监18个月

summary.zh_hant: 日本陸上自衛隊官員村田晃大強闖中國駐日本大使館案，東京地方法院再次舉行庭審，檢方建議判處村田晃大監禁18個月，辯方則要求判處罰款，法庭下月24日裁決。村田晃大今年3月攜刀翻牆強行闖入中國使館，隨後被日本警方拘捕，陸上自衛隊8月對他作出免職處分。東京地方法院上月初首次就案件舉行公開庭審，日本檢方以闖入建築物、威脅使館工作人員等罪名對村田晃大提出公訴，辯方否認威脅使館工作人員，僅承認闖入建築物和違反槍支刀具法的罪名。中國駐日使館事後向日方提出嚴正交涉並表示強烈抗議，要求日方作出負責任交代。
summary.en: Tokyo District Court has heard further proceedings in the case of Japanese Ground Self-Defense Force officer Murata Akihiro, who forced his way into the Chinese Embassy in Japan, with prosecutors seeking an 18-month prison term and the defence asking for a fine; the court will deliver its verdict on December 24. Murata climbed over the embassy wall carrying a knife in March and was arrested by Japanese police; the Ground Self-Defense Force dismissed him in August. At the first public hearing early last month, prosecutors charged Murata with trespassing and threatening embassy staff; the defence denied the threat charge, admitting only trespassing and violating firearms and swords control legislation. The Chinese Embassy in Japan lodged solemn representations with the Japanese side, expressing strong protest and demanding a responsible account.
summary.zh_hans: 日本陆上自卫队官员村田晃大强闯中国驻日本大使馆案，东京地方法院再次举行庭审，检方建议判处村田晃大监禁18个月，辩方则要求判处罚款，法庭下月24日裁决。村田晃大今年3月携刀翻墙强行闯入中国使馆，随后被日本警方拘捕，陆上自卫队8月对他作出免职处分。东京地方法院上月初首次就案件举行公开庭审，日本检方以闯入建筑物、威胁使馆工作人员等罪名对村田晃大提出公诉，辩方否认威胁使馆工作人员，仅承认闯入建筑物和违反枪支刀具法的罪名。中国驻日使馆事后向日方提出严正交涉并表示强烈抗议，要求日方作出负责任交代。

title.zh_hant: 地盤禁煙逾3個月　巡查7300個地盤發84張定額罰款
title.en: Construction-site smoking ban: 7,300 sites inspected in over three months, 84 fixed penalty notices issued
title.zh_hans: 地盘禁烟逾3个月　巡查7300个地盘发84张定额罚款

summary.zh_hant: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，政府今年7月17日正式實施地盤全面禁煙，截至10月底，勞工處共巡查了7300個地盤，共向違規吸煙人士發出84張「定額罰款通知書」，亦向地盤承建商發出5張吿票，牽涉4宗個案。孫玉菡出席一個活動致辭時表示，巡查的7300個地盤中有部分是建基於市民投訴，但大多數是勞工處的突擊檢查；而發出的84張「定額罰款通知書」中，有28張是建基於市民投訴，大多數都附有相片，甚至有錄像。孫玉菡又說，年初優化了《安全使用移動式升降工作平台指引》，7月底亦在憲報刊登《竹棚架工作安全守則》及《金屬棚架工作安全守則》增編，為承建商提供清晰、可遵循的實務指引。
summary.en: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said the government fully banned smoking at construction sites from July 17 this year, and by the end of October the Labour Department had inspected 7,300 sites, issuing 84 fixed penalty notices to people smoking in breach of the rules and five summonses to site contractors involving four cases. Speaking at an event, Sun said some of the 7,300 inspections followed public complaints, but most were surprise checks by the department; of the 84 fixed penalty notices, 28 followed complaints, most of them supported by photos or even video. Sun added that the guidelines on the safe use of mobile elevating work platforms were updated early this year, and additions to the bamboo and metal scaffolding safety codes were gazetted at the end of July, giving contractors clear, practical guidance to follow.
summary.zh_hans: 劳工及福利局局长孙玉菡表示，政府今年7月17日正式实施地盘全面禁烟，截至10月底，劳工处共巡查了7300个地盘，共向违规吸烟人士发出84张「定额罚款通知书」，亦向地盘承建商发出5张吿票，牵涉4宗个案。孙玉菡出席一个活动致辞时表示，巡查的7300个地盘中有部分是建基于市民投诉，但大多数是劳工处的突击检查；而发出的84张「定额罚款通知书」中，有28张是建基于市民投诉，大多数都附有相片，甚至有录像。孙玉菡又说，年初优化了《安全使用移动式升降工作平台指引》，7月底亦在宪报刊登《竹棚架工作安全守则》及《金属棚架工作安全守则》增编，为承建商提供清晰、可遵循的实务指引。

title.zh_hant: DESIGN@HKG 2026今日開幕　逾40項設計活動遍全港
title.en: DESIGN@HKG 2026 launches today with over 40 design events across Hong Kong
title.zh_hans: DESIGN@HKG 2026今日开幕　逾40项设计活动遍全港

summary.zh_hant: 由文化體育及旅遊局轄下文創產業發展處贊助、香港設計中心主辦的DESIGN@HKG 2026今日正式啟動，活動至11月24日，聯同逾80個本地及國際夥伴在全港各區舉辦逾40項主題活動。文創產業專員在開幕禮上表示，DESIGN@HKG是今年新推出的品牌，作為年度設計旗艦活動「設計營商周」的城市項目，透過更多設計主題地區活動，促進跨界別、跨地域交流合作，進一步展現香港作為亞洲設計之都的創新實力。系列活動遍及山頂、中環、灣仔、尖沙咀、油麻地、西貢等地，包括互動裝置、電車導賞團、設計展覽、工作坊及分享會等。
summary.en: DESIGN@HKG 2026, sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency under the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and organised by the Hong Kong Design Centre, was officially launched today and runs until November 24, with more than 80 local and international partners presenting over 40 themed events across Hong Kong. The Commissioner for Cultural and Creative Industries said at the opening ceremony that DESIGN@HKG is a new brand launched this year as the city programme of the annual design flagship event Business of Design Week, using more design-themed district activities to promote cross-sectoral and cross-regional exchanges and further demonstrate Hong Kong's innovative strength as Asia's design capital. Events will take place around the territory, including the Peak, Central, Wan Chai, Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Ma Tei and Sai Kung, encompassing interactive installations, guided tram tours, design exhibitions, workshops and sharing sessions.
summary.zh_hans: 由文化体育及旅游局辖下文创产业发展处赞助、香港设计中心主办的DESIGN@HKG 2026今日正式启动，活动至11月24日，联同逾80个本地及国际伙伴在全港各区举办逾40项主题活动。文创产业专员在开幕礼上表示，DESIGN@HKG是今年新推出的品牌，作为年度设计旗舰活动「设计营商周」的城市项目，透过更多设计主题地区活动，促进跨界别、跨地域交流合作，进一步展现香港作为亚洲设计之都的创新实力。系列活动遍及山顶、中环、湾仔、尖沙咀、油麻地、西贡等地，包括互动装置、电车导赏团、设计展览、工作坊及分享会等。

image_caption: DESIGN@HKG 2026 今日舉行開幕禮。（政府新聞處）

title.zh_hant: UFC總裁懷特拒任白宮發言人　稱不想從政
title.en: UFC chief White turns down White House press secretary job, says he does not want to enter politics
title.zh_hans: UFC总裁怀特拒任白宫发言人　称不想从政

summary.zh_hant: 美國終極格鬥冠軍賽總裁懷特當地星期一到訪白宮，與總統特朗普共同出席新聞發布會，拒絕特朗普提出擔任白宮發言人的工作邀請。特朗普前一晚已表示，自己早前邀請懷特擔任白宮發言人只是開玩笑；兩人星期一共同出席發布會時，特朗普當眾問懷特是否想成為白宮發言人，還是只想繼續搞終極格鬥冠軍賽，懷特回應時說，感謝特朗普的提議，但自己不想從政。懷特是特朗普的老朋友，今年較早時協助在白宮草坪舉辦了一場終極格鬥冠軍賽。特朗普上月宣布任命保守派評論員扎卡里亞出任白宮發言人，接替離職的萊維特，但扎卡里亞上任不足一星期就離任，相關職位之後一直懸空。
summary.en: UFC president Dana White visited the White House on Monday local time and appeared at a press conference with President Donald Trump, turning down Trump's offer to serve as White House press secretary. Trump had said the previous evening that his earlier invitation to White was only a joke; at the press conference he asked White in front of reporters whether he wanted to be press secretary or would rather keep running the UFC, and White replied that he was grateful for the offer but did not want to enter politics. White is an old friend of Trump and helped organise a UFC event on the White House lawn earlier this year. Trump last month named conservative commentator Zacharia as press secretary to succeed the departed Leavitt, but Zacharia left the post within a week and it has remained vacant since.
summary.zh_hans: 美国终极格斗冠军赛总裁怀特当地星期一到访白宫，与总统特朗普共同出席新闻发布会，拒绝特朗普提出担任白宫发言人的工作邀请。特朗普前一晚已表示，自己早前邀请怀特担任白宫发言人只是开玩笑；两人星期一共同出席发布会时，特朗普当众问怀特是否想成为白宫发言人，还是只想继续搞终极格斗冠军赛，怀特回应时说，感谢特朗普的提议，但自己不想从政。怀特是特朗普的老朋友，今年较早时协助在白宫草坪举办了一场终极格斗冠军赛。特朗普上月宣布任命保守派评论员扎卡里亚出任白宫发言人，接替离职的莱维特，但扎卡里亚上任不足一星期就离任，相关职位之后一直悬空。

title.zh_hant: 特朗普引述黃仁勳稱不知婚外情對象是「間諜」
title.en: Trump says Huang denied knowing affair partner was a 'spy'
title.zh_hans: 特朗普引述黄仁勋称不知婚外情对象是「间谍」

summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普與英偉達行政總裁黃仁勳通話，特朗普引述對方指，根本不知道婚外情對象是「間諜」。特朗普又說，下星期與國家主席習近平在深圳碰面時，他不會提起這件事。美國國會眾議院的民主黨議員表明，會推動調查黃仁勳的婚外情有否損害美國國家安全。
summary.en: US President Donald Trump spoke by phone with Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang, saying Huang told him he had no idea his affair partner was a 'spy'. Trump added that he will not raise the matter when he meets Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen next week. Democrats in the US House of Representatives said they will push for an investigation into whether Huang's affair harmed US national security.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普与英伟达行政总裁黄仁勋通话，特朗普引述对方指，根本不知道婚外情对象是「间谍」。特朗普又说，下星期与国家主席习近平在深圳碰面时，他不会提起这件事。美国国会众议院的民主党议员表明，会推动调查黄仁勋的婚外情有否损害美国国家安全。

title.zh_hant: 李家超在邵逸夫獎頒獎禮致辭　祝賀七位得獎者
title.en: John Lee congratulates seven Shaw Prize laureates at award ceremony
title.zh_hans: 李家超在邵逸夫奖颁奖礼致辞　祝贺七位得奖者

summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今晚出席第23屆邵逸夫獎頒獎典禮並致辭，祝賀天文學、生命科學與醫學及數學科學三個範疇共七位得獎者，讚揚他們的開創性工作及重要發現推動文明演進，為下一代照亮前路。他表示香港同樣重視科學，今年9月公布的首份五年計劃以發展北部都會區為重點，推動教育、產業與科研融合發展，並將發展三個大學城，佔地逾1,000公頃，其中一個聚焦醫藥、生命及健康科技、人工智能、機械人、微電子及新興產業。
summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee attended the 23rd Shaw Prize Award Presentation Ceremony this evening and delivered a speech congratulating the seven laureates across three disciplines — astronomy, life science and medicine, and mathematical sciences — praising their pioneering work and consequential discoveries for advancing civilisation and lighting the way for the next generation. He said Hong Kong shares that commitment to science, and its inaugural Five-Year Plan, launched in September, places high priority on developing the Northern Metropolis to promote the integrated development of education, industry, and research and technology, including three university towns covering more than 1,000 hectares, one of which will focus on medicine, life and health technology, AI, robotics, microelectronics and emerging industries.
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今晚出席第23届邵逸夫奖颁奖典礼并致辞，祝贺天文学、生命科学与医学及数学科学三个范畴共七位得奖者，赞扬他们的开创性工作及重要发现推动文明演进，为下一代照亮前路。他表示香港同样重视科学，今年9月公布的首份五年计划以发展北部都会区为重点，推动教育、产业与科研融合发展，并将发展三个大学城，占地逾1,000公顷，其中一个聚焦医药、生命及健康科技、人工智能、机器人、微电子及新兴产业。
