title.zh_hant: 勞工處周四周五旺角招聘會　逾2700個職位空缺
title.en: Labour Department job fair in Mong Kok on Thursday and Friday offers more than 2,700 vacancies
title.zh_hans: 劳工处周四周五旺角招聘会　逾2700个职位空缺

summary.zh_hant: 勞工處將於11月12及13日在旺角麥花臣場館舉行「開拓新領域」招聘會，提供逾2,700個優質職位空缺。逾60間機構參與，為期兩日，當中逾1,800個空缺來自餐飲、零售、物流及運輸業；約30間機構每日設攤位即場招聘。職位種類廣泛，包括助理屋宇裝備工程師、分行經理、技術主任、登記護士、倉務主任、物流助理、醫務助理、助理康復服務工作員、助理物業服務主任、文員、客戶服務助理、速遞員、海關運作主任、空運服務協調員、營業員、品質控制員、交通督導員、客戶服務中心主任、保安員、廚師及司機等。約83%職位為全職，大部分月薪介乎12,000至25,000元；約94%要求中七學歷程度或以下；約52%歡迎無相關工作經驗者。求職者可在場內遞交申請或獲安排即場面試。招聘會時間為上午11時至下午5時30分，地點為旺角奶路臣街38號麥花臣場館1樓，免費入場，每日最後入場時間為下午5時。
summary.en: The Labour Department will hold the 'Opening Up a New Terrain' job fair at MacPherson Stadium in Mong Kok on November 12 and 13, offering more than 2,700 quality vacancies. Over 60 organisations will take part over the two days, with more than 1,800 of the vacancies from catering, retail, logistics and transport; about 30 organisations will recruit on site each day. The vacancies cover a wide range of roles, including assistant building services engineer, branch manager, technical officer, registered nurse, warehouse supervisor, logistics assistant, medical assistant, assistant rehabilitation services worker, assistant property services officer, clerk, customer service assistant, courier, customs operations officer, air cargo services coordinator, salesperson, quality control officer, traffic supervisor, customer service centre supervisor, security guard, cook and driver. About 83% of the posts are full-time, with most monthly salaries between HK$12,000 and HK$25,000; about 94% require Form 7 education or below, and about 52% welcome applicants without relevant experience. Job seekers can apply on site or be arranged for on-the-spot interviews. The fair runs from 11am to 5:30pm at 1/F, MacPherson Stadium, 38 Nelson Street, Mong Kok, with free admission and last entry at 5pm each day.
summary.zh_hans: 劳工处将于11月12及13日在旺角麦花臣场馆举行“开拓新领域”招聘会，提供逾2700个优质职位空缺。逾60间机构参与，为期两日，当中逾1800个空缺来自餐饮、零售、物流及运输业；约30间机构每日设摊位即场招聘。职位种类广泛，包括助理屋宇装备工程师、分行经理、技术主任、登记护士、仓务主任、物流助理、医务助理、助理康复服务工作员、助理物业服务主任、文员、客户服务助理、速递员、海关运作主任、空运服务协调员、营业员、品质控制员、交通督导员、客户服务中心主任、保安员、厨师及司机等。约83%职位为全职，大部分月薪介乎12000至25000元；约94%要求中七学历程度或以下；约52%欢迎无相关工作经验者。求职者可在场内递交申请或获安排即场面试。招聘会时间为上午11时至下午5时30分，地点为旺角奶路臣街38号麦花臣场馆1楼，免费入场，每日最后入场时间为下午5时。

title.zh_hant: 內地10月出口升35.2%　進口升41.6%創近五年半最快增速
title.en: China's October exports rise 35.2% as imports jump 41.6%, fastest in nearly five and a half years
title.zh_hans: 内地10月出口升35.2%　进口升41.6%创近五年半最快增速

summary.zh_hant: 海關總署公布，內地10月以美元計價出口按年增長35.2%，高過市場預期的33.5%；進口按年增長41.6%，創近五年半最快增速，亦高過預期的32%。出口和進口按月分別下跌7.8%和2.2%，上月貿易順差近1,053億美元，少過預期的1,258億美元。今年首10個月，內地出口按年升22.7%，進口按年升29%。東盟繼續是最大貿易夥伴，出口至東盟按年升30.5%，由東盟進口增長28.1%；出口至美國升12.1%，進口升7.8%；出口至香港升50.3%，進口急升約1.06倍。以人民幣計價，內地上月出口按年升28.7%，進口按年升34.7%，貿易順差近7,128億元人民幣。
summary.en: China's customs authority reported that October exports in US dollar terms rose 35.2% year on year, above the market forecast of 33.5%, while imports jumped 41.6%, the fastest growth in nearly five and a half years and also above the expected 32%. Exports and imports fell 7.8% and 2.2% month on month, and last month's trade surplus was nearly US$105.3 billion, below the expected US$125.8 billion. In the first 10 months of the year, exports rose 22.7% year on year and imports 29%. ASEAN remained the largest trading partner, with exports to ASEAN up 30.5% and imports from ASEAN up 28.1%; exports to the United States rose 12.1% and imports 7.8%, while exports to Hong Kong rose 50.3% and imports surged about 106%. In yuan terms, October exports rose 28.7% and imports 34.7% year on year, with a trade surplus of nearly 712.8 billion yuan.
summary.zh_hans: 海关总署公布，内地10月以美元计价出口按年增长35.2%，高过市场预期的33.5%；进口按年增长41.6%，创近五年半最快增速，亦高过预期的32%。出口和进口按月分别下跌7.8%和2.2%，上月贸易顺差近1053亿美元，少过预期的1258亿美元。今年首10个月，内地出口按年升22.7%，进口按年升29%。东盟继续是最大贸易伙伴，出口至东盟按年升30.5%，由东盟进口增长28.1%；出口至美国升12.1%，进口升7.8%；出口至香港升50.3%，进口急升约1.06倍。以人民币计价，内地上月出口按年升28.7%，进口按年升34.7%，贸易顺差近7128亿元人民币。

title.zh_hant: 工程師何永業指數碼工作日誌擴展至新裝升降機工程助把關
title.en: Engineer Ho Wing-yip says extending digital logbooks to new lift works will help oversight
title.zh_hans: 工程师何永业指数码工作日志扩展至新装升降机工程助把关

summary.zh_hant: 臺日電梯漏裝720部升降機的耐火門框組件，機電署預計兩至三個月內完成執修。資深電機及屋宇裝備工程師何永業表示，目前難以確定漏裝門框組件在業內是否普遍現象，要待全港所有升降機公司在本月中向機電署提交報告後，才能知道是否個別事件。他認同機電署有監管把關責任，對於署方提出將維修適用的數碼工作日誌擴展至新裝及更換工程，需要提交安裝門框組件的相片及影片，他認同有助當局把關，成本低、節省時間，而且數碼影像附有拍攝日期等資訊，難以造假，又建議有關做法或可擴展至其他行業的工程。他期望涉事升降機在年底或明年初能夠完成執修工作。
summary.en: Tai Yat Elevator failed to install fire-resistant door-frame components in 720 lifts, and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department expects rectification to take two to three months. Veteran electrical and building services engineer Ho Wing-yip said it is not yet possible to tell whether the omissions are common across the industry; that will only be known once all lift companies in Hong Kong submit their reports to the department in mid-November. He agreed the department has a duty to regulate and monitor, and backed its proposal to extend the digital logbook used for maintenance to new installation and replacement works, requiring photos and videos of door-frame installation, saying it would help oversight at low cost and with time savings, and that the dated digital images would be hard to falsify; he suggested the approach could be extended to other trades. He hopes the affected lifts can be rectified by the end of the year or early next year.
summary.zh_hans: 台日电梯漏装720部升降机的耐火门框组件，机电署预计两至三个月内完成执修。资深电机及屋宇装备工程师何永业表示，目前难以确定漏装门框组件在业内是否普遍现象，要待全港所有升降机公司在本月中向机电署提交报告后，才能知道是否个别事件。他认同机电署有监管把关责任，对于署方提出将维修适用的数码工作日志扩展至新装及更换工程，需要提交安装门框组件的相片及影片，他认同有助当局把关，成本低、节省时间，而且数码影像附有拍摄日期等资讯，难以造假，又建议有关做法或可扩展至其他行业的工程。他期望涉事升降机在年底或明年初能够完成执修工作。

title.zh_hant: 芯德半導體將把握全球產業機遇　登臨科技將持續加大研發投入
title.en: Xinde Semiconductor to seize global industry opportunities; Denglin Technology to keep raising R&D investment
title.zh_hans: 芯德半导体将把握全球产业机遇　登临科技将持续加大研发投入

summary.zh_hant: 內地半導體封測服務供應商芯德半導體，以及通用圖形處理器提供商登臨科技首日掛牌。芯德半導體董事長張國棟在上市儀式致辭說，登陸港股是全新起點，公司將把握全球產業機遇，持續深耕先進封測核心技術，以穩健經營回報股東和客戶；公司成立以來始終錨定先進封測主賽道，實現多品類封裝產品穩定量產，躋身國內先進封測第一梯隊。登臨科技首席執行官兼董事會主席王晨輝則說，未來公司將持續加大研發投入，推進新一代高性能產品的商業化落地；公司自主研發的圖形處理器架構及軟件棧兼容主流人工智能軟件生態，按2025年收入計，已成為內地企業人工智能通用圖形處理器市場第三大公司，前兩名都是國際品牌。
summary.en: Mainland semiconductor packaging and testing service provider Xinde Semiconductor and general-purpose GPU provider Denglin Technology made their Hong Kong debuts. Xinde chairman Zhang Guodong said at the listing ceremony that listing in Hong Kong is a fresh starting point and the company will seize global industry opportunities, keep deepening its advanced packaging and testing technology and reward shareholders and customers through steady operations, noting it has become a first-tier domestic player in advanced packaging with stable mass production across multiple product categories. Denglin chief executive and chairman Wang Chenhui said the company will keep increasing R&D investment and push the commercialisation of its next-generation high-performance products; its self-developed GPU architecture and software stack are compatible with mainstream AI software ecosystems, and by 2025 revenue it had become the third-largest company in mainland China's enterprise AI GPGPU market, with the top two both international brands.
summary.zh_hans: 内地半导体封测服务供应商芯德半导体，以及通用图形处理器提供商登临科技首日挂牌。芯德半导体董事长张国栋在上市仪式致辞说，登陆港股是全新起点，公司将把握全球产业机遇，持续深耕先进封测核心技术，以稳健经营回报股东和客户；公司成立以来始终锚定先进封测主赛道，实现多品类封装产品稳定量产，跻身国内先进封测第一梯队。登临科技首席执行官兼董事会主席王晨辉则说，未来公司将持续加大研发投入，推进新一代高性能产品的商业化落地；公司自主研发的图形处理器架构及软件栈兼容主流人工智能软件生态，按2025年收入计，已成为内地企业人工智能通用图形处理器市场第三大公司，前两名都是国际品牌。

title.zh_hant: 中方呼籲推動烏克蘭危機早日實現政治解決　達成有約束力和平協議
title.en: China urges early political settlement of Ukraine crisis and a binding peace agreement
title.zh_hans: 中方呼吁推动乌克兰危机早日实现政治解决　达成有约束力和平协议

summary.zh_hant: 中國常駐聯合國副代表孫磊表示，烏克蘭問題正迎來談判解決的關鍵時刻，中方支持通向和平的努力，希望有關各方相向而行，維持積極勢頭，推動危機早日實現政治解決。孫磊在安理會烏克蘭問題公開會上發言，說近期當事方就如何政治解決危機發表看法，國際社會做了許多旨在推動勸和促談的外交努力，俄羅斯、烏克蘭、美國還將舉行新一輪三方會談。有關各方應展現政治意願，保持接觸溝通，逐步積累共識，共同致力於達成一份全面、持久、有約束力的和平協議。
summary.en: China's deputy permanent representative to the United Nations, Sun Lei, said the Ukraine issue is at a critical moment for a negotiated settlement and that China supports efforts towards peace, hoping all parties will work in the same direction, sustain the positive momentum and push for an early political resolution. Speaking at a Security Council open meeting on Ukraine, Sun said the parties concerned had recently shared views on a political settlement, the international community had made extensive diplomatic efforts to encourage talks, and Russia, Ukraine and the United States would hold a new round of trilateral talks. He said all parties should show political will, maintain contact and communication, gradually build consensus and work together towards a comprehensive, lasting and binding peace agreement.
summary.zh_hans: 中国常驻联合国副代表孙磊表示，乌克兰问题正迎来谈判解决的关键时刻，中方支持通向和平的努力，希望有关各方相向而行，维持积极势头，推动危机早日实现政治解决。孙磊在安理会乌克兰问题公开会上发言，说近期当事方就如何政治解决危机发表看法，国际社会做了许多旨在推动劝和促谈的外交努力，俄罗斯、乌克兰、美国还将举行新一轮三方会谈。有关各方应展现政治意愿，保持接触沟通，逐步积累共识，共同致力于达成一份全面、持久、有约束力的和平协议。

title.zh_hant: 郭芙蓉指升降機漏裝門框組件匪夷所思　姚潔凝倡引入第三方檢驗
title.en: Kwok Fu-yung calls missing lift door-frame components baffling; Yiu Kit-ying proposes third-party inspections
title.zh_hans: 郭芙蓉指升降机漏装门框组件匪夷所思　姚洁凝倡引入第三方检验

summary.zh_hant: 臺日電梯漏裝720部升降機的耐火門框組件，機電署預計兩至三個月內完成執修。機電署升降機及自動梯安全諮詢委員會成員姚潔凝形容，共720部升降機漏裝門框組件的數字驚人，因應當局調查正進行，她不猜測背後動機，但引述坊間所指臺日或許希望「慳得就慳」。對於審批新建升降機或完成主要更改工程後發出「准用證」或「復用證」時的「三重檢驗機制」，她認同可作優化，希望機電署引入獨立第三方檢驗，進一步保障市民安全，但指出檢驗成本及時間都會增加，小業主或有擔憂。民建聯立法會議員郭芙蓉在同一節目表示，臺日電梯需為事件負上最大責任，現行監管制度在執行層面有偏差，相關政府部門需作反思，包括加強日常抽檢比例與深度、強化註冊工程師的獨立性和問責性，以及加強罰則和除牌機制。
summary.en: Tai Yat Elevator failed to install fire-resistant door-frame components in 720 lifts, and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department expects the rectification to take two to three months. Yiu Kit-ying, a member of the department's Lift and Escalator Safety Advisory Committee, described the figure of 720 lifts as astonishing and declined to speculate on motives while the investigation is under way, though she cited public speculation that the company may have wanted to cut corners. On the three-tier inspection system used before issuing use permits or resumption permits for new or substantially altered lifts, she said the system had worked in the past but could be improved, and she hopes the department will introduce independent third-party inspections, while noting that this would raise costs and time and that small property owners may worry. DAB legislator Kwok Fu-yung said on the same programme that Tai Yat must bear the greatest responsibility, adding that the incident showed the regulatory system had failed in execution and that the departments concerned must reflect, including by increasing the proportion and depth of routine spot checks, strengthening the independence and accountability of registered engineers, and toughening penalties and licence revocations.
summary.zh_hans: 台日电梯漏装720部升降机的耐火门框组件，机电署预计两至三个月内完成执修。机电署升降机及自动梯安全咨询委员会成员姚洁凝形容，共720部升降机漏装门框组件的数字惊人，因应当局调查正进行，她不猜测背后动机，但引述坊间所指台日或许希望“悭得就悭”。对于审批新建升降机或完成主要更改工程后发出“准用证”或“复用证”时的“三重检验机制”，她认同可作优化，希望机电署引入独立第三方检验，进一步保障市民安全，但指出检验成本及时间都会增加，小业主或有担忧。民建联立法会议员郭芙蓉在同一节目表示，台日电梯需为事件负上最大责任，现行监管制度在执行层面有偏差，相关政府部门需作反思，包括加强日常抽检比例与深度、强化注册工程师的独立性和问责性，以及加强罚则和除牌机制。

title.zh_hant: 維港渡海泳周日舉行　灣仔北及尖沙咀周末實施特別交通安排
title.en: Victoria Harbour Race on Sunday as special traffic arrangements take effect in Wan Chai North and Tsim Sha Tsui
title.zh_hans: 维港渡海泳周日举行　湾仔北及尖沙咀周末实施特别交通安排

summary.zh_hant: 運輸署提醒市民，為配合星期日舉行的維港渡海泳2026，11月14至15日在灣仔北及尖沙咀實施特別交通及運輸安排。博覽道東金紫荊廣場外一段，將於11月15日凌晨零時三十分至約下午1時臨時封閉；會展及九龍公眾碼頭1至4號登岸梯級，將於11月14日上午9時至11月15日約下午1時分階段封閉。水上的士「尖沙咀東—中環」航線11月14日全日停航，11月15日上午三班由尖沙咀東開出的班次取消；灣仔往來尖沙咀渡輪11月15日由頭班船至上午11時停航，中環往來紅磡渡輪至上午11時10分停航。過海巴士961號在博覽道東的總站遷往灣仔游泳池外港灣道，城巴H3號在博覽道東近金紫荊廣場的巴士站亦暫停。
summary.en: The Transport Department reminds the public that special traffic and transport arrangements will be in place in Wan Chai North and Tsim Sha Tsui on 14-15 November for the Victoria Harbour Race 2026 on Sunday. The section of Expo Drive East outside Golden Bauhinia Square will be temporarily closed from 00:30 to about 13:00 on 15 November, and the landing steps at the Convention Centre and Kowloon Public Piers No. 1 to 4 will be closed in stages from 09:00 on 14 November to about 13:00 on 15 November. The water taxi service between Tsim Sha Tsui East and Central will be suspended all day on 14 November, with three departures from Tsim Sha Tsui East cancelled on the morning of 15 November; the Wan Chai-Tsim Sha Tsui ferry will be suspended from the first sailing until 11:00 on 15 November, and the Central-Hung Hom ferry until 11:10. Cross-harbour bus route 961 will move its Expo Drive East terminus to Harbour Road outside Wan Chai Swimming Pool, and Citybus route H3 will suspend its stop on Expo Drive East near Golden Bauhinia Square.
summary.zh_hans: 运输署提醒市民，为配合星期日举行的维港渡海泳2026，11月14至15日在湾仔北及尖沙咀实施特别交通及运输安排。博览道东金紫荆广场外一段，将于11月15日凌晨零时三十分至约下午1时临时封闭；会展及九龙公众码头1至4号登岸梯级，将于11月14日上午9时至11月15日约下午1时分阶段封闭。水上的士“尖沙咀东—中环”航线11月14日全日停航，11月15日上午三班由尖沙咀东开出的班次取消；湾仔往来尖沙咀渡轮11月15日由头班船至上午11时停航，中环往来红磡渡轮至上午11时10分停航。过海巴士961号在博览道东的总站迁往湾仔游泳池外港湾道，城巴H3号在博览道东近金紫荆广场的巴士站亦暂停。

title.zh_hant: 深證成指初段升逾1%　創業板指數升逾2%
title.en: Shenzhen Component up more than 1% in early trading as ChiNext rises over 2%
title.zh_hans: 深证成指初段升逾1%　创业板指数升逾2%

title.zh_hant: 人行公開市場開展1900億元人民幣隔夜逆回購
title.en: PBOC conducts 190 billion yuan of overnight reverse repos in open market operations
title.zh_hans: 人行公开市场开展1900亿元人民币隔夜逆回购

summary.zh_hant: 人民銀行在公開市場開展1,900億元人民幣隔夜逆回購操作，利率維持於1.25厘。對沖到期量後，單日淨投放80億元，結束之前6日淨回籠。
summary.en: The People's Bank of China conducted 190 billion yuan of overnight reverse repurchase operations in the open market, with the rate unchanged at 1.25%. After offsetting maturities, the operation injected a net 80 billion yuan in a single day, ending six consecutive days of net withdrawals.
summary.zh_hans: 人民银行在公开市场开展1900亿元人民币隔夜逆回购操作，利率维持于1.25厘。对冲到期量后，单日净投放80亿元，结束之前6日净回笼。

title.zh_hant: 恒指競價時段升172點　2隻新股開市個別發展
title.en: Hang Seng up 172 points in pre-opening session as two new listings move in opposite directions
title.zh_hans: 恒指竞价时段升172点　2只新股开市个别发展

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks rose in the pre-opening session, with the Hang Seng Index at 24,621, up 172 points or 0.7%, and the Tech Index at 4,072, up 31 points or 0.78%. Two new stocks debuted: Xinde Semiconductor opened at HK$10.70, more than 20% above its offer price, while Denglin Technology opened at HK$229, nearly 1% below its offer price.

title.zh_hant: 日央行：部分決策者呼籲加快加息步伐
title.en: Bank of Japan: some policymakers call for faster pace of rate hikes
title.zh_hans: 日央行：部分决策者呼吁加快加息步伐

summary.zh_hant: 日本央行公布10月會議意見摘要，顯示隨著核心通脹率達到2%的目標，部分決策者呼籲加快加息步伐。有委員表示，之前加息的效果尚未顯現，金融環境仍然寬鬆，央行有必要加快將利率調整至中性水平；另一名委員亦表示，基礎通脹率已達2%，需盡快使政策利率達到中性水平。亦有委員提到，需要警惕未來加息拖累經濟、拉低通脹的風險。日本央行在10月29日及30日的會議上，維持指標利率在1.25厘。
summary.en: The Bank of Japan's summary of opinions from its October meeting shows that, with core inflation reaching the 2% target, some policymakers called for a faster pace of rate hikes. One member said the effects of earlier hikes had yet to show and financial conditions remained loose, so the bank needed to move its policy rate to neutral more quickly; another said underlying inflation had reached 2% and the policy rate should reach neutral as soon as possible. Other members warned of the risk that further hikes could weigh on the economy and pull inflation down. The Bank of Japan kept its benchmark rate at 1.25% at its 29-30 October meeting.
summary.zh_hans: 日本央行公布10月会议意见摘要，显示随着核心通胀率达到2%的目标，部分决策者呼吁加快加息步伐。有委员表示，之前加息的效果尚未显现，金融环境仍然宽松，央行有必要加快将利率调整至中性水平；另一名委员亦表示，基础通胀率已达2%，需尽快使政策利率达到中性水平。亦有委员提到，需要警惕未来加息拖累经济、拉低通胀的风险。日本央行在10月29日及30日的会议上，维持指标利率在1.25厘。

title.zh_hant: 深圳現代物流業發展蓬勃　鹽田港拓展國際經貿航線
title.en: Shenzhen's modern logistics sector thrives as Yantian Port expands international trade routes
title.zh_hans: 深圳现代物流业发展蓬勃　盐田港拓展国际经贸航线

summary.zh_hant: 亞太經合組織峰會將於深圳舉行，深圳現代物流業發展蓬勃，是全市四大支柱產業之一，佔經濟總量大約一成。根據市政府數據，深圳去年港口集裝箱吞吐量突破3,500萬個標準箱，增長超過5%，創開港以來新高，深圳港現時是全球第四大集裝箱樞紐港。位於深圳東南面的鹽田港每星期營運近100條國際航線，其中53條聯通亞太經合組織成員經濟體，今年新增14條相關航線；港口亦正推進智慧碼頭建設，並透過海鐵聯運及每日6班駁船，加強與香港葵青貨櫃碼頭的合作。
summary.en: With the APEC summit set to be held in Shenzhen, the city's modern logistics sector is thriving as one of its four pillar industries, accounting for about 10% of the local economy. City government data shows Shenzhen's container throughput exceeded 35 million TEUs last year, up more than 5% to a record high, making it the world's fourth-largest container hub port. Yantian Port in south-eastern Shenzhen now runs nearly 100 international shipping routes a week, 53 of them linking APEC member economies, with 14 new APEC routes added this year; the port is also building a smart terminal and strengthening cooperation with Hong Kong's Kwai Tsing container terminals through sea-rail intermodal transport and six daily barge services.
summary.zh_hans: 亚太经合组织峰会将于深圳举行，深圳现代物流业发展蓬勃，是全市四大支柱产业之一，占经济总量大约一成。根据市政府数据，深圳去年港口集装箱吞吐量突破3500万个标准箱，增长超过5%，创开港以来新高，深圳港现时是全球第四大集装箱枢纽港。位于深圳东南面的盐田港每星期营运近100条国际航线，其中53条联通亚太经合组织成员经济体，今年新增14条相关航线；港口亦正推进智慧码头建设，并透过海铁联运及每日6班驳船，加强与香港葵青货柜码头的合作。

title.zh_hant: 人民幣兌美元中間價上升

summary.zh_hans: 人民币兑美元中间价报6.7167，较上日中间价高21点子，较市场预测偏弱约510点子。

title.zh_hans: 台股初段升近3%

summary.en: Taiwan stocks rose nearly 3% in early trading, with the weighted index at 42,797 earlier, up 1,135 points or 2.73%.
summary.zh_hans: 台湾股市在开市初段升近3%，加权指数较早时报42797点，升1135点，升幅2.73%。

title.zh_hant: 埃森科特獲授權組閣　以色列政局仍存變數
title.en: Eisenkot authorised to form government as Israeli politics remain unsettled
title.zh_hans: 埃森科特获授权组阁　以色列政局仍存变数

summary.zh_hant: 以色列較早前結束大選，由於未有政黨取得絕對多數，需要籌組聯合政府。領導反對派陣營的以色列國防軍前總參謀長埃森科特，現階段以取得較多推薦人的優勢，獲總統正式授權組建新政府，但據報談判前景依然存在變數。分析認為，若果反對派成功組閣，將意味著長期執政、現時擔任看守總理的內塔尼亞胡需要下台；但即使總理換人，亦不代表以色列對外政策未來將出現重大轉變。另外亦要視乎美國中期選舉過後，特朗普政府會否調整以色列政策。
summary.en: Israel recently held a general election in which no party won an outright majority, leaving a coalition government to be formed. Gadi Eisenkot, the former Israel Defense Forces chief of staff who leads the opposition bloc, has been formally authorised by the president to form a new government, having secured more endorsements at this stage, though reports say the negotiations still face uncertainty. Analysts say that if the opposition succeeds in forming a government, long-serving caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu would have to step down, but a change of premier would not necessarily mean a major shift in Israel's foreign policy. Much will also depend on whether the Trump administration adjusts its Israel policy after the US midterm elections.
summary.zh_hans: 以色列较早前结束大选，由于未有政党取得绝对多数，需要筹组联合政府。领导反对派阵营的以色列国防军前总参谋长埃森科特，现阶段以取得较多推荐人的优势，获总统正式授权组建新政府，但据报谈判前景依然存在变数。分析认为，若果反对派成功组阁，将意味着长期执政、现时担任看守总理的内塔尼亚胡需要下台；但即使总理换人，亦不代表以色列对外政策未来将出现重大转变。另外亦要视乎美国中期选举过后，特朗普政府会否调整以色列政策。

title.zh_hant: 特朗普稱現階段沒必要再對伊朗採取軍事行動
title.en: Trump says no further military action against Iran needed for now
title.zh_hans: 特朗普称现阶段没必要再对伊朗采取军事行动

summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普表示，美國重啟對伊朗軍事行動的可能性相當小，局勢正朝著結束衝突的積極方向發展。他星期一在白宮表示，現階段似乎無必要對伊朗採取軍事行動，伊朗戰事已經事實上結束，目前情況基本維持現狀，但美方嚴陣以待。特朗普同日與到訪的卡塔爾首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德會談，雙方深入討論伊朗議題；卡塔爾、沙特阿拉伯、阿聯酋、巴林、科威特等國都傾向維持現狀，繼續實施海上封鎖。
summary.en: US President Donald Trump said the likelihood of the United States resuming military action against Iran is quite small and the situation is moving in a positive direction towards ending the conflict. Speaking at the White House on Monday, Trump said there seemed no need for further military action against Iran for now and the war was effectively over, with the status quo largely maintained but the US ready to act if circumstances change. Trump also met visiting Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Mohammed the same day for in-depth talks on Iran; Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait and others favour maintaining the status quo, including continuing the maritime blockade.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普表示，美国重启对伊朗军事行动的可能性相当小，局势正朝着结束冲突的积极方向发展。他星期一在白宫表示，现阶段似乎无必要对伊朗采取军事行动，伊朗战事已经事实上结束，目前情况基本维持现状，但美方严阵以待。特朗普同日与到访的卡塔尔首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德会谈，双方深入讨论伊朗议题；卡塔尔、沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、巴林、科威特等国都倾向维持现状，继续实施海上封锁。

title.zh_hant: 立法會明年起議員議案須附調研依據　李慧琼：深化行政立法良性互動
title.en: LegCo motions to carry research basis from next year as Lee Wai-king pledges deeper executive-legislature cooperation
title.zh_hans: 立法会明年起议员议案须附调研依据　李慧琼：深化行政立法良性互动

summary.zh_hant: 立法會昨日舉行交流午宴，行政長官李家超、各司局長、行政會議成員、立法會議員等出席。立法會主席李慧琼致辭時表示，行政長官一直以實際行動、創新方式深化行政立法良性互動，立法會將進一步加強調研履職。她預告明年起議員提出無立法效力議案時，將附上調研依據及倡議，方便政府和公眾掌握提案原意及理據，讓公共政策討論更科學化。李慧琼指出，今屆立法會及委員會至今已就多個政策議題進行21次本地調研考察，未來將定期揀選重要政策議題調研，形成扎實建議供政府、委員會和社會參考。就行政長官提出的兩方面重點工作期望，李慧琼表示立法會一直牢記於心、積極落實：今年7月立法會高效審議並通過新皇崗口岸條例草案；近月法案委員會多次加班完成審議北都發展條例草案，今個星期三將在大會恢復二讀辯論。她指出，立法會今年至今撥出逾1,300億元，當中接近三成、約370億元用於北部都會區相關項目；亦通過延續2萬元新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃撥款。政府因應宏福苑火災報告提出系統性改革，立法會上星期通過「打擊圍標、推動圍標行為刑事化」議員議案，不同事務委員會亦已開會討論改革方案。
summary.en: The Legislative Council held an exchange luncheon yesterday, attended by Chief Executive John Lee, principal officials, Executive Council members and legislators. LegCo President Starry Lee Wai-king said in her address that the Chief Executive has deepened positive executive-legislature interaction through practical action and innovation, and that LegCo will further strengthen research-based performance of its duties. She announced that, from next year, members tabling motions without legislative effect will attach their research basis and proposals, so the government and the public can better grasp the original intent and rationale of the proposals and public policy discussion can become more scientific. Lee said LegCo and its committees have so far conducted 21 local research visits on various policy issues in the current term and will regularly select important policy topics for research. On the Chief Executive's two priority expectations, she said LegCo has kept them in mind and acted on them: in July, LegCo efficiently scrutinised and passed the new Huanggang Port regulation bill, and the bills committee on the Northern Metropolis development bill has worked overtime in recent months, with second reading debate resuming in the Council this Wednesday. She said LegCo has approved more than HK$130 billion so far this year, nearly 30% of it, about HK$37 billion, for Northern Metropolis projects, and has also approved funding to extend the HK$20,000 newborn baby bonus. Following the Wang Fuk Court fire report, the government has proposed systemic reforms, and LegCo passed a members' motion last week on criminalising bid-rigging in building maintenance, with various panels already discussing the reform proposals.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会昨日举行交流午宴，行政长官李家超、各司局长、行政会议成员、立法会议员等出席。立法会主席李慧琼致辞时表示，行政长官一直以实际行动、创新方式深化行政立法良性互动，立法会将进一步加强调研履职。她预告明年起议员提出无立法效力议案时，将附上调研依据及倡议，方便政府和公众掌握提案原意及理据，让公共政策讨论更科学化。李慧琼指出，今届立法会及委员会至今已就多个政策议题进行21次本地调研考察，未来将定期拣选重要政策议题调研，形成扎实建议供政府、委员会和社会参考。就行政长官提出的两方面重点工作期望，李慧琼表示立法会一直牢记于心、积极落实：今年7月立法会高效审议并通过新皇岗口岸条例草案；近月法案委员会多次加班完成审议北都发展条例草案，今个星期三将在大会恢复二读辩论。她指出，立法会今年至今拨出逾1300亿元，当中接近三成、约370亿元用于北部都会区相关项目；亦通过延续2万元新生婴儿奖励金计划拨款。政府因应宏福苑火灾报告提出系统性改革，立法会上星期通过“打击围标、推动围标行为刑事化”议员议案，不同事务委员会亦已开会讨论改革方案。

title.zh_hant: 日股初段升逾2%
title.en: Japanese stocks rise more than 2% in early trading
title.zh_hans: 日股初段升逾2%

summary.zh_hant: 日本股市在開市初段升逾2%，日經平均指數重上6萬點水平，較早時報60,159點，升1,383點，升幅2.35%。
summary.en: Japanese stocks rose more than 2% in early trading, with the Nikkei average climbing back above the 60,000 level to 60,159 earlier, up 1,383 points or 2.35%.
summary.zh_hans: 日本股市在开市初段升逾2%，日经平均指数重上6万点水平，较早时报60159点，升1383点，升幅2.35%。

title.zh_hant: 韓股初段升逾5%
title.en: South Korean stocks rise more than 5% in early trading
title.zh_hans: 韩股初段升逾5%

summary.zh_hant: 韓國股市在開市初段升逾半成，首爾綜合指數較早時報5,273點，升254點，升幅5.07%。
summary.en: South Korean stocks rose more than 5% in early trading, with the KOSPI index at 5,273 earlier, up 254 points or 5.07%.
summary.zh_hans: 韩国股市在开市初段升逾半成，首尔综合指数较早时报5273点，升254点，升幅5.07%。

title.zh_hant: 烏克蘭談判代表團抵達阿布扎比參加俄美烏三方會談
title.en: Ukrainian delegation arrives in Abu Dhabi for Russia-US-Ukraine trilateral talks
title.zh_hans: 乌克兰谈判代表团抵达阿布扎比参加俄美乌三方会谈

summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基表示，烏方談判代表團已經抵達阿聯酋首都阿布扎比，參加即將舉行的俄美烏三方會談。代表團將與歐洲伙伴單獨會晤，目標是促成真正的和平。烏方代表表示將重點討論人道主義議題，並希望雙方就下一階段交換戰俘達成共識。烏克蘭常駐聯合國代表梅利尼克說，重大決定仍需由烏俄領導人面對面會晤才能作出，澤連斯基願意在莫斯科以外的任何地方與普京會面。
summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian negotiating delegation has arrived in Abu Dhabi to take part in the upcoming Russia-US-Ukraine trilateral talks. The delegation will hold separate meetings with European partners, with the sole goal of achieving a genuine peace. Ukrainian representatives said humanitarian issues will be the focus and they hope both sides can agree on the next prisoner exchange. Ukraine's ambassador to the United Nations, Andrii Melnyk, said major decisions still require a face-to-face meeting between the Ukrainian and Russian leaders, adding that Zelenskyy is willing to meet Vladimir Putin anywhere except Moscow.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，乌方谈判代表团已经抵达阿联酋首都阿布扎比，参加即将举行的俄美乌三方会谈。代表团将与欧洲伙伴单独会晤，目标是促成真正的和平。乌方代表表示将重点讨论人道主义议题，并希望双方就下一阶段交换战俘达成共识。乌克兰常驻联合国代表梅利尼克说，重大决定仍需由乌俄领导人面对面会晤才能作出，泽连斯基愿意在莫斯科以外的任何地方与普京会面。

title.zh_hant: 紐約聯儲調查：10月美國消費者對就業前景憂慮加劇
title.en: New York Fed survey: US consumers' job worries grew in October
title.zh_hans: 纽约联储调查：10月美国消费者对就业前景忧虑加剧

summary.zh_hant: 紐約聯邦儲備銀行公布10月消費者預期調查，預計一年後失業率上升的受訪者比例升至2020年4月以來最高，當時正值新冠疫情初期。受訪者認為10月非自願失業的可能性有所上升，但仍處於相對較低水平，同時認為失業後找到新工作的可能性亦有所增加。通脹預期方面，受訪者預計一年後通脹率3.9%，三年後3.3%，五年後3%，與9月調查結果一致。
summary.en: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York's October consumer expectations survey found the share of respondents expecting unemployment to rise over the next year at its highest since April 2020, at the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. Respondents saw a higher chance of involuntary job loss in October, though it remained relatively low, and also saw better odds of finding a new job if laid off. Inflation expectations were unchanged from September: 3.9% in one year, 3.3% in three years and 3% in five years.
summary.zh_hans: 纽约联邦储备银行公布10月消费者预期调查，预计一年后失业率上升的受访者比例升至2020年4月以来最高，当时正值新冠疫情初期。受访者认为10月非自愿失业的可能性有所上升，但仍处于相对较低水平，同时认为失业后找到新工作的可能性亦有所增加。通胀预期方面，受访者预计一年后通胀率3.9%，三年后3.3%，五年后3%，与9月调查结果一致。

title.zh_hant: 美聯邦眾議員馬西提交決議案推動彈劾國防部長赫格塞思
title.en: US Representative Massie files resolution to push impeachment of Defence Secretary Hegseth
title.zh_hans: 美联邦众议员马西提交决议案推动弹劾国防部长赫格塞思

summary.zh_hant: 美國肯塔基州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員馬西向眾議院提交決議案，尋求推動全院就彈劾國防部長赫格塞思進行表決。議案涉及8項彈劾條款，包括未經國會批准就對伊朗發動戰事，以及其他濫權行為。眾議院民主黨領袖傑弗里斯表示強烈支持彈劾，認為赫格塞思必須離任；總統特朗普則表示對赫格塞思有信心，認為彈劾呼籲並不公平。
summary.en: Republican US Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky has filed a resolution in the House of Representatives seeking a full vote on impeaching Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth. The resolution contains eight articles of impeachment, including waging war against Iran without congressional approval and other abuses of power. House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said he strongly supports impeaching Hegseth and that he must leave office, while President Donald Trump said he has confidence in Hegseth and called the impeachment calls unfair.
summary.zh_hans: 美国肯塔基州共和党籍联邦众议员马西向众议院提交决议案，寻求推动全院就弹劾国防部长赫格塞思进行表决。议案涉及8项弹劾条款，包括未经国会批准就对伊朗发动战事，以及其他滥权行为。众议院民主党领袖杰弗里斯表示强烈支持弹劾，认为赫格塞思必须离任；总统特朗普则表示对赫格塞思有信心，认为弹劾呼吁并不公平。

title.zh_hant: 港股ADR與本港收市比較個別發展
title.en: Hong Kong stock ADRs mixed against local close
title.zh_hans: 港股ADR与本港收市比较个别发展

summary.zh_hant: 港股美國預託證券（ADR）與本港收市比較個別發展。金融股方面，滙控ADR較本港收市升逾3%，友邦升近1%；科技股方面，ATMXJ的ADR都較本港收市下跌，其中京東同阿里巴巴跌近1%或以上。
summary.en: Hong Kong stocks' American depositary receipts (ADRs) were mixed against their Hong Kong closes. Among financials, HSBC's ADR rose more than 3% against its local close and AIA gained nearly 1%; among technology stocks, the ADRs of ATMXJ all fell, with JD.com and Alibaba down nearly 1% or more.
summary.zh_hans: 港股美国预托证券（ADR）与本港收市比较个别发展。金融股方面，汇控ADR较本港收市升逾3%，友邦升近1%；科技股方面，ATMXJ的ADR都较本港收市下跌，其中京东和阿里巴巴跌近1%或以上。

title.zh_hant: 美元下跌　市場風險偏好升溫
title.en: Dollar falls as risk appetite picks up
title.zh_hans: 美元下跌　市场风险偏好升温

summary.zh_hant: 美元兌主要貨幣下跌，油價向下，中東局勢憂慮紓緩，市場風險偏好升溫。美元指數在紐約尾市跌逾0.5%，報101.65；歐元兌美元升0.7%，較早時報1.1223美元；英鎊兌美元升近0.7%，報1.3439美元；美元兌日圓跌逾0.3%，報157.9日圓。市場亦關注周二公布的美國消費者物價指數，以及本周多名聯儲局官員講話。
summary.en: The US dollar fell against major currencies as oil prices declined, concerns over the Middle East eased and market risk appetite warmed up. The dollar index fell more than 0.5% in late New York trading to 101.65; the euro rose 0.7% against the dollar to 1.1223 earlier, sterling gained nearly 0.7% to 1.3439, and the dollar slipped more than 0.3% against the yen to 157.9. Markets are also watching US consumer price index data due on Tuesday and speeches by several Federal Reserve officials this week.
summary.zh_hans: 美元兑主要货币下跌，油价向下，中东局势忧虑纾缓，市场风险偏好升温。美元指数在纽约尾市跌逾0.5%，报101.65；欧元兑美元升0.7%，较早时报1.1223美元；英镑兑美元升近0.7%，报1.3439美元；美元兑日圆跌逾0.3%，报157.9日圆。市场亦关注周二公布的美国消费者物价指数，以及本周多名联储局官员讲话。

title.zh_hant: 金價曾升2%　美元疲弱及油價下跌
title.en: Gold rises as much as 2% on weaker dollar and lower oil prices
title.zh_hans: 金价曾升2%　美元疲弱及油价下跌

summary.zh_hant: 金價上升，因美元疲弱，以及油價下跌紓緩通脹憂慮。現貨金一度升至近每盎司4,150美元水平，升幅2%，較早時報4,134.74美元，升幅1.7%；紐約期金收市報每盎司4,114.5美元，升幅近1%。
summary.en: Gold prices rose as a weaker US dollar and falling oil prices eased inflation concerns. Spot gold at one point climbed to near US$4,150 an ounce, up 2%, and was earlier quoted at US$4,134.74, up 1.7%; New York gold futures settled at US$4,114.5 an ounce, up nearly 1%.
summary.zh_hans: 金价上升，因美元疲弱，以及油价下跌纾缓通胀忧虑。现货金一度升至近每盎司4150美元水平，升幅2%，较早时报4134.74美元，升幅1.7%；纽约期金收市报每盎司4114.5美元，升幅近1%。

title.zh_hant: 國際油價低收逾4%至近6%　特朗普暗示將對伊朗克制
title.en: Oil prices fall more than 4% to nearly 6% as Trump signals restraint on Iran
title.zh_hans: 国际油价低收逾4%至近6%　特朗普暗示将对伊朗克制

summary.zh_hant: 國際油價跌逾4%至近6%收市，之前美國總統特朗普淡化再次對伊朗發動打擊的可能性。倫敦布蘭特期油收市報每桶92.57美元，跌5.75美元，跌幅5.8%；紐約期油報每桶86.85美元，跌3.98美元，跌幅近4.4%。
summary.en: International oil prices fell more than 4% to nearly 6% at the close, after US President Donald Trump played down the possibility of striking Iran again. Brent crude settled at US$92.57 a barrel, down US$5.75 or 5.8%; New York crude closed at US$86.85 a barrel, down US$3.98 or nearly 4.4%.
summary.zh_hans: 国际油价跌逾4%至近6%收市，之前美国总统特朗普淡化再次对伊朗发动打击的可能性。伦敦布兰特期油收市报每桶92.57美元，跌5.75美元，跌幅5.8%；纽约期油报每桶86.85美元，跌3.98美元，跌幅近4.4%。

title.zh_hant: 天文台今晨錄得最低17.8度　入秋以來最低紀錄
title.en: Observatory records 17.8°C this morning, lowest since autumn began
title.zh_hans: 天文台今晨录得最低17.8度　入秋以来最低纪录

summary.zh_hant: 本港今早各區氣溫普遍較昨日低7度左右。截至上午5時30分，天文台錄得最低氣溫17.8度，是入秋以來的最低紀錄，新界普遍再低一、兩度。天文台預測今日天氣顯著轉涼，最高氣溫約23度，吹清勁偏北風，初時離岸及高地吹強風，稍後轉吹和緩東北風。
summary.en: Temperatures across Hong Kong were generally about 7 degrees lower this morning than yesterday. As of 5:30am, the Observatory recorded a minimum temperature of 17.8 degrees Celsius, the lowest since autumn began, with the New Territories generally one to two degrees cooler. The Observatory forecasts a marked drop in temperature today, with a maximum of about 23 degrees, fresh northerly winds, strong winds offshore and on high ground at first, easing to a moderate northeasterly later.
summary.zh_hans: 本港今早各区气温普遍较昨日低7度左右。截至上午5时30分，天文台录得最低气温17.8度，是入秋以来的最低纪录，新界普遍再低一、两度。天文台预测今日天气显著转凉，最高气温约23度，吹清劲偏北风，初时离岸及高地吹强风，稍后转吹和缓东北风。

title.zh_hant: 道指高收逾1100點　納指升近3%　Nvidia跌逾4%
title.en: Dow closes up over 1,100 points, Nasdaq gains nearly 3%, Nvidia falls more than 4%
title.zh_hans: 道指高收逾1100点　纳指升近3%　Nvidia跌逾4%

summary.zh_hant: 美股三大指數收市升逾2%至近3%，油價下跌，晶片股造好，但Nvidia受到醜聞拖累，低收逾4%。道瓊斯指數最多曾升近1,290點，收市報52,389點，升1,104點，升幅近2.2%；納斯達克指數收市報25,253點，升673點，升幅2.7%；標準普爾500指數報7,549點，升173點，升幅近2.4%。費城半導體指數急升近7%，應用材料同AMD升逾11%至13%，博通升近9%。
summary.en: The three major US stock indexes closed up more than 2% to nearly 3%, as oil prices fell and chip stocks rallied, though Nvidia dropped more than 4% amid a scandal. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose as much as nearly 1,290 points intraday and closed at 52,389, up 1,104 points or nearly 2.2%; the Nasdaq closed at 25,253, up 673 points or 2.7%; the S&P 500 ended at 7,549, up 173 points or nearly 2.4%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged nearly 7%, with Applied Materials and AMD up more than 11% to 13% and Broadcom up nearly 9%.
summary.zh_hans: 美股三大指数收市升逾2%至近3%，油价下跌，芯片股造好，但Nvidia受到丑闻拖累，低收逾4%。道琼斯指数最多曾升近1290点，收市报52389点，升1104点，升幅近2.2%；纳斯达克指数收市报25253点，升673点，升幅2.7%；标准普尔500指数报7549点，升173点，升幅近2.4%。费城半导体指数急升近7%，应用材料和AMD升逾11%至13%，博通升近9%。

title.zh_hant: 歐股高收逾1%
title.en: European stocks close up more than 1%
title.zh_hans: 欧股高收逾1%

summary.zh_hant: 歐洲主要股市收市升逾1%，銀行股同國防股上升帶動大市。德國DAX指數報26,267點，升446點，升幅1.7%；法國CAC指數報8,233點，升94點，升幅近1.2%；英國富時100指數報10,782點，升108點，升幅1%。
summary.en: European stock markets closed up more than 1%, led higher by bank and defence shares. Germany's DAX ended at 26,267, up 446 points or 1.7%; France's CAC closed at 8,233, up 94 points or nearly 1.2%; Britain's FTSE 100 finished at 10,782, up 108 points or 1%.
summary.zh_hans: 欧洲主要股市收市升逾1%，银行股和国防股上升带动大市。德国DAX指数报26267点，升446点，升幅1.7%；法国CAC指数报8233点，升94点，升幅近1.2%；英国富时100指数报10782点，升108点，升幅1%。

title.zh_hant: 特朗普談中期選舉　稱選民不喜歡戰爭及汽油價格上漲
title.en: Trump on midterm elections says voters dislike war and rising petrol prices
title.zh_hans: 特朗普谈中期选举　称选民不喜欢战争及汽油价格上涨

summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普表示，國民對以色列抱有難以置信的厭惡，是共和黨在中期選舉失利的主要原因之一。他接受電視節目訪問談及共和黨表現，分析指除了他本人名字不在選票上，背後有更深層次原因，選民不喜歡戰爭，亦不喜歡汽油價格上漲。特朗普亦談及副總統萬斯日前在社交媒體發表的長文，稱不反對對方觀點，發文前萬斯曾請示過他；萬斯早前在文中說，共和黨選舉失利的原因就是美以伊戰事。
summary.en: US President Donald Trump said Americans hold an incredible dislike of Israel, one of the main reasons for the Republican Party's losses in the midterm elections. In a television interview about the party's performance, he said that apart from his own name not being on the ballot, there were deeper reasons: voters do not like war, and they do not like petrol prices going up. Trump also discussed a lengthy social media post by Vice President JD Vance, saying he had no objection to its views and that Vance had checked with him before posting; Vance had written that the reason for the Republican losses was the US-Israel-Iran war.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普表示，国民对以色列抱有难以置信的厌恶，是共和党在中期选举失利的主要原因之一。他接受电视节目访问谈及共和党表现，分析指除了他本人名字不在选票上，背后有更深层次原因，选民不喜欢战争，亦不喜欢汽油价格上涨。特朗普亦谈及副总统万斯日前在社交媒体发表的长文，称不反对对方观点，发文前万斯曾请示过他；万斯早前在文中说，共和党选举失利的原因就是美以伊战事。

title.zh_hant: 土耳其鋼鐵廠爆炸增至最少16死　總統稱已展開調查
title.en: Türkiye steel plant blast death toll rises to at least 16; president says investigation under way
title.zh_hans: 土耳其钢铁厂爆炸增至最少16死　总统称已展开调查

summary.zh_hant: 土耳其總統埃爾多安表示，西部伊茲密爾省一間鋼鐵廠發生大規模爆炸，遇難人數增至最少16人，當局已展開調查，查明事故原因、經過及責任。爆炸於當地星期一中午左右發生，地點是阿利阿區的哈巴斯鋼鐵廠，當時一台設備正進行例行維修，爆炸造成巨大破壞並引發火警，其後被撲熄。包括勞工和社會保障部長、能源和自然資源部長在內的多名土耳其高級官員，已前往事發地監督善後工作。
summary.en: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said a major explosion at a steel plant in the western province of Izmir has killed at least 16 people, and that an investigation is under way into the cause, sequence of events and responsibility. The blast happened around noon local time on Monday at the Habas steel plant in the Aliağa district, while a piece of equipment was undergoing routine maintenance; it caused extensive damage and a fire that was later put out. Several senior Turkish officials, including the labour and social security minister and the energy and natural resources minister, have gone to the site to oversee the aftermath.
summary.zh_hans: 土耳其总统埃尔多安表示，西部伊兹密尔省一间钢铁厂发生大规模爆炸，遇难人数增至最少16人，当局已展开调查，查明事故原因、经过及责任。爆炸于当地星期一中午左右发生，地点是阿利阿区的哈巴斯钢铁厂，当时一台设备正进行例行维修，爆炸造成巨大破坏并引发火警，其后被扑熄。包括劳工和社会保障部长、能源和自然资源部长在内的多名土耳其高级官员，已前往事发地监督善后工作。

title.zh_hant: 俄羅斯外交官員稱俄方無意及無計劃進攻歐洲國家
title.en: Russian diplomat says Moscow has no intention or plans to attack European states
title.zh_hans: 俄罗斯外交官员称俄方无意及无计划进攻欧洲国家

summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯外交部副部長里亞布科夫表示，俄方無意、無計劃亦無理由進攻歐洲國家，強調俄方不威脅任何人，若遭受侵略將被迫回應。他在歐安組織一場圓桌會議上說，西方國家正將歐洲軍事衝突視作幾乎注定而不可避免，批評部分歐洲國家政府無意結束俄烏戰事。里亞布科夫又說，俄方相信歐洲各國遲早會願意在平等及不可分割安全等原則上與俄方對話，否則無法實現長期穩定。
summary.en: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergey Ryabkov said Russia has no intention, no plans and no reason to attack European countries, stressing that Moscow threatens no one but would be forced to respond if attacked. Speaking at an OSCE roundtable, he said Western countries were treating military conflict in Europe as almost inevitable, and criticised some European governments for having no desire to end the Russia-Ukraine war. Ryabkov added that Moscow believes European countries will sooner or later be willing to talk on the basis of equality and indivisible security, without which long-term stability cannot be achieved.
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯外交部副部长里亚布科夫表示，俄方无意、无计划亦无理由进攻欧洲国家，强调俄方不威胁任何人，若遭受侵略将被迫回应。他在欧安组织一场圆桌会议上说，西方国家正将欧洲军事冲突视作几乎注定而不可避免，批评部分欧洲国家政府无意结束俄乌战事。里亚布科夫又说，俄方相信欧洲各国迟早会愿意在平等及不可分割安全等原则上与俄方对话，否则无法实现长期稳定。

title.zh_hant: 法國指責伊朗革命衛隊是超市冷藏系統網絡攻擊幕後黑手
title.en: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for cyberattack on supermarket refrigeration systems
title.zh_hans: 法国指责伊朗革命卫队是超市冷藏系统网络攻击幕后黑手

summary.zh_hant: 法國指責伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊是上月法國遭受網絡攻擊的幕後黑手，警告若伊朗繼續發動網絡攻擊，歐盟將對德黑蘭施加更多制裁。法國外長巴羅在當地星期一表示，伊斯蘭革命衛隊是之前針對法國超市冷藏系統網絡攻擊的幕後實施者，法國已召見伊朗駐法國大使，伊朗將因此面臨後果，包括歐盟層面的制裁。巴黎檢察院同日發聲明指，針對上月法國約700間超市的冷藏系統遭受網絡攻擊的事件，司法機關已對伊斯蘭革命衛隊旗下網絡組織展開司法調查，要求簽發國際逮捕令；調查對象包括伊朗網絡組織「沙希德卡韋」的負責人、兩名副手及其他可能被查明身份的人，該組織隸屬於伊斯蘭革命衛隊電子與網絡中心。路透社報道，伊朗常駐聯合國代表團未回應事件；伊朗一直否認實施過惡意網絡行動。
summary.en: France has accused Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps of being behind a cyberattack on France last month, warning that the European Union will impose further sanctions on Tehran if Iran continues to launch cyberattacks. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said on Monday local time that the Revolutionary Guards were behind the earlier cyberattack targeting the refrigeration systems of French supermarkets, and that France has summoned the Iranian ambassador, with Iran facing consequences including EU-level sanctions. The Paris prosecutor's office said in a statement the same day that, in connection with the cyberattack on the refrigeration systems of around 700 French supermarkets last month, judicial authorities have opened a judicial investigation into a cyber organisation under the Revolutionary Guards and requested international arrest warrants; those under investigation include the head of the Iranian cyber group Shahid Kaveh, two deputies and others whose identities may be established, with the group belonging to the Guards' electronic and cyber centre. Reuters reported that Iran's permanent mission to the United Nations did not respond, and that Iran has consistently denied carrying out malicious cyber operations.
summary.zh_hans: 法国指责伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队是上月法国遭受网络攻击的幕后黑手，警告若伊朗继续发动网络攻击，欧盟将对德黑兰施加更多制裁。法国外长巴罗在当地星期一表示，伊斯兰革命卫队是之前针对法国超市冷藏系统网络攻击的幕后实施者，法国已召见伊朗驻法国大使，伊朗将因此面临后果，包括欧盟层面的制裁。巴黎检察院同日发声明指，针对上月法国约700间超市的冷藏系统遭受网络攻击的事件，司法机关已对伊斯兰革命卫队旗下网络组织展开司法调查，要求签发国际逮捕令；调查对象包括伊朗网络组织「沙希德卡韦」的负责人、两名副手及其他可能被查明身份的人，该组织隶属于伊斯兰革命卫队电子与网络中心。路透社报道，伊朗常驻联合国代表团未回应事件；伊朗一直否认实施过恶意网络行动。

title.zh_hant: 何立峰晤加國財長　稱中方願深化合作推動經濟關係穩定健康發展
title.en: He Lifeng meets Canadian finance minister, says China ready to deepen cooperation for stable economic ties
title.zh_hans: 何立峰晤加国财长　称中方愿深化合作推动经济关系稳定健康发展

summary.zh_hant: 中共中央政治局委員、國務院副總理、中加經濟財金戰略對話中方牽頭人何立峰，與對話的加方牽頭人、加拿大財政部長商鵬飛、國際貿易部長西杜，當地星期一在加拿大溫哥華共同主持第二次中加經濟財金戰略對話。何立峰表示，在兩國領導人戰略引領下，中加關係實現轉圜，雙邊交往重回正軌；今次對話是落實雙方領導人重要共識的具體措施，中方願意與加方共同努力，深化經貿、金融、投資等領域合作，推動中加經濟關係穩定健康發展，助力構建中加新型戰略伙伴關係。新華社報道，商鵬飛表示加方高度重視對華關係，願意與中方一同落實好兩國領導人共識，加強政策溝通協調，深化經濟財金領域互利合作；西杜說希望拓展加中經貿領域務實合作，推動兩國經貿關係取得更大發展。對話期間，雙方達成一系列互利共贏成果和共識。
summary.en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council and Chinese lead for the China-Canada Economic and Financial Strategic Dialogue, co-chaired the second round of the dialogue in Vancouver, Canada, on Monday local time with the Canadian leads, Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne and International Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu. He said that under the strategic guidance of the two countries' leaders, China-Canada relations have turned around and bilateral exchanges are back on track; the dialogue is a concrete step to implement the leaders' important consensus, and China is ready to work with Canada to deepen cooperation in trade, finance and investment, promote the stable and healthy development of economic relations, and help build a new strategic partnership between the two countries. Xinhua reported Champagne as saying Canada attaches great importance to its relations with China and is ready to implement the leaders' consensus with China, strengthen policy communication and coordination, and deepen mutually beneficial cooperation in economic and financial areas; Sidhu said he hopes to expand practical cooperation in trade and economic fields and achieve greater development in bilateral economic relations. The two sides reached a series of mutually beneficial outcomes and consensus during the dialogue.
summary.zh_hans: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、中加经济财金战略对话中方牵头人何立峰，与对话的加方牵头人、加拿大财政部长商鹏飞、国际贸易部长西杜，当地星期一在加拿大温哥华共同主持第二次中加经济财金战略对话。何立峰表示，在两国领导人战略引领下，中加关系实现转圜，双边交往重回正轨；今次对话是落实双方领导人重要共识的具体措施，中方愿意与加方共同努力，深化经贸、金融、投资等领域合作，推动中加经济关系稳定健康发展，助力构建中加新型战略伙伴关系。新华社报道，商鹏飞表示加方高度重视对华关系，愿意与中方一同落实好两国领导人共识，加强政策沟通协调，深化经济财金领域互利合作；西杜说希望拓展加中经贸领域务实合作，推动两国经贸关系取得更大发展。对话期间，双方达成一系列互利共赢成果和共识。

title.zh_hant: 「志願聯盟」於波蘭啟動首次多國聯合軍事演習
title.en: 'Coalition of the Willing' launches first multinational joint exercise in Poland
title.zh_hans: 「志愿联盟」于波兰启动首次多国联合军事演习

summary.zh_hant: 英法牽頭組建的「志願聯盟」，當地星期一在波蘭啟動首次多國聯合軍事演習，為俄烏戰事結束後在烏克蘭部署部隊作準備。根據波蘭國防部消息，今次演習共有來自11個國家、約2,800名軍人參加，將持續至本月22日；演習主要在波蘭東南部、距離烏克蘭約100公里的新登巴鎮一帶舉行，海上演習在土耳其進行，由設於法國巴黎的多國部隊作戰指揮部負責指揮。俄羅斯外交部發言人扎哈羅娃早前表示，西方仍然不願正視俄羅斯合理的安全關注，反而繼續加劇局勢升級，俄方絕不接受在烏克蘭部署外國武裝力量。
summary.en: The 'Coalition of the Willing', led by Britain and France, launched its first multinational joint military exercise in Poland on Monday local time, in preparation for deploying troops in Ukraine once the Russia-Ukraine war ends. According to Poland's defence ministry, the exercise involves around 2,800 troops from 11 countries and will run until November 22; it is taking place mainly around Nowa Deba in south-eastern Poland, about 100 kilometres from Ukraine, with the maritime exercise held in Turkey, under the command of the multinational force operations headquarters in Paris. Russian foreign ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said earlier that the West remains unwilling to acknowledge Russia's legitimate security concerns and is instead escalating the situation, adding that Russia will never accept the deployment of foreign armed forces in Ukraine.
summary.zh_hans: 英法牵头组建的「志愿联盟」，当地星期一在波兰启动首次多国联合军事演习，为俄乌战事结束后在乌克兰部署部队作准备。根据波兰国防部消息，今次演习共有来自11个国家、约2,800名军人参加，将持续至本月22日；演习主要在波兰东南部、距离乌克兰约100公里的新登巴镇一带举行，海上演习在土耳其进行，由设于法国巴黎的多国部队作战指挥部负责指挥。俄罗斯外交部发言人扎哈罗娃早前表示，西方仍然不愿正视俄罗斯合理的安全关注，反而继续加剧局势升级，俄方绝不接受在乌克兰部署外国武装力量。

title.zh_hant: 「愛達·花城號」開啟交付後首個試營運航次
title.en: Adora Flora City begins first trial voyage since delivery
title.zh_hans: 「爱达·花城号」开启交付后首个试营运航次

summary.zh_hant: 第二艘國產大型郵輪「愛達·花城號」，昨日從上海國際郵輪港出發，開啟交付後的首個試營運航次，並計劃於本月12日抵達廣州南沙國際郵輪母港，全面檢驗郵輪營運能力，標誌著「愛達·花城號」向正式商業營運邁出關鍵一步。新華社報道，航次期間「愛達·花城號」將圍繞海事營運、航行安全、產品服務、船岸協同及全船信息系統等多個環節，開展系統性測試與調整；在模擬真實營運的狀態下，郵輪將針對客房服務、餐飲娛樂、購物休閒等核心體驗進行壓力測試，進一步檢驗各部門之間的協同配合和響應能力。
summary.en: China's second domestically built large cruise ship, the Adora Flora City, departed Shanghai International Cruise Terminal yesterday on its first trial voyage since delivery, and is scheduled to arrive at Guangzhou's Nansha International Cruise Home Port on November 12, in a comprehensive test of the ship's operational capability and a key step towards formal commercial operation. Xinhua reported that during the voyage the ship will carry out systematic testing and adjustments across maritime operations, navigational safety, products and services, ship-to-shore coordination and the vessel-wide information system; in a simulated real operating environment, it will stress-test core experiences including cabin service, dining and entertainment, and shopping and leisure, further testing coordination and responsiveness between departments.
summary.zh_hans: 第二艘国产大型邮轮「爱达·花城号」，昨日从上海国际邮轮港出发，开启交付后的首个试营运航次，并计划于本月12日抵达广州南沙国际邮轮母港，全面检验邮轮营运能力，标志着「爱达·花城号」向正式商业营运迈出关键一步。新华社报道，航次期间「爱达·花城号」将围绕海事营运、航行安全、产品服务、船岸协同及全船信息系统等多个环节，开展系统性测试与调整；在模拟真实营运的状态下，邮轮将针对客房服务、餐饮娱乐、购物休闲等核心体验进行压力测试，进一步检验各部门之间的协同配合和响应能力。

image_caption: 「愛達·花城號」開啟交付後首個試營運航次，標誌著郵輪向正式商業營運邁出關鍵一步。（新華社）

title.zh_hant: 伊朗軍方發言人稱軍事學說正由防禦威懾轉向進攻
title.en: Iranian military spokesman says doctrine shifting from defence and deterrence towards offence
title.zh_hans: 伊朗军方发言人称军事学说正由防御威慑转向进攻

summary.zh_hant: 伊朗軍方發言人阿克拉米尼亞表示，伊朗武裝部隊正落實最高領袖近期的指示，今後軍事行動將更注重快速回應和打擊效果，不再受地理範圍限制。伊朗伊斯蘭共和國通訊社報道，阿克拉米尼亞表示，最高領袖的指示已成為武裝部隊採取行動的依據，伊朗之前的軍事學說以防禦和威懾為基礎，如今正向進攻性方向轉變；伊朗不會因美國國內政治變化而放緩軍事能力建設，將繼續推進提升威懾能力計劃。阿克拉米尼亞又指，美國企圖在霍爾木茲海峽南部設置虛假航道，誘導航運公司及船東使用相關航線；航運公司和船東可在與伊朗武裝部隊協調後，通過指定的安全航線通行，武裝部隊將確保航線安全。
summary.en: An Iranian military spokesman said Iran's armed forces are implementing recent instructions from the supreme leader, and that future military operations will place greater emphasis on rapid response and strike effectiveness, no longer limited by geographical scope. Iran's Islamic Republic News Agency reported the spokesman as saying the supreme leader's instructions have become the basis for the armed forces' actions, and that Iran's previous military doctrine was built on defence and deterrence but is now shifting towards an offensive direction; Iran will not slow its military capability building because of domestic political changes in the United States and will continue its programme to enhance deterrence. The spokesman also said the United States is attempting to set up a false shipping lane south of the Strait of Hormuz to lure shipping companies and shipowners onto it, and that shipping companies and shipowners may pass through designated safe lanes after coordinating with Iran's armed forces, which will ensure the safety of those lanes.
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗军方发言人阿克拉米尼亚表示，伊朗武装部队正落实最高领袖近期的指示，今后军事行动将更注重快速回应和打击效果，不再受地理范围限制。伊朗伊斯兰共和国通讯社报道，阿克拉米尼亚表示，最高领袖的指示已成为武装部队采取行动的依据，伊朗之前的军事学说以防御和威慑为基础，如今正向进攻性方向转变；伊朗不会因美国国内政治变化而放缓军事能力建设，将继续推进提升威慑能力计划。阿克拉米尼亚又指，美国企图在霍尔木兹海峡南部设置虚假航道，诱导航运公司及船东使用相关航线；航运公司和船东可在与伊朗武装部队协调后，通过指定的安全航线通行，武装部队将确保航线安全。

title.zh_hant: 烏克蘭代表團啟程往阿布扎比　準備參加烏美俄三方會談
title.en: Ukrainian delegation heads to Abu Dhabi for trilateral talks with US and Russia
title.zh_hans: 乌克兰代表团启程往阿布扎比　准备参加乌美俄三方会谈

summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭對外情報局局長烏梅羅夫表示，烏方談判代表團已啟程前往阿聯酋首都阿布扎比，參加預定的烏美俄三方會談，代表團將盡一切可能，確保歐洲伙伴參與外交進程。烏梅羅夫在社交媒體發文表示，會談期間英國、法國、德國、意大利四國代表，以及北約與歐盟代表亦會抵達阿布扎比，烏方將與歐洲伙伴舉行單獨會晤協調立場，目標是實現長期、可持續的和平及安全保障，並為戰後重建創造切實機遇。美國總統特使威特科夫早前表示，美方將於本月10日至11日在阿布扎比斡旋烏克蘭與俄羅斯之間的工作層級談判，將是美俄烏相隔9個月就俄烏局勢再啟三方會談。
summary.en: Rustem Umerov, head of Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service, said the Ukrainian negotiating delegation has set off for Abu Dhabi, capital of the United Arab Emirates, to take part in scheduled trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States and Russia, and that the delegation will do everything possible to ensure European partners take part in the diplomatic process. Writing on social media, Umerov said representatives of Britain, France, Germany and Italy, as well as NATO and the European Union, will also arrive in Abu Dhabi during the talks, and that Ukraine will hold separate meetings with its European partners to coordinate positions, with the goal of achieving long-term, sustainable peace and security guarantees and creating real opportunities for post-war reconstruction. US presidential envoy Steve Witkoff said earlier that the US will mediate working-level talks between Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11, the first trilateral talks on the Russia-Ukraine situation in nine months.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰对外情报局局长乌梅罗夫表示，乌方谈判代表团已启程前往阿联酋首都阿布扎比，参加预定的乌美俄三方会谈，代表团将尽一切可能，确保欧洲伙伴参与外交进程。乌梅罗夫在社交媒体发文表示，会谈期间英国、法国、德国、意大利四国代表，以及北约与欧盟代表亦会抵达阿布扎比，乌方将与欧洲伙伴举行单独会晤协调立场，目标是实现长期、可持续的和平及安全保障，并为战后重建创造切实机遇。美国总统特使威特科夫早前表示，美方将于本月10日至11日在阿布扎比斡旋乌克兰与俄罗斯之间的工作层级谈判，将是美俄乌相隔9个月就俄乌局势再启三方会谈。

title.zh_hant: 甯漢豪稱七年樓齡賠償很大機會不會維持現有優厚水平
title.en: Bernadette Linn says seven-year flat-age compensation is very likely to be less generous than at present
title.zh_hans: 甯汉豪称七年楼龄赔偿很大机会不会维持现有优厚水平

summary.zh_hant: 市區重建局舉辦25周年研討會，發展局局長甯漢豪表示，政府已在北部都會區古洞北及粉嶺北新發展區預留三幅土地，讓市建局考慮興建新單位，作為日後新「樓換樓」計劃下的替代單位。發展局正與市建局共同檢視財政和運作模式，包括檢討「同區七年樓齡」現金收購機制及「樓換樓」安排；甯漢豪透露，現行七年樓齡賠償很大機會不會維持現有優厚水平，目標在明年上半年提出具體建議並展開諮詢。市建局行政總監蔡宏興認為，「同區七年樓齡」收購機制不可持續，以最近四個提出收購建議的項目為例，收購呎價較市價普遍高出約1.3至1.4倍，令很多私人發展商難以收購舊樓，因為業主會等待市建局收購，結果阻礙私人市場參與市區更新。
summary.en: At a seminar marking the 25th anniversary of the Urban Renewal Authority, Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the government has reserved three sites in the Kwu Tung North and Fanling North new development areas of the Northern Metropolis for the authority to consider building new flats as replacement units under a future new flat-for-flat scheme. The Development Bureau is reviewing the authority's financial and operating model with it, including the "same-district seven-year flat age" cash acquisition mechanism and the flat-for-flat arrangement; Linn revealed that the current seven-year flat-age compensation is very likely not to stay as generous as it is now, with the aim of putting forward specific proposals and starting a consultation in the first half of next year. The authority's managing director said the "same-district seven-year flat age" acquisition mechanism is unsustainable, citing the four most recent projects for which acquisition offers were made, where the acquisition price per square foot was generally 1.3 to 1.4 times the market price, making it hard for many private developers to acquire old buildings because owners wait for the authority to buy them, which hinders private-sector participation in urban renewal.
summary.zh_hans: 市区重建局举办25周年研讨会，发展局局长甯汉豪表示，政府已在北部都会区古洞北及粉岭北新发展区预留三幅土地，让市建局考虑兴建新单位，作为日后新「楼换楼」计划下的替代单位。发展局正与市建局共同检视财政和运作模式，包括检讨「同区七年楼龄」现金收购机制及「楼换楼」安排；甯汉豪透露，现行七年楼龄赔偿很大机会不会维持现有优厚水平，目标在明年上半年提出具体建议并展开咨询。市建局行政总监蔡宏兴认为，「同区七年楼龄」收购机制不可持续，以最近四个提出收购建议的项目为例，收购呎价较市价普遍高出约1.3至1.4倍，令很多私人发展商难以收购旧楼，因为业主会等待市建局收购，结果阻碍私人市场参与市区更新。

title.zh_hant: 默茨提名艾格納競選總統　若當選將成德國首位女性國家元首
title.en: Merz nominates Aigner for German presidency; if elected she would be Germany's first female head of state
title.zh_hans: 默茨提名艾格纳竞选总统　若当选将成德国首位女性国家元首

summary.zh_hant: 德國總理、基民盟主席默茨提名巴伐利亞州議會議長艾格納，競逐下任總統；若果當選，艾格納將成為德國史上首位女性國家元首。默茨與艾格納一同出席記者會時表示，在當前地緣政治危機交織、國內極端勢力抬頭的背景下，德國需要一位能夠團結社會、為民眾提供指引的總統，艾格納政治經驗豐富，而且能夠贏得廣泛的社會共鳴。來自基社盟、61歲的艾格納表示，未來會努力彌合社會分歧，堅決反對民粹主義和極端主義。德國將於明年1月30日舉行聯邦大會，選出現任總統施泰因邁爾的繼任人；由於聯盟黨和執政盟友社民黨佔據多數席位，預計艾格納將順利當選。
summary.en: German Chancellor and Christian Democratic Union leader Friedrich Merz has nominated Ilse Aigner, president of the Bavarian state parliament, to run for the presidency; if elected, Aigner would become Germany's first female head of state. Speaking at a joint press conference with Aigner, Merz said that against a backdrop of intertwined geopolitical crises and rising extremism at home, Germany needs a president who can unite society and offer guidance to the public, adding that Aigner is politically experienced and able to win broad social resonance. Aigner, 61, from the Christian Social Union, said she would work to bridge social divides and firmly oppose populism and extremism. Germany will hold a Federal Convention on January 30 next year to elect a successor to incumbent President Frank-Walter Steinmeier; with the CDU/CSU alliance and its governing partner, the Social Democratic Party, holding a majority of seats, Aigner is expected to be elected smoothly.
summary.zh_hans: 德国总理、基民盟主席默茨提名巴伐利亚州议会议长艾格纳，竞逐下任总统；若果当选，艾格纳将成为德国史上首位女性国家元首。默茨与艾格纳一同出席记者会时表示，在当前地缘政治危机交织、国内极端势力抬头的背景下，德国需要一位能够团结社会、为民众提供指引的总统，艾格纳政治经验丰富，而且能够赢得广泛的社会共鸣。来自基社盟、61岁的艾格纳表示，未来会努力弥合社会分歧，坚决反对民粹主义和极端主义。德国将于明年1月30日举行联邦大会，选出现任总统施泰因迈尔的继任人；由于联盟党和执政盟友社民党占据多数席位，预计艾格纳将顺利当选。

title.zh_hant: 美股初段造好　道指曾升逾700點　Nvidia一度急挫近9%
title.en: US stocks open higher; Dow once up over 700 points as Nvidia slides nearly 9%
title.zh_hans: 美股初段造好　道指曾升逾700点　Nvidia一度急挫近9%

summary.zh_hant: 美國股市初段造好，三大指數升逾1%。道瓊斯指數曾升逾710點，一度觸及52,000點關口，較早時報51,972點，升686點，升幅1.34%；標準普爾500指數報7,487點，升110點，升幅1.5%；納斯達克指數報25,033點，升454點，升幅1.85%。Nvidia開市後曾跌近9%，其後跌幅收窄至不足6%。集團行政總裁黃仁勳承認有婚外情，董事會正調查他是否曾經成為外國情報活動的目標。
summary.en: US stocks opened higher, with the three major indices up more than 1%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average once rose more than 710 points and briefly touched the 52,000 mark, standing at 51,972 points in early trading, up 686 points or 1.34%; the S&P 500 was at 7,487 points, up 110 points or 1.5%; and the Nasdaq was at 25,033 points, up 454 points or 1.85%. Nvidia fell nearly 9% after the open before narrowing its loss to under 6%. Chief executive Jensen Huang has acknowledged an extramarital affair, and the board is investigating whether he was ever a target of foreign intelligence activity.
summary.zh_hans: 美国股市初段造好，三大指数升逾1%。道琼斯指数曾升逾710点，一度触及52,000点关口，较早时报51,972点，升686点，升幅1.34%；标准普尔500指数报7,487点，升110点，升幅1.5%；纳斯达克指数报25,033点，升454点，升幅1.85%。Nvidia开市后曾跌近9%，其后跌幅收窄至不足6%。集团行政总裁黄仁勋承认有婚外情，董事会正调查他是否曾经成为外国情报活动的目标。

title.zh_hant: 環保署呼籲市民提防虛假回收補貼計劃　署方已就事件報案
title.en: Environmental Protection Department warns public against fraudulent recycling subsidy scheme and has reported case to police
title.zh_hans: 环保署呼吁市民提防虚假回收补贴计划　署方已就事件报案

summary.zh_hant: 環保署表示，近日接獲公眾查詢有關聲稱由一間企業與環保署聯合推出的回收補貼計劃，有關宣傳海報指在「再生資源回收激勵計劃」下，回收會得到補貼。環保署澄清，署方從未與任何機構聯合推出名為「再生資源回收激勵計劃」的項目，亦從未授權任何人士或團體使用環保署的名稱及標誌發布有關宣傳，經檢視後發現海報上的環保署及相關企業標誌均屬不實，署方已就事件向警方報案。環保署呼籲市民提高警覺，切勿相信來歷不明的海報、連結或通訊軟件訊息，亦不要參與可疑的回收補貼活動和向不明來源透露個人資料或財務資料；如曾就虛假回收補貼計劃提供個人資料或進行交易，應盡快報警求助。
summary.en: The Environmental Protection Department (EPD) said it recently received public enquiries about a recycling subsidy scheme purportedly jointly launched by an enterprise and the EPD, with a publicity poster claiming that recycling would be subsidised under a "Renewable Resource Recovery Incentive Scheme". The EPD clarified that it has never jointly launched any project named the "Renewable Resource Recovery Incentive Scheme" with any organisation, nor has it authorised any individual or entity to use the EPD's name and logo for such publicity, and that upon review the EPD and related enterprise logos on the poster were found to be false. The department has reported the case to the Police. The EPD urged the public to stay alert and not to believe posters, links or messaging software messages from unknown sources, not to take part in suspicious recycling subsidy activities, and not to disclose personal data or financial information to unknown sources. Anyone who has provided personal information or conducted transactions in connection with the fraudulent recycling subsidy scheme is advised to contact the Police as soon as possible.
summary.zh_hans: 环保署表示，近日接获公众查询有关声称由一间企业与环保署联合推出的回收补贴计划，有关宣传海报指在「再生资源回收激励计划」下，回收会得到补贴。环保署澄清，署方从未与任何机构联合推出名为「再生资源回收激励计划」的项目，亦从未授权任何人士或团体使用环保署的名称及标志发布有关宣传，经检视后发现海报上的环保署及相关企业标志均属不实，署方已就事件向警方报案。环保署呼吁市民提高警觉，切勿相信来历不明的海报、连结或通讯软件讯息，亦不要参与可疑的回收补贴活动和向不明来源透露个人资料或财务资料；如曾就虚假回收补贴计划提供个人资料或进行交易，应尽快报警求助。

title.zh_hant: 港鐵稱向承建商跟進東涌西站支柱施工質量問題　全面配合政府徹查
title.en: MTR follows up with contractor over Tung Chung West station pillar construction quality and will fully co-operate with government investigation
title.zh_hans: 港铁称向承建商跟进东涌西站支柱施工质量问题　全面配合政府彻查

summary.zh_hant: 港鐵表示，早前巡視興建中的東涌西站時，發現承建商在月台層的部分支柱出現施工質量問題。公司繼早前按工程合約及質量管制規範向承建商發出不合規通知書後，正嚴正向相關承建商跟進其在事件中的失誤、處理情況，以及責任問題，目前亦待承建商就事件提交完整報告並提出補救方案。港鐵表示，非常重視鐵路項目的監管和工程質素，會持續巡查並採取其他監督措施，確保項目質素。公司會繼續與相關政府部門保持密切溝通，確保工程在施工過程及完工交付時的安全和質素符合合約標準，並會全面配合政府部門徹查事件，按時提交有關成因、補救方案以及與承建商跟進行動的報告，重申對任何不符標準的工程做法絕不姑息，會嚴肅跟進到底。
summary.en: MTR said that during an earlier inspection of the Tung Chung West station under construction, it found construction quality problems in some pillars at the platform level built by the contractor. Having already issued a non-compliance notice to the contractor under the works contract and quality control requirements, the company is now seriously following up with the contractor on its failings in the incident, how it was handled, and the question of responsibility, and is awaiting the contractor's full report and remedial plan. MTR said it attaches great importance to the supervision and engineering quality of railway projects and will continue inspections and other monitoring measures to ensure project quality. The company will maintain close communication with the relevant government departments to ensure the safety and quality of the works during construction and on completion meet contractual standards, will fully co-operate with the government departments' investigation into the incident, and will submit reports on the cause, the remedial plan and follow-up action with the contractor on time, reiterating that it will show no tolerance for any construction practice that does not meet standards and will follow the matter through seriously.
summary.zh_hans: 港铁表示，早前巡视兴建中的东涌西站时，发现承建商在月台层的部分支柱出现施工质量问题。公司继早前按工程合约及质量管制规范向承建商发出不合规通知书后，正严正向相关承建商跟进其在事件中的失误、处理情况，以及责任问题，目前亦待承建商就事件提交完整报告并提出补救方案。港铁表示，非常重视铁路项目的监管和工程质素，会持续巡查并采取其他监督措施，确保项目质素。公司会继续与相关政府部门保持密切沟通，确保工程在施工过程及完工交付时的安全和质素符合合约标准，并会全面配合政府部门彻查事件，按时提交有关成因、补救方案以及与承建商跟进行动的报告，重申对任何不符标准的工程做法绝不姑息，会严肃跟进到底。

title.zh_hant: 美俄烏三方會談周二舉行　拉夫羅夫稱將關注安全議題
title.en: US-Russia-Ukraine talks to start Tuesday; Lavrov says security issues will be focus
title.zh_hans: 美俄乌三方会谈周二举行　拉夫罗夫称将关注安全议题

summary.zh_hant: 美俄烏三方會談星期二起一連兩日在阿聯酋首都阿布扎比舉行。俄羅斯外長拉夫羅夫在會談前夕表示，按照美國國務卿魯比奧的說法，談判將會關注俄烏雙方的安全，以及地區安全，俄方歡迎美國在安全保障問題上的立場。對於歐洲國家代表是否參與談判，克里姆林宮發言人表示，歐洲國家擁有與美國及烏克蘭溝通的渠道，但在阿布扎比舉行的會是俄美烏三方談判。歐盟委員會主席馮德萊恩同日發表聲明，表示與烏克蘭總統澤連斯基通話，討論到即將在阿布扎比舉行的會談，歐盟將會與合作夥伴一同出席相關談判。
summary.en: Trilateral talks between the United States, Russia and Ukraine will be held over two days starting Tuesday in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on the eve of the talks that, according to US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, the negotiations will focus on the security of both Russia and Ukraine, as well as regional security, and that Russia welcomes the US position on security guarantees. On whether European representatives will take part, a Kremlin spokesman said European countries have channels to communicate with the US and Ukraine, but the meeting in Abu Dhabi will be a trilateral negotiation between Russia, the US and Ukraine. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said in a statement on the same day that she had spoken with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy about the upcoming talks in Abu Dhabi, adding that the European Union will attend the relevant negotiations together with its partners.
summary.zh_hans: 美俄乌三方会谈星期二起一连两日在阿联酋首都阿布扎比举行。俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫在会谈前夕表示，按照美国国务卿鲁比奥的说法，谈判将会关注俄乌双方的安全，以及地区安全，俄方欢迎美国在安全保障问题上的立场。对于欧洲国家代表是否参与谈判，克里姆林宫发言人表示，欧洲国家拥有与美国及乌克兰沟通的渠道，但在阿布扎比举行的会是俄美乌三方谈判。欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩同日发表声明，表示与乌克兰总统泽连斯基通话，讨论到即将在阿布扎比举行的会谈，欧盟将会与合作伙伴一同出席相关谈判。

title.zh_hant: 文創產業發展處率業界參與金雞百花電影節　展現香港電影新創意
title.en: CCIDA leads industry delegation to Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival to showcase new creativity of Hong Kong cinema
title.zh_hans: 文创产业发展处率业界参与金鸡百花电影节　展现香港电影新创意

summary.zh_hant: 文化體育及旅遊局轄下的文創產業發展處率領業界代表團，參與在廈門舉行的第39屆中國金雞百花電影節，透過放映、映後分享及業界活動，向內地同業及觀眾展示近年香港電影多元蓬勃的面貌，提升新一代香港電影人的能見度，開拓內地市場機遇。7部獲電影發展基金支持的電影於今日及明日（11月9日及10日）放映，主創及演員出席，包括馮志強《衝浪》、譚偉貞及陳家樂《有個約會》、黃綺琳《Afterpiece》、黃浩及王諾賢《好旅行》、周家怡《天堂鳥》、楊亮進及楊偉倫《我們天生如此》，以及林雪兒及邵美琪《死胡同》。香港電影人亦參與「華語電影之夜」等電影節官方活動，積極推廣香港電影，與內地業界建立聯繫，探索未來合作機會。
summary.en: The Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency (CCIDA) under the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau led an industry delegation to participate in the 39th China Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival in Xiamen, showcasing the diverse and vibrant creative landscape of recent Hong Kong film production to Mainland counterparts and audiences through film screenings, post-screening sharing sessions and industry events, with the aim of raising the visibility of new-generation Hong Kong filmmakers and unlocking opportunities for them in the Mainland market. Seven films supported by the Film Development Fund are being screened today and tomorrow (November 9 and 10), with their filmmakers and cast attending, including "Wakesurf Lovers" by Fung Chih-chiang, "Someone Like Me" by Tam Wai-ching and Carlos Chan, "Afterpiece" by Keane Wong, "Good Trip" by Wong Hoi and Norris Wong, "Bird of Paradise" with Catherine Chau, "We Are Born Good" by Yeung Leung-chuen and Yeung Wai-lun, and "Dead End" by Isabella Lam and Maggie Shiu. The Hong Kong filmmakers are also taking part in official festival events such as "Chinese-language Film Night", promoting Hong Kong cinema, building connections with Mainland industry counterparts and exploring future collaboration opportunities.
summary.zh_hans: 文化体育及旅游局辖下的文创产业发展处率领业界代表团，参与在厦门举行的第39届中国金鸡百花电影节，透过放映、映后分享及业界活动，向内地同业及观众展示近年香港电影多元蓬勃的面貌，提升新一代香港电影人的能见度，开拓内地市场机遇。7部获电影发展基金支持的电影于今日及明日（11月9日及10日）放映，主创及演员出席，包括冯志强《冲浪》、谭伟贞及陈家樂《有个约会》、黄绮琳《Afterpiece》、黄浩及王诺贤《好旅行》、周家怡《天堂鸟》、杨亮进及杨伟伦《我们天生如此》，以及林雪儿及邵美琪《死胡同》。香港电影人亦参与「华语电影之夜」等电影节官方活动，积极推广香港电影，与内地业界建立联系，探索未来合作机会。

en: Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival
