title.en: CAAC to support Hong Kong's strengths, pursue differentiated development with mainland airport clusters
title.zh_hant: 民航局：積極支持香港發揮優勢　與內地機場群錯位發展
title.zh_hans: 民航局：积极支持香港发挥优势　与内地机场群错位发展

summary.en: Deputy Administrator of the Civil Aviation Administration of China Han Jun said at the third Super Terminal Expo that the CAAC will actively support Hong Kong in leveraging its "one country, two systems" institutional advantages, international network and professional services, pursuing differentiated and coordinated development with mainland airport clusters. He praised Hong Kong International Airport as one of the world's most important international aviation hubs, with cargo volumes ranking among the world's best for years, and pledged deeper practical cooperation in route network expansion, aviation logistics, smart civil aviation and the low-altitude economy.
summary.zh_hant: 國家民用航空局副局長韓鈞出席第三屆超級樞紐博覽會致辭時表示，中國民航將積極支持香港發揮「一國兩制」制度優勢、國際化網絡優勢及專業服務優勢，與內地機場群錯位發展、協同聯動，在航線網絡拓展、航空物流、智慧民航建設及低空經濟等方面深化務實合作。他讚揚香港國際機場是全球最重要的國際航空樞紐之一，貨運量多年位居世界前列，成就是特區政府與業界長期努力的成果，也是改革開放和「一國兩制」成功實踐的生動體現。
summary.zh_hans: 国家民用航空局副局长韩钧出席第三届超级枢纽博览会致辞时表示，中国民航将积极支持香港发挥「一国两制」制度优势、国际化网络优势及专业服务优势，与内地机场群错位发展、协同联动，在航线网络拓展、航空物流、智慧民航建设及低空经济等方面深化务实合作。他赞扬香港国际机场是全球最重要的国际航空枢纽之一，货运量多年位居世界前列，成就是特区政府与业界长期努力的成果，也是改革开放和「一国两制」成功实践的生动体现。

title.en: Parking meter system back to normal, no evidence of cyberattack, says Transport Department
title.zh_hant: 咪錶泊車系統恢復正常運作　運輸署：無證據顯示被攻擊
title.zh_hans: 咪表泊车系统恢复正常运作　运输署：无证据显示被攻击

summary.en: The Transport Department said the parking meter system has resumed normal operation after the operator completed urgent repairs. The department will continue to press the operator to thoroughly investigate the cause and submit a report to prevent recurrence. There is so far no evidence that the system was attacked, and the department will notify the Digital Policy Office. The system was taken out of service earlier for emergency maintenance, and Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said police would temporarily not enforce on-street parking meters before repairs were completed.
summary.zh_hant: 運輸署表示，經營運商全力搶修後，咪錶泊車系統已恢復正常運作。署方會繼續督促營運商徹查事故原因及提交報告，防止同類事件再發生；至今沒有證據顯示系統被攻擊，署方會通報數字政策辦公室。咪錶系統早前因故障需要緊急維修，一度暫停服務；運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，在完成復修前，警方暫不會對路旁泊車位執法。
summary.zh_hans: 运输署表示，经营运商全力抢修后，咪表泊车系统已恢复正常运作。署方会继续督促营运商彻查事故原因及提交报告，防止同类事件再发生；至今没有证据显示系统被攻击，署方会通报数字政策办公室。咪表系统早前因故障需要紧急维修，一度暂停服务；运输及物流局局长陈美宝表示，在完成复修前，警方暂不会对路旁泊车位执法。

title.en: Third Super Terminal Expo opens in Hong Kong; Mable Chan touts smart airport benchmarks
title.zh_hant: 第三屆超級樞紐博覽會開幕　陳美寶：香港設全球智慧機場新標竿
title.zh_hans: 第三届超级枢纽博览会开幕　陈美宝：香港设全球智慧机场新标竿

summary.en: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan opened the third Super Terminal Expo in Hong Kong today, welcoming the significant growth in participants and exhibition booths compared with last year. She said the expanded showcase spotlights Hong Kong's smart airport initiatives, aircraft maintenance and recycling, and the rapidly evolving low-altitude economy. With the three-runway system unlocking new potential and the Airport City vision taking shape through SKYTOPIA, Hong Kong is setting new global benchmarks for smart airports, sustainability and seamless travel. Hong Kong International Airport recently won Global Airport of the Year at the Payload Asia Awards.
summary.zh_hant: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶今日為第三屆超級樞紐博覽會主持開幕儀式。她致辭時表示，今屆展會的參展商和展位較去年大幅增加，足證香港在全球航空版圖的地位穩固。展會聚焦本港智慧機場措施、飛機維修及回收，以及發展迅速的低空經濟。她指出，隨着三跑道系統釋放新潛力，以及透過SKYTOPIA實現機場城市願景，香港正為智慧機場、可持續發展及無縫出行訂立全球新標竿。香港國際機場早前在Payload Asia Awards勇奪「全球年度機場」殊榮。
summary.zh_hans: 运输及物流局局长陈美宝今日为第三届超级枢纽博览会主持开幕仪式。她致辞时表示，今届展会的参展商和展位较去年大幅增加，足证香港在全球航空版图的地位稳固。展会聚焦本港智慧机场措施、飞机维修及回收，以及发展迅速的低空经济。她指出，随着三跑道系统释放新潜力，以及透过SKYTOPIA实现机场城市愿景，香港正为智慧机场、可持续发展及无缝出行订立全球新标竿。香港国际机场早前在Payload Asia Awards勇夺「全球年度机场」殊荣。

title.en: Immigration facilitation scheme for arbitration participants expanded from today
title.zh_hant: 參與仲裁程序人士入境便利計劃即日起擴大
title.zh_hans: 参与仲裁程序人士入境便利计划即日起扩大

summary.en: The Government has expanded the Immigration Facilitation Scheme for Persons Participating in Arbitral Proceedings in Hong Kong with effect from today. Since the scheme was regularised on March 1, 2025, it has been well received by the legal and dispute resolution sector and the international arbitration community, strengthening Hong Kong's position as a premier international arbitration hub. The expansion now covers arbitral proceedings physically taking place in Hong Kong, including hybrid hearings, administered by dispute resolution institutions or permanent offices in the mainland, Macao, Taiwan or overseas that are supported by a designated Hong Kong institution under the Mainland-Hong Kong arrangement on interim measures in aid of arbitration.
summary.zh_hant: 政府宣布即日起擴大「參與香港仲裁程序人士入境便利計劃」。計劃自2025年3月1日恆常化以來，深受法律及爭議解決業界和國際仲裁社群歡迎，有效便利在港進行的國際及跨境仲裁程序，鞏固香港作為首屈一指國際仲裁中心的地位。今次擴大涵蓋在港實際進行的仲裁程序（包括混合模式聆訊），由內地、澳門、台灣或海外設立的爭議解決機構或常設辦事處管理，並獲香港指定仲裁及爭議解決機構在內地與香港法院就仲裁程序相互協助保全安排下提供支援。
summary.zh_hans: 政府宣布即日起扩大「参与香港仲裁程序人士入境便利计划」。计划自2025年3月1日恒常化以来，深受法律及争议解决业界和国际仲裁社群欢迎，有效便利在港进行的国际及跨境仲裁程序，巩固香港作为首屈一指国际仲裁中心的地位。今次扩大涵盖在港实际进行的仲裁程序（包括混合模式聆讯），由内地、澳门、台湾或海外设立的争议解决机构或常设办事处管理，并获香港指定仲裁及争议解决机构在内地与香港法院就仲裁程序相互协助保全安排下提供支援。

title.en: Special traffic arrangements in Central, Wan Chai for World Triathlon Cup this weekend
title.zh_hant: 三項鐵人世界盃本周末中環灣仔舉行　警方實施特別交通安排
title.zh_hans: 三项铁人世界杯本周末中环湾仔举行　警方实施特别交通安排

summary.en: Police announced special traffic arrangements in Central and Wan Chai from November 4 to 8 to facilitate the 2026 World Triathlon Cup – Hong Kong, an "M" Mark major sports event taking place on November 7 and 8. Roads including Expo Drive will be temporarily closed at specified times, with traffic diversions in place; the public are urged to plan journeys in advance and use public transport. The event lets athletes race in Victoria Harbour and along Central's streets, reinforcing Hong Kong's status as a centre for international sports events.
summary.zh_hant: 警方今日宣布，為配合三項鐵人世界盃—香港賽事，將於11月4日至8日在中環及灣仔實施特別交通安排，呼籲市民及早規劃行程，盡量使用公共交通工具。賽事屬「M」品牌大型體育活動，於11月7至8日舉行，運動員將在維多利亞港和中環街道競逐。屆時博覽道等道路將於指定時間臨時封閉並實施交通改道。
summary.zh_hans: 警方今日宣布，为配合三项铁人世界杯—香港赛事，将于11月4日至8日在中环及湾仔实施特别交通安排，呼吁市民及早规划行程，尽量使用公共交通工具。赛事属「M」品牌大型体育活动，于11月7至8日举行，运动员将在维多利亚港和中环街道竞逐。届时博览道等道路将于指定时间临时封闭并实施交通改道。

title.en: Christopher Hui promotes Hong Kong finance at Beijing symposium; IPO fundraising tops HK$380b in first three quarters
title.zh_hant: 許正宇北京出席京港洽談會金融合作活動　首三季IPO集資逾3800億
title.zh_hans: 许正宇北京出席京港洽谈会金融合作活动　首三季IPO集资逾3800亿

summary.en: Financial Services Secretary Christopher Hui began a Beijing visit today, attending the thematic financial cooperation session of the 29th Beijing Hong Kong Economic Cooperation Symposium to promote Hong Kong's financial strengths, highlighting the "Finance+" strategy and five chapters spanning fintech and green finance. He said IPO fundraising in Hong Kong exceeded HK$380 billion in the first three quarters, more than double a year earlier, and met People's Bank of China officials to discuss renminbi internationalisation.
summary.zh_hant: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇今日展開北京訪問，出席第29屆京港經貿合作洽談會「京港金融合作」專題活動，向內地官方及商界推介香港金融機遇，強調「金融＋」策略及金融科技、綠色金融等五大篇章。他透露今年首三季香港IPO集資額超過3,800億港元，按年升逾一倍；他亦拜會了中國人民銀行國際司官員，商討人民幣國際化等議題。
summary.zh_hans: 财经事务及库务局局长许正宇今日展开北京访问，出席第29届京港经贸合作洽谈会「京港金融合作」专题活动，向内地官方及商界推介香港金融机遇，强调「金融＋」策略及金融科技、绿色金融等五大篇章。他透露今年首三季香港IPO集资额超过3,800亿港元，按年升逾一倍；他亦拜会了中国人民银行国际司官员，商讨人民币国际化等议题。

image_caption: 許正宇在第29屆京港經貿合作洽談會「京港金融合作」專題活動上演講。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Customs seizes 66 suspected illegally imported live birds at Lok Ma Chau, arrests mainland woman
title.zh_hant: 海關落馬洲檢獲66隻懷疑非法進口活雀　拘一名內地女子
title.zh_hans: 海关落马洲检获66只怀疑非法进口活雀　拘一名内地女子

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs today arrested a 34-year-old mainland woman at the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line control point, seizing 66 suspected illegally imported live birds from her luggage, worth about HK$3,000; the case has been handed to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department. Under the Public Health (Animals and Birds) Regulations, importing birds without a valid health certificate is an offence punishable by a fine of up to HK$25,000.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關今日在落馬洲支線管制站拘捕一名34歲內地女子，在其行李內檢獲66隻懷疑非法進口的活雀鳥，市值約3,000元，案件已交由漁農自然護理署跟進。根據《公眾衞生（動物及禽鳥）規例》，沒有有效衞生證明而進口雀鳥屬違法行為，最高可罰款25,000元。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关今日在落马洲支线管制站拘捕一名34岁内地女子，在其行李内检获66只怀疑非法进口的活雀鸟，市值约3,000元，案件已交由渔农自然护理署跟进。根据《公众卫生（动物及禽鸟）规例》，没有有效卫生证明而进口雀鸟属违法行为，最高可罚款25,000元。

image_caption: 海關在落馬洲支線管制站檢獲的懷疑非法進口活雀鳥。（政府新聞處）

title.en: HKMA's fifth Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit concludes with about 280 leaders attending
title.zh_hant: 金管局第五屆全球金融領袖投資峰會圓滿結束　約280金融領袖出席
title.zh_hans: 金管局第五届全球金融领袖投资峰会圆满结束　约280金融领袖出席

summary.en: The fifth Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit hosted by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority concluded its main summit today, with about 280 global financial leaders attending, including around 120 chairmen and chief executives; this year's theme is "Rethinking the Playbook". The three-day summit began with a welcome dinner last night and will close tomorrow with a "Conversations with Global Investors" forum co-organised by the HKMA, the SFC and the Hong Kong Academy of Finance.
summary.zh_hant: 由金管局主辦的第五屆全球金融領袖投資峰會今日舉行主峰會並圓滿結束，約280名全球金融領袖出席，當中約120人為集團主席或行政總裁；今年主題為「Rethinking the Playbook」。峰會一連三日，由昨晚的歡迎晚宴揭開序幕，明日將以金管局、證監會及香港金融學院合辦的「與全球投資者對話」論壇作結。
summary.zh_hans: 由金管局主办的第五届全球金融领袖投资峰会今日举行主峰会并圆满结束，约280名全球金融领袖出席，当中约120人为集团主席或行政总裁；今年主题为「Rethinking the Playbook」。峰会一连三日，由昨晚的欢迎晚宴揭开序幕，明日将以金管局、证监会及香港金融学院合办的「与全球投资者对话」论坛作结。

image_caption: 金管局總裁余偉文在第五屆全球金融領袖投資峰會上致歡迎辭。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Hong Kong Q3 GDP estimated up 5.2%, fastest first-three-quarter growth in five years
title.zh_hant: 本港第三季GDP預估增長5.2%　首三季合計五年來最快
title.zh_hans: 本港第三季GDP预估增长5.2%　首三季合计五年来最快

summary.en: The Census and Statistics Department today released advance estimates showing Hong Kong's GDP grew 5.2% in real terms in the third quarter, up from 4.2% in Q2 and 1.9% quarter on quarter after seasonal adjustment; growth for the first three quarters totalled 5.1%, the fastest in five years. Private consumption rose 2.8%, goods exports jumped 30.4% and services output grew 4.3%; revised figures and the full-year forecast will be released on November 13.
summary.zh_hant: 政府統計處今日發表第三季本地生產總值預先估計數字，實質增長5.2%，高於第二季的4.2%，經季節性調整後按季升1.9%；首三季合計增長5.1%，是五年來同期最快。私人消費開支升2.8%、貨物出口升30.4%、服務輸出升4.3%；修訂數字及全年經濟預測將於11月13日公布。
summary.zh_hans: 政府统计处今日发表第三季本地生产总值预先估计数字，实质增长5.2%，高于第二季的4.2%，经季节性调整后按季升1.9%；首三季合计增长5.1%，是五年来同期最快。私人消费开支升2.8%、货物出口升30.4%、服务输出升4.3%；修订数字及全年经济预测将于11月13日公布。

title.en: September retail sales up 6.4% year on year, rising for 17th consecutive month
title.zh_hant: 9月零售銷售按年升6.4%　連升17個月
title.zh_hans: 9月零售销售按年升6.4%　连升17个月

summary.en: The Census and Statistics Department today released provisional September retail sales figures: total sales value reached HK$33.4 billion, up 6.4% year on year, the 17th consecutive monthly increase; sales for the first nine months rose 8.3%. Online sales accounted for 13.1% of the total at HK$4.4 billion, up 12%; jewellery and watches rose 20.3% and clothing 11.1%, while supermarket goods fell 1% and motor vehicles and parts dropped 34.7%. The government attributed the growth to an earlier Mid-Autumn Festival and recovering visitor spending.
summary.zh_hant: 政府統計處今日公布9月零售業銷貨額臨時數字，總銷貨價值334億港元，按年升6.4%，是連續第17個月增長；首9個月合計升8.3%。網上銷售佔總額13.1%，達44億港元，按年升12%；珠寶首飾鐘錶升20.3%、服裝升11.1%，超市貨品則跌1%、汽車及零件跌34.7%。政府表示中秋提早及訪港旅客回升帶動增長。
summary.zh_hans: 政府统计处今日公布9月零售业销货额临时数字，总销货价值334亿港元，按年升6.4%，是连续第17个月增长；首9个月合计升8.3%。网上销售占总额13.1%，达44亿港元，按年升12%；珠宝首饰钟表升20.3%、服装升11.1%，超市货品则跌1%、汽车及零件跌34.7%。政府表示中秋提早及访港旅客回升带动增长。

title.en: John Lee begins Beijing visit, says sub-centre offers lessons for Northern Metropolis
title.zh_hant: 李家超展開北京訪問　參觀城市副中心：對北都有參考價值
title.zh_hans: 李家超展开北京访问　参观城市副中心：对北都有参考价值

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee began his Beijing visit today, touring the Beijing sub-centre in the afternoon, including the Beijing Library and a planning exhibition, and said its holistic planning experience offers useful reference for Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis. He later met Beijing party secretary Yin Li and mayor Yin Yong to exchange views on deepening Beijing-Hong Kong cooperation; he will address the opening ceremony of the 29th Beijing Hong Kong Economic Cooperation Symposium tomorrow before heading to Shanghai.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日開始北京訪問行程，下午參觀北京城市副中心，包括北京圖書館及中共北京市委規劃展廳，形容副中心的整體規劃經驗對香港推動北部都會區有參考價值。他之後會見中共北京市委書記尹力及市長殷勇，雙方就深化京港合作交換意見；他明日將出席第29屆京港經貿合作洽談會開幕式並演講，之後轉往上海。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日开始北京访问行程，下午参观北京城市副中心，包括北京图书馆及中共北京市委规划展厅，形容副中心的整体规划经验对香港推动北部都会区有参考价值。他之后会见中共北京市委书记尹力及市长殷勇，双方就深化京港合作交换意见；他明日将出席第29届京港经贸合作洽谈会开幕式并演讲，之后转往上海。

image_caption: 行政長官李家超展開北京訪問行程，參觀北京城市副中心，包括北京城市圖書館。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Yuen Long councillor Sei Chun-hing jailed 30 months over underage sex case, to lose seat
title.zh_hant: 元朗區議員施峻興與未成年少女案判囚兩年半　將喪失議席
title.zh_hans: 元朗区议员施峻兴与未成年少女案判囚两年半　将丧失议席

summary.en: The District Court today sentenced Yuen Long district councillor Sei Chun-hing to 30 months in prison after he was convicted of sexual intercourse with a girl under 16. Under the District Councils Ordinance, a councillor sentenced to more than three months without the option of a fine is disqualified, but as both sides may still appeal, the government said it will closely follow the judicial process; his councillor's honorarium has been suspended since his conviction on September 14.
summary.zh_hant: 區域法院今日判處元朗區議員施峻興入獄兩年半，他早前被裁定與一名未滿16歲女童性交罪成。根據《區議會條例》，議員被判監超過三個月且沒有罰款選項即被取消資格，但由於控辯雙方仍可上訴，政府表示會密切跟進司法程序；他的議員酬金自9月14日被定罪後已被暫停發放。
summary.zh_hans: 区域法院今日判处元朗区议员施峻兴入狱两年半，他早前被裁定与一名未满16岁女童性交罪成。根据《区议会条例》，议员被判监超过三个月且没有罚款选项即被取消资格，但由于控辩双方仍可上诉，政府表示会密切跟进司法程序；他的议员酬金自9月14日被定罪后已被暂停发放。

title.en: State Council financial report: moderately loose monetary policy to continue, property whitelist normalised
title.zh_hant: 國務院金融工作報告：續推適度寬鬆貨幣政策　房地產白名單常態化
title.zh_hans: 国务院金融工作报告：续推适度宽松货币政策　房地产白名单常态化

summary.en: The State Council's report on financial work was today submitted to the 25th session of the 14th National People's Congress Standing Committee for deliberation, setting out five priorities: continuing a moderately loose monetary policy, strengthening financial regulation including cracking down on illegal financial activities and exploring AI applications, better serving the real economy, deepening financial reform and opening-up, and steadily defusing risks in key areas. The report also proposes normalising the "whitelist" mechanism for property financing.
summary.zh_hant: 國務院《金融工作情況報告》今日提請十四屆全國人大常委會第二十五次會議審議，提出下一步五方面金融工作：繼續實施適度寬鬆的貨幣政策、加強金融監管包括嚴打非法金融活動及探索人工智能應用、提升服務實體經濟的適配性，以及深化金融改革與開放、穩健化解重點領域風險。報告亦提出常態化運行房地產融資「白名單」機制。
summary.zh_hans: 国务院《金融工作情况报告》今日提请十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议审议，提出下一步五方面金融工作：继续实施适度宽松的货币政策、加强金融监管包括严打非法金融活动及探索人工智能应用、提升服务实体经济的适配性，以及深化金融改革与开放、稳健化解重点领域风险。报告亦提出常态化运行房地产融资「白名单」机制。

title.en: Travel regulator to launch intangible-heritage tour guide licence next year
title.zh_hant: 旅監局明年推「非遺」專項導遊牌照　首季起接受申請
title.zh_hans: 旅监局明年推「非遗」专项导游牌照　首季起接受申请

summary.en: The Travel Industry Authority plans to roll out a tour guide licence centred on intangible cultural heritage in phases next year, with applications opening in the first quarter; the first phase covers heritage festival projects such as the Cheung Chau Bun Festival and the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance. Some lawmakers asked whether the scope could be broadened to create more jobs for guides, while others raised concerns about unlicensed guides, which the government vowed not to tolerate.
summary.zh_hant: 旅遊業監管局計劃明年分階段推出以「非物質文化遺產」為核心的專項導遊牌照，明年首季起接受申請；首階段涵蓋長洲太平清醮、中秋大坑舞火龍等非遺節慶項目。有議員關注牌照範圍能否擴闊以增加導遊就業機會，亦有議員關注非法導遊問題，政府強調絕不姑息。
summary.zh_hans: 旅游业监管局计划明年分阶段推出以「非物质文化遗产」为核心的专项导游牌照，明年首季起接受申请；首阶段涵盖长洲太平清醮、中秋大坑舞火龙等非遗节庆项目。有议员关注牌照范围能否扩阔以增加导游就业机会，亦有议员关注非法导游问题，政府强调绝不姑息。

title.en: Apple Q4 beats expectations with record results; iPhone sales up over 17%
title.zh_hant: 蘋果上季業績創新高兼勝預期　iPhone銷售按年升逾17%
title.zh_hans: 苹果上季业绩创新高兼胜预期　iPhone销售按年升逾17%

summary.en: Apple reported fiscal Q4 2026 results with quarterly revenue of US$114.5 billion and net profit of US$30.71 billion, both up 12% year on year, and EPS of US$2.10 — all records beating market expectations. iPhone sales reached US$57.58 billion, up over 17%; Mac rose nearly 24% to US$10.79 billion while iPad fell over 10%; services revenue hit a record US$31.57 billion but grew at its slowest pace since 2022. Greater China revenue rose 21% to US$17.5 billion, below the expected US$18.75 billion; it is the first earnings report under new CEO John Ternus, and shares fell about 4% after hours.
summary.zh_hant: 蘋果公布2026財年第四季業績，季度收入1,145億美元、純利307.1億美元，分別按年升12%，每股盈利2.1美元，三項均創歷史新高並勝過市場預期。iPhone銷售達575.8億美元，按年升逾17%；Mac升近24%至107.9億美元，iPad則跌逾10%；服務業務收入315.7億美元創新高，但增速是2022年以來最慢。大中華區收入175億美元升21%，惟低於預期的187.5億美元；這是新任行政總裁John Ternus上任後首份財報，盤後股價跌約4%。
summary.zh_hans: 苹果公布2026财年第四季业绩，季度收入1,145亿美元、纯利307.1亿美元，分别按年升12%，每股盈利2.1美元，三项均创历史新高并胜过市场预期。iPhone销售达575.8亿美元，按年升逾17%；Mac升近24%至107.9亿美元，iPad则跌逾10%；服务业务收入315.7亿美元创新高，但增速是2022年以来最慢。大中华区收入175亿美元升21%，惟低于预期的187.5亿美元；这是新任行政总裁John Ternus上任后首份财报，盘后股价跌约4%。

title.en: Hang Seng Index closes up 0.57% at 23,525
title.zh_hant: 港股收市升0.57%　恒指報23525點
title.zh_hans: 港股收市升0.57%　恒指报23525点

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks closed higher today, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.57% at 23,525.97; the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 0.74% and the H-share index added 0.47%. Tech stocks were mostly higher — JD.com rose over 5% and NetEase nearly 3%, while Lenovo fell over 6%; pork producers strengthened in the afternoon with Muyuan up over 6%, and insurers were active with CPIC up over 4%. Optical communications stocks slumped, with Zhongji Innolight down over 10% on news of Marvell's acquisition of Lumentum.
summary.zh_hant: 港股今日收市做好，恒生指數升0.57%，報23,525.97點；恒生科技指數升0.74%，國企指數升0.47%。科網股漲多跌少，京東升超5%、網易升近3%，聯想則跌超6%；豬肉股午後走強，牧原升超6%；保險股亦表現活躍，中國太保升超4%。光通信板塊下挫，中際旭創跌超10%，市場指與Marvell收購Lumentum的消息有關。
summary.zh_hans: 港股今日收市做好，恒生指数升0.57%，报23,525.97点；恒生科技指数升0.74%，国企指数升0.47%。科网股涨多跌少，京东升超5%、网易升近3%，联想则跌超6%；猪肉股午后走强，牧原升超6%；保险股亦表现活跃，中国太保升超4%。光通信板块下挫，中际旭创跌超10%，市场指与Marvell收购Lumentum的消息有关。

title.en: Kim Yoo-jung makes whirlwind Taiwan visit, raves about local beef noodles
title.zh_hant: 金裕貞旋風訪台出席品牌活動　大讚台灣牛肉麵超好吃
title.zh_hans: 金裕贞旋风访台出席品牌活动　大赞台湾牛肉面超好吃

summary.en: South Korean actress Kim Yoo-jung made a whirlwind visit to Taiwan today as brand ambassador for "JUVELOOK", attending a press conference. She revealed she tried local beef noodles the moment she arrived last night, calling them "so delicious" and joking she would keep eating them throughout her stay. Her recent drama "Hundred-Day Lies" has been generating buzz online.
summary.zh_hant: 韓國演員金裕貞今日以「JUVELOOK 喬雅露」品牌形象大使身份旋風來台出席記者會。她透露昨晚一抵台就搶先品嚐地道牛肉麵，直呼「超好吃」，笑言「接下來在台灣的時間我都要繼續吃牛肉麵」。她近期主演的新劇《百日謊言》引發社群熱議。
summary.zh_hans: 韩国演员金裕贞今日以「JUVELOOK 乔雅露」品牌形象大使身份旋风来台出席记者会。她透露昨晚一抵台就抢先品尝地道牛肉面，直呼「超好吃」，笑言「接下来在台湾的时间我都要继续吃牛肉面」。她近期主演的新剧《百日谎言》引发社群热议。

image_caption: 金裕貞今日旋風來台，以品牌形象大使身份出席記者會。（Wow!NEWS）

title.en: Russian strike on Ukraine humanitarian aid point kills at least 26; Zelenskyy condemns 'vile terror'
title.zh_hant: 烏克蘭人道救援據點遭轟炸　至少26死澤倫斯基斥卑劣恐攻
title.zh_hans: 乌克兰人道救援据点遭轰炸　至少26死泽伦斯基斥卑劣恐攻

summary.en: A humanitarian aid point in Zaporizhzhia, southeastern Ukraine, was hit by successive Russian strikes on November 2, killing at least 26 people and injuring five. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned it as a "vile act of terror" by Russian forces, showing Moscow has no intention of de-escalating toward peace; Russia has not responded to the strikes.
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭東南部札波羅熱一處人道救援據點，本月2日遭俄軍連續轟炸，造成至少26人死亡、5人受傷。總統澤倫斯基痛批這是俄軍「卑劣的恐怖攻擊行徑」，顯示俄方根本無意降溫尋求和平；俄軍至今未對空襲作出回應。
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰东南部札波罗热一处人道救援据点，本月2日遭俄军连续轰炸，造成至少26人死亡、5人受伤。总统泽伦斯基痛批这是俄军「卑劣的恐怖攻击行径」，显示俄方根本无意降温寻求和平；俄军至今未对空袭作出回应。

image_caption: 札波羅熱一處人道救援據點遭轟炸後，救援人員在現場搜救。（公視新聞）

title.en: UN ends 35-year Western Sahara peacekeeping mission as MINURSO mandate lapses
title.zh_hant: 聯合國西撒哈拉維和任務結束35年使命　古特雷斯重申撒哈拉人民自決權
title.zh_hans: 联合国西撒哈拉维和任务结束35年使命　古特雷斯重申撒哈拉人民自决权

summary.en: The UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) has ended after 35 years, with its mandate expiring at midnight on Saturday. The Security Council failed on Friday to agree on an extension: a US-drafted resolution was vetoed by Russia, while a rival Russian text did not win enough votes. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres stressed that the withdrawal does not abrogate the Sahrawi people's inalienable right to self-determination, and said the UN will keep pursuing a political solution through his personal envoy. Morocco's Royal Court called the 35-year chapter closed.
summary.zh_hant: 聯合國駐西撒哈拉全民投票特派團（MINURSO）嘅授權喺上周六午夜屆滿，35年維和任務正式結束。安理會上周五未能就延續授權達成共識：美國提出嘅決議草案被俄羅斯否決，俄羅斯自己嘅草案亦未獲足夠票數通過。秘書長古特雷斯強調，維和人員撤走唔等於撒哈拉人民失去不可剝奪嘅自決權，聯合國會繼續透過特使推動政治解決。摩洛哥王室就話，35年嘅一頁已經揭過。
summary.zh_hans: 联合国驻西撒哈拉全民投票特派团（MINURSO）的授权在上周六午夜届满，35年维和任务正式结束。安理会上周五未能就延续授权达成共识：美国提出的决议草案被俄罗斯否决，俄罗斯自己的草案亦未获足够票数通过。秘书长古特雷斯强调，维和人员撤走不等于撒哈拉人民失去不可剥夺的自决权，联合国会继续透过特使推动政治解决。摩洛哥王室则说，35年的一页已经揭过。

image_caption: 聯合國西撒哈拉全民投票特派團（MINURSO）維和人員在沙漠地區巡邏。（聯合國）

title.en: Bulgaria exit polls point to Yotova win in presidential runoff
title.zh_hant: 保加利亞總統決選出口民調：約廷諾娃料52%勝出　成首位民選女總統
title.zh_hans: 保加利亚总统决选出口民调：约廷诺娃料52%胜出　成首位民选女总统

summary.en: Exit polls in Bulgaria suggest acting President Iliana Yotova is the likely winner of Sunday's presidential runoff, with around 52 percent of the vote against about 44 percent for former caretaker prime minister Andrey Gyurov. If confirmed, the 62-year-old would become Bulgaria's first elected female head of state. Neither candidate secured a majority in the first round on October 25, which drew a record-low turnout of about 23 percent. Official results are expected on Monday. Exit polls by BNR and Alpha Research put Yotova at 51 to 52.5 percent, and preliminary counting of about 75 percent of ballots, reported by BGNES, gives her 56.1 percent against 39.9 percent for Andrey Gyurov, with turnout around 29 percent. Updated: parallel vote counts published on November 2 put Yotova at 57.4 to 58.2 percent against 38.6 to 39.6 percent for Gyurov, while a Central Election Commission partial tally with 17.39 percent of polling-station reports processed gave her 57.94 percent to his 39.01 percent. Gyurov conceded defeat. The commission says official results are expected by November 4 at the latest, and Yotova is due to begin a five-year term on January 22, 2027.
summary.zh_hant: 保加利亞周日舉行總統決選，多間民調機構嘅出口民調顯示，現任總統約廷諾娃有望以約52%得票率擊敗前看守總理古羅夫。如果結果得到確認，62歲嘅約廷諾娃將成為保加利亞首位民選女總統。10月25日首輪投票兩人都未能過半數，投票率僅約23%創歷史新低。官方結果預計周一公布。官方廣播電台 BNR 同 Alpha Research 嘅出口民調分別顯示約廷諾娃得票 51% 同 52.5%；保加利亞通訊社 BGNES 引述初步計票（已點約 75% 選票）話，約廷諾娃得票 56.1%，領先居羅夫嘅 39.9%，投票率約 29%。（更新）11月2日最新計票數字：多間民調機構嘅平行計票顯示約廷諾娃得票 57.4% 至 58.2%，居羅夫 38.6% 至 39.6%；中央選舉委員會處理咗 17.39% 投票站報告後嘅部分統計顯示，約廷諾娃得票 57.94%，居羅夫 39.01%。居羅夫已經承認敗選。選委會話正式結果預計最遲 11 月 4 日公布；約廷諾娃將於 2027 年 1 月 22 日就任，任期五年。
summary.zh_hans: 保加利亚周日举行总统决选，多间民调机构的出口民调显示，现任总统约廷诺娃有望以约52%得票率击败前看守总理古罗夫。如果结果得到确认，62岁的约廷诺娃将成为保加利亚首位民选女总统。10月25日首轮投票两人都未能过半数，投票率仅约23%创历史新低。官方结果预计周一公布。官方广播电台 BNR 和 Alpha Research 的出口民调分别显示约廷诺娃得票 51% 和 52.5%；保加利亚通讯社 BGNES 引述初步计票（已点约 75% 选票）说，约廷诺娃得票 56.1%，领先居罗夫的 39.9%，投票率约 29%。（更新）11月2日最新计票数字：多间民调机构的平行计票显示约廷诺娃得票 57.4% 至 58.2%，居罗夫 38.6% 至 39.6%；中央选举委员会处理了 17.39% 投票站报告后的部分统计显示，约廷诺娃得票 57.94%，居罗夫 39.01%。居罗夫已经承认败选。选委会说正式结果预计最迟 11 月 4 日公布；约廷诺娃将于 2027 年 1 月 22 日就任，任期五年。

title.en: Pope hopes Oleshky truce cooperation can spur Ukraine-Russia peace
title.zh_hant: 教宗：盼奧列什基停火合作帶動烏俄和平進程
title.zh_hans: 教宗：盼奥列什基停火合作带动乌俄和平进程

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV said on Sunday he hopes the cooperation shown by Russia and Ukraine in implementing a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky will pave the way for broader peace efforts. The two sides agreed on October 23 to a six-day humanitarian truce, brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump with the involvement of the Pope, to allow aid deliveries and civilian evacuations from the frontline town suffering severe shortages. It was the longest local pause in fighting since the full-scale invasion. President Zelenskiy said peace negotiators would meet for fresh talks in early November.
summary.zh_hant: 教宗良十四世周日表示，希望俄烏雙方喺奧列什基實施停火時展現嘅合作，可以為更廣泛嘅和平努力鋪路。俄烏10月23日同意喺俄軍佔領嘅奧列什基停火六日，由美國第一夫人梅拉尼婭居中斡旋、教宗亦有參與，方便向糧食同藥物嚴重短缺嘅前線城鎮運送援助同撤離平民。呢次係俄烏全面開戰以嚟最長嘅局部停火，約2000名平民獲安排撤離或補給。澤連斯基話，和平談判代表將喺11月初再會面。
summary.zh_hans: 教宗良十四世周日表示，希望俄乌双方在奥列什基实施停火时展现的合作，可以为更广泛的和平努力铺路。俄乌10月23日同意在俄军占领的奥列什基停火六日，由美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅居中斡旋、教宗亦有参与，方便向粮食和药物严重短缺的前线城镇运送援助和撤离平民。这次是俄乌全面开战以来最长的局部停火，约2000名平民获安排撤离或补给。泽连斯基说，和平谈判代表将在11月初再会面。

title.en: Iran's supreme leader orders immediate, geographically unrestricted response to any new US-Israeli attack
title.zh_hant: 伊朗最高領袖下令：美以若再動武　即時無地域限制反擊
title.zh_hans: 伊朗最高领袖下令：美以若再动武　即时无地域限制反击

summary.en: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has ordered the armed forces to meet any renewed US or Israeli military or terrorist attack with an immediate and effective response without geographical restrictions. Meeting senior commanders, he also instructed the military to update its list of potential targets to cover all kinds of American and Israeli assets, physical and non-physical. The statement said that if enemies resume attacks, it will be Iran that determines when and under what conditions they end. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that President Trump had not yet decided on new strikes against Iran.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗最高領袖哈梅內伊會見三軍高級將領，下令如果美國或以色列再次發動軍事或恐怖襲擊，伊朗武裝部隊必須即時作出有效回應，而且唔設地域限制。佢同時要求軍方更新打擊目標清單，涵蓋美以兩國各類有形同無形資產。聲明又話，如果敵人重啟戰事，幾時同點樣結束將由伊朗話事。美國國務卿魯比奧周六話，特朗普未決定係咪再打擊伊朗。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊会见三军高级将领，下令如果美国或以色列再次发动军事或恐怖袭击，伊朗武装部队必须即时作出有效回应，而且不设地域限制。他同时要求军方更新打击目标清单，涵盖美以两国各类有形和无形资产。声明又说，如果敌人重启战事，何时和怎样结束将由伊朗话事。美国国务卿鲁比奥周六说，特朗普未决定是否再打击伊朗。

image_caption: 德黑蘭街頭嘅伊朗最高領袖壁畫。（bloompakistan）

title.en: John Lee: Hong Kong to become international I&T hub after 2030; over 120 firms in Lok Ma Chau Loop
title.zh_hant: 李家超：2030年後基本建成國際創科中心　河套逾120機構進駐
title.zh_hans: 李家超：2030年后基本建成国际创科中心　河套逾120机构进驻

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee said in a video speech at the opening of the 2026 Greater Bay Area Science Forum on Saturday that Hong Kong will, under its first five-year plan published in September, basically become an international innovation and technology centre after 2030. He revealed that more than 120 I&T enterprises and organisations have set up in the Hong Kong Park of the Lok Ma Chau Loop, up from over 100 when the Policy Address was delivered. The government also plans to step up new industrialisation and research commercialisation cooperation with Guangdong and Shenzhen. The San Tin Technopole will provide about 210 hectares of I&T land to complement the Loop.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超周六喺2026大灣區科學論壇開幕式發表視像致辭，話香港會按今年9月公布嘅首份五年規劃，喺2030年後基本建成國際創新科技中心。佢透露，河套香港園區已有超過120間創科企業同機構進駐，較施政報告公布時嘅逾100間再有增加。政府亦計劃同廣東省及深圳市加強新型工業同科研成果轉化合作。新田科技城就會提供約210公頃創科用地，同河套分工發展。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超周六在2026大湾区科学论坛开幕式发表视频致辞，说香港会按今年9月公布的首份五年规划，在2030年后基本建成国际创新科技中心。他透露，河套香港园区已有超过120间创科企业和机构进驻，较施政报告公布时的逾100间再有增加。政府亦计划和广东省及深圳市加强新型工业和科研成果转化合作。新田科技城就会提供约210公顷创科用地，和河套分工发展。

title.en: 131,000 mainland visitors enter Hong Kong on Halloween eve as city celebrates
title.zh_hant: 萬聖節前夜13.1萬內地客入境　蘭桂坊冀生意增五成
title.zh_hans: 万圣节前夜13.1万内地客入境　兰桂坊冀生意增五成

summary.en: About 131,000 mainland visitors entered Hong Kong on Halloween eve, according to immigration figures, as a mega concert was held at Kai Tak Stadium on the night of October 30 and Halloween events took place across the city. The Tourism Board's first-ever Hong Kong Halloween Month has spread festivities from the traditional Lan Kwai Fong to Mong Kok, Kai Tak and other districts. With Halloween itself falling on a Saturday, the whole city plunged into celebration from the evening, and Lan Kwai Fong businesses hope turnover will rise 50 percent year on year.
summary.zh_hant: 入境處數字顯示，萬聖節前夜約13.1萬人次內地旅客入境香港；啟德主場館10月30日晚舉行大型演唱會，全港多區亦有萬聖節活動。今年旅發局首辦「香港萬聖月」，將節慶由傳統嘅蘭桂坊擴散到旺角、啟德等區。適逢萬聖節正日係星期六，全城由傍晚開始進入狂歡狀態，蘭桂坊業界期望生意按年增加五成。
summary.zh_hans: 入境处数字显示，万圣节前夜约13.1万人次内地旅客入境香港；启德主场馆10月30日晚举行大型演唱会，全港多区亦有万圣节活动。今年旅发局首办「香港万圣月」，将节庆由传统的兰桂坊扩散到旺角、启德等区。适逢万圣节正日是星期六，全城由傍晚开始进入狂欢状态，兰桂坊业界期望生意按年增加五成。

image_caption: 萬聖節期間香港多區舉行慶祝活動，吸引大批市民同遊客參與。（新浪／香江資訊）

title.en: Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 opens with 45,000 expected from 120 economies
title.zh_hant: 香港金融科技周今日開幕　逾45,000人聚會展　聚焦金融+、AI+
title.zh_hans: 香港金融科技周今日开幕　逾45,000人聚会展　聚焦金融+、AI+

summary.en: Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 opened on Sunday, running through November 6 with the main forum held at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on November 2 and 3. Organised by the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau and InvestHK, the five-day event is expected to draw more than 45,000 participants from over 120 economies, alongside 1,000-plus speakers and 800 exhibitors and startups. This year's theme, 'Fintech Nexus: Bridging the World, Building the Future', is built around three growth engines — Finance+, AI+ and global expansion — with 10 dedicated forums on AI, digital assets, Web3, green tech and more. The government said it will announce new measures on AI application and governance, tokenisation and payment connectivity during the week.
summary.zh_hant: 香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026 今日正式開幕，一連五日去到 11 月 6 日，主論壇今明兩日喺灣仔會展舉行。活動由財經事務及庫務局、商務及經濟發展局同投資推廣署主辦，預計吸引嚟自超過 120 個經濟體、逾 45,000 人參與，演講嘉賓超過 1,000 人，參展機構同初創企業超過 800 家。今屆主題係「金融科技樞紐 聯通世界 共建未來」，議程圍繞三大增長引擎「金融+」、「AI+」同全球拓展，設 10 個專題論壇，涵蓋 AI、數字資產、Web3、綠色科技等範疇。政府話，活動期間會圍繞人工智能應用同治理、代幣化、支付互聯等領域公布一系列新措施。
summary.zh_hans: 香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026 今日正式开幕，一连五日到 11 月 6 日，主论坛今明两日在湾仔会展举行。活动由财经事务及库务局、商务及经济发展局和投资推广署主办，预计吸引来自超过 120 个经济体、逾 45,000 人参与，演讲嘉宾超过 1,000 人，参展机构和初创企业超过 800 家。今届主题是「金融科技枢纽 联通世界 共建未来」，议程围绕三大增长引擎「金融+」、「AI+」和全球拓展，设 10 个专题论坛，涵盖 AI、数字资产、Web3、绿色科技等范畴。政府说，活动期间会围绕人工智能应用和治理、代币化、支付互联等领域公布一系列新措施。

image_caption: 金管局聯同投資推廣署今日合辦第十一屆香港金融科技周。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Iran: Strait of Hormuz could reopen in 48 hours if deal reached with US
title.zh_hant: 伊朗：若美伊達成協議　荷姆茲海峽48小時內可重開
title.zh_hans: 伊朗：若美伊达成协议　荷姆兹海峡48小时内可重开

summary.en: Iran's foreign minister told Al Jazeera that if Tehran reaches an agreement with Washington, the Strait of Hormuz could be reopened within two days. Iranian and Qatari mediators have held a third day of talks in Doha aimed at ending the US-Israeli war against Iran, discussing what he called a 'two-day proposal'. Iran's conditions include lifting new sanctions, reducing the US military presence in the region, restoring oil waivers and releasing frozen assets. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that Washington prefers a diplomatic solution.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗外長阿拉格齊接受半島電視台訪問時話，如果德黑蘭同華府達成協議，荷姆茲海峽可以喺兩日內重開。伊朗同卡達調解代表喺杜哈進行第三日會談，推動結束美以對伊朗嘅戰爭，雙方正討論所謂「兩天提案」。伊朗開出嘅條件包括解除新增制裁、減少美軍喺區內部署、恢復石油豁免同釋放被凍結資金。美國國務卿魯比奧周六話，美方傾向用外交方式解決。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗外长阿拉格齐接受半岛电视台访问时说，如果德黑兰和华府达成协议，荷姆兹海峡可以在两日内重开。伊朗和卡达调解代表在杜哈进行第三日会谈，推动结束美以对伊朗的战争，双方正讨论所谓「两天提案」。伊朗开出的条件包括解除新增制裁、减少美军在区内部署、恢复石油豁免和释放被冻结资金。美国国务卿鲁比奥周六说，美方倾向用外交方式解决。

title.en: Israeli airstrikes kill at least 8 in Gaza; 1,580 dead since October ceasefire
title.zh_hant: 以軍空襲加沙致至少8死　停火以來累計1,580人喪生
title.zh_hans: 以军空袭加沙致至少8死　停火以来累计1,580人丧生

summary.en: Israeli forces carried out airstrikes across Gaza on Saturday, killing at least eight people and injuring several others, according to Palestinian news agency reports. A drone strike in Khan Younis killed five policemen, while an attack in western Gaza City killed three people, including a child. Gaza health authorities said 1,580 people have been killed and 5,711 injured since the ceasefire took effect on October 10, 2025.
summary.zh_hant: 巴勒斯坦通訊社11月1日報道，以軍當日對加沙多地發動空襲，至少8人死亡、多人受傷。汗尤尼斯一宗無人機襲擊造成5名警察死亡，加沙城西部一地遇襲，3人死亡包括一名兒童。加沙衛生部門話，自2025年10月10日停火以嚟，已有1,580人死亡、5,711人受傷。
summary.zh_hans: 巴勒斯坦通讯社11月1日报道，以军当日对加沙多地发动空袭，至少8人死亡、多人受伤。汗尤尼斯一宗无人机袭击造成5名警察死亡，加沙城西部一地遇袭，3人死亡包括一名儿童。加沙卫生部门说，自2025年10月10日停火以来，已有1,580人死亡、5,711人受伤。

image_caption: 加沙地帶空襲過後，挖土機在瓦礫堆中清理現場。（京報網／新華社）

title.en: Nicholas Tse hit by glow stick thrown from crowd at Wenzhou concert, carries on
title.zh_hant: 謝霆鋒溫州演唱會被觀眾掟熒光棒砸中腿部　笑住繼續唱
title.zh_hans: 谢霆锋温州演唱会被观众扔荧光棒砸中腿部　笑着继续唱

summary.en: Nicholas Tse was hit in the leg by a glow stick thrown from the stands during his 'Evolution' concert at the Wenzhou Olympic Sports Centre on October 31. A man in white reportedly hurled the light stick while Tse was performing on an extended mechanical stage. The singer did not stop or pursue the matter, smiling and continuing the show; when confronted by fans, the man claimed he threw it out of genuine admiration, a claim many netizens rejected as an excuse.
summary.zh_hant: 10月31日謝霆鋒喺溫州奧體中心「進化」演唱會演出期間，被一名白衣男子從看台掟出嘅熒光棒擊中腿部。當時謝霆鋒正喺伸出嘅機械臂舞台上唱歌，佢冇停低追究，溫柔一笑繼續演出。該男子被現場歌迷質問時，辯稱係「發自內心喜歡」先扔，唔少網民唔收貨，視為狡辯，要求嚴懲。
summary.zh_hans: 10月31日谢霆锋在温州奥体中心「进化」演唱会演出期间，被一名白衣男子从看台扔出的荧光棒击中腿部。当时谢霆锋正在伸出的机械臂舞台上唱歌，他没有停下追究，温柔一笑继续演出。该男子被现场歌迷质问时，辩称是「发自内心喜欢」才扔，不少网民不买账，视为狡辩，要求严惩。

title.en: Wakin Chau announces he is about to become a grandfather at Jinan concert
title.zh_hant: 周華健濟南演唱會宣布「要當爺爺了」　笑言改歌名《親親我的孫兒寶貝》
title.zh_hans: 周华健济南演唱会宣布「要当爷爷了」　笑言改歌名《亲亲我的孙儿宝贝》

summary.en: Wakin Chau surprised fans at his Jinan concert on the evening of October 31 by announcing that he is about to become a grandfather. Before singing 'My Dearest Baby', he shared the story behind the song, written for his son Andrew, and said he now plans to rename it 'My Dearest Grandchild Baby'. China Performance Industry Association data showed large-scale commercial performances grossed 17.111 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, up 17.7 percent year on year.
summary.zh_hant: 10月31日晚周華健喺濟南演唱會上，喺唱《親親我的寶貝》之前同歌迷分享喜訊，宣布自己即將當爺爺。佢話首歌當年係寫畀兒子周厚安，而家兒子大咗，笑言要將歌名改做《親親我的孫兒寶貝》。同場公布嘅中國演出行業協會數據顯示，2026年上半年5,000人以上大型營業性演出票房達171.11億元人民幣，按年增長17.7%。
summary.zh_hans: 10月31日晚周华健在济南演唱会上，在唱《亲亲我的宝贝》之前和歌迷分享喜讯，宣布自己即将当爷爷。他说首歌当年是写给儿子周厚安，如今儿子大了，笑言要将歌名改做《亲亲我的孙儿宝贝》。同场公布的中国演出行业协会数据显示，2026年上半年5,000人以上大型营业性演出票房达171.11亿元人民币，按年增长17.7%。

title.en: John Lee opens Hong Kong FinTech Week, calling Hong Kong the world's fintech capital
title.zh_hant: 李家超金融科技周開幕演辭：香港係世界金融科技之都　首個五年規劃定方向
title.zh_hans: 李家超金融科技周开幕演辞：香港是世界金融科技之都　首个五年规划定方向

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee opened Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 on Monday morning, welcoming about 1,000 government leaders and fintech, finance and technology professionals from over 100 countries and economies to the five-day event at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. In his speech, Lee said Hong Kong's first-ever Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development, unveiled less than two months ago and aligned with the national 15th Five-Year Plan, gives businesses certainty about direction and opportunities. He described Hong Kong as 'the world's fintech capital', noting it ranks first globally in economic freedom, second in competitiveness, hosts more than 1,400 fintech companies, and anchors the world's top-ranked Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou innovation cluster. The week brings together more than 800 exhibitors and startups and over 30 delegations from the Mainland and abroad.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日朝早喺灣仔會展出席香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026開幕禮，歡迎嚟自超過100個國家同經濟體、約1,000位政府領袖同金融科技、金融、科技界專業人士參與呢場一連五日嘅盛會。佢喺演辭中話，香港兩個月前公布首個五年經濟社會發展規劃，同國家「十五五」規劃銜接，為企業同投資者提供方向同機遇嘅確定性。佢形容香港係「世界金融科技之都」：經濟自由度全球第一、競爭力全球第二，擁有逾1,400間金融科技公司，深港穗科技集群更連續兩年位列世界知識產權組織全球創新指數第一。今屆活動雲集超過800間參展商同初創企業，以及逾30個來自內地同海外嘅代表團。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日朝早在湾仔会展出席香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026开幕礼，欢迎来自超过100个国家和经济体、约1,000位政府领袖和金融科技、金融、科技界专业人士参与这场一连五日的盛会。他在演辞中说，香港两个月前公布首个五年经济社会发展规划，同国家「十五五」规划衔接，为企业和投资者提供方向和机遇的确定性。他形容香港是「世界金融科技之都」：经济自由度全球第一、竞争力全球第二，拥有逾1,400间金融科技公司，深港穗科技集群更连续两年位列世界知识产权组织全球创新指数第一。今届活动云集超过800间参展商和初创企业，以及逾30个来自内地和海外的代表团。

image_caption: 行政長官李家超今日喺灣仔會展出席香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026，並喺投資推廣署展位同在場嘉賓合照。（政府新聞處）

title.en: ICAC charges two former Johnson Cleaning executives over HK$75m bribery conspiracy
title.zh_hant: 廉署落案起訴莊臣前高層　涉收逾7,500萬賄款批出清潔車合約
title.zh_hans: 廉署落案起诉庄臣前高层　涉收逾7,500万贿款批出清洁车合约

summary.en: The Independent Commission Against Corruption has charged two former senior figures at Johnson Cleaning Services Company Limited with conspiring to accept advantages worth more than HK$75 million in connection with the purchase and maintenance of cleaning vehicles. William Fung Chi-wang, 54, a former director of Johnson and former chief executive of its parent company, and Jimmy Lee Sai-leung, 57, a former general manager, were charged on October 30 with one count of conspiracy for an agent to accept advantages, contrary to section 9(1)(b) of the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance. They are due to appear at Kwun Tong Magistrates' Courts on November 2. Investigators allege that between November 2024 and January 2026, Johnson acquired several fleets of cleaning vehicles from a supplier and engaged the same supplier for maintenance, spending more than HK$160 million, with the two men conspiring to accept over HK$75 million from the supplier's proprietor and others as a reward for favouring the supplier in Johnson's business dealings.
summary.zh_hant: 廉政公署落案起訴莊臣有限公司（Johnson Cleaning Services）兩名前高層，涉嫌串謀接受逾7,500萬元利益，涉及採購同維修清潔車輛。兩名被告分別係54歲前董事兼母公司前行政總裁馮志宏，以及57歲前總經理李仕樑，10月30日被控一項串謀使代理人接受利益罪，違反《防止賄賂條例》第9(1)(b)條，案件今日（11月2日）喺觀塘裁判法院提堂。廉署指，2024年11月至2026年1月期間，莊臣向同一供應商購入多批清潔車輛並交畀該供應商做維修，開支超過1.6億元；兩人涉嫌串謀接受供應商東主等人超過7,500萬元賄款，作為優待該供應商嘅報酬。
summary.zh_hans: 廉政公署落案起诉庄臣有限公司（Johnson Cleaning Services）两名前高层，涉嫌串谋接受逾7,500万元利益，涉及采购和维修清洁车辆。两名被告分别是54岁前董事兼母公司前行政总裁冯志宏，以及57岁前总经理李仕樑，10月30日被控一项串谋使代理人接受利益罪，违反《防止贿赂条例》第9(1)(b)条，案件今日（11月2日）在观塘裁判法院提堂。廉署指，2024年11月至2026年1月期间，庄臣向同一供应商购入多批清洁车辆并交畀该供应商做维修，开支超过1.6亿元；两人涉嫌串谋接受供应商东主等人超过7,500万元贿款，作为优待该供应商的报酬。

title.en: Only one in five Hongkongers trust banks to stop deepfake scams, FIS survey finds
title.zh_hant: 調查：僅兩成港人相信銀行可擋深偽詐騙　41%曾受AI假冒詐騙滋擾
title.zh_hans: 调查：仅两成港人相信银行可挡深伪诈骗　41%曾受AI假冒诈骗滋扰

summary.en: Only 23 percent of Hong Kong consumers are confident their banks could stop a deepfake scam before money leaves their accounts, the lowest proportion among four markets surveyed by financial technology company FIS in its 2026 Consumer Pulse Survey. The survey found 41 percent of respondents had themselves been targeted by AI deepfake or impersonation fraud, or knew someone who had, while only 19 percent were confident their banks would refund stolen money. On the other hand, Hong Kong recorded the highest awareness of stablecoins among the four markets, at 78 percent. Amit Chopra, FIS's head of banking and payments for Asia-Pacific, said banks need stronger fraud detection systems to identify scams before funds are transferred.
summary.zh_hant: 金融科技公司 FIS 發表嘅 2026 年消費者脈搏調查發現，只有 23% 香港消費者相信銀行可以喺深偽詐騙騙走錢之前攔截，係四個受訪市場之中最低。調查發現 41% 受訪者自己或者認識嘅人曾經成為 AI 深偽或假冒詐騙嘅目標，只有 19% 相信銀行會退回被騙款項。另一邊廂，香港喺四個市場之中對穩定幣嘅認知度最高，達到 78%。FIS 亞太區銀行及支付業務主管 Amit Chopra 話，銀行需要更強嘅詐騙偵測系統，先可以喺資金轉走之前識破騙局。
summary.zh_hans: 金融科技公司 FIS 发表的 2026 年消费者脉搏调查发现，只有 23% 香港消费者相信银行可以在深伪诈骗骗走钱之前拦截，是四个受访市场之中最低。调查发现 41% 受访者自己或者认识的人曾经成为 AI 深伪或假冒诈骗的目标，只有 19% 相信银行会退回被骗款项。另一边厢，香港在四个市场之中对稳定币的认知度最高，达到 78%。FIS 亚太区银行及支付业务主管 Amit Chopra 说，银行需要更强的诈骗侦测系统，才可以在资金转走之前识破骗局。

title.en: Liantang boundary control point tops 100 million passenger crossings
title.zh_hant: 蓮塘／香園圍口岸出入境人次破一億　日均9.4萬
title.zh_hans: 莲塘／香园围口岸出入境人次破一亿　日均9.4万

summary.en: The Liantang/Heung Yuen Wai Boundary Control Point had recorded more than 100 million passenger crossings and over 6 million vehicle crossings by November 1, according to the Shenzhen General Station of Exit and Entry Frontier Inspection. Opened in August 2020, the crossing averaged 94,000 passenger crossings a day, with volumes growing by an annual average of more than 37 percent over six years. Hong Kong and Macao residents made more than 21.3 million crossings there in the first ten months of 2026, up 12.7 percent year on year. The figures count crossing instances, not unique individuals.
summary.zh_hant: 深圳出入境邊防檢查總站公布，截至11月1日，蓮塘／香園圍邊境管制站出入境旅客人次突破一億，車輛超過600萬架次。口岸喺2020年8月開通，日均旅客出入境人次9.4萬，六年嚟旅客人次年均增長逾37%。今年首十個月，港澳居民經呢個口岸出入境超過2,130萬人次，按年升12.7%。數字係出入境人次，唔係獨特人數。
summary.zh_hans: 深圳出入境边防检查总站公布，截至11月1日，莲塘／香园围边境管制站出入境旅客人次突破一亿，车辆超过600万架次。口岸在2020年8月开通，日均旅客出入境人次9.4万，六年来旅客人次年均增长逾37%。今年首十个月，港澳居民经这个口岸出入境超过2,130万人次，按年升12.7%。数字是出入境人次，不是独特人数。

title.en: Hang Seng jumps 1.5% to lead mixed Asian open as mainland shares and Nikkei fall
title.zh_hant: 恒指今早升1.46%報23,294點　亞洲股市個別發展滬指跌1.44%
title.zh_hans: 恒指今早升1.46%报23,294点　亚洲股市个别发展沪指跌1.44%

summary.en: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index jumped 1.46 percent to 23,294.42 in Monday's morning session, leading regional gainers as Asian markets opened the trading week in mixed fashion. South Korea's KOSPI added 0.51 percent and India's Sensex rose 0.42 percent, while mainland China's SSE Composite dropped 1.44 percent, Japan's Nikkei 225 slipped 0.33 percent and Australia's ASX 200 retreated 0.35 percent. The Philippines Stock Exchange was closed for the All Souls' Day public holiday. The report noted that no single macroeconomic catalyst was identified for the divergent regional moves.
summary.zh_hant: 港股今朝高開高走，恒生指數早市升1.46%，報23,294.42點，領漲亞洲股市，亞洲其他市場就個別發展：南韓 KOSPI 升0.51%、印度 Sensex 升0.42%；上證綜指跌1.44%、日經225跌0.33%、澳洲 ASX 200 跌0.35%。菲律賓股市因為萬聖節後嘅追思節假期休市。報告指，今早亞洲股市走勢分歧，背後未見單一宏觀因素主導。
summary.zh_hans: 港股今朝高开高走，恒生指数早市升1.46%，报23,294.42点，领涨亚洲股市，亚洲其他市场就个别发展：南韩 KOSPI 升0.51%、印度 Sensex 升0.42%；上证综指跌1.44%、日经225跌0.33%、澳洲 ASX 200 跌0.35%。菲律宾股市因为万圣节后的追思节假期休市。报告指，今早亚洲股市走势分歧，背后未见单一宏观因素主导。

title.en: John Lee to visit Beijing and Shanghai from November 3 for symposium and import expo
title.zh_hant: 李家超明起訪京滬　出席京港洽談會及進博會
title.zh_hans: 李家超明起访京沪　出席京港洽谈会及进博会

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee will depart for Beijing and Shanghai tomorrow (November 3) to attend the 29th Beijing Hong Kong Economic Cooperation Symposium and the ninth China International Import Expo, returning to Hong Kong on November 6. In Beijing, Lee will meet city officials and deliver a speech at the symposium's opening ceremony on November 4, held under the theme of both places seizing opportunities under the national 15th Five-Year Plan. He will travel to Shanghai the same day to attend the expo's opening ceremony and the Hongqiao International Economic Forum on November 5, visit the Hong Kong exhibition area and the booths of Hong Kong enterprises, deliver a speech at a sub-forum and meet Shanghai officials. Lee said Hong Kong would continue to deepen exchanges with the Mainland and play the roles of "super connector" and "super value-adder". Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki will be Acting Chief Executive during his absence.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超聽日（11月3日）起程前往北京同上海，出席第29屆北京香港經濟合作研討洽談會同第九屆中國國際進口博覽會，11月6日返港。佢喺北京期間會會見北京市官員，並喺11月4日洽談會開幕禮致辭，今屆主題係「京港攜手奮進『十五五』」。李家超同日轉往上海，11月5日出席進博會開幕禮同虹橋國際經濟論壇，參觀香港展區同港企展位，並喺論壇分論壇發表演辭，亦會會見上海市官員。佢話香港會繼續深化同內地交流合作，發揮「超級聯繫人」同「超級增值人」嘅角色。佢離港期間，政務司司長陳國基署任行政長官。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超听日（11月3日）起程前往北京同上海，出席第29届北京香港经济合作研讨洽谈会同第九届中国国际进口博览会，11月6日返港。他在北京期间会会见北京市官员，并在11月4日洽谈会开幕礼致辞，今届主题是「京港携手奋进『十五五』」。李家超同日转往上海，11月5日出席进博会开幕礼同虹桥国际经济论坛，参观香港展区同港企展位，并在论坛分论坛发表演辞，亦会会见上海市官员。他说香港会继续深化同内地交流合作，发挥「超级联系人」同「超级增值人」的角色。他离港期间，政务司司长陈国基署任行政长官。

title.en: Paul Chan: Hong Kong set for strongest annual growth in five years; women take 45% of senior finance roles
title.zh_hant: 陳茂波：香港今年增長料五年最勁　女性佔金融高層45%
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：香港今年增长料五年最劲　女性占金融高层45%

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan told the Women Chief Executives Summit 2026 on Monday that Hong Kong's economy grew 5.1 percent in the first half of the year and that third-quarter figures to be released tomorrow will mark a 15th consecutive quarter of growth, with the full-year forecast likely to be revised upwards — putting the city on course for its strongest annual growth in five years. Chan said the two principles for building resilient institutions are drawing on the widest possible pool of talent and managing capital with a long-term perspective. Citing a study by WCE Hong Kong, KPMG and the Women's Foundation, he noted women now hold 45 percent of senior leadership positions in the financial institutions studied, up from 34 percent in 2018, and that for the first time the chief executives of both the Securities and Futures Commission and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange are women. He added that women are expected to control a substantial share of wealth by 2030 as a major transfer of wealth gets under way.
summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波今日喺 Women Chief Executives Summit 2026 發表主題演辭，話香港今年上半年經濟增長5.1%，聽日公布嘅第三季數字將係連續第15個季度增長，全年增長預測好可能向上修訂，香港今年有望錄得五年嚟最強勁嘅全年增長。佢話，要建立經得起變局嘅機構，有兩個關鍵：吸納最廣闊嘅人才，以及用長遠眼光管理資本。佢引述 WCE Hong Kong、KPMG 同婦女基金會嘅聯合研究，指受訪金融機構嘅女性高層比例由2018年嘅34%升到45%，證監會同港交所嘅行政總裁更係有史以來首次同為女性。佢又話，隨著財富大轉移展開，女性預計到2030年將掌控相當大比例嘅財富。
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波今日在 Women Chief Executives Summit 2026 发表主题演辞，说香港今年上半年经济增长5.1%，听日公布的第三季数字将是连续第15个季度增长，全年增长预测好可能向上修订，香港今年有望录得五年来最强劲的全年增长。他说，要建立经得起变局的机构，有两个关键：吸纳最广阔的人才，以及用长远眼光管理资本。他引述 WCE Hong Kong、KPMG 同妇女基金会的联合研究，指受访金融机构的女性高层比例由2018年的34%升到45%，证监会同港交所的行政总裁更是史无前例同为女性。他又说，随着财富大转移展开，女性预计到2030年将掌控相当大比例的财富。

image_caption: 財政司司長陳茂波今日喺 Women Chief Executives Summit 2026 發表主題演辭。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Paul Chan lays out three fintech priorities: efficiency, inclusion and trust
title.zh_hant: 陳茂波金融科技周演辭：效率、共融、信任係三大優先
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波金融科技周演辞：效率、共融、信任是三大优先

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan set out three priorities for Hong Kong's next stage of fintech development — efficiency as the engine, inclusion as the purpose and trust as the foundation — in a speech at Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 on Monday. On efficiency, he cited the Faster Payment System's more than 22 million registrations, one-business-day settlement for tokenised government green bonds versus five days conventionally, and the fourth digital green bond offering raising about HK$20 billion across four currencies. On inclusion, he said the Commercial Data Interchange has facilitated more than 125,000 SME loan applications involving nearly HK$110 billion in credit since 2022, helping banks lend on data rather than collateral. On trust, he pointed to stablecoin issuer licences granted in April and the HKMA's new Project SAGE, which explores how AI agents should be governed, stressing that responsibility for AI agents' actions remains with the deploying institution.
summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波今日喺香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026 發表演辭，提出金融科技發展下一階段三大優先：效率係引擎、共融係目的、信任係根基。效率方面，佢提到「轉數快」登記用戶超過2,200萬；代幣化政府綠色債券結算只需一個營業日，遠快過傳統方式嘅五日；第四批數碼綠色債券籌集約200億元，橫跨四種貨幣。共融方面，商業數據通（CDI）自2022年推出以嚟，已促成超過12.5萬宗中小企貸款申請，涉及近1,100億元信貸，令銀行可以睇數據批貸，唔使淨係睇抵押品。信任方面，佢提到今年4月批出首批穩定幣發行人牌照，以及金管局新推出嘅 Project SAGE，研究點樣規管 AI 代理，強調 AI 代理做嘢，責任仍然歸機構。
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波今日在香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026 发表演辞，提出金融科技发展下一阶段三大优先：效率是引擎、共融是目的、信任是根基。效率方面，他提到「转数快」登记用户超过2,200万；代币化政府绿色债券结算只需一个营业日，远快过传统方式的五日；第四批数码绿色债券筹集约200亿元，横跨四种货币。共融方面，商业数据通（CDI）自2022年推出以来，已促成超过12.5万宗中小企贷款申请，涉及近1,100亿元信贷，令银行可以睇数据批贷，不使净系睇抵押品。信任方面，他提到今年4月批出首批稳定币发行人牌照，以及金管局新推出的 Project SAGE，研究点样规管 AI 代理，强调 AI 代理做嘢，责任仍然归机构。

image_caption: 財政司司長陳茂波今日喺香港金融科技周x StartmeupHK 2026發表主題演辭。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Asia+ Festival brings Malaysia's HANDS Percussion and Balinese gamelan to Sha Tin Town Hall
title.zh_hant: 亞藝無疆音樂會《Taksu — 甘美蘭之靈》　馬來西亞鼓樂團聯乘印尼甘美蘭
title.zh_hans: 亚艺无疆音乐会《Taksu — 甘美兰之灵》　马来西亚鼓乐团联乘印尼甘美兰

summary.en: The fourth Asia+ Festival will stage the concert "Taksu – The Spirit of Gamelan" at 8pm on November 6 and 7 at the Sha Tin Town Hall Auditorium. Malaysia's leading percussion ensemble HANDS Percussion will perform alongside Indonesia's Gamelan Yuganada, fusing the pulse of Chinese lion dance drums and Malaysian 24 Festive Drums with the sonorities of Balinese gamelan, joined by Mak Yong dance and song and the Hong Kong Children's Choir (Chamber Youth), which will perform a reimagined "Jasmine Flower". The concert is also part of the sixth Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Culture and Arts Festival. Tickets are priced at HK$200 to HK$400 at URBTIX, with a meet-the-artist session after the November 6 performance.
summary.zh_hant: 第四屆「亞藝無疆」藝術節將於11月6日同7日晚上8點，喺沙田大會堂演奏廳呈獻音樂會《Taksu — 甘美蘭之靈》。馬來西亞首席敲擊樂團 HANDS Percussion 聯同印尼甘美蘭樂團 Gamelan Yuganada，將中國醒獅鼓同馬來西亞廿四節令鼓嘅澎湃鼓點，同峇里甘美蘭嘅空靈音色融為一體，同場仲有 Mak Yong 舞蹈同歌唱表演，以及香港兒童合唱團（室樂青年團）獻唱重新編曲嘅《茉莉花》。呢場音樂會亦係第六屆粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節節目之一。門票200至400元，喺城市售票網發售；11月6日場次演後設有演後座談。
summary.zh_hans: 第四届「亚艺无疆」艺术节将于11月6日同7日晚上8点，在沙田大会堂演奏厅呈献音乐会《Taksu — 甘美兰之灵》。马来西亚首席敲击乐团 HANDS Percussion 联同印尼甘美兰乐团 Gamelan Yuganada，将中国醒狮鼓同马来西亚廿四节令鼓的澎湃鼓点，同峇里甘美兰的空灵音色融为一体，同场还有 Mak Yong 舞蹈同歌唱表演，以及香港儿童合唱团（室乐青年团）献唱重新编曲的《茉莉花》。这场音乐会亦是第六届粤港澳大湾区文化艺术节节目之一。门票200至400元，在城市售票网发售；11月6日场次演后设有演后座谈。

image_caption: 第四屆「亞藝無疆」藝術節音樂會《Taksu — 甘美蘭之靈》下月6至7號舉行。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Sun Dong heads to Wuzhen for 2026 World Internet Conference summit
title.zh_hant: 孫東今赴烏鎮出席世界互聯網大會　將喺AI智能體分論壇致辭
title.zh_hans: 孙东今赴乌镇出席世界互联网大会　将在AI智能体分论坛致辞

summary.en: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Professor Sun Dong will depart for Wuzhen, Zhejiang, this afternoon to attend the 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit, held under the theme of openness, joint contribution and shared benefits in cyberspace. Professor Sun will attend the opening ceremony and ministerial meeting, and deliver opening remarks at the Global Cooperation and Innovation Forum on mutual trust, interconnectivity and interoperability of AI agents as well as the Cross-Strait, Hong Kong and Macao Internet Development Forum. Acting Commissioner for Digital Policy Daniel Cheung will also attend the summit. Professor Sun returns to Hong Kong on Wednesday evening; Under Secretary Lillian Cheong will act as secretary during his absence.
summary.zh_hant: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東教授今午出發去浙江烏鎮，出席2026年世界互聯網大會烏鎮峰會，今屆主題係「開源開放　共建共治共享——攜手構建網絡空間命運共同體」。孫東將出席開幕式同部長級會議，並喺「AI 智能體互信互聯互通全球合作創新論壇」同「兩岸三地互聯網發展論壇」發表開幕演辭。署理數字政策專員張偉光亦會出席峰會。孫東星期三（11月4日）傍晚返港，離港期間由副局長張曼莉署任局長。
summary.zh_hans: 创新科技及工业局局长孙东教授今午出发去浙江乌镇，出席2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会，今届主题是「开源开放　共建共治共享——携手构建网络空间命运共同体」。孙东将出席开幕式同部长级会议，并在「AI 智能体互信互联互通全球合作创新论坛」同「两岸三地互联网发展论坛」发表开幕演辞。署理数字政策专员张伟光亦会出席峰会。孙东星期三（11月4日）傍晚返港，离港期间由副局长张曼莉署任局长。

title.en: John Lee meets education minister Huai Jinpeng to deepen education co-operation
title.zh_hant: 李家超會見教育部部長懷進鵬　談深化教育合作交流
title.zh_hans: 李家超会见教育部部长怀进鹏　谈深化教育合作交流

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee met Minister of Education Huai Jinpeng on Monday to exchange views on deepening co-operation and exchanges in education. Also attending were Secretary for Education Choi Yuk-lin and Director of the Chief Executive's Office Carol Yip. Lee welcomed Huai's visit to Hong Kong, noting the city has five universities ranked among the world's top 100 with education competitiveness ranking among the world's best. He said the government is fully implementing Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan to develop the city into an international hub for high-calibre talent, attracting outstanding students from around the world through the Task Force on Study in Hong Kong, with the inaugural Study in Hong Kong Week launched this year. Lee also said Hong Kong is accelerating development of the Northern Metropolis with a university town as its main focus, bringing together education, technology, industry, talent and urban development, and hoped to strengthen co-operation with the Ministry of Education to encourage more top-tier Mainland higher education and research institutions to set up a presence there. The two sides also discussed thriving higher education exchanges in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, including teacher training, digital education and patriotic education.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日會見教育部部長懷進鵬，就深化教育合作交流交換意見。教育局局長蔡若蓮同行政長官辦公室主任葉文娟亦有出席。李家超歡迎懷進鵬訪港，話香港有5間大學躋身全球百強，教育競爭力名列世界前茅；特區政府正全力落實香港首份五年計劃，將香港打造成國際高端人才集聚高地，並透過「留學香港專責小組」吸納全球優秀學生來港升學，今年仲推出咗首屆「留學香港周」。佢又話，香港正加速發展北部都會區，以大學城為發展重心，集教育、科技、產業、人才、城建五大要素，希望同教育部加強合作，鼓勵更多內地頂尖高等院校同科研機構落戶北都，將頂尖學術科研力量同本地院校優勢結合，促進更多創科成果轉化落實，實現優勢互補、互利共贏。雙方亦談到大灣區高等教育交流合作蓬勃，包括師資培訓、數字教育同愛國主義教育等領域。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日会见教育部部长怀进鹏，就深化教育合作交流交换意见。教育局局长蔡若莲同行政长官办公室主任叶文娟亦有出席。李家超欢迎怀进鹏访港，说香港有5间大学跻身全球百强，教育竞争力名列世界前茅；特区政府正全力落实香港首份五年计划，将香港打造成国际高端人才集聚高地，并透过「留学香港专责小组」吸纳全球优秀学生来港升学，今年还推出了首届「留学香港周」。他又说，香港正加速发展北部都会区，以大学城为发展重心，集教育、科技、产业、人才、城建五大要素，希望同教育部加强合作，鼓励更多内地顶尖高等院校同科研机构落户北都，将顶尖学术科研力量同本地院校优势结合，促进更多创科成果转化落实，实现优势互补、互利共赢。双方亦谈到大湾区高等教育交流合作蓬勃，包括师资培训、数字教育同爱国主义教育等领域。
