title.en: LegCo transport panel tours Central Kowloon Bypass ahead of December 6 full opening
title.zh_hant: 立法會交通事務委員會視察中九龍繞道　九龍灣段12月6日通車
title.zh_hans: 立法会交通事务委员会视察中九龙绕道　九龙湾段12月6日通车

summary.en: The Legislative Council Panel on Transport visited the Central Kowloon Bypass (Kowloon Bay Section) on Monday to learn about the latest progress before commissioning, accompanied by Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan, with 18 Members and non-Members taking part. Members received a briefing at the Tseung Kwan O - Lam Tin Tunnel Administration Building and toured the Tunnel Control Centre to see how traffic inside the tunnel is monitored through CCTV and automatic incident detection systems. The Central Kowloon Bypass (Yau Ma Tei Section) was commissioned last December, and the remaining Kowloon Bay Section will open on December 6 this year. The 3.4-kilometre Kowloon Bay Section links the Tseung Kwan O-Lam Tin Tunnel and the Yau Ma Tei Section to form Route 6, connecting Yau Ma Tei, Kai Tak and Tseung Kwan O with a fixed toll of HK$8. Peak-hour journey time between Tseung Kwan O and Yau Ma Tei is expected to fall sharply from 65 minutes to 12 minutes. Members asked the Government to step up publicity before commissioning and closely monitor traffic in the initial stage.
summary.zh_hant: 立法會交通事務委員會今日視察中九龍繞道（九龍灣段），了解通車前嘅最新進展同隧道工程挑戰。運輸及物流局局長陳美寶陪同，一共有18位委員同非委員參與。委員先喺將軍澳—藍田隧道行政大樓聽取簡介，參觀隧道控制中心，了解點樣透過閉路電視同自動事故偵測系統監察隧道內交通；其後視察九龍灣段嘅出入口同隧道管，了解連接藍田交匯處同啟德嘅行車安排，以及海底隧道施工挑戰。中九龍繞道（油麻地段）已於去年12月通車，九龍灣段將於今年12月6日通車。全長3.4公里嘅九龍灣段連接將藍隧道同油麻地段，形成6號幹線，貫通油麻地、啟德、將軍澳等多區，固定收費8元；繁忙時間將軍澳往油麻地嘅行車時間，預計由過去65分鐘大幅縮短到12分鐘。委員要求政府喺通車前加強公眾宣傳，並密切監察通車初期嘅交通情況。
summary.zh_hans: 立法会交通事务委员会今日视察中九龙绕道（九龙湾段），了解通车前的最新进展同隧道工程挑战。运输及物流局局长陈美宝陪同，一共有18位委员同非委员参与。委员先在将军澳—蓝田隧道行政大楼听取简介，参观隧道控制中心，了解点样透过闭路电视同自动事故侦测系统监察隧道内交通；其后视察九龙湾段的出入口同隧道管，了解连接蓝田交汇处同启德的行车安排，以及海底隧道施工挑战。中九龙绕道（油麻地段）已于去年12月通车，九龙湾段将于今年12月6日通车。全长3.4公里的九龙湾段连接将蓝隧道同油麻地段，形成6号干线，贯通油麻地、启德、将军澳等多区，固定收费8元；繁忙时间将军澳往油麻地的行车时间，预计由过去65分钟大幅缩短到12分钟。委员要求政府在通车前加强公众宣传，并密切监察通车初期的交通情况。

image_caption: 立法會交通事務委員會今日視察中九龍繞道（九龍灣段），了解通車前嘅最新進展。（政府新聞處）

title.en: HKMA advances Project Ensemble pilot to 24x7 settlement in tokenised central bank money
title.zh_hant: 金管局推「Ensemble」新階段　代幣化央行貨幣全天候結算
title.zh_hans: 金管局推「Ensemble」新阶段　代币化央行货币全天候结算

summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced on Monday that EnsembleTX, the pilot phase of Project Ensemble, has entered a new chapter supporting interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions in tokenised Central Bank Money (CeBM) on a 24x7 basis. Participating banks and industry pioneers have increased to 12 and 20 respectively. The new capability lets banks and pioneers settle tokenised transactions in a timely manner beyond conventional operating hours, meeting the needs of an increasingly global, always-on digital financial market. EnsembleTX was launched in November 2025, initially using the HKD Real Time Gross Settlement system for interbank settlement, enabling real-value transactions involving tokenised deposits and digital assets in a controlled pilot environment. The HKMA will continue working with the Securities and Futures Commission on a supportive, co-ordinated environment for the tokenised financial ecosystem. HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue said Project Ensemble has moved from experimentation and piloting in just two years to a new phase focused on commercialising tokenisation applications in Hong Kong, adding that the commercialisation of tokenised deposits and digital assets is expected to gain momentum.
summary.zh_hant: 金管局今日宣布，「Ensemble」項目嘅先導階段 EnsembleTX 進入新階段，支援代幣化存款交易以代幣化央行貨幣（CeBM）作銀行間結算，全天候24x7運作；參與銀行同行業先行者分別增至12間同20間。金管局話，新功能令參與銀行同先行者可以喺傳統營運時間以外，及時結算代幣化交易，應對愈嚟愈全球化、全天候運作嘅數字金融市場需求。EnsembleTX 於2025年11月推出，初期透過港元即時支付結算（RTGS）系統作代幣化存款交易嘅銀行間結算，喺受控先導環境下進行涉及代幣化存款同數字資產嘅真實價值交易。金管局將繼續同證監會緊密合作，促進有利代幣化金融生態及相關市場基建發展嘅環境。總裁余偉文話，「Ensemble」項目喺短短兩年內由實驗同先導，過渡到推動代幣化應用商業化嘅新階段；隨住全球銀行紛紛推出代幣化存款，代幣化存款同數字資產嘅商業化勢頭預料會加快。
summary.zh_hans: 金管局今日宣布，「Ensemble」项目的先导阶段 EnsembleTX 进入新阶段，支援代币化存款交易以代币化央行货币（CeBM）作银行间结算，全天候24x7运作；参与银行同行业先行者分别增至12间同20间。金管局说，新功能令参与银行同先行者可以在传统营运时间以外，及时结算代币化交易，应对愈嚟愈全球化、全天候运作的数字金融市场需求。EnsembleTX 于2025年11月推出，初期透过港元即时支付结算（RTGS）系统作代币化存款交易的银行间结算，在受控先导环境下进行涉及代币化存款同数字资产的真实价值交易。金管局将继续同证监会紧密合作，促进有利代币化金融生态及相关市场基建发展的环境。总裁余伟文说，「Ensemble」项目在短短两年内由实验同先导，过渡到推动代币化应用商业化的新阶段；随住全球银行纷纷推出代币化存款，代币化存款同数字资产的商业化势头预料会加快。

title.en: HKMA launches Project SAGE for agentic finance governance
title.zh_hant: 金管局推 Project SAGE　規管 AI 代理金融兼設專家組
title.zh_hans: 金管局推 Project SAGE　规管 AI 代理金融兼设专家组

summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced on Monday the launch of Project SAGE (Securing Agentic Finance with Governance and Enablement) to support the responsible development and adoption of agentic finance in Hong Kong, and established the Agentic Finance Expert Group, comprising financial institutions, technology service providers, professional service firms and academia. The HKMA said that as agentic AI technologies mature, the industry is moving beyond internal adoption to explore how AI agents can make financial services more efficient and secure, a paradigm known as agentic finance with the potential to transform customer engagement. Project SAGE focuses on four areas: market development and use-case exploration (B2C agentic commerce and everyday payments, B2B procurement and treasury management, and machine-to-machine usage-based payments); agent identity, including Know Your Agent practices; interoperability standards; and legal and regulatory frameworks covering governance, liability and consumer protection. Chief Executive Eddie Yue said the initiatives aim to foster innovation while reinforcing Hong Kong's leading role in next-generation financial technology, ensuring agentic finance serves users' best interests and safeguards financial system stability.
summary.zh_hant: 金管局今日宣布推出 Project SAGE（Securing Agentic Finance with Governance and Enablement），支持「代理金融」（agentic finance）喺香港負責任發展同應用，並成立「代理金融專家組」，成員包括金融機構、科技服務供應商、專業服務公司同大學。金管局指，隨著代理式人工智能技術成熟，金融業正由內部應用，發展到探索 AI 代理點樣令金融服務更有效率、更安全，呢個新範式就係「代理金融」，有潛力改變客戶同金融服務嘅互動方式。Project SAGE 聚焦四大範疇：市場發展同用例探索，包括 B2C 代理商務同日常支付、B2B 採購同財資管理、機器對機器按用量收費等；代理身份，探索驗證 AI 代理身份同授權嘅方法，包括「認識你嘅 AI 代理」（KYA）做法；互操作性標準；法律同監管框架，包括管治安排、責任、消費者保障。總裁余偉文話，希望喺促進創新嘅同時，鞏固香港喺下一代金融科技嘅領導地位，確保代理金融服務用戶最佳利益，並保障金融體系穩定。
summary.zh_hans: 金管局今日宣布推出 Project SAGE（Securing Agentic Finance with Governance and Enablement），支持「代理金融」（agentic finance）在香港负责任发展同应用，并成立「代理金融专家组」，成员包括金融机构、科技服务供应商、专业服务公司同大学。金管局指，随着代理式人工智能技术成熟，金融业正由内部应用，发展到探索 AI 代理点样令金融服务更有效率、更安全，这个新范式就是「代理金融」，有潜力改变客户同金融服务的互动方式。Project SAGE 聚焦四大范畴：市场发展同用例探索，包括 B2C 代理商务同日常支付、B2B 采购同财资管理、机器对机器按用量收费等；代理身份，探索验证 AI 代理身份同授权的方法，包括「认识你的 AI 代理」（KYA）做法；互操作性标准；法律同监管框架，包括管治安排、责任、消费者保障。总裁余伟文说，希望在促进创新的同时，巩固香港在下一代金融科技的领导地位，确保代理金融服务用户最佳利益，并保障金融体系稳定。

title.en: AFCD plants 30 'Corals of Hope' to mark 30th anniversary of marine parks
title.zh_hant: 海岸公園30周年　漁護署種30株「希望珊瑚」護海洋生態
title.zh_hans: 海岸公园30周年　渔护署种30株「希望珊瑚」护海洋生态

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department held a "Corals of Hope" planting ceremony on Monday, planting 30 corals at Hoi Ha Wan Marine Park with members of the community to celebrate the 30th anniversary of marine parks. Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan, officiating at the ceremony, said coral communities are a precious natural asset of Hong Kong; over 30 years, marine parks have protected marine habitats and served as important venues for scientific research and public education. Hong Kong has recorded more than 80 species of hard corals, about one-tenth of global species, of remarkably high ecological value. Since the first batch of marine parks and a marine reserve were established in 1996, Hong Kong now has eight marine parks and one marine reserve totalling 8,517 hectares. The "Corals of Hope" were propagated in local laboratories and transplanted to Hoi Ha Wan, where water quality is excellent. The AFCD is also pressing ahead with designating Sharp Island Marine Park, and will continue expanding the marine protected area network in an orderly manner under the goals of Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan (2026-2030).
summary.zh_hant: 漁農自然護理署今日舉行「希望珊瑚」種植儀式，聯同市民喺海下灣海岸公園種植30株「希望珊瑚」，慶祝海岸公園成立30周年。主禮嘅環境及生態局局長謝展寰話，珊瑚群落係香港珍貴嘅自然資產；海岸公園30年嚟唔單止保護海洋生境，亦係重要嘅科研同公眾教育場所。漁護署話，香港錄得超過80種石珊瑚，佔全球種類約一成，生態價值極高；自1996年設立首批海岸公園同海岸保護區，現有8個海岸公園同1個海岸保護區，總面積8,517公頃。今次種植嘅「希望珊瑚」喺本地實驗室繁殖，再移植到水質優良嘅海下灣海岸公園。漁護署亦正推進指定橋咀洲海岸公園，保護橋咀洲東西兩岸嘅重要珊瑚群落；未來會繼續按《香港首份五年計劃（2026-2030）》嘅目標，有序擴展海洋保護區網絡。
summary.zh_hans: 渔农自然护理署今日举行「希望珊瑚」种植仪式，联同市民在海下湾海岸公园种植30株「希望珊瑚」，庆祝海岸公园成立30周年。主礼的环境及生态局局长谢展寰说，珊瑚群落是香港珍贵的自然资产；海岸公园30年来不单止保护海洋生境，亦是重要的科研同公众教育场所。渔护署说，香港录得超过80种石珊瑚，占全球种类约一成，生态价值极高；自1996年设立首批海岸公园同海岸保护区，现有8个海岸公园同1个海岸保护区，总面积8,517公顷。这次种植的「希望珊瑚」在本地实验室繁殖，再移植到水质优良的海下湾海岸公园。渔护署亦正推进指定桥咀洲海岸公园，保护桥咀洲东西两岸的重要珊瑚群落；未来会继续按《香港首份五年计划（2026-2030）》的目标，有序扩展海洋保护区网络。

image_caption: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰今日出席海岸公園30周年「希望珊瑚」種植儀式。（政府新聞處）

title.en: John Lee welcomes UNIDROIT Asia-Pacific Liaison Office opening in Hong Kong
title.zh_hant: 李家超法律周演辭：歡迎國際統一私法協會亞太聯絡處落戶香港
title.zh_hans: 李家超法律周演辞：欢迎国际统一私法协会亚太联络处落户香港

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee delivered a speech at Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 on Monday, celebrating the centenary of the International Institute for the Unification of Private Law (UNIDROIT) and the opening of its first office outside its Rome seat — the Asia-Pacific Liaison Office in Hong Kong. Lee said it was a day of double celebration, honouring 100 years of UNIDROIT's contribution to the modernisation and harmonisation of private law, while witnessing a new chapter for the organisation in Asia's world city. He said the Liaison Office will serve as a focal point for enhanced engagement with member states and stakeholders in the region and play a crucial role in UNIDROIT's legislative and institutional work. Lee stressed that Hong Kong, as the only common-law jurisdiction in China, has a robust rule of law and deep pool of legal talent, noting the 2026 World Justice Project Rule of Law Index ranked Hong Kong sixth in East Asia and the Pacific, with "Absence of Corruption" and "Order and Security" staying in the global top 10. The Liaison Office can also co-operate with other international organisations headquartered here, such as the International Organization for Mediation. Hong Kong Legal Week runs for five days, also featuring the second Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Lawyers Forum and the third Asia-Pacific International Private Law Summit.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日喺香港法律周2026發表演辭，慶祝國際統一私法協會（UNIDROIT）成立100周年，以及協會首個設於羅馬總部以外嘅亞太聯絡處喺香港開幕。李家超話，今日係雙重慶祝：既紀念 UNIDROIT 過去100年為私法現代化同統一化作出嘅非凡貢獻，亦見證亞太聯絡處落戶「亞洲國際都會」香港。佢話，亞太聯絡處將成為加強同區內成員國及持份者聯繫嘅樞紐，喺 UNIDROIT 嘅立法同制度工作發揮關鍵作用。李家超強調，香港係中國境內唯一實行普通法嘅司法管轄區，擁有穩固法治同深厚法律人才庫；2026年世界正義工程法治指數將香港列為東亞及太平洋第六，「無貪污」及「秩序與安全」維持全球頭十。聯絡處亦可同早前落戶香港嘅國際調解院等國際組織合作。法律周為期五日，仲包括第二屆粵港澳大灣區律師論壇同第三屆亞太國際私法峰會。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日在香港法律周2026发表演辞，庆祝国际统一私法协会（UNIDROIT）成立100周年，以及协会首个设于罗马总部以外的亚太联络处在香港开幕。李家超说，今日是双重庆祝：既纪念 UNIDROIT 过去100年为私法现代化同统一化作出的非凡贡献，亦见证亚太联络处落户「亚洲国际都会」香港。他说，亚太联络处将成为加强同区内成员国及持份者联系的枢纽，在 UNIDROIT 的立法同制度工作发挥关键作用。李家超强调，香港是中国境内唯一实行普通法的司法管辖区，拥有稳固法治同深厚法律人才库；2026年世界正义工程法治指数将香港列为东亚及太平洋第六，「无贪污」及「秩序与安全」维持全球头十。联络处亦可同早前落户香港的国际调解院等国际组织合作。法律周为期五日，还包括第二届粤港澳大湾区律师论坛同第三届亚太国际私法峰会。

image_caption: 行政長官李家超今日喺香港法律周2026發表演辭，慶祝國際統一私法協會成立100周年及亞太聯絡處開幕。（政府新聞處）

title.en: LegCo to resume second reading of crypto-asset reporting bill on Wednesday
title.zh_hant: 立法會周三復會　二讀《加密資產申報框架》條例草案
title.zh_hans: 立法会周三复会　二读《加密资产申报框架》条例草案

summary.en: The Legislative Council will hold a meeting at 11am on Wednesday (November 4) at the LegCo Complex, resuming the Second Reading debate on the Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Bill 2026. If supported by Members, the Bill will be committed to the committee of the whole Council and set down for Third Reading after consideration. On Members' motions, Christine Fong will move a motion on "Combating bid-rigging and promoting the criminalization of bid-rigging", with Ray Wong, Chris Ip and Joephy Chan moving separate amendments; Chan Cho-kwong will move a motion on "Adhering to the principle of 'ageing in place as the core' for the building of an elderly-friendly community"; and Lau Chi-pang will move a proposed resolution to extend the period for amending subsidiary legislation. Members will also ask the Government 22 questions, six requiring oral replies.
summary.zh_hant: 立法會星期三（11月4日）上午11點喺立法會綜合大樓大會堂舉行會議，將恢復二讀辯論《2026年稅務（修訂）（加密資產申報框架及經修訂共同申報準則）條例草案》。草案如獲議員支持通過二讀，將交全體委員會審議，再進行三讀。同日，方國珊議員會動議「打擊圍標及推動圍標刑事化」議案，黃錦輝、葉傲冬、陳月明議員會分別動議修正案；陳凱榮議員會動議「以居家安老為核心建設長者友善社區」議案；劉智鵬教授會動議延長修訂附屬法例期限嘅擬議決議。議員亦會向政府提出22條質詢，當中6條要求口頭答覆。
summary.zh_hans: 立法会星期三（11月4日）上午11点在立法会综合大楼大会堂举行会议，将恢复二读辩论《2026年税务（修订）（加密资产申报框架及经修订共同申报准则）条例草案》。草案如获议员支持通过二读，将交全体委员会审议，再进行三读。同日，方国珊议员会动议「打击围标及推动围标刑事化」议案，黄锦辉、叶傲冬、陈月明议员会分别动议修正案；陈凯荣议员会动议「以居家安老为核心建设长者友善社区」议案；刘智鹏教授会动议延长修订附属法例期限的拟议决议。议员亦会向政府提出22条质询，当中6条要求口头答覆。

title.en: Hong Kong Response Exhibition to Venice Architecture Biennale opens in Causeway Bay and Central
title.zh_hant: 威尼斯建築雙年展香港回應展開幕　展出本港經典複合建築
title.zh_hans: 威尼斯建筑双年展香港回应展开幕　展出本港经典复合建筑

summary.en: Sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency, the Hong Kong Response Exhibition to the Hong Kong Exhibition at Biennale Architettura 2025 in Venice runs from today to November 15 at Urban Sky, Hysan Place in Causeway Bay and Knotting Space, H Queen's in Central, featuring around 30 sets of exhibits. Themed 'Projecting Future Heritage', the roving exhibition is the last stop of the series after Venice, Bangkok and Shanghai, showcasing Hong Kong's lesser-known yet classic composite buildings, multifunctional market complexes, co-op housing and public housing estates. Commissioner for Cultural and Creative Industries Drew Lai said the Government has supported the city's participation since 2010 to promote Hong Kong's architectural culture internationally.
summary.zh_hant: 由文創產業發展處贊助、香港建築師學會雙年展基金會主辦嘅「威尼斯建築雙年展2025香港展覽回應展」，今日起至11月15號喺銅鑼灣希慎廣場 Urban Sky 同中環 H Queen's Knotting Space 舉行，展出約30組展品。今屆巡迴展主題係「投射未來遺產」，繼威尼斯、曼谷、上海之後，香港係最後一站，聚焦本港較少人認識但經典嘅複合建築、多用途街市綜合體、合作社樓宇、公共屋邨同街道基建。文創產業專員劉茵婷話，政府自2010年起支持香港建築界參與威尼斯建築雙年展，向國際推廣香港建築文化。
summary.zh_hans: 由文创产业发展处赞助、香港建筑师学会双年展基金会主办的「威尼斯建筑双年展2025香港展览回应展」，今日起至11月15号在铜锣湾希慎广场 Urban Sky 和中环 H Queen's Knotting Space 举行，展出约30组展品。今届巡回展主题是「投射未来遗产」，继威尼斯、曼谷、上海之后，香港是最后一站，聚焦本港较少人认识但经典的复合建筑、多用途街市综合体、合作社楼宇、公共屋邨和街道基建。文创产业专员刘茵婷说，政府自2010年起支持香港建筑界参与威尼斯建筑双年展，向国际推广香港建筑文化。

image_caption: 威尼斯建築雙年展香港回應展今日起喺銅鑼灣同中環舉行，展出約30組展品。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Hong Kong Customs seizes 5.1kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport; Mainland man arrested
title.zh_hant: 海關機場截獲5.1公斤懷疑大麻花　42歲內地男被捕
title.zh_hans: 海关机场截获5.1公斤怀疑大麻花　42岁内地男被捕

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs detected a drug trafficking case at Hong Kong International Airport today, seizing about 5.1 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds, three types of products containing suspected Part I poison, and 261 duty-not-paid cigarettes, with an estimated market value of about HK$1.06 million. A 42-year-old Mainland male passenger who arrived from Bangkok was arrested after the items were found in his carry-on baggage. He has been charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug, possession of dutiable goods and possession of Part I poison, and will appear at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts tomorrow.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關今日喺香港國際機場偵破一宗販毒案，檢獲約5.1公斤懷疑大麻花、三款含懷疑第I部毒藥嘅產品，同261支未完稅香煙，估計市值約106萬元。一名42歲由曼谷抵港嘅內地男乘客，喺手提行李被搜出呢批物品後被捕。被捕男子被控販運危險藥物、管有應課稅品同管有第I部毒藥等罪名，聽日喺西九龍裁判法院提堂。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关今日在香港国际机场侦破一宗贩毒案，检获约5.1公斤怀疑大麻花、三款含怀疑第I部毒药的产品，和261支未完税香烟，估计市值约106万元。一名42岁由曼谷抵港的内地男乘客，在手提行李被搜出这批物品后被捕。被捕男子被控贩运危险药物、管有应课税品和管有第I部毒药等罪名，明日在西九龙裁判法院提堂。

image_caption: 海關喺機場檢獲約5.1公斤懷疑大麻花等物品，估計市值約106萬元。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Learjet 60 crashes into Florida neighborhood, killing all nine aboard
title.zh_hant: 佛州商務機墮住宅區起火　機上9人全部罹難
title.zh_hans: 佛州商务机坠住宅区起火　机上9人全部罹难

summary.en: A Learjet 60 business jet crashed into a suburban neighbourhood in Greenacres, Palm Beach County, Florida, on Sunday afternoon, killing all nine people on board. The aircraft had departed Austin, Texas, and was bound for the Bahamas when it went into a steep dive and erupted into a fireball near a mobile home community. No ground casualties were confirmed, though about 600 residents were evacuated from the area. US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed the deaths, and the FAA and NTSB have opened a joint investigation, with a briefing expected on Monday.
summary.zh_hant: 一架 Learjet 60 商務機星期日下晝墮毀喺美國佛羅里達州棕櫚灘縣 Greenacres 住宅區，機上9人全部罹難。架機由德州奧斯汀起飛，原定前往巴哈馬，中途急劇俯衝，墮地後起火爆炸，喺流動房屋社區附近造成一個大坑。地面暫時未有傷亡報告，約600名居民要疏散。美國運輸部長達菲確認死訊，聯邦航空局同國家運輸安全委員會已展開聯合調查，預計星期一交代詳情。
summary.zh_hans: 一架 Learjet 60 商务机星期日下午坠毁在美国佛罗里达州棕榈滩县 Greenacres 住宅区，机上9人全部罹难。该机由得州奥斯汀起飞，原定前往巴哈马，中途急剧俯冲，坠地后起火爆炸，在流动房屋社区附近造成一个大坑。地面暂时未有伤亡报告，约600名居民要疏散。美国运输部长达菲确认死讯，联邦航空局和国家运输安全委员会已展开联合调查，预计星期一交代详情。

title.en: Paul Chan: drawing on widest talent pool makes financial sector stronger
title.zh_hant: 陳茂波：吸納最廣泛人才　令金融業更強大
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：吸纳最广泛人才　令金融业更强大

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan delivered the keynote speech at the Women Chief Executives Summit 2026 today under the theme 'Female Voices of Impact and Innovation'. Chan said building institutions that succeed through uncertainty requires drawing on the widest possible pool of talent and managing capital with a long-term perspective. He noted that for the first time, the CEOs of both the Securities and Futures Commission and HKEX are women, and cited a study finding women hold 45 per cent of senior leadership roles in the financial institutions surveyed, up from 34 per cent in 2018.
summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波今日喺女行政總裁高峰會2026發表主題演辭，今屆主題係「Female Voices of Impact and Innovation」。陳茂波話，要建立能夠喺不明朗環境下成功嘅機構，關鍵係吸納最廣泛嘅人才同以長遠眼光管理資本。佢指出，證監會同港交所行政總裁歷史上首次同時由女性出任；一項研究亦顯示，受訪金融機構女性高層佔比由2018年嘅34%升至45%。
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波今日在女行政总裁高峰会2026发表主题演辞，今届主题是「Female Voices of Impact and Innovation」。陈茂波说，要建立能够在不明朗环境下成功的机构，关键是吸纳最广泛的人才和以长远眼光管理资本。他指出，证监会和港交所行政总裁历史上首次同时由女性出任；一项研究亦显示，受访金融机构女性高层占比由2018年的34%升至45%。

image_caption: 財政司司長陳茂波今日喺女行政總裁高峰會2026發表主題演辭。（政府新聞處）

title.en: HKMA and HKUST launch Post-Quantum Cryptography Toolkit for banks
title.zh_hant: 金管局聯同科大推後量子密碼工具包　助銀行應對量子運算威脅
title.zh_hans: 金管局联同科大推后量子密码工具包　助银行应对量子运算威胁

summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology today launched the Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Toolkit to help banks plan and advance their transition to quantum-safe cryptography. The toolkit provides governance guidance, cryptographic exposure assessment, transition planning tools and implementation monitoring. The move follows the HKMA's Quantum Preparedness Index launched in July 2026, which scored the banking sector 2.3 out of 10, indicating early-stage readiness for the quantum era.
summary.zh_hant: 金管局同香港科技大學今日推出「後量子密碼工具包」，協助銀行規劃同推進過渡到抗量子密碼技術。工具包涵蓋管治指引、密碼暴露評估、過渡規劃工具同實施進度監察。今次係跟進金管局今年7月推出嘅「量子準備指數」，當時銀行業得分2.3分（滿分10分），顯示量子時代準備工作只係起步階段。
summary.zh_hans: 金管局和香港科技大学今日推出「后量子密码工具包」，协助银行规划和推进过渡到抗量子密码技术。工具包涵盖管治指引、密码暴露评估、过渡规划工具和实施进度监察。今次是跟进金管局今年7月推出的「量子准备指数」，当时银行业得分2.3分（满分10分），显示量子时代准备工作只是起步阶段。

title.en: 341 Japanese aquatic food samples tested for radiation, all pass safety limits
title.zh_hant: 食安中心檢測341個日本水產樣本輻射水平　全部合格
title.zh_hans: 食安中心检测341个日本水产样本辐射水平　全部合格

summary.en: The Centre for Food Safety conducted radiological tests on 341 food samples of aquatic and related products, seaweeds and sea salt imported from Japan between noon on October 30 and noon today, and none exceeded the safety limit. The Food Safety Order prohibiting aquatic products, sea salt and seaweeds from 10 Japanese metropolises and prefectures remains in force. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department also tested 150 local catch samples, all of which passed.
summary.zh_hant: 食物安全中心喺10月30號中午至今日中午期間，為341個由日本進口嘅水產及相關產品、海藻同海鹽樣本做輻射檢測，冇樣本超標。禁止10個都縣水產、海鹽同海藻進口嘅《食物安全命令》繼續生效。漁護署亦為150個本地漁獲樣本做輻射檢測，全部合格。
summary.zh_hans: 食物安全中心在10月30号中午至今日中午期间，为341个由日本进口的水产及相关产品、海藻和海盐样本做辐射检测，没样本超标。禁止10个都县水产、海盐和海藻进口的《食物安全命令》继续生效。渔护署亦为150个本地渔获样本做辐射检测，全部合格。

title.en: Six new community-acquired Legionnaires' disease cases recorded in a week
title.zh_hant: 一星期錄6宗社區感染退伍軍人病　今年累計169宗
title.zh_hans: 一星期录6宗社区感染退伍军人病　今年累计169宗

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection today reported six new community-acquired Legionnaires' disease cases recorded between October 25 and 31, involving six men aged 48 to 78. Investigations are under way and the cases are so far sporadic, with no epidemiological linkages established. As of October 31, 169 cases had been recorded this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024. The CHP reminded the public to properly use and maintain man-made water systems, and advised susceptible groups to observe precautions strictly.
summary.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心今日公布，10月25至31號期間錄得6宗社區感染退伍軍人病個案，涉及6名48至78歲男子。中心正調查感染源頭，初步顯示屬散發個案，未發現流行病學關連。截至10月31號，今年累計錄得169宗，2025年同2024年分別有167宗同135宗。防護中心提醒市民正確使用同保養人造供水系統，易感群組要嚴格遵守預防措施。
summary.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心今日公布，10月25至31号期间录得6宗社区感染退伍军人病个案，涉及6名48至78岁男子。中心正调查感染源头，初步显示属散发个案，未发现流行病学关连。截至10月31号，今年累计录得169宗，2025年和2024年分别有167宗和135宗。防护中心提醒市民正确使用和保养人造供水系统，易感群组要严格遵守预防措施。

title.en: CHP investigating confirmed Mpox case involving 33-year-old man
title.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心調查一宗猴痘確診個案　33歲男病人情況穩定
title.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心调查一宗猴痘确诊个案　33岁男病人情况稳定

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a confirmed Mpox case involving a 33-year-old man who developed a genital rash on October 21 that later spread to his chest and limbs, followed by fever. He sought treatment at North District Hospital on October 30 and was admitted for isolation; he is in stable condition. Laboratory testing confirmed the Monkeypox virus. The patient reported high-risk exposure with a man in Hong Kong during the incubation period. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 118 Mpox cases, all male.
summary.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗猴痘確診個案，涉及一名33歲男子。病人10月21號起喺生殖器範圍出疹，之後蔓延到胸口同四肢，再發燒；10月30號去北區醫院求醫並入院隔離，情況穩定，化驗證實感染猴痘病毒。病人話潛伏期內喺香港同男子有高風險接觸。自2022年起，本港累計錄得118宗猴痘個案，全部係男性。
summary.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心正调查一宗猴痘确诊个案，涉及一名33岁男子。病人10月21号起在生殖器范围出疹，之后蔓延到胸口和四肢，再发烧；10月30号去北区医院求医并入院隔离，情况稳定，化验证实感染猴痘病毒。病人说潜伏期内在香港和男子有高风险接触。自2022年起，本港累计录得118宗猴痘个案，全部是男性。

title.en: HKMA alerts public to fraudulent websites impersonating Octopus
title.zh_hant: 金管局籲提防假冒八達通欺詐網站　切勿經連結登入
title.zh_hans: 金管局吁提防假冒八达通欺诈网站　切勿经链接登入

summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority today alerted the public to fraudulent websites reported by Octopus Cards Limited. The HKMA reminded the public that banks will not send SMS or emails with embedded hyperlinks directing customers to carry out transactions, nor ask for login passwords or one-time passwords by phone, email or SMS. Anyone who has provided personal information or conducted transactions through the scams should contact the relevant bank and report to the Police's Crime Wing Information Centre at 2860 5012.
summary.zh_hant: 金管局今日提醒市民，提防八達通卡有限公司舉報嘅欺詐網站。金管局重申，銀行唔會透過短訊或電郵夾附超連結要求客戶進行交易，亦唔會用電話、電郵或短訊索取登入密碼或一次性密碼。市民如果曾經喺呢啲網站提供個人資料或進行交易，應該聯絡相關銀行，並向警方商業罪案調查科情報中心（2860 5012）報案。
summary.zh_hans: 金管局今日提醒市民，提防八达通卡有限公司举报的欺诈网站。金管局重申，银行不会透过短讯或电邮夹附超连结要求客户进行交易，亦不会用电话、电邮或短讯索取登入密码或一次性密码。市民如果曾经在这些网站提供个人资料或进行交易，应该联络相关银行，并向警方商业罪案调查科情报中心（2860 5012）报案。

title.en: Hong Kong suspends poultry imports from Washington's Kittitas County over H5N1 outbreak
title.zh_hant: 華盛頓州基帝塔斯縣爆H5N1禽流感　本港即時暫停進口當地禽肉禽蛋
title.zh_hans: 华盛顿州基帝塔斯县爆H5N1禽流感　本港即时暂停进口当地禽肉禽蛋

summary.en: The Centre for Food Safety today instructed the trade to suspend with immediate effect the import of poultry meat and products, including eggs, from Kittitas County, Washington, US, following a World Organisation for Animal Health notification of a highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza outbreak there. In the first nine months of this year, Hong Kong imported about 33,270 tonnes of chilled and frozen poultry meat and 92.33 million poultry eggs from the US. The CFS said it has contacted the US authorities and will monitor the situation closely.
summary.zh_hant: 食物安全中心今日宣布，因應世界動物衞生組織通報美國華盛頓州基帝塔斯縣爆發高致病性H5N1禽流感，即時指示業界暫停進口當地禽肉同禽肉產品（包括禽蛋）。今年首9個月，本港由美國進口約33,270噸冰鮮冷藏禽肉同9,233萬隻禽蛋。食安中心話已聯絡美國當局，會密切監察禽流感疫情發展。
summary.zh_hans: 食物安全中心今日宣布，因应世界动物卫生组织通报美国华盛顿州基帝塔斯县爆发高致病性H5N1禽流感，即时指示业界暂停进口当地禽肉和禽肉产品（包括禽蛋）。今年首9个月，本港由美国进口约33,270吨冰鲜冷藏禽肉和9,233万只禽蛋。食安中心说已联络美国当局，会密切监察禽流感疫情发展。

title.en: Seven-year-old girl in intensive care with severe influenza; CHP urges vaccination
title.zh_hant: 7歲女童染流感重症入深切治療部　衞生防護中心籲盡早打針
title.zh_hans: 7岁女童染流感重症入深切治疗部　卫生防护中心吁尽早打针

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection today recorded a severe paediatric influenza case involving a 7-year-old girl with good past health. She developed fever, cough and malaise on October 27, was admitted to Kwong Wah Hospital on October 29, and was later transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit with respiratory distress. Her specimen tested positive for influenza A (H3). She had not received the seasonal influenza vaccine. A total of 29 severe paediatric influenza cases have been recorded this season; the CHP urged the public to get vaccinated as soon as possible.
summary.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心今日錄得一宗兒童流感重症個案，涉及一名7歲女童。女童本身健康良好，10月27號開始發燒、咳同周身唔舒服，10月29號入廣華醫院，病情惡化出現呼吸困難，轉入兒科深切治療部，呼吸道樣本對甲型流感（H3）呈陽性反應。佢冇接種季節性流感疫苗。今個流感季節累計錄得29宗兒童流感重症，防護中心呼籲市民盡早接種疫苗。
summary.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心今日录得一宗儿童流感重症个案，涉及一名7岁女童。女童本身健康良好，10月27号开始发烧、咳和周身不舒服，10月29号入广华医院，病情恶化出现呼吸困难，转入儿科深切治疗部，呼吸道样本对甲型流感（H3）呈阳性反应。她没接种季节性流感疫苗。今个流感季节累计录得29宗儿童流感重症，防护中心呼吁市民尽早接种疫苗。

title.en: Christopher Hui: data, tokenisation and AI are the three tools bridging fintech's future
title.zh_hant: 許正宇：數據、代幣化、AI係連接金融科技未來嘅三大工具
title.zh_hans: 许正宇：数据、代币化、AI是连接金融科技未来的三大工具

summary.en: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui told the 'FinTech Nexus: Where Data, Tokens and AI Converge' panel at Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK Festival 2026 that data, tokenisation and AI are the three tools bridging fintech's future. He announced an interbank tokenised gold transaction project under the HKMA's Project Ensemble, with a token representing a standard 400-ounce gold bar priced against Hong Kong's HAU gold reference price, plus tokenised deposits. The Stock Exchange will pilot blockchain-backed trading of tokenised carbon credits this year. Hui also said a bill to regulate advisory, dealing, custody and management of virtual assets will be introduced to LegCo before year-end.
summary.zh_hant: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇喺香港金融科技周x StartmeupHK 2026「FinTech Nexus」專題討論環節話，數據、代幣化同人工智能係連接金融科技未來嘅三大工具。佢宣布即將推出銀行同業代幣化黃金交易項目，喺金管局「Ensemble」項目下以代幣代表一條標準400安士金條，用香港黃金參考價HAU計價，另設代幣化存款。港交所今年會試行以區塊鏈為基礎嘅代幣化碳信用交易。許正宇亦話，年底前會向立法會提交規管虛擬資產諮詢、交易、託管同管理嘅條例草案。
summary.zh_hans: 财经事务及库务局局长许正宇在香港金融科技周x StartmeupHK 2026「FinTech Nexus」专题讨论环节说，数据、代币化和人工智能是连接金融科技未来的三大工具。他宣布即将推出银行同业代币化黄金交易项目，在金管局「Ensemble」项目下以代币代表一条标准400安士金条，用香港黄金参考价HAU计价，另设代币化存款。港交所今年会试行以区块链为基础的代币化碳信用交易。许正宇亦说，年底前会向立法会提交规管虚拟资产咨询、交易、托管和管理的条例草案。

image_caption: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇今日喺金融科技周專題討論環節致辭。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Tourism Strategy Committee holds seventh meeting; visitor arrivals hit post-pandemic record
title.zh_hant: 旅遊業策略委員會開第七次會議　首9個月訪港旅客4,070萬人次
title.zh_hans: 旅游业策略委员会开第七次会议　首9个月访港旅客4,070万人次

summary.en: The Tourism Strategy Committee, chaired by Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law, held its seventh meeting today to discuss tourism initiatives under Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address. Members backed plans to deepen '+tourism' experiences and develop Hong Kong into a core demonstration zone for multi-destination tourism. Visitor arrivals reached 40.7 million in the first nine months of 2026, up 12 per cent year on year, with August's 5.46 million setting a new post-pandemic monthly record; full-year arrivals are projected at 53.8 million.
summary.zh_hant: 由文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩主持嘅旅遊業策略委員會今日舉行第七次會議，討論《香港首份五年計劃》同2026年《施政報告》下嘅旅遊政策措施。委員支持深化「+旅遊」體驗，將香港打造成多程目的地旅遊核心示範區。今年首9個月訪港旅客達4,070萬人次，按年升12%，其中8月份546萬人次創疫後單月新高；預計全年訪港旅客可達5,380萬人次，相關旅遊總消費2,381億元。
summary.zh_hans: 由文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩主持的旅游业策略委员会今日举行第七次会议，讨论《香港首份五年计划》和2026年《施政报告》下的旅游政策措施。委员支持深化「+旅游」体验，将香港打造成多程目的地旅游核心示范区。今年首9个月访港旅客达4,070万人次，按年升12%，其中8月份546万人次创疫后单月新高；预计全年访港旅客可达5,380万人次，相关旅游总消费2,381亿元。

image_caption: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩今日主持旅遊業策略委員會第七次會議。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Wah Fu Estate redevelopment: first reception estate to complete late this year, rehousing done by Q3 2027
title.zh_hant: 華富邨重建最新進展　首個接收屋邨料今年底落成　2027年第三季完成調遷
title.zh_hans: 华富邨重建最新进展　首个接收屋邨料今年底落成　2027年第三季完成调迁

summary.en: The Housing Authority today briefed the Southern District Council on the latest progress of the clearance and rehousing plan for Wah Fu Estate redevelopment, winning general support for the proposed public housing at New Wah Fu Estate Phase 1. Construction at five reception sites in Pok Fu Lam South is proceeding in an orderly manner; the first, Wah Fu North Estate on Wah King Street, is expected to complete late this year, with residents of Wah On House and Wah Lok House moving in progressively. The entire rehousing is expected to conclude in the third quarter of 2027, followed by demolition.
summary.zh_hant: 房屋委員會今日向南區區議會匯報華富邨重建清拆同調遷計劃最新進展，並就華富邨第一期新公營房屋發展諮詢議員，獲得普遍支持。薄扶林南五個接收地盤工程進展順利，首個接收屋邨華景街華富北邨預計今年底落成，華安樓同華樂樓居民將陸續遷入。整個調遷程序預計2027年第三季完成，之後展開清拆工程。
summary.zh_hans: 房屋委员会今日向南区区议会汇报华富邨重建清拆和调迁计划最新进展，并就华富邨第一期新公营房屋发展咨询议员，获得普遍支持。薄扶林南五个接收地盘工程进展顺利，首个接收屋邨华景街华富北邨预计今年底落成，华安楼和华乐楼居民将陆续迁入。整个调迁程序预计2027年第三季完成，之后展开清拆工程。

title.en: Hong Kong joins 27th Shenzhen Reading Month with 30 events through December 5
title.zh_hant: 「港參與第27屆深圳讀書月」深圳開幕　約30項活動至12月5日
title.zh_hans: 「港参与第27届深圳读书月」深圳开幕　约30项活动至12月5日

summary.en: Hong Kong's participation in the 27th Shenzhen Reading Month opened in Shenzhen today, with the Hong Kong publishing industry staging around 30 events until December 5, including 'The World of Hong Kong Kung Fu' thematic exhibition and book fair, book fairs of selected Hong Kong publications, and a symposium on the historical walk in the Greater Bay Area. Presented by the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and implemented by the Hong Kong Publishing Federation, the programme aims to deepen publishing exchanges between the two cities. Commissioner for Cultural and Creative Industries Drew Lai said at the opening ceremony that this is the fourth consecutive year Hong Kong has joined the event in response to the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Co-Reading Consensus.
summary.zh_hant: 「港參與第27屆深圳讀書月」今日喺深圳開幕，香港出版業界由今日起至12月5日喺深圳舉辦約30項活動，包括「香港功夫世界」主題展覽暨書展、「香港優質圖書書展」同「粵港澳大灣區歷史文化行」研討會，促進兩地出版業交流合作。文化創意產業專員黎敏儀喺開幕禮致辭話，香港連續第四年參與深圳讀書月，響應「深港共讀共識」，推動大灣區閱讀氛圍。
summary.zh_hans: 「港参与第27届深圳读书月」今日在深圳开幕，香港出版业界由今日起至12月5日在深圳举办约30项活动，包括「香港功夫世界」主题展览暨书展、「香港优质图书书展」和「粤港澳大湾区历史文化行」研讨会，促进两地出版业交流合作。文化创意产业专员黎敏仪在开幕礼致辞说，香港连续第四年参与深圳读书月，响应「深港共读共识」，推动大湾区阅读氛围。

image_caption: 文化創意產業專員黎敏儀（右三）率領香港出版業界代表團出席第27屆深圳讀書月開幕典禮。（政府新聞處）

title.en: John Lee sets four expectations for youth at 2026 Hong Kong Scout Rally
title.zh_hant: 香港童軍大會操今早大球場舉行　李家超寄語青年四點期望
title.zh_hans: 香港童军大会操今早大球场举行　李家超寄语青年四点期望

summary.en: The 2026 Hong Kong Scout Rally was held at Hong Kong Stadium this morning, with more than 14,000 scouts taking part in the parade, reaffirmation of promise and inspection ceremony, which also featured the flag-raising and presentation of scout awards. Chief Executive John Lee, in his capacity as the Chief Scout of Hong Kong, delivered a speech setting out four expectations for young people: embrace the country, look to the world, strengthen their willpower, and serve others with joy. This year's rally carries the theme 'Together We Strive Together We Thrive'. The Scout Association of Hong Kong is the city's largest uniformed youth group, with more than 34,000 youth members.
summary.zh_hant: 「2026年香港童軍大會操」今早10時喺香港大球場舉行，超過1.4萬名童軍參與會操、覆誓同步操檢閱，儀式包括升國旗、頒發童軍獎勵等。以香港童軍總領袖身分出席嘅行政長官李家超致辭，對青年提出四點期望：胸懷家國、放眼世界、錘鍊意志、助人為樂。今年大會操主題係「百載傳承　同行未來」。香港童軍總會係本港規模最大嘅青少年制服團體，擁有超過3.4萬名青少年會員。
summary.zh_hans: 「2026年香港童军大会操」今早10时在香港大球场举行，超过1.4万名童军参与会操、覆誓和步操检阅，仪式包括升国旗、颁发童军奖励等。以香港童军总领袖身份出席的行政长官李家超致辞，对青年提出四点期望：胸怀家国、放眼世界、锤炼意志、助人为乐。今年大会操主题是「百载传承　同行未来」。香港童军总会是本港规模最大的青少年制服团体，拥有超过3.4万名青少年会员。

image_caption: 行政長官李家超今早喺香港大球場出席「2026年香港童軍大會操」並致辭。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Germany's Gen Z protests turn violent at night; 30 arrested in Frankfurt looting
title.zh_hant: 德國逾30城Z世代示威入夜變調　法蘭克福砸店搶掠30人被捕
title.zh_hans: 德国逾30城Z世代示威入夜变调　法兰克福砸店抢掠30人被捕

summary.en: Protests called by the youth initiative 'Gen Z regelt' swept more than 30 German cities on October 31, with organisers saying about 120,000 people took to the streets over education funding, the cost of living and environmental protection. Largely peaceful by day, the demonstrations turned violent after dark in several cities. In Frankfurt, masked rioters smashed shop windows and looted stores, including a gun shop; police deployed special units, water cannon and helicopters and had made about 30 arrests by Sunday morning. Rioting and vandalism were also reported in Cologne and Hamburg.
summary.zh_hant: 由青年倡議組織「Gen Z regelt（Z世代來做主）」發起嘅示威，喺10月31日席捲德國30多個城市，組織方話約12萬人上街，訴求包括增加教育經費、應對生活成本上漲同環境保護。示威日間大致和平，但入夜後喺多地演變成暴力騷亂：法蘭克福有蒙面暴徒砸爛多間商店櫥窗搶掠，包括一間武器店；警方出動特種部隊、水炮同直升機，截至周日凌晨拘捕約30人。科隆同漢堡亦有騷亂同破壞報告。
summary.zh_hans: 由青年倡议组织「Gen Z regelt（Z世代来做主）」发起的示威，在10月31日席卷德国30多个城市，组织方说约12万人上街，诉求包括增加教育经费、应对生活成本上涨和环境保护。示威日间大致和平，但入夜后在多地演变成暴力骚乱：法兰克福有蒙面暴徒砸烂多间商店橱窗抢掠，包括一间武器店；警方出动特种部队、水炮和直升机，截至周日凌晨拘捕约30人。科隆和汉堡亦有骚乱和破坏报告。

title.en: Only one secondary deal among Hong Kong's top 10 estates over the weekend
title.zh_hant: 十大屋苑周末僅錄1宗成交　連續22周維持單位數
title.zh_hans: 十大屋苑周末仅录1宗成交　连续22周维持单位数

summary.en: Hong Kong's top 10 housing estates recorded just one secondary transaction over the weekend of October 31 to November 1, at Mei Foo Sun Chuen, with the other nine estates seeing none, according to Hong Kong Property Agency's branch statistics. That is about 50 per cent down from the two deals a week earlier, marking the 22nd consecutive weekend of single-digit transactions. Hong Kong Property research director Wang Pindi said buyers remain focused on new launches, holding back the secondary market; with the Fed keeping rates unchanged and local interest rates low, purchasing power should gradually be released.
summary.zh_hant: 據香港置業分行統計，剛過去嘅周末（10月31日至11月1日）十大指標屋苑僅錄得約1宗成交，嚟自美孚新邨，其餘九個屋苑零成交，較上周末嘅2宗按周跌約50%，並連續第22個周末維持單位數。香港置業研究部董事王品弟話，雖然冇全新大型樓盤應市，但新盤日前開價部署短期開售，市場焦點集中喺一手，窒礙二手交投；隨住美聯儲維持利率不變、本港息口維持低位，有利樓市釋放購買力。
summary.zh_hans: 据香港置业分行统计，刚过去的周末（10月31日至11月1日）十大指标屋苑仅录得约1宗成交，来自美孚新邨，其余九个屋苑零成交，较上周末的2宗按周跌约50%，并连续第22个周末维持单位数。香港置业研究部董事王品弟说，虽然没有全新大型楼盘应市，但新盘日前开价部署短期开售，市场焦点集中在一手，窒碍二手交投；随着美联储维持利率不变、本港息口维持低位，有利楼市释放购买力。

title.en: Paul Chan: Q3 GDP growth to beat forecasts; Fintech Week and investment summit open tomorrow
title.zh_hant: 陳茂波：第三季經濟增長超預期　金融科技周與投資峰會明日開幕
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：第三季经济增长超预期　金融科技周与投资峰会明日开幕

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his blog that the advance estimate of third-quarter GDP, due on Tuesday, will come in above market expectations and accelerate from the second quarter, marking Hong Kong's 15th straight quarter of growth, with the first three quarters combined posting the biggest increase in five years. Tech innovation is a key driver: September exports surged 64.9% year on year, the 20th straight month of double-digit growth and a record in over 40 years. Hong Kong Fintech Week and the Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit open tomorrow, drawing representatives from more than 100 economies.
summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波在網誌表示，周二公布的第三季本地生產總值預先估計數字將高於市場預期，增速較第二季加快，香港將連續第15個季度錄得正增長，首三季合計增幅為五年來同期最大，全年增長預測可望再上調。科技創新是增長重要動力，9月商品出口貨值按年大升64.9%，連續第20個月錄得雙位數增長，單月增幅創逾40年新高。香港金融科技周與國際金融領袖投資峰會明日同步開幕，匯聚全球百多個經濟體代表。
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波在网志表示，周二公布的第三季本地生产总值预先估计数字将高于市场预期，增速较第二季加快，香港将连续第15个季度录得正增长，首三季合计增幅为五年来同期最大，全年增长预测可望再上调。科技创新是增长重要动力，9月商品出口货值按年大升64.9%，连续第20个月录得双位数增长，单月增幅创逾40年新高。香港金融科技周与国际金融领袖投资峰会明日同步开幕，汇聚全球百多个经济体代表。

title.en: Macau October gaming revenue MOP 21.68b, down 10% for fifth straight month
title.zh_hant: 澳門10月博彩收入216.8億　按年跌一成連跌五個月
title.zh_hans: 澳门10月博彩收入216.8亿　按年跌一成连跌五个月

summary.en: Macau's Gaming Inspection and Coordination Bureau announced October gross gaming revenue of MOP 21.68 billion, down 10% year on year — the fifth consecutive monthly decline — though up about 20% from September. Cumulative revenue for the first ten months reached MOP 208.8 billion, up 1.6% year on year. Chief Executive Sam Hou-fai said the government will not adjust its full-year forecast of MOP 236 billion for now and continues to assess the impact of the decline.
summary.zh_hant: 澳門博彩監察協調局公布，10月博彩毛收入216.8億澳門元，按年下跌10%，連續第五個月錄得按年下跌；按月則回升約兩成。今年首十個月累計博彩收入2088億澳門元，按年增長1.6%。行政長官岑浩輝表示，暫不調整全年2360億澳門元博彩稅收預測，會繼續觀察賭收下跌的影響。
summary.zh_hans: 澳门博彩监察协调局公布，10月博彩毛收入216.8亿澳门元，按年下跌10%，连续第五个月录得按年下跌；按月则回升约两成。今年首十个月累计博彩收入2088亿澳门元，按年增长1.6%。行政长官岑浩辉表示，暂不调整全年2360亿澳门元博彩税收预测，会继续观察赌收下跌的影响。

title.en: Civil Aid Service Band marks 50th anniversary with concert
title.zh_hant: 民安隊樂隊50周年音樂會　逾千隊員及家屬出席
title.zh_hans: 民安队乐队50周年音乐会　逾千队员及家属出席

summary.en: The Civil Aid Service held a concert at Hong Kong Baptist University today to celebrate the 50th anniversary of its band, premiering the CAS song 'United We Stand'. More than 1,000 serving and retired members and their families attended. Under Secretary for Security Michael Cheuk praised the band's journey from a small unit into a widely recognised music group over the past half-century. The programme featured the band performing with HKBU students, alongside Chinese drum and dance performances by the Cadet Corps.
summary.zh_hant: 民安隊今日在浸會大學大學會堂舉行樂隊50周年音樂會，首演隊歌《United We Stand》，逾千名現役及退役隊員與家屬出席。保安局副局長卓孝業致辭，讚揚樂隊半世紀來由小規模單位發展成廣受社會認同的音樂團體。音樂會由樂隊聯同浸大學生演出多首名曲，少年團亦有中國鼓及舞蹈表演。
summary.zh_hans: 民安队今日在浸会大学大学会堂举行乐队50周年音乐会，首演队歌《United We Stand》，逾千名现役及退役队员与家属出席。保安局副局长卓孝业致辞，赞扬乐队半世纪来由小规模单位发展成广受社会认同的音乐团体。音乐会由乐队联同浸大学生演出多首名曲，少年团亦有中国鼓及舞蹈表演。

image_caption: 民安隊今日在浸會大學大學會堂舉行「民安隊樂隊50周年音樂會」。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Man suspected of falling after drinking at West Kowloon's Sorrento, injuring helper below
title.zh_hans: 擎天半岛男子疑醉酒后失足坠楼　压伤平台外籍女佣
title.zh_hant: 擎天半島男子疑醉酒後失足墮樓　壓傷平台外籍女傭

summary.en: A man fell from a height at Sorrento, 1 Austin Road West in West Kowloon, at around 7:43pm on Saturday, striking a foreign domestic helper who was walking on the podium below. Both were conscious when rescuers arrived: the man was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital and the woman to Kwong Wah Hospital. Preliminary information suggests the man had been at a barbecue gathering at the residential clubhouse and may have lost his footing after drinking; the injured man was seen wearing a neck brace as he was carried to hospital on a stretcher. Police are investigating the circumstances.
summary.zh_hans: 一名男子昨晚（31 日）约 7 时 43 分在西九龙柯士甸道西 1 号擎天半岛怀疑从高处坠下，压中一名正在平台行走的外籍家庭佣工。两人获救时均清醒，男子送往伊利沙伯医院治理，女佣送往广华医院。初步消息指，男子曾在屋苑会所参加烧烤聚会，怀疑饮酒后失足坠下；伤者戴上颈箍、由担架床送院，旁有女伴陪同。警方正调查事件经过。
summary.zh_hant: 一名男子昨晚（31 日）約 7 時 43 分在西九龍柯士甸道西 1 號擎天半島懷疑從高處墮下，壓中一名正在平台行走的外籍家庭傭工。兩人獲救時均清醒，男子送往伊利沙伯醫院治理，女傭送往廣華醫院。初步消息指，男子曾在屋苑會所參加燒烤聚會，懷疑飲酒後失足墮下；傷者戴上頸箍、由擔架床送院，旁有女伴陪同。警方正調查事件經過。

image_caption: 傷者戴上頸箍由救護員送院。（點心日報 Dim Sum Daily）

title.en: US ends daylight saving time, clocks fall back one hour
title.zh_hans: 美国今晨结束夏令时间　时钟拨慢一小时
title.zh_hant: 美國今晨結束夏令時間　時鐘撥慢一小時

summary.en: Most of the United States ended daylight saving time at 2:00 a.m. local time on Sunday, November 1, with clocks turned back one hour to standard time, giving people an extra hour of sleep. Hawaii, most of Arizona and several US territories do not observe the change. Debate over making daylight saving permanent continues: the Sunshine Protection Act passed the House in July 2026, but Senate leaders say there is no consensus for it to become law.
summary.zh_hans: 美国大部分地区于当地时间11月1日凌晨2时结束夏令时间，时钟拨慢一小时回复标准时间，民众可多睡一小时。夏威夷、亚利桑那州大部分地区及多个美国属地不参与调钟。应否永久采用夏令时间在美国政坛仍争论不休：《阳光保护法案》今年7月已在众议院通过，但参议院领袖指暂未有共识令其成为法律。
summary.zh_hant: 美國大部分地區於當地時間11月1日凌晨2時結束夏令時間，時鐘撥慢一小時回復標準時間，民眾可多睡一小時。夏威夷、亞利桑那州大部分地區及多個美國屬地不參與調鐘。應否永久採用夏令時間在美國政壇仍爭論不休：《陽光保護法案》今年7月已在眾議院通過，但參議院領袖指暫未有共識令其成為法律。

image_caption: 美國大部分地區今晨結束夏令時間，時鐘撥慢一小時。（Times Now World）

title.en: Macau's new Culture and Sports Bureau takes effect today after four-body merger
title.zh_hans: 澳门文化体育局今起生效　四机构合并重组
title.zh_hant: 澳門文化體育局今起生效　四機構合併重組

summary.en: Macau's Executive Council has completed deliberation on the administrative regulation on the organisation and operation of the new Culture and Sports Bureau, which merges the Cultural Affairs Bureau, the Cultural Development Fund, the Sports Bureau and the Sports Fund. The regulation takes effect today, November 1. The reorganised bureau will carry out eight core functions covering tangible and intangible cultural heritage, libraries and archives, cultural and arts development, culture and sports industry cultivation, public sports and events, and elite athletes and sports science.
summary.zh_hans: 澳门行政会早前完成讨论《文化体育局的组织及运作》行政法规草案，合并重组文化局、文化发展基金、体育局及体育基金，设立文化体育局，法规自今日（11月1日）起生效。重组后的文化体育局将履行八大核心职能，涵盖物质与非物质文化遗产、图书与档案、文化艺术事业发展、文化体育产业培育、大众体育与赛事，以及精英运动员与体育科学等。
summary.zh_hant: 澳門行政會早前完成討論《文化體育局的組織及運作》行政法規草案，合併重組文化局、文化發展基金、體育局及體育基金，設立文化體育局，法規自今日（11月1日）起生效。重組後的文化體育局將履行八大核心職能，涵蓋物質與非物質文化遺產、圖書與檔案、文化藝術事業發展、文化體育產業培育、大眾體育與賽事，以及精英運動員與體育科學等。

title.en: Nicholas Tse's Wenzhou shows continue tonight with upgraded rock stage
title.zh_hans: 谢霆锋温州站今晚第二场　机械摇滚舞台藏歌单
title.zh_hant: 謝霆鋒溫州站今晚第二場　機械搖滾舞台藏歌單

summary.en: Nicholas Tse's 'Evolution Nic Live' concert opened its two-night Wenzhou stand at the Wenzhou Olympic Sports Center Stadium last night, with the second show tonight (November 1). Rehearsals revealed an upgraded mechanical-rock stage design replacing the cyber aesthetic, with Tse in a hoodie wielding his angel guitar. Soundcheck versions of 'Volcano' and 'Miscalculation' were heard, while the official setlist still holds hidden surprises. Both shows sold out on release.
summary.zh_hans: 谢霆锋「Evolution Nic Live进化演唱会」温州站昨晚在温州奥体中心体育场开唱，今晚（1日）举行第二场。彩排透露本站舞台由赛博风升级为机械摇滚风格，谢霆锋身穿带帽卫衣、手持天使吉他亮相；《活火山》《估计错误》等已在彩排唱响，正式歌单仍有「隐藏款」待揭晓。两场门票早前开售即告售罄。
summary.zh_hant: 謝霆鋒「Evolution Nic Live進化演唱會」溫州站昨晚在溫州奧體中心體育場開唱，今晚（1日）舉行第二場。彩排透露本站舞台由賽博風升級為機械搖滾風格，謝霆鋒身穿帶帽衛衣、手持天使吉他亮相；《活火山》《估計錯誤》等已在彩排唱響，正式歌單仍有「隱藏款」待揭曉。兩場門票早前開售即告售罄。

title.en: Moon to pass through Ghost Cluster tonight; Taipei observatory urges binocular viewing
title.zh_hans: 今晚11时月入鬼宿星团　台北天文馆吁用双筒望远镜赏月伴星
title.zh_hant: 今晚11時月入鬼宿星團　台北天文館籲用雙筒望遠鏡賞月伴星

summary.en: From around 11 p.m. tonight (November 1) until about 1 a.m., the Moon will pass in front of the Ghost Cluster in Cancer, creating a striking moon-meets-starfield sight. The Taipei Astronomical Museum advises the public to use binoculars and look toward the eastern sky for the best view. The Ghost Cluster is a well-known open star cluster that appears to the naked eye as a hazy patch of light.
summary.zh_hans: 今晚（1日）深夜11时至明日凌晨1时左右，月球将行经巨蟹座的鬼宿星团，形成月伴群星的特殊天象。台北天文馆建议民众透过双筒望远镜朝东方天空观赏，把握秋冬夜空的独特景致。鬼宿星团是著名的疏散星团，肉眼看来如一团朦胧白雾，又被称为「积尸气」。
summary.zh_hant: 今晚（1日）深夜11時至明日凌晨1時左右，月球將行經巨蟹座的鬼宿星團，形成月伴群星的特殊天象。台北天文館建議民眾透過雙筒望遠鏡朝東方天空觀賞，把握秋冬夜空的獨特景致。鬼宿星團是著名的疏散星團，肉眼看來如一團朦朧白霧，又被稱為「積尸氣」。

image_caption: 月球經過鬼宿星團示意圖。（臺北市立天文科學教育館）

title.en: Rezaei says he has read Vance's letter but not replied; Strait of Hormuz stays closed
title.zh_hans: 雷扎伊：已阅万斯来信未回复　霍尔木兹海峡维持关闭
title.zh_hant: 雷扎伊：已閱萬斯來信未回覆　霍爾木茲海峽維持關閉

summary.en: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei said in an interview aired on Iranian television that he has read the letter from US Vice President J.D. Vance but has not yet replied, describing the changed American tone as a good sign. He stressed, however, that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed and no negotiations will begin until Iran's seven conditions are met. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said separately that a Qatari-mediated proposal could reopen the strait within two days, but Tehran currently has no plans to meet US officials.
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊在伊朗电视台播出的访问中表示，已读过美国副总统万斯的来信但尚未回复，形容美方语气「完全改变」是好兆头，但强调在伊朗提出的七项条件获满足前，不会开放霍尔木兹海峡，也不会展开谈判。伊朗外长阿拉格齐同日表示，卡塔尔斡旋下或有方案在两日内重开海峡，但伊朗目前无意与美方官员会面。
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷扎伊在伊朗電視台播出的訪問中表示，已讀過美國副總統萬斯的來信但尚未回覆，形容美方語氣「完全改變」是好兆頭，但強調在伊朗提出的七項條件獲滿足前，不會開放霍爾木茲海峽，也不會展開談判。伊朗外長阿拉格齊同日表示，卡塔爾斡旋下或有方案在兩日內重開海峽，但伊朗目前無意與美方官員會面。

title.en: Bocuse d'Or Asia-Pacific selection begins in Macau today; China team competes on day one
title.zh_hans: 名厨赛亚太区选拔赛今起一连两日澳门举行　中国队首日登场
title.zh_hant: 名廚賽亞太區選拔賽今起一連兩日澳門舉行　中國隊首日登場

summary.en: The Bocuse d'Or Asia-Pacific 2026 selection, hailed as the 'Olympics of gastronomy', takes place at The Venetian Macao today and tomorrow (November 1-2), with eight lead chefs and their teams competing for places in the grand final. China's lead chef Chun Kei Wong competes today alongside teams from Vietnam, India and Sri Lanka; New Zealand, Malaysia, Japan and Thailand follow tomorrow. The official opening ceremony was held at Macau Fisherman's Wharf yesterday afternoon.
summary.zh_hans: 有「厨艺奥运」之称的Bocuse d'Or名厨赛，亚太区选拔赛首次移师澳门，今明两日（11月1至2日）在澳门威尼斯人举行，8位主厨及团队竞逐晋级全球总决赛资格。中国队主厨黄俊基将于今日登场，同场还有越南、印度及斯里兰卡队；新西兰、马来西亚、日本及泰国队则于明日出战。官方开幕礼昨日已在澳门渔人码头举行。
summary.zh_hant: 有「廚藝奧運」之稱的Bocuse d'Or名廚賽，亞太區選拔賽首次移師澳門，今明兩日（11月1至2日）在澳門威尼斯人舉行，8位主廚及團隊競逐晉級全球總決賽資格。中國隊主廚黃俊基將於今日登場，同場還有越南、印度及斯里蘭卡隊；紐西蘭、馬來西亞、日本及泰國隊則於明日出戰。官方開幕禮昨日已在澳門漁人碼頭舉行。

title.en: Australia tourism chief: China remains a leading source market
title.zh_hans: 澳旅游局：中国仍是领先客源市场　消费占比近三成
title.zh_hant: 澳旅遊局：中國仍是領先客源市場　消費佔比近三成

summary.en: Tourism Australia managing director Robin Mac told Xinhua that China's outbound travel market to Australia is growing strongly and China remains one of its leading source markets, expected to stay so in the coming years. Australian Bureau of Statistics data shows mainland China was Australia's second-largest short-term visitor source in FY2025-26 with 1.127 million arrivals, up about 18.2% year on year; in the 12 months to June 2026, mainland Chinese visitors were also the biggest contributors to international visitor spending in Australia at 29%.
summary.zh_hans: 澳洲旅游局局长麦克接受新华社访问时表示，中国赴澳旅游市场增长强劲，中国一直是澳洲领先的客源市场之一，预计未来数年仍将如此。澳洲统计局数据显示，2025至2026财年，中国内地是澳洲第二大短期旅客来源地，入境112.7万人次，按年增长约18.2%；截至2026年6月的12个月内，中国内地旅客更是澳洲国际访客消费的最大贡献者，占比达29%。
summary.zh_hant: 澳洲旅遊局局長麥克接受新華社訪問時表示，中國赴澳旅遊市場增長強勁，中國一直是澳洲領先的客源市場之一，預計未來數年仍將如此。澳洲統計局數據顯示，2025至2026財年中國內地是澳洲第二大短期旅客來源地，入境112.7萬人次，按年增長約18.2%；截至2026年6月的12個月內，中國內地旅客更是澳洲國際訪客消費的最大貢獻者，佔比達29%。

title.en: Hong Kong Cybersecurity Attack and Defence Drill 2026 concludes after 60-hour exercise
title.zh_hant: 香港網絡安全攻防演練2026圓滿結束　51支藍隊60小時實戰
title.zh_hans: 香港网络安全攻防演练2026圆满结束　51支蓝队60小时实战

summary.en: The Hong Kong Cybersecurity Attack and Defence Drill 2026, spearheaded by the Digital Policy Office, concluded successfully last night (October 31). The three-day, 60-hour drill fielded 51 defending Blue Teams covering 28 government departments, 23 public organisations and newly joined private enterprises, against 23 attacking Red Teams from Hong Kong and Mainland cybersecurity bodies, four local tertiary institutions and teams recommended by the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong. Acting Deputy Commissioner (Digital Infrastructure) Cari Wu witnessed the finale, thanked the co-organisers and participating teams, and encouraged continued collaboration to build a robust cybersecurity shield for Hong Kong.
summary.zh_hant: 由數字政策辦公室牽頭的「香港網絡安全攻防演練2026」昨晚（10月31日）圓滿結束。今屆演練歷時三日共60小時，51支防守藍隊涵蓋28個政府部門、23間公營機構及新加入的私營企業；23支攻擊紅隊來自中港兩地網絡安全專業機構、四間本地大專院校及廣東省網信辦推薦隊伍。署理副專員（數字基建）胡嘉兒在現場見證演練結束，感謝各協辦單位及參賽隊伍，並鼓勵各單位繼續在網絡安全領域緊密交流，共同為香港築起高水平網絡安全屏障。
summary.zh_hans: 由数字政策办公室牵头的「香港网络安全攻防演练2026」昨晚（10月31日）圆满结束。本届演练历时三日共60小时，51支防守蓝队涵盖28个政府部门、23间公营机构及新加入的私营企业；23支攻击红队来自中港两地网络安全专业机构、四间本地大专院校及广东省网信办推荐队伍。署理副专员（数字基建）胡嘉儿在现场见证演练结束，感谢各协办单位及参赛队伍，并鼓励各单位继续在网络安全领域紧密交流，共同为香港筑起高水平网络安全屏障。

title.en: North Korea conducts power assessment test of tactical ballistic missile dispersal warhead
title.zh_hant: 朝鮮進行戰術導彈散布戰鬥部威力評估試驗
title.zh_hans: 朝鲜进行战术导弹散布战斗部威力评估试验

summary.en: North Korea's Missile Administration conducted a power assessment test of a tactical ballistic missile dispersal warhead on October 31, the KCNA reported on November 1. Test results released by the administration's ballistic missile system and warhead institutes showed that a standard Type-2 dispersal warhead could level a target area of about 12 to 13 hectares. The administration said the test was part of regular scientific research aimed at enhancing combat system power.
summary.zh_hant: 據朝中社11月1日報道，朝鮮導彈總局10月31日進行了戰術彈道導彈散布戰鬥部威力評估試驗。朝鮮導彈總局彈道導彈系統研究所和戰鬥部研究所公布的試驗結果顯示，採用標準二型散布戰鬥部可將約12至13公頃目標區域夷為平地。導彈總局表示，今次試驗屬於定期開展的科研活動，旨在提升戰鬥系統威力。
summary.zh_hans: 据朝中社11月1日报道，朝鲜导弹总局10月31日进行了战术弹道导弹散布战斗部威力评估试验。朝鲜导弹总局弹道导弹系统研究所和战斗部研究所公布的试验结果显示，采用标准二型散布战斗部可将约12至13公顷目标区域夷为平地。导弹总局表示，今次试验属于定期开展的科研活动，旨在提升战斗系统威力。

title.en: GBA National Innovation Center signs 11 partnerships to deepen industry-academia collaboration
title.zh_hant: 大灣區國創中心與11家單位簽約　推進產學研合作
title.zh_hans: 大湾区国创中心与11家单位签约　推进产学研合作

summary.en: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area National Center of Technology Innovation signed industry-academia-research cooperation agreements with 11 partners, including Topstar and Maiwei Technology, at a 2026 Greater Bay Area Science Forum event in Nansha, Guangzhou yesterday. Themed 'Wisdom converges in the GBA, sci-tech innovation leads the future', the event focused on embodied intelligence, advanced manufacturing and industrial software. A sci-tech achievement exhibition runs at the Nansha International Convention and Exhibition Center from October 31 to November 2, with over 40 exhibitors showcasing innovations and applications.
summary.zh_hant: 粵港澳大灣區國家技術創新中心昨日在廣州南沙舉行的2026大灣區科學論壇專場活動上，與拓斯達、邁為技術等11家單位簽署產學研合作協議，推動科研供給精準對接企業技術需求。活動以「智匯大灣區　科創領未來」為主題，聚焦具身智能、先進製造、工業軟件等前沿領域。10月31日至11月2日，科技成果展覽在南沙國際會展中心同期舉行，40餘家單位集中展示創新成果與應用實踐。
summary.zh_hans: 粤港澳大湾区国家技术创新中心昨日在广州南沙举行的2026大湾区科学论坛专场活动上，与拓斯达、迈为技术等11家单位签署产学研合作协议，推动科研供给精准对接企业技术需求。活动以「智汇大湾区　科创领未来」为主题，聚焦具身智能、先进制造、工业软件等前沿领域。10月31日至11月2日，科技成果展览在南沙国际会展中心同期举行，40余家单位集中展示创新成果与应用实践。

title.en: China's VAT withholding mechanism for individuals' service income takes effect today
title.zh_hant: 內地自然人增值稅代扣代繳今起施行　單位代個人繳稅
title.zh_hans: 内地自然人增值税代扣代缴今起施行　单位代个人缴税

summary.en: China's first VAT withholding mechanism for individuals took effect today. Under the new rules from the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration, domestic entities purchasing R&D, software, design, consulting, film and TV production, cultural and education services from individuals must withhold and remit VAT. The statutory rate is 3%, reduced to 1% through end-2027; withholders must file and pay within 15 days from the first day of the month following the taxable transaction.
summary.zh_hant: 內地首次引入的自然人增值稅代扣代繳機制今日起正式施行。根據財政部、稅務總局公布的《境內單位代扣代繳自然人增值稅管理辦法》，境內單位向自然人購買研發、軟件、設計、諮詢、影視製作、文化及教育等服務時，須按規定代扣代繳增值稅。現行法定徵收率為3%，2027年底前減按1%徵稅；扣繳義務人須於發生應稅交易次月1日起15日內完成申報繳稅。
summary.zh_hans: 内地首次引入的自然人增值税代扣代缴机制今日起正式施行。根据财政部、税务总局公布的《境内单位代扣代缴自然人增值税管理办法》，境内单位向自然人购买研发、软件、设计、咨询、影视制作、文化及教育等服务时，须按规定代扣代缴增值税。现行法定征收率为3%，2027年底前减按1%征税；扣缴义务人须于发生应税交易次月1日起15日内完成申报缴税。

title.en: China's crewed lunar mission adopts two-launch lunar-orbit rendezvous plan
title.zh_hant: 中國載人登月採「兩次發射、環月對接」方案　研製穩步推進
title.zh_hans: 中国载人登月采「两次发射、环月对接」方案　研制稳步推进

summary.en: China's crewed lunar exploration program will use a 'two launches, lunar-orbit rendezvous' approach, chief designer Wang Xiang revealed at the 7th Manned Spaceflight Academic Conference that opened October 31. Two rockets will separately send the Lanyue lunar lander and the Mengzhou crewed spacecraft into Earth-Moon transfer orbit before rendezvous and docking in lunar orbit. Development work for the lunar landing phase is progressing steadily. The two-day conference drew over 800 experts under the theme of empowering high-quality manned spaceflight with digital intelligence.
summary.zh_hant: 在10月31日開幕的第七屆載人航天學術大會上，中國載人月球探測工程總設計師王翔透露，工程採用「兩次發射、環月對接」方案：兩枚火箭分別將「攬月」月面着陸器與「夢舟」載人飛船送入地月轉移軌道，再於環月軌道交會對接。目前工程登月階段各項研製建設工作正穩步推進。本屆大會為期兩天，800餘位專家學者以「智匯星河　數智賦能載人航天高質量發展」為主題交流研討。
summary.zh_hans: 在10月31日开幕的第七届载人航天学术大会上，中国载人月球探测工程总设计师王翔透露，工程采用「两次发射、环月对接」方案：两枚火箭分别将「揽月」月面着陆器与「梦舟」载人飞船送入地月转移轨道，再于环月轨道交会对接。目前工程登月阶段各项研制建设工作正稳步推进。本届大会为期两天，800余位专家学者以「智汇星河　数智赋能载人航天高质量发展」为主题交流研讨。

title.en: Customs seizes 6kg of suspected cocaine at airport; 22-year-old Filipino woman arrested
title.zh_hant: 海關機場破獲販毒案　22歲菲籍女子藏6公斤可卡因被捕
title.zh_hans: 海关机场破获贩毒案　22岁菲籍女子藏6公斤可卡因被捕

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs detected a drug trafficking case at Hong Kong International Airport yesterday, seizing about 6 kilograms of suspected cocaine with an estimated market value of about HK$3.6 million. A 22-year-old Filipino woman arriving from Phnom Penh, Cambodia had the drugs concealed in her check-in suitcase and was arrested. She has been charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug and will appear at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts tomorrow. Customs reminds the public never to take part in drug trafficking for monetary return or carry unknown items for others. Trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關昨日在香港國際機場破獲一宗販毒案，檢獲約6公斤懷疑可卡因，市值約360萬元。一名22歲菲律賓籍女旅客由柬埔寨金邊抵港，清關時在其寄艙行李內發現該批懷疑可卡因，女子其後被捕。她已被控一項販運危險藥物罪，案件明日（11月2日）在西九龍裁判法院提堂。海關提醒市民切勿為金錢利益參與販毒，亦不要替他人攜帶不明物品。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关昨日在香港国际机场破获一宗贩毒案，检获约6公斤怀疑可卡因，市值约360万元。一名22岁菲律宾籍女旅客由柬埔寨金边抵港，清关时在其托运行李内发现该批怀疑可卡因，女子其后被捕。她已被控一项贩运危险药物罪，案件明日（11月2日）在西九龙裁判法院提堂。海关提醒市民切勿为金钱利益参与贩毒，亦不要替他人携带不明物品。根据《危险药物条例》，贩运危险药物最高可判罚款500万元及终身监禁。

title.en: Chris Tang on Wang Fuk Court report: Fire Services had shortcomings; "as trivial as dust" on his own future
title.zh_hant: 鄧炳強談宏福苑報告：消防處有不足　自言去留「輕如鴻毛」
title.zh_hans: 邓炳强谈宏福苑报告：消防处有不足　自言去留「轻如鸿毛」

summary.en: Secretary for Security Chris Tang responded to the Wang Fuk Court independent committee report in a television interview aired today. The report found the Fire Services Department had not properly discharged its regulatory duties and lacked crisis awareness over large building renovation works, failing to spot in time that fire alarms had been switched off and that openings had been made in escape staircases. Tang admitted the department had shortcomings and a duty to inspect, noting that highly divided responsibilities at the time meant the defects were not caught promptly. A Level Two investigation under the departmental head accountability system has been triggered, and senior Fire Services officers are expected to face scrutiny by the Public Service Commission. On his own future as bureau chief, Tang said he was "as trivial as dust" and would follow the Chief Executive's decision.
summary.zh_hant: 保安局局長鄧炳強在今日播出的電視訪問中，回應宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告。報告指消防處未有妥善履行監管職責，對大型樓宇維修工程缺乏危機意識，未能及時發現火警鐘被關掉及走火樓梯被擅自開生口等問題。鄧炳強承認部門有不足、有巡查責任，當時職責高度分散，令問題未能及時發現。部門首長責任制下的兩級調查機制已經啟動，資深消防處人員預料要面對公務員敍用委員會調查。被問及個人去留時，鄧炳強說自己「輕如鴻毛」，會跟隨行政長官的決定。
summary.zh_hans: 保安局局长邓炳强在今日播出的电视访问中，回应宏福苑火灾独立委员会报告。报告指消防处未有妥善履行监管职责，对大型楼宇维修工程缺乏危机意识，未能及时发现火警钟被关掉及走火楼梯被擅自开生口等问题。邓炳强承认部门有不足、有巡查责任，当时职责高度分散，令问题未能及时发现。部门首长责任制下的两级调查机制已经启动，资深消防处人员预料要面对公务员叙用委员会调查。被问及个人去留时，邓炳强说自己「轻如鸿毛」，会跟随行政长官的决定。

title.en: Hong Kong man arrested in Macau over drug-laced e-cigarettes
title.zh_hant: 港男涉澳門販售含毒電子煙被捕　至少向3人轉售
title.zh_hans: 港男涉澳门贩售含毒电子烟被捕　至少向3人转售

summary.en: Macau's Judiciary Police yesterday arrested a 35-year-old Hong Kong man working as an electrician in Macau, suspected of smuggling drug-laced e-cigarettes from Hong Kong for sale. Officers seized six e-cigarettes containing drug oil, worth about MOP$8,000, on his person, and found four more used devices at his residence. Laboratory tests confirmed the e-cigarettes contained the controlled substance THC, and the man's urine test was also positive. He faces three charges of illegal drug consumption, possession and trafficking, and was escorted to the Public Prosecutions Office this morning. Police believe he resold at least three e-cigarettes at MOP$1,400 each and are tracking down other suspects.
summary.zh_hant: 澳門司警昨日拘捕一名35歲、在澳門從事電工的香港男子，懷疑他由香港偷運含毒品成分的電子煙到澳門出售。司警在其身上搜出6支含毒品煙油的電子煙，市值約8,000澳門元，其後在其住所再搜出4支已吸食完的電子煙機。經化驗，這些電子煙含有受管制的四氫大麻酚成分，男子尿液檢測亦呈陽性反應。他涉嫌觸犯非法吸食、持有及販賣麻醉及精神科藥物三項罪名，今早由司警押送檢察院偵訊。司警相信他至少以每支1,400澳門元向3人轉售，正追查其他涉案者。
summary.zh_hans: 澳门司警昨日拘捕一名35岁、在澳门从事电工的香港男子，怀疑他由香港偷运含毒品成分的电子烟到澳门出售。司警在其身上搜出6支含毒品烟油的电子烟，市值约8,000澳门元，其后在其住所再搜出4支已吸食完的电子烟机。经化验，这些电子烟含有受管制的四氢大麻酚成分，男子尿液检测亦呈阳性反应。他涉嫌触犯非法吸食、持有及贩卖麻醉及精神科药物三项罪名，今早由司警押送检察院侦讯。司警相信他至少以每支1,400澳门元向3人转售，正追查其他涉案者。

title.en: Paul Lam: building maintenance reforms a "revolutionary change"; bid-rigging criminalisation targeted for April
title.zh_hant: 林定國：樓宇維修改革是革命性改變　圍標刑事化望明年4月通過
title.zh_hans: 林定国：楼宇维修改革是革命性改变　围标刑事化望明年4月通过

summary.en: In response to the Wang Fuk Court fire independent committee report, the government plans to table several bills in the Legislative Council within this year, criminalising bid-rigging in building maintenance works and amending the Competition Ordinance and Buildings Ordinance. Speaking on a radio programme today, Secretary for Justice Paul Lam described the overhaul as a revolutionary change to the entire building maintenance ecosystem, saying all amendments and measures are interlocking to raise standards and strengthen regulation. Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said bid-rigging is complex, involving not just tendering but also price-fixing and market-sharing, and the government plans to list the offences as scheduled offences under the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance, aiming for passage around April next year.
summary.zh_hant: 政府因應宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告，計劃今年內向立法會提交多條條例，將樓宇維修工程圍標刑事化，並修訂《競爭條例》及《建築物條例》等。律政司司長林定國今日出席電台節目時形容，這是樓宇大維修整個生態的革命性改變，所有修訂及一系列措施環環緊扣，透過提高標準及加強監管以達到目的。商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺表示，圍標問題複雜，不僅涉及投標，亦牽涉合謀定價、瓜分市場等，政府計劃將相關罪行納入《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》指明罪行，期望明年4月左右通過修例。
summary.zh_hans: 政府因应宏福苑火灾独立委员会报告，计划今年内向立法会提交多条条例，将楼宇维修工程围标刑事化，并修订《竞争条例》及《建筑物条例》等。律政司司长林定国今日出席电台节目时形容，这是楼宇大维修整个生态的革命性改变，所有修订及一系列措施环环紧扣，透过提高标准及加强监管以达到目的。商务及经济发展局局长丘应桦表示，围标问题复杂，不仅涉及投标，亦牵涉合谋定价、瓜分市场等，政府计划将相关罪行纳入《有组织及严重罪行条例》指明罪行，期望明年4月左右通过修例。

title.en: Three Hong Kong newspapers raise prices; Ming Pao up to HK$15 from today
title.zh_hant: 三份報章加價　明報今起每份15元　經濟及信報明日起調整
title.zh_hans: 三份报章加价　明报今起每份15元　经济及信报明日起调整

summary.en: Three Hong Kong newspapers are raising their retail prices. Ming Pao raised its price by HK$3 to HK$15 per copy from today (November 1), a 25% increase. Hong Kong Economic Times and Hong Kong Economic Journal will follow from tomorrow (November 2): the Economic Times rises from HK$12 to HK$15, while the Economic Journal rises by HK$3 to HK$18 per copy.
summary.zh_hant: 本港三份報章加價。明報今日（11月1日）起加價3元至每份15元，加幅25%；經濟日報及信報由明日（11月2日）起加價，經濟日報由12元加至15元，信報則加價3元至每份18元。
summary.zh_hans: 本港三份报章加价。明报今日（11月1日）起加价3元至每份15元，加幅25%；经济日报及信报由明日（11月2日）起加价，经济日报由12元加至15元，信报则加价3元至每份18元。

title.en: Mainland woman jailed four weeks for smuggling 1,381 duty-not-paid cigarettes
title.zh_hans: 内地女旅客藏1,381支未完税烟闯关　判监四星期
title.zh_hant: 內地女旅客藏1,381支未完稅煙闖關　判監四星期

summary.en: Customs officers intercepted a 59-year-old Mainland woman at Heung Yuen Wai Boundary Control Point yesterday and seized 1,381 duty-not-paid cigarettes, worth about HK$6,200 with duty potential of about HK$4,500. She was sentenced to four weeks' imprisonment at Shatin Magistrates' Courts today. Customs welcomed the custodial sentence as a deterrent, reminding the public that the maximum penalty under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance is a HK$2 million fine and seven years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 海关昨日在香园围边境管制站截查一名59岁内地女旅客，在其身上搜出1,381支未完税香烟，市值约6,200元，应课税款约4,500元。该名旅客今日在沙田裁判法院被判监禁四星期。海关欢迎判刑，认为具相当阻吓作用，提醒市民切勿以身试法；根据《应课税品条例》，最高可判罚款200万元及监禁七年。
summary.zh_hant: 海關昨日在香園圍邊境管制站截查一名59歲內地女旅客，在其身上搜出1,381支未完稅香煙，市值約6,200元，應課稅款約4,500元。該名旅客今日在沙田裁判法院被判監禁四星期。海關歡迎判刑，認為具相當阻嚇作用，提醒市民切勿以身試法；根據《應課稅品條例》，最高可判罰款200萬元及監禁七年。

image_caption: 涉事女旅客以衣物掩蓋未完稅香煙。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Customs seizes 5kg of suspected cannabis buds worth HK$1.1m at airport; Mainland man arrested
title.zh_hans: 机场截获5公斤大麻花值110万　37岁内地男旅客被捕
title.zh_hant: 機場截獲5公斤大麻花值110萬　37歲內地男旅客被捕

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs today intercepted a 37-year-old Mainland man arriving from Bangkok at Hong Kong International Airport, finding about 5 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on suitcase. The haul has an estimated market value of about HK$1.1 million, and the man was arrested. Customs said it will step up intelligence-led enforcement against drug trafficking, reminding the public that trafficking in dangerous drugs carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 海关今日在香港国际机场截查一名由泰国曼谷抵港的37岁内地男旅客，在其手提行李箱内搜出约5公斤怀疑大麻花，市值约110万元，该名男子随即被捕。案件仍在调查中。海关表示会继续加强情报分析打击跨境贩毒，并提醒市民切勿为金钱利益参与贩毒；根据《危险药物条例》，贩毒最高可判罚款500万元及终身监禁。
summary.zh_hant: 海關今日在香港國際機場截查一名由泰國曼谷抵港的37歲內地男旅客，在其手提行李箱內搜出約5公斤懷疑大麻花，市值約110萬元，該名男子隨即被捕。案件仍在調查中。海關表示會繼續加強情報分析打擊跨境販毒，並提醒市民切勿為金錢利益參與販毒；根據《危險藥物條例》，販毒最高可判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。

image_caption: 海關檢獲的懷疑大麻花。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Wang Fuk Court fire inquiry report released; government unveils building maintenance reforms
title.zh_hans: 宏福苑大火独立调查报告出炉　政府推楼宇维修监管改革
title.zh_hant: 宏福苑大火獨立調查報告出爐　政府推樓宇維修監管改革

summary.en: The government has released the report of the independent committee of inquiry into the Wang Fuk Court fire, proposing reforms to building maintenance oversight. Chief Secretary Eric Chan said the first phase of a centralized database of building maintenance projects and professionals will launch in May or June next year, while a new public body will help homeowners oversee repair works from January. Authorities also plan to amend ordinances to criminalize bid-rigging and other anti-competitive conduct in building maintenance tenders. The November 26, 2025 blaze killed 168 people and displaced nearly 2,000 families.
summary.zh_hans: 政府公布宏福苑大火独立调查委员会报告，提出一系列楼宇维修监管改革。政务司司长陈国基表示，政府将于明年中推出楼宇维修工程及专业人士纪录中央数据库首阶段，并成立新公营机构，由明年1月起协助业主监督维修工程。当局亦计划修例打击楼宇维修招标中的围标等反竞争行为，包括将围标刑事化。宏福苑大火发生于去年11月26日，造成168人死亡、近2,000个家庭流离失所。
summary.zh_hant: 政府公布宏福苑大火獨立調查委員會報告，提出一系列樓宇維修監管改革。政務司司長陳國基表示，政府將於明年中推出樓宇維修工程及專業人士紀錄中央資料庫首階段，並成立新公營機構，由明年1月起協助業主監督維修工程。當局亦計劃修例打擊樓宇維修招標中的圍標等反競爭行為，包括將圍標刑事化。宏福苑大火發生於去年11月26日，造成168人死亡、近2,000個家庭流離失所。

title.en: Paul Chan: Hong Kong may post strongest economic growth in five years in 2026
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：香港今年经济增长或创五年最强
title.zh_hant: 陳茂波：香港今年經濟增長或創五年最強

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said on a radio programme today that Hong Kong's economy grew 5.1% in the first half of the year, with strong exports and investment continuing into the third quarter, giving 2026 a chance of recording the strongest full-year growth in five years. He cited high visitor numbers, busy streets and mega events such as the Wine and Dine Festival, with FinTech Week coming up, as drivers of momentum.
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波今日在电台节目表示，本港上半年经济增长5.1%，第三季出口及投资表现持续强劲，2026年全年经济增长有机会创五年来最强。他指出访港旅客数字高企、街头人流畅旺，加上美酒佳肴巡礼等多项盛事，以及即将举行的金融科技周，均为经济带来动力。
summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波今日在電台節目表示，本港上半年經濟增長5.1%，第三季出口及投資表現持續強勁，2026年全年經濟增長有機會創五年來最強。他指出訪港旅客數字高企、街頭人流暢旺，加上美酒佳餚巡禮等多項盛事，以及即將舉行的金融科技周，均為經濟帶來動力。

title.en: Commerce ministry seeks public views on draft dual-use export control enforcement rules
title.zh_hans: 商务部就两用物项出口管制调查执法办法公开征求意见
title.zh_hant: 商務部就兩用物項出口管制調查執法辦法公開徵求意見

summary.en: The Ministry of Commerce has drafted measures on investigation and enforcement of dual-use item export controls and opened them for public comment until November 29. The draft comprises seven chapters and 61 articles covering procedural rules, supervision and inspection, case filing, administrative penalties, and enforcement and closure. The ministry said it will refine the draft based on feedback and push for early promulgation.
summary.zh_hans: 商务部起草《两用物项出口管制调查执法办法（征求意见稿）》，即日起向社会公开征求意见，截止日期为11月29日。征求意见稿共七章六十一条，涵盖一般程序规则、监督检查、立案调查、行政处罚决定、执行与结案等内容。商务部表示，将根据反馈意见完善草案，推动办法尽快出台。
summary.zh_hant: 商務部起草《兩用物項出口管制調查執法辦法（徵求意見稿）》，即日起向社會公開徵求意見，截止日期為11月29日。徵求意見稿共七章六十一條，涵蓋一般程序規則、監督檢查、立案調查、行政處罰決定、執行與結案等內容。商務部表示，將根據反饋意見完善草案，推動辦法盡快出台。

title.en: NYT: ex-Megaspeed executive probed as Chinese intel asset; Huang says dealings normal
title.zh_hant: 紐時：新加坡 Megaspeed 前高層涉為北京蒐集情報　黃仁勳稱往來完全正常
title.zh_hans: 纽时：新加坡 Megaspeed 前高层涉为北京搜集情报　黄仁勋称往来完全正常

summary.en: The New York Times reported exclusively on Oct 29 that US intelligence is investigating Alice Huang, a former senior executive of Singapore data-centre firm Megaspeed International, whom US officials believe to be a Chinese intelligence asset helping Beijing evade US advanced AI chip export controls and divert Nvidia chips to China. Huang was photographed multiple times with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, including at a Taipei bar in June 2024 and a business dinner in May 2025. Jensen Huang responded on the 29th that Nvidia's dealings with Megaspeed were 'completely normal, nothing out of the ordinary,' saying the company had audited every GPU deployment and found no illegal diversion, and that the US government never alerted him to suspicions. The report added that Donald Trump was briefed a year ago but took no action over concerns about the economy and markets; Megaspeed said it has hired outside counsel and is cooperating, while the Commerce Department's probe moved to the Justice Department this year.
summary.zh_hant: 《紐約時報》10 月 29 日獨家報道，美國情報機構正調查新加坡資料中心公司 Megaspeed 前高層黃樂（Alice Huang），美方認定她是替北京蒐集情報的情報資產，涉嫌協助中國規避美國先進 AI 晶片出口管制、把輝達晶片轉運至中國。黃樂曾多次與輝達行政總裁黃仁勳同框，包括 2024 年 6 月台北科技展後酒吧合照及 2025 年 5 月商務晚餐。黃仁勳 29 日回應指，輝達與 Megaspeed 往來完全正常、毫無異常，已逐一核查對方所有 GPU 部署情況，確認無非法轉運；美國政府事前從未向他通報相關懷疑。報道又指特朗普早於一年前已聽取相關情報簡報，但因擔心影響經濟及股市而未採取行動；Megaspeed 稱已聘請外部法律顧問全面調查並配合美方，商務部的調查今年已移交司法部。
summary.zh_hans: 《纽约时报》10 月 29 日独家报道，美国情报机构正调查新加坡资料中心公司 Megaspeed 前高层黄乐（Alice Huang），美方认定她是替北京搜集情报的情报资产，涉嫌协助中国规避美国先进 AI 芯片出口管制、把辉达芯片转运至中国。黄乐曾多次与辉达行政总裁黄仁勋同框，包括 2024 年 6 月台北科技展后酒吧合照及 2025 年 5 月商务晚餐。黄仁勋 29 日回应指，辉达与 Megaspeed 往来完全正常、毫无异常，已逐一核查对方所有 GPU 部署情况，确认无非法转运；美国政府事前从未向他通报相关怀疑。报道又指特朗普早于一年前已听取相关情报简报，但因担心影响经济及股市而未采取行动；Megaspeed 称已聘请外部法律顾问全面调查并配合美方，商务部的调查今年已移交司法部。

title.en: Hegseth fires three-star general accused of leaking Iran and Ukraine secrets
title.zh_hant: 赫格塞思解僱三星中將西爾維亞　涉洩露伊朗及俄烏機密情報
title.zh_hans: 赫格塞思解雇三星中将西尔维亚　涉泄露伊朗及俄乌机密情报

summary.en: US news site Axios exclusively published on Oct 29 an internal investigation report alleging that Army Lt Gen Brett Sylvia, director of the Joint Staff's strategy, plans and policy directorate (J5), leaked classified information on the Iran war and the Russia-Ukraine conflict to two journalists over about a year, and admitted it after failing three to four polygraph examinations. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth removed him for serious misconduct and referred the case to the Justice Department; Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell stressed 'zero tolerance' for unauthorised disclosures. Two other Pentagon sources told CBS the firing was linked to the polygraph results but disputed the underlying accusations. Sylvia previously commanded the 101st Airborne Division and served in Afghanistan and Iraq; at least 26 senior generals have left since Hegseth took office.
summary.zh_hant: 美國新聞網站 Axios 10 月 29 日獨家披露內部調查報告，指參謀長聯席會議戰略、計劃與政策局（J5）局長、陸軍中將布雷特·西爾維亞，在約一年時間內向兩間媒體的兩名記者洩露伊朗戰爭及俄烏衝突的機密情報，並在三至四次測謊中未能通過後承認。國防部長赫格塞思以嚴重失當行為為由解除其職務，案件已移交司法部；五角大樓首席發言人帕內爾強調對故意洩露機密「零容忍」。另有兩名五角大樓消息人士向 CBS 表示，解職與測謊結果有關，但質疑相關指控。西爾維亞曾任第 101 空降師師長，多次派駐阿富汗及伊拉克；據統計，赫格塞思上任以來已有至少 26 名高級將領離職。
summary.zh_hans: 美国新闻网站 Axios 10 月 29 日独家披露内部调查报告，指参谋长联席会议战略、计划与政策局（J5）局长、陆军中将布雷特·西尔维亚，在约一年时间内向两间媒体的两名记者泄露伊朗战争及俄乌冲突的机密情报，并在三至四次测谎中未能通过后承认。国防部长赫格塞思以严重失当行为为由解除其职务，案件已移交司法部；五角大楼首席发言人帕内尔强调对故意泄露机密「零容忍」。另有两名五角大楼消息人士向 CBS 表示，解职与测谎结果有关，但质疑相关指控。西尔维亚曾任第 101 空降师师长，多次派驻阿富汗及伊拉克；据统计，赫格塞思上任以来已有至少 26 名高级将领离职。

image_caption: 美國五角大樓資料圖片。（中華網）

title.en: Halloween Mark Six snowball draw tonight, jackpot estimated at HK$80 million
title.zh_hant: 萬聖節金多寶今晚 9:30 攪珠　頭獎估計 8,000 萬港元
title.zh_hans: 万圣节金多宝今晚 9:30 搅珠　头奖估计 8,000 万港元

summary.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club's Halloween Mark Six snowball draw takes place tonight (Oct 31) at 9:30pm, with a HK$60 million snowball added; a single HK$10 winning ticket could take home an estimated HK$80 million jackpot. Ticket sales close at 9:15pm and the draw airs live on TVB Plus channel 82. The regular Oct 29 draw was suspended to allow more time for ticket sales. Of nine snowball draws held so far in 2026, eight produced jackpot winners, including a single HK$78.19 million payout; statistics show six numbers appeared at least three times, with number 28 the hottest at five appearances.
summary.zh_hant: 香港賽馬會萬聖節金多寶將於今晚（10 月 31 日）9 時 30 分攪珠，特設 6,000 萬港元金多寶；以 10 港元一注獨中計算，估計頭獎基金高達 8,000 萬港元，截止售票時間為晚上 9 時 15 分，攪珠於 TVB Plus 82 台直播。為預留更多時間供市民投注，原定 10 月 29 日的六合彩攪珠暫停舉行。據統計，2026 年至今舉行 9 次金多寶，其中 8 次頭獎有人中，幸運二金多寶頭獎曾一注獨得逾 7,819 萬港元；當中 6 個號碼至少出現 3 次，「28」號出現 5 次最為當旺。
summary.zh_hans: 香港赛马会万圣节金多宝将于今晚（10 月 31 日）9 时 30 分搅珠，特设 6,000 万港元金多宝；以 10 港元一注独中计算，估计头奖基金高达 8,000 万港元，截止售票时间为晚上 9 时 15 分，搅珠于 TVB Plus 82 台直播。为预留更多时间供市民投注，原定 10 月 29 日的六合彩搅珠暂停举行。据统计，2026 年至今举行 9 次金多宝，其中 8 次头奖有人中，幸运二金多宝头奖曾一注独得逾 7,819 万港元；当中 6 个号码至少出现 3 次，「28」号出现 5 次最为当旺。

title.en: Qatari mediators arrive in Tehran to broker resumption of US-Iran talks
title.zh_hant: 卡塔爾調解團抵德黑蘭　斡旋美伊重啟停火談判
title.zh_hans: 卡塔尔调解团抵德黑兰　斡旋美伊重启停火谈判

summary.en: Iran's IRNA and Al Jazeera report that a Qatari mediation delegation arrived in Tehran on the morning of Oct 30, led by a senior adviser to Qatar's prime minister and foreign minister, to receive Iran's reply to US Vice President JD Vance's letter and to refine a new diplomatic path. Sources say talks could be arranged within a week in Doha or Istanbul. The trip follows Vance's Oct 25 letter to Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei proposing a resumption of peace talks; Foreign Minister Araghchi said Tehran still gives diplomacy a chance but insists on its seven conditions and 'seven-day plan'. Meanwhile Trump has warned Gulf allies to prepare for a short, intense military operation after next week's midterm elections.
summary.zh_hant: 據伊朗伊斯蘭共和國通訊社及半島電視台報道，卡塔爾調解代表團於當地時間 10 月 30 日上午抵達德黑蘭，由卡塔爾首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德的高級顧問帶隊，目的是接收伊朗對美國副總統萬斯信件的答覆，並進一步細化新的外交路徑。消息指雙方可能於一週內安排會談，地點或為多哈或伊斯坦布爾。背景是萬斯 10 月 25 日致信伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷扎伊，提議重啟和平談判；伊朗外長阿拉格齊稱德黑蘭仍願給外交一線機會，但堅持七項條件及「七日方案」。與此同時，特朗普已告誡海灣盟友，為下周中期選舉後一場短促、高強度的軍事行動做好準備。
summary.zh_hans: 据伊朗伊斯兰共和国通讯社及半岛电视台报道，卡塔尔调解代表团于当地时间 10 月 30 日上午抵达德黑兰，由卡塔尔首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德的高级顾问带队，目的是接收伊朗对美国副总统万斯信件的答复，并进一步细化新的外交路径。消息指双方可能于一周内安排会谈，地点或为多哈或伊斯坦布尔。背景是万斯 10 月 25 日致信伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊，提议重启和平谈判；伊朗外长阿拉格齐称德黑兰仍愿给外交一线机会，但坚持七项条件及「七日方案」。与此同时，特朗普已告诫海湾盟友，为下周中期选举后一场短促、高强度的军事行动做好准备。

title.en: Beijing warns of further countermeasures over FCC's China lab restrictions
title.zh_hant: 商務部回應 FCC 檢測實驗室限制措施：如美方一意孤行將進一步反制
title.zh_hans: 商务部回应 FCC 检测实验室限制措施：如美方一意孤行将进一步反制

summary.en: A Commerce Ministry spokesperson responded to the US Federal Communications Commission's Oct 29 vote to adopt testing-lab restrictions, voicing strong dissatisfaction and firm opposition and noting China has already taken countermeasures. The measure, effective Dec 1 2028, bars authorisation of testing labs, telecom certification bodies and lab accreditation bodies located in China and other so-called 'non-reciprocal economies'. The spokesperson accused the US of ignoring repeated Chinese representations and violating the consensus reached by the two heads of state, seriously harming Chinese and other trading partners' interests and disrupting China-US economic stability and global supply chains; forced 'testing reshoring' will raise compliance costs and lengthen delivery cycles, ultimately hurting US firms and consumers. Beijing urged Washington to immediately revoke the measures, warning it will 'take further necessary measures' if the US persists.
summary.zh_hant: 商務部發言人就美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）10 月 29 日投票通過檢測實驗室限制措施答記者問，表示中方強烈不滿、堅決反對，前期已採取反制措施予以回應。該措施自 2028 年 12 月 1 日起，禁止授權位於中國等所謂「非互惠經濟體」的檢測實驗室、電信認證機構及實驗室認可機構。發言人指美方罔顧中方反覆交涉、違背兩國元首達成的重要共識，嚴重損害中方及其他貿易夥伴利益，破壞中美經貿穩定及全球產供鏈；美方強推「檢測回流」將抬高企業檢測成本、拉長交付周期，最終損害美國企業及消費者利益。中方敦促美方立即撤銷有關措施，「如美方一意孤行，中方將進一步採取必要措施」。
summary.zh_hans: 商务部发言人就美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）10 月 29 日投票通过检测实验室限制措施答记者问，表示中方强烈不满、坚决反对，前期已采取反制措施予以回应。该措施自 2028 年 12 月 1 日起，禁止授权位于中国等所谓「非互惠经济体」的检测实验室、电信认证机构及实验室认可机构。发言人指美方罔顾中方反复交涉、违背两国元首达成的重要共识，严重损害中方及其他贸易伙伴利益，破坏中美经贸稳定及全球产供链；美方强推「检测回流」将抬高企业检测成本、拉长交付周期，最终损害美国企业及消费者利益。中方敦促美方立即撤销有关措施，「如美方一意孤行，中方将进一步采取必要措施」。

title.en: Rock column collapse in Turkey's Cappadocia kills 2, injures 5
title.zh_hant: 土耳其卡帕多奇亞石柱坍塌　2 死 5 傷
title.zh_hans: 土耳其卡帕多奇亚石柱坍塌　2 死 5 伤

summary.en: A natural rock column collapsed on Oct 29 at Cappadocia, Turkey's famous tourist region, killing 2 people and injuring 5, the Turkish justice minister said. The chimney-shaped pillar near the Goreme Open Air Museum broke off and fell into a crowded area shortly after heavy rain hit the region. Authorities have assigned prosecutors to investigate while search and rescue continues; the victims' nationalities have not been disclosed. Balloon tours in Cappadocia have been suspended due to rain, snow and strong winds.
summary.zh_hant: 土耳其著名旅遊區卡帕多奇亞一處天然石柱10月29日發生坍塌，土耳其司法部長表示事故造成2人死亡、5人受傷。事發地點位於格雷梅露天博物館附近，一處煙囪狀石柱脫落崩塌，跌入人群聚集區域；當地此前剛經歷暴雨。當局已指派檢察機關調查，搜救仍在進行，傷者國籍尚未公布；受雨雪及大風影響，卡帕多奇亞熱氣球項目已暫停營運。
summary.zh_hans: 土耳其著名旅游区卡帕多奇亚一处天然石柱10月29日发生坍塌，土耳其司法部长表示事故造成2人死亡、5人受伤。事发地点位于格雷梅露天博物馆附近，一处烟囱状石柱脱落崩塌，跌入人群聚集区域；当地此前刚经历暴雨。当局已指派检察机关调查，搜救仍在进行，伤者国籍尚未公布；受雨雪及大风影响，卡帕多奇亚热气球项目已暂停运营。

title.en: Alaska Senate race rocked by namesake-candidate row as Trump cries election fraud
title.zh_hant: 美中期選舉阿拉斯加州爆「同名」風波　特朗普斥選舉舞弊
title.zh_hans: 美中期选举阿拉斯加州爆「同名」风波　特朗普斥选举舞弊

summary.en: A New York Times investigation published Oct 28 revealed that people linked to Democrat Mary Peltola's campaign secretly recruited a retired teacher named Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. — the same name as Republican incumbent Senator Dan S. Sullivan — to run in Alaska's Senate race in a bid to siphon votes from the incumbent. Donald Trump called the episode 'election fraud at the highest level' on social media, demanding Peltola be prosecuted and removed from the ballot; her campaign denied recruiting any spoiler candidates. Alaska officials said candidate eligibility is a state matter beyond federal reach, and the state supreme court ruled in June that the namesake candidate may stay on the ballot. With the Nov 3 midterms days away, the row adds uncertainty to a race that could decide Senate control.
summary.zh_hant: 《紐約時報》10月28日披露，民主黨陣營去年夏天起秘密策劃「選票組成計劃」，找來與爭取連任的共和黨聯邦參議員丹恩·蘇利文（Dan S. Sullivan）同名同姓的退休教師丹恩·小蘇利文（Daniel J. Sullivan Jr.）參選阿拉斯加州參議員，意圖分薄現任議員票源。特朗普28日在社交平台斥責事件是「最高級別的選舉舞弊」，要求起訴民主黨候選人佩爾托拉並將其除名；佩爾托拉陣營否認招募「攪局者」。阿拉斯加州政府回應指候選人資格屬州法事務，聯邦政府無權干預；州最高法院今年6月已裁定小蘇利文可留名選票。11月3日中期選舉在即，事件為可能左右參議院控制權的選戰添上變數。
summary.zh_hans: 《纽约时报》10月28日披露，民主党阵营去年夏天起秘密策划「选票组成计划」，找来与争取连任的共和党联邦参议员丹恩·苏利文（Dan S. Sullivan）同名同姓的退休教师丹恩·小苏利文（Daniel J. Sullivan Jr.）参选阿拉斯加州参议员，意图分薄现任议员票源。特朗普28日在社交平台斥责事件是「最高级别的选举舞弊」，要求起诉民主党候选人佩尔托拉并将其除名；佩尔托拉阵营否认招募「搅局者」。阿拉斯加州政府回应指候选人资格属州法事务，联邦政府无权干预；州最高法院今年6月已裁定小苏利文可留名选票。11月3日中期选举在即，事件为可能左右参议院控制权的选战添上变数。

title.en: Halloween weekend: Shenzhen Bay extends clearance to 2am, Citybus runs overnight B13S
title.zh_hant: 萬聖節周末料深宵北上人潮湧現　深圳灣延長通關城巴開通宵線
title.zh_hans: 万圣节周末料深宵北上人潮涌现　深圳湾延长通关城巴开通宵线

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities and transport operators have rolled out a combined plan to handle crowds over the Halloween weekend, when Lan Kwai Fong street parties, the Wine & Dine Festival and a major concert at Kai Tak are expected to draw large crowds. Shenzhen Bay Port will extend passenger clearance to 2am for two consecutive nights, while cross-border bus operators extend last departures from major urban districts. Citybus will run overnight special route B13S from Central to the 24-hour Huanggang Port on Saturday and Sunday early mornings. Transport chief Mable Chan inspected interchange hubs and pledged extra buses and drivers on standby; officials expect the busiest northbound window at Huanggang to be 11pm-2am from Oct 30 to Nov 1.
summary.zh_hant: 因應萬聖節周末中環蘭桂坊街頭派對、美酒佳餚巡禮及啟德大型演唱會等活動，港府與公共交通營運商推出綜合疏導方案。深圳灣口岸旅客清關時間連續兩晚延長至凌晨2時，跨境巴士延長由銅鑼灣、灣仔、中環、尖沙咀及旺角等主要市區出發的尾班車時間；城巴於周六及周日凌晨開辦通宵特別路線B13S，由中環直達24小時通關的皇崗口岸。運輸署署長程詠怡視察多個轉乘樞紐，承諾安排後備車輛及司機加密班次；當局預計10月30日至11月1日每晚11時至凌晨2時，為皇崗口岸北行出境最繁忙時段。
summary.zh_hans: 因应万圣节周末中环兰桂坊街头派对、美酒佳肴巡礼及启德大型演唱会等活动，港府与公共交通营运商推出综合疏导方案。深圳湾口岸旅客清关时间连续两晚延长至凌晨2时，跨境巴士延长由铜锣湾、湾仔、中环、尖沙咀及旺角等主要市区出发的尾班车时间；城巴于周六及周日凌晨开办通宵特别路线B13S，由中环直达24小时通关的皇岗口岸。运输署署长程咏怡视察多个转乘枢纽，承诺安排后备车辆及司机加密班次；当局预计10月30日至11月1日每晚11时至凌晨2时，为皇岗口岸北行出境最繁忙时段。

title.en: Malaysia's last print evening paper bows out as Guangming Daily prints final edition today
title.zh_hant: 馬來西亞最後一份紙本晚報　《光明日報》晚報今出最後一期
title.zh_hans: 马来西亚最后一份纸本晚报　《光明日報》晚报今出最后一期

summary.en: Malaysia's Guangming Daily will print the final edition of its evening paper on Oct 31, ending distribution in northern Malaysia from Nov 1 and closing the chapter on the country's last print evening newspaper. The paper said the move follows changes in market conditions and reading habits, as readers migrate from print to mobile and digital platforms. The Guangming e-paper will continue to publish evening news at 6pm daily, and the paper is urging long-time subscribers to switch to its daily edition.
summary.zh_hant: 馬來西亞《光明日報》晚報於10月31日出版最後一期，11月1日起停止在北馬地區發行，全國最後一份紙本晚報正式退場。報社表示，決定是順應市場環境與讀者閱讀習慣的轉變，讀者由等報紙送到手上，變成拿起手機即掌握消息。紙本晚報停發後，《光明電子報》將繼續每日下午6時發布晚間新聞，報社亦呼籲長期訂戶轉為支持日報。
summary.zh_hans: 马来西亚《光明日報》晚报于10月31日出版最后一期，11月1日起停止在北马地区发行，全国最后一份纸本晚报正式退场。报社表示，决定是顺应市场环境与读者阅读习惯的转变，读者由等报纸送到手上，变成拿起手机即掌握消息。纸本晚报停发后，《光明电子报》将继续每日下午6时发布晚间新闻，报社亦呼吁长期订户转为支持日报。

title.zh_hant: 10月中國製造業PMI回落至49.3%　重回收縮區間
title.zh_hans: 10月中国制造业PMI回落至49.3%　重回收缩区间
title.en: China's October manufacturing PMI falls to 49.3%, back in contraction

summary.zh_hant: 國家統計局今早公布，10月中國製造業採購經理指數（PMI）為49.3%，較上月下降0.8個百分點，重回榮枯線以下。非製造業商務活動指數和綜合PMI產出指數同為49.7%，企業生產經營活動總體放緩。不過裝備製造、高技術製造等新動能行業延續擴張，對沖整體回落壓力。
summary.zh_hans: 国家统计局今早公布，10月中国制造业采购经理指数（PMI）为49.3%，较上月下降0.8个百分点，重回荣枯线以下。非制造业商务活动指数和综合PMI产出指数同为49.7%，企业生产经营活动总体放缓。不过装备制造、高技术制造等新动能行业延续扩张，对冲整体回落压力。
summary.en: China's National Bureau of Statistics said October manufacturing PMI came in at 49.3%, down 0.8 points from September and back below the 50 expansion-contraction line. The non-manufacturing index and composite output index both stood at 49.7%, signalling a broad slowdown, though equipment and high-tech manufacturing kept expanding and cushioned the decline.

title.zh_hant: 中國稀土11月2日起停牌　籌劃重大資產重組
title.zh_hans: 中国稀土11月2日起停牌　筹划重大资产重组
title.en: China Rare Earth to suspend trading from Nov 2 for major restructuring

summary.zh_hant: 中國稀土昨晚公告，收到中國稀土集團通知，計劃以發行股份方式購買中稀（涼山）稀土股權並募集配套資金。公司股票自11月2日起停牌，預計不超過10個交易日、即11月16日前披露交易方案。交易構成重大資產重組和關聯交易，但不構成重組上市。
summary.zh_hans: 中国稀土昨晚公告，收到中国稀土集团通知，计划以发行股份方式购买中稀（凉山）稀土股权并募集配套资金。公司股票自11月2日起停牌，预计不超过10个交易日、即11月16日前披露交易方案。交易构成重大资产重组和关联交易，但不构成重组上市。
summary.en: China Rare Earth announced it will suspend trading from November 2 after receiving notice from China Rare Earth Group of a plan to acquire Zhongxi (Liangshan) Rare Earth equity via a share issue plus a fundraising placement. A deal outline is expected within 10 trading days, by November 16. The transaction would be a major asset restructuring and related-party deal, but not a backdoor listing.
