title.zh_hant: 富士康董事長會晤OpenAI奧特曼　洽談新合作
title.zh_hans: 富士康董事长会晤OpenAI奥特曼　洽谈新合作
title.en: Foxconn chairman meets OpenAI's Altman to discuss new partnership

summary.zh_hant: 據路透社報道，富士康董事長劉揚偉透露，已與OpenAI行政總裁奧特曼會面，雙方正推進新合作，細節確認後正式公布。劉揚偉明言AI行業並無泡沫，預計公司明年保持雙位數增長。AI伺服器已成富士康最重要增長引擎，雲計算與網絡產品業務佔第二季營收突破五成。
summary.zh_hans: 据路透社报道，富士康董事长刘扬伟透露，已与OpenAI行政总裁奥特曼会面，双方正推进新合作，细节确认后正式公布。刘扬伟明言AI行业并无泡沫，预计公司明年保持双位数增长。AI服务器已成富士康最重要增长引擎，云计算与网络产品业务占第二季营收突破五成。
summary.en: Reuters reports Foxconn chairman Young Liu met OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, with the two sides advancing a new partnership to be announced once details are confirmed. Liu said the AI industry is not in a bubble and forecast double-digit growth next year. AI servers are now Foxconn's key growth engine, with cloud and networking products topping 50% of second-quarter revenue.

title.zh_hant: 陳奕迅26場錄音騷近500萬人登記　官方報警打擊黃牛
title.zh_hans: 陈奕迅26场录音骚近500万人登记　官方报警打击黄牛
title.en: Eason Chan's 26 recording sessions draw nearly 5m ballot entries; organisers report scalpers to police

summary.zh_hant: 陳奕迅《McDonald's Presents: Recording Sessions with Mr. Eason Chan》26場實體錄音騷，於10月28至29日開放抽籤登記，截至30日深夜錄得逾495萬個登記申請。網上湧現「必中攻略」及黃牛暗盤，主辦單位已報警備案並展開大規模核查，嚴打重複登記及可疑帳戶。大會承諾九成門票作公開發售，首輪中籤結果11月2日公布。
summary.zh_hans: 陈奕迅《McDonald's Presents: Recording Sessions with Mr. Eason Chan》26场实体录音骚，于10月28至29日开放抽签登记，截至30日深夜录得逾495万个登记申请。网上涌现「必中攻略」及黄牛暗盘，主办单位已报警备案并展开大规模核查，严打重复登记及可疑账户。大会承诺九成门票作公开发售，首轮中签结果11月2日公布。
summary.en: Eason Chan's 26 'Recording Sessions' live shows opened ballot registration on October 28-29 and had received over 4.95 million entries by late October 30. With scalpers and bogus 'guaranteed win' guides spreading online, organisers have filed a police report and launched large-scale screening against duplicate and suspicious registrations. Ninety percent of tickets are reserved for public sale, with first-round results out on November 2.

title.zh_hant: Vinexpo Asia連續五年獨家在港舉行　首場明年6月會展上演
title.zh_hans: Vinexpo Asia连续五年独家在港举行　首场明年6月会展上演
title.en: Vinexpo Asia to be held exclusively in Hong Kong for five straight years from 2027

summary.zh_hant: 旅發局與全球葡萄酒和烈酒展覽主辦機構Vinexposium簽署諒解備忘錄，建立五年策略夥伴關係。國際葡萄酒和烈酒商貿展Vinexpo Asia由明年起至2031年連續五年每年獨家在香港舉行，首場明年6月8至10日在香港會議展覽中心舉行。簽約儀式在文體旅局局長羅淑佩和旅發局主席林建岳見證下完成。
summary.zh_hans: 旅发局与全球葡萄酒和烈酒展览主办机构Vinexposium签署谅解备忘录，建立五年策略伙伴关系。国际葡萄酒和烈酒商贸展Vinexpo Asia由明年起至2031年连续五年每年独家在香港举行，首场明年6月8至10日在香港会议展览中心举行。签约仪式在文体旅局局长罗淑佩和旅发局主席林建岳见证下完成。
summary.en: The Hong Kong Tourism Board and global wine and spirits fair organiser Vinexposium signed an MOU establishing a five-year strategic partnership. Vinexpo Asia will be held exclusively in Hong Kong every year from 2027 to 2031, with the first edition on June 8-10 next year at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. The signing was witnessed by culture, sports and tourism secretary Rosanna Law and HKTB chairman Peter Lam.

image_caption: 旅發局與Vinexposium簽署諒解備忘錄後大合照。（政府新聞處）

title.zh_hant: 金管局萬聖節中環推防騙街頭活動　教跳「絕蕉舞」
title.zh_hans: 金管局万圣节中环推防骗街头活动　教跳「绝蕉舞」
title.en: HKMA brings anti-scam street event to Central on Halloween with 'anti-scam dance'

summary.zh_hant: 金管局今日下午5時至晚上11時在中環皇后大道中（中環街市外）舉辦萬聖節街頭互動體驗活動，即場教授「絕蕉舞」防騙招式，對抗假客服、假公安、假速遞員及交友騙局。警方統計今年首8個月本港錄得近3萬宗騙案，損失逾52億港元，平均每分鐘損失超過15,000港元。
summary.zh_hans: 金管局今日下午5时至晚上11时在中环皇后大道中（中环街市外）举办万圣节街头互动体验活动，即场教授「绝蕉舞」防骗招式，对抗假客服、假公安、假速递员及交友骗局。警方统计今年首8个月本港录得近3万宗骗案，损失逾52亿港元，平均每分钟损失超过15,000港元。
summary.en: The HKMA is staging a Halloween street event outside Central Market on Queen's Road Central from 5pm to 11pm today, teaching an 'anti-scam dance' to fight fake customer-service, fake police, fake courier and romance scams. Police figures show nearly 30,000 scam cases in the first eight months of this year, with losses topping HK$5.2 billion — over HK$15,000 lost every minute.

title.zh_hant: 幼稚園通告籲勿慶祝萬聖節　稱「供奉死神」惹網民熱議
title.zh_hans: 幼稚园通告吁勿庆祝万圣节　称「供奉死神」惹网民热议
title.en: Kindergarten notice urging parents to shun Halloween as 'worshipping death' sparks online debate

summary.zh_hant: 有教會幼稚園發通告呼籲家長「切勿慶祝萬聖節」，聲稱萬聖節源於供奉死神、召喚邪靈的「死節」，「不給糖就搗蛋」實為古代詛咒儀式。有家長將通告上載至Threads，引發近五千人點讚、逾千留言，網民幾乎一面倒批評校方說法極端，反問「聖誕節本是太陽神誕，教會是否也應反對慶祝」。
summary.zh_hans: 有教会幼稚园发通告呼吁家长「切勿庆祝万圣节」，声称万圣节源于供奉死神、召唤邪灵的「死节」，「不给糖就捣蛋」实为古代诅咒仪式。有家长将通告上载至Threads，引发近五千人点赞、逾千留言，网民几乎一面倒批评校方说法极端，反问「圣诞节本是太阳神诞，教会是否也应反对庆祝」。
summary.en: A church-run kindergarten issued a notice urging parents not to celebrate Halloween, claiming the festival originated as a 'festival of death' worshipping the god of death and summoning evil spirits, with trick-or-treating rooted in ancient curses. A parent posted the notice on Threads, drawing nearly 5,000 likes and over 1,000 comments, with netizens overwhelmingly criticising the school as extreme — one asking whether churches should then also oppose Christmas, since December 25 was once a sun-god festival.

image_caption: 涉事幼稚園發出的萬聖節通告。（門徒媒體）

title.zh_hant: 「博物館節2026」今日開鑼　17間博物館推逾60項節目
title.zh_hans: 「博物馆节2026」今日开锣　17间博物馆推逾60项节目
title.en: Muse Fest HK 2026 kicks off today with 60+ programmes across 17 museums

summary.zh_hant: 康文署主辦的「博物館節2026」今日起至11月30日舉行，轄下17間博物館及藝術空間推出逾60項節目。頭炮「博物館FUN日」今明兩日在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行，以「拼貼今昔・香港故事」為主題，設有「格仔茶檔」等港式像素風裝置及麻將填色、涼茶招牌鎖匙扣等懷舊工作坊。活動並聯同大灣區博物館聯盟10間博物館及24個澳門和本地藝文機構，為第六屆粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節的貢獻節目。
summary.zh_hans: 康文署主办的「博物馆节2026」今日起至11月30日举行，辖下17间博物馆及艺术空间推出逾60项节目。头炮「博物馆FUN日」今明两日在香港文化中心露天广场举行，以「拼贴今昔・香港故事」为主题，设有「格仔茶档」等港式像素风装置及麻将填色、凉茶招牌钥匙扣等怀旧工作坊。活动并联同大湾区博物馆联盟10间博物馆及24个澳门和本地艺文机构，为第六届粤港澳大湾区文化艺术节的贡献节目。
summary.en: The LCSD's Muse Fest HK 2026 runs from today until November 30, with more than 60 programmes across its 17 museums and art spaces. The opening Fun@Museum Carnival takes place today and tomorrow at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza under the theme 'A Collage of Past and Present, Hong Kong Story', featuring Hong Kong-style pixel-art installations such as the 'Grid Tea Stall' plus nostalgic workshops like mahjong colouring and herbal-tea-sign keychain making. The festival also partners with 10 Greater Bay Area Museum Alliance museums and 24 Macao and local arts organisations as a contribution programme of the 6th GBA Culture and Arts Festival.

image_caption: 「博物館節2026」頭炮「博物館FUN日」今明兩日在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行，圖為港式主題裝置「格仔茶檔」。（政府新聞處）

title.zh_hant: 警方反三合會行動拘58人　包括10名學生
title.zh_hans: 警方反三合会行动拘58人　包括10名学生
title.en: Police arrest 58 in anti-triad operation, including 10 students

summary.zh_hant: 警方有組織罪案及三合會調查科展開反三合會行動，在各區共拘捕58人，年齡介乎14至73歲，其中10人是學生。總督察陳柏琪表示，今年初留意到青少年犯罪有上升趨勢，遂派出探員喬裝深入調查，揭發有青少年被誘騙參與刑事毀壞、販毒及傷人等非法行為。警方前日突擊搜查九龍及新界多個地點，以自稱三合會成員、串謀傷人、販運危險藥物等罪名拘捕49男9女，打擊一個活躍於九龍區、利用青少年犯案的三合會社團，並堵截其收入來源。警方表示行動會繼續，不排除再有人被捕，並提醒青少年不要誤信「搵快錢」的虛假承諾。
summary.zh_hans: 警方有组织罪案及三合会调查科展开反三合会行动，在各区共拘捕58人，年龄介乎14至73岁，其中10人是学生。总督察陈柏琪表示，今年初留意到青少年犯罪有上升趋势，遂派出探员乔装深入调查，揭发有青少年被诱骗参与刑事毁坏、贩毒及伤人等非法行为。警方前日突击搜查九龙及新界多个地点，以自称三合会成员、串谋伤人、贩运危险药物等罪名拘捕49男9女，打击一个活跃于九龙区、利用青少年犯案的三合会社团，并堵截其收入来源。警方表示行动会继续，不排除再有人被捕，并提醒青少年不要误信「搵快钱」的虚假承诺。
summary.en: Police's Organised Crime and Triad Bureau arrested 58 people aged 14 to 73 across Hong Kong in an anti-triad operation, including 10 students. Chief Inspector Chan Pak-ki said officers went undercover earlier this year after spotting a rise in youth crime, uncovering teenagers lured into criminal damage, drug trafficking and wounding. In raids across Kowloon and the New Territories two days ago, 49 men and 9 women were arrested for claiming triad membership, conspiracy to wound, drug trafficking and other offences, dismantling a Kowloon-based triad syndicate that exploited young people and cutting off its income. Police say the operation continues and warned teenagers not to fall for false promises of 'easy money'.

image_caption: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科總督察陳柏琪見記者。（香港電台）

title.zh_hant: 香港法律周下周一開鑼　一連五天聚焦法律科技
title.zh_hans: 香港法律周下周一开锣　一连五天聚焦法律科技
title.en: Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 opens Monday with five-day programme

summary.zh_hant: 律政司年度旗艦活動「香港法律周2026」下周一（11月2日）起一連五天舉行，主題為「協作與創新：法律協同，共創未來」。開幕日將舉行國際統一私法協會100周年亞太區會議，並為該會首個設於羅馬以外的亞太聯絡處揭幕，標誌香港國際法律樞紐地位的重要里程碑。其餘重點活動包括第三屆亞太國際私法峰會、慶祝聯合國國際貿易法委員會成立60周年活動、法律科技論壇，以及第二屆粵港澳大灣區律師論壇。
summary.zh_hans: 律政司年度旗舰活动「香港法律周2026」下周一（11月2日）起一连五天举行，主题为「协作与创新：法律协同，共创未来」。开幕日将举行国际统一私法协会100周年亚太区会议，并为该会首个设于罗马以外的亚太联络处揭幕，标志香港国际法律枢纽地位的重要里程碑。其余重点活动包括第三届亚太国际私法峰会、庆祝联合国国际贸易法委员会成立60周年活动、法律科技论坛，以及第二届粤港澳大湾区律师论坛。
summary.en: The Department of Justice's flagship Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 runs for five days from Monday (November 2) under the theme 'Collaboration & Innovation: Legal Synergy for a Shared Future'. The opening day features the UNIDROIT Centenary Regional Conference for the Asia-Pacific and the opening of UNIDROIT's first office outside Rome — its Asia-Pacific Liaison Office — a milestone for Hong Kong as a legal hub. Other highlights include the 3rd Asia-Pacific International Private Law Summit, a celebration of UNCITRAL's 60th anniversary, the LawTech Forum and the 2nd GBA Lawyers Forum.

title.zh_hant: 幣安稱已補足約八成被盜資產　提幣料11月1日起分階段恢復
title.zh_hans: 币安称已补足约八成被盗资产　提币料11月1日起分阶段恢复
title.en: Binance says 80% of stolen assets recovered, withdrawals to resume Nov 1

summary.zh_hant: 幣安今日凌晨發布第二份事件更新，表示已提撥逾63.4億美元公司資金，補足約八成在10月30日熱錢包被盜事件中損失的資產，其餘正從市場買回。鏈上分析公司TRM Labs及Chainalysis均以高度確信指向北韓黑客組織TraderTraitor所為，FBI已介入調查。幣安指約30億美元被盜資產已被凍結，入金服務維持正常，提幣預計在約34小時內、即11月1日下午起分階段恢復，初步儲備證明將於11月2日前公布。
summary.zh_hans: 币安今日凌晨发布第二份事件更新，表示已提拨逾63.4亿美元公司资金，补足约八成在10月30日热钱包被盗事件中损失的资产，其余正从市场买回。链上分析公司TRM Labs及Chainalysis均以高度确信指向北韩黑客组织TraderTraitor所为，FBI已介入调查。币安指约30亿美元被盗资产已被冻结，入金服务维持正常，提币预计在约34小时内、即11月1日下午起分阶段恢复，初步储备证明将于11月2日前公布。
summary.en: Binance said in a second incident update early today that it has set aside over US$6.34 billion in company funds, covering about 80% of the assets stolen in the October 30 hot-wallet hack, with the rest being bought back from the market. Chainalysis and TRM Labs both attributed the attack to North Korea-linked group TraderTraitor with high confidence, and the FBI has joined the investigation. Binance said about US$3 billion in stolen funds has been frozen, deposits remain normal, and withdrawals are expected to resume in phases from the afternoon of November 1, with an initial proof of reserves due before November 2.

image_caption: 設計圖片。（AI設計圖片）

title.zh_hant: 伊朗稱四艘油輪荷姆茲海峽觸雷起火　美方否認
title.zh_hans: 伊朗称四艘油轮荷姆兹海峡触雷起火　美方否认
title.en: Iran says four tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz; US disputes claim

summary.zh_hant: 伊朗革命衛隊海軍周五表示，第四艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽行經「未經授權南線」時觸雷起火，該艘超級油輪載有逾200萬桶原油；連同周四的三艘，共有四艘油輪起火。伊朗未公布涉事船隻名稱，說法未經獨立核實。英國海事貿易行動辦公室另報告兩宗獨立事件，包括有油輪被不明物體擊中，以及有小艇在船體安裝爆炸裝置引致機艙起火。美軍中央司令部否認伊朗說法，稱主航道的水雷已經清除；阿曼則救起一艘巴拿馬籍油輪上25名船員。事件刺激布蘭特油價升至每桶117美元。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗革命卫队海军周五表示，第四艘油轮在荷姆兹海峡行经「未经授权南线」时触雷起火，该艘超级油轮载有逾200万桶原油；连同周四的三艘，共有四艘油轮起火。伊朗未公布涉事船只名称，说法未经独立核实。英国海事贸易行动办公室另报告两宗独立事件，包括有油轮被不明物体击中，以及有小艇在船体安装爆炸装置引致机舱起火。美军中央司令部否认伊朗说法，称主航道的水雷已经清除；阿曼则救起一艘巴拿马籍油轮上25名船员。事件刺激布兰特油价升至每桶117美元。
summary.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Navy said Friday a fourth oil tanker struck a mine and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz while using an 'unauthorised southern route'; the supertanker was carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude, bringing the total to four tankers ablaze since Thursday. Iran did not name the vessels and the claims could not be independently verified. The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency separately reported two incidents, including a tanker hit by an unknown projectile and explosive devices attached to a hull by a small boat. US Central Command disputed Iran's account, saying mines had been cleared from the main lanes, while Oman rescued 25 crew from a Panama-flagged tanker. Brent crude rose to US$117 a barrel.

title.zh_hant: 美批准向烏克蘭出售500枚愛國者導彈　涉資21億美元
title.zh_hans: 美批准向乌克兰出售500枚爱国者导弹　涉资21亿美元
title.en: US approves $2.1bn sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine

summary.zh_hant: 美國國務院周五批准向烏克蘭出售500枚愛國者PAC-3 MSE型攔截導彈，總值約21億美元。烏克蘭將透過加拿大、德國、挪威的出資及歐盟「烏克蘭支援貸款」，經美國JUMPSTART計劃支付費用，洛克希德馬丁為主要承包商。由於導彈尚未生產，預計要到2030年代初才開始交付。總統澤連斯基11天前曾公開抗議美方軍援延誤。
summary.zh_hans: 美国国务院周五批准向乌克兰出售500枚爱国者PAC-3 MSE型拦截导弹，总值约21亿美元。乌克兰将透过加拿大、德国、挪威的出资及欧盟「乌克兰支援贷款」，经美国JUMPSTART计划支付费用，洛克希德马丁为主要承包商。由于导弹尚未生产，预计要到2030年代初才开始交付。总统泽连斯基11天前曾公开抗议美方军援延误。
summary.en: The US State Department on Friday approved the sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 MSE interceptor missiles to Ukraine for an estimated US$2.1 billion. Kyiv will pay through contributions from Canada, Germany and Norway channelled via the US JUMPSTART programme, plus funds from the EU's Ukraine Support Loan, with Lockheed Martin as the principal contractor. With the missiles yet to be manufactured, deliveries are not expected until the early 2030s. President Zelensky had publicly protested delays in US military aid 11 days earlier.

title.en: 6th Greater Bay Area Culture and Arts Festival opens with Hong Kong programmes touring GBA cities
title.zh_hans: 第六届粤港澳大湾区文化艺术节开幕　港精彩节目巡演大湾区
title.zh_hant: 第六屆粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節開幕　港精彩節目巡演大灣區

summary.en: The 6th Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Culture and Arts Festival opened today, running about six weeks across GBA cities. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department has curated 23 local and visiting programmes and exhibitions to bring high-calibre Hong Kong productions to Mainland GBA cities. Under Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Raistlin Lau said at tonight's opening ceremony in Shenzhen that arts and cultural exchange is a key bridge in building a world-class bay area.
summary.zh_hans: 第六届粤港澳大湾区文化艺术节今日开幕，一连约六个星期在大湾区各城市举行。康文署策划23个本地及访港节目与展览，支持香港艺团和艺术家将高质素制作带到内地大湾区城市。文化体育及旅游局副局长刘震今晚在深圳出席开幕礼并致辞，指艺文交流是建设世界级湾区的重要桥梁。
summary.zh_hant: 第六屆粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節今日開幕，一連約六個星期在大灣區各城市舉行。康文署策劃23個本地及訪港節目與展覽，支持香港藝團和藝術家將高質素製作帶到內地大灣區城市。文化體育及旅遊局副局長劉震今晚在深圳出席開幕禮並致辭，指藝文交流是建設世界級灣區的重要橋樑。

title.en: Hong Kong Customs seizes 10 suspected endangered live turtles at airport
title.zh_hans: 海关机场检获10只疑濒危活龟　估值约10万元
title.zh_hant: 海關機場檢獲10隻疑瀕危活龜　估值約10萬元

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs today seized 10 live turtles of suspected endangered species, worth about HK$100,000, at Hong Kong International Airport. Officers intercepted two parcels from the United States declared as plastic home products and found the turtles inside. The case was handed to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department; importing endangered species in breach of the ordinance carries up to HK$10 million in fines and 10 years' jail.
summary.zh_hans: 海关今日在香港国际机场检获10只疑属濒危物种的活龟，估计市值约10万元。海关人员经风险评估，截查两个由美国寄往香港、报称载有塑胶家居用品的邮包，发现该批活龟藏于其中。案件已交渔农自然护理署跟进；根据《保护濒危动植物物种条例》，违例进口濒危物种最高可罚款1,000万元及监禁10年。
summary.zh_hant: 海關今日在香港國際機場檢獲10隻疑屬瀕危物種的活龜，估計市值約10萬元。海關人員經風險評估，截查兩個由美國寄往香港、報稱載有塑膠家居用品的郵包，發現該批活龜藏於其中。案件已交漁農自然護理署跟進；根據《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》，違例進口瀕危物種最高可罰款1,000萬元及監禁10年。

image_caption: 海關檢獲的疑屬瀕危物種活龜。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Mark Six Halloween Snowball: no jackpot winner; next draw Nov 5 with HK$108M top prize
title.zh_hans: 万圣节金多宝搅珠结果：头奖无人中　下期11月5日头奖1.08亿
title.zh_hant: 萬聖節金多寶攪珠結果：頭獎無人中　下期11月5日頭獎1.08億

summary.en: Tonight's Mark Six Halloween Snowball draw produced numbers 10, 11, 19, 27, 37 and 43 with special number 8, but no jackpot winner. Turnover reached about HK$188 million; 9.5 second-prize tickets won HK$716,830 each and 317 third-prize tickets won HK$57,280 each. With the jackpot unclaimed, the scheduled Nov 3 draw is cancelled; the next draw on Thursday, Nov 5 carries an estimated HK$108 million top prize including over HK$80.43 million in snowball funds.
summary.zh_hans: 六合彩万圣节金多宝今晚搅珠，搅出号码为10、11、19、27、37、43，特别号码8，头奖无人中奖。投注总额约1.88亿元，二奖9.5注中，每注派71.68万元；三奖317注中，每注派5.73万元。由于头奖落空，原订11月3日的搅珠取消，下期11月5日（星期四）搅珠，估计头奖基金1.08亿元，其中多宝逾8,042万元。
summary.zh_hant: 六合彩萬聖節金多寶今晚攪珠，攪出號碼為10、11、19、27、37、43，特別號碼8，頭獎無人中獎。投注總額約1.88億元，二獎9.5注中，每注派71.68萬元；三獎317注中，每注派5.73萬元。由於頭獎落空，原訂11月3日的攪珠取消，下期11月5日（星期四）攪珠，估計頭獎基金1.08億元，其中多寶逾8,042萬元。

title.en: Halloween crowds pack Lan Kwai Fong; police impose crowd control, urge revellers to go elsewhere
title.zh_hans: 万圣节兰桂坊逼爆　警方人流管制吁转往他区
title.zh_hant: 萬聖節蘭桂坊逼爆　警方人流管制籲轉往他區

summary.en: Central's Lan Kwai Fong was packed on Halloween night, with police imposing one-way crowd control from the evening and urging the public to consider celebrating elsewhere. On-site signs showed it would take about 180 minutes to walk from IFC to Lan Kwai Fong. Some Mainland tourists made special trips to Hong Kong for the atmosphere, while others were put off by the crowds.
summary.zh_hans: 万圣节晚上中环兰桂坊人头涌涌，警方由傍晚起实施单向人流管制，并呼吁市民考虑转往其他地区庆祝。有现场指示牌显示，由国际金融中心步行往兰桂坊需时约180分钟。有内地旅客专程来港感受气氛，亦有旅客见人潮挤拥后打退堂鼓。
summary.zh_hant: 萬聖節晚上中環蘭桂坊人頭湧湧，警方由傍晚起實施單向人流管制，並呼籲市民考慮轉往其他地區慶祝。有現場指示牌顯示，由國際金融中心步行往蘭桂坊需時約180分鐘。有內地旅客專程來港感受氣氛，亦有旅客見人潮擠擁後打退堂鼓。

title.en: Anthropic warns small AI models could gain self-replication ability within months
title.zh_hans: Anthropic警告：小型AI模型或数月内能自我复制扩散
title.zh_hant: Anthropic警告：小型AI模型或數月內能自我複製擴散

summary.en: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team has published research warning that small AI models could gain the ability to self-replicate and spread across insecure devices within months, potentially forming hard-to-eradicate autonomous networks. Cybersecurity experts say this would mark an evolution of Mirai-style botnets, as AI can identify unfamiliar devices on its own. Anthropic recently filed for an IPO, prompting questions over whether the timing uses safety concerns for marketing.
summary.zh_hans: Anthropic旗下 Frontier Red Team 发表研究，警告小型人工智能模型可能在数月内具备自我复制并在不安全设备上扩散的能力，或形成难以根除的自主网络。有网络安全专家认为，这代表僵尸网络攻击手法的演变，AI可自行识别陌生设备。Anthropic近期刚提交上市申请，研究发表时机引起借安全议题作市场推广的质疑。
summary.zh_hant: Anthropic旗下 Frontier Red Team 發表研究，警告小型人工智能模型可能在數月內具備自我複製並在不安全設備上擴散的能力，或形成難以根除的自主網絡。有網絡安全專家認為，這代表殭屍網絡攻擊手法的演變，AI可自行識別陌生設備。Anthropic近期剛提交上市申請，研究發表時機引起借安全議題作市場推廣的質疑。

title.en: Seven-year-old girl in critical condition with severe influenza A infection
title.zh_hant: 7歲女童染甲型流感併發敗血性休克　情況危殆
title.zh_hans: 7岁女童染甲型流感并发败血性休克　情况危殆

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection today recorded a severe paediatric influenza case. A seven-year-old girl with underlying illness developed a runny nose, diarrhoea and abdominal pain on Oct 29, then fever and convulsion the next day; she was sent to Tuen Mun Hospital A&E and transferred to paediatric ICU, diagnosed with influenza A (H1) complicated by septic shock, now in critical condition. She had no travel history and had not received this season's flu vaccine. This season has seen 28 severe paediatric cases: 20 recovered, two stable, four critical and two deaths. The CHP urges early vaccination.
summary.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心今日公布一宗兒童嚴重流感個案。一名7歲女童本身有長期病患，10月29日起出現流鼻涕、肚瀉及肚痛，翌日發燒抽搐送往屯門醫院急症室，其後轉入兒科深切治療部，確診甲型（H1）流感併發敗血性休克，現時情況危殆。女童在潛伏期內無外遊，亦未接種今季流感疫苗。本流感季至今累計28宗兒童嚴重個案，當中20人已康復出院、2人穩定、4人危殆、2人死亡。防護中心呼籲市民盡早接種疫苗。
summary.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心今日公布一宗儿童严重流感个案。一名7岁女童本身有长期病患，10月29日起出现流鼻涕、肚泻及肚痛，翌日发烧抽搐送往屯门医院急症室，其后转入儿科深切治疗部，确诊甲型（H1）流感并发败血性休克，现时情况危殆。女童在潜伏期内无外游，亦未接种今季流感疫苗。本流感季至今累计28宗儿童严重个案，当中20人已康复出院、2人稳定、4人危殆、2人死亡。防护中心呼吁市民尽早接种疫苗。

title.en: Quad foreign ministers voice grave concern over economic coercion in Atlanta
title.zh_hant: 四國外長亞特蘭大會談　就經濟脅迫表達深刻關切
title.zh_hans: 四国外长亚特兰大会谈　就经济胁迫表达深刻关切

summary.en: The foreign ministers of Japan, the United States, Australia and India held a Quad foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta today and issued a joint press release. With China in mind, the statement expressed grave concern over economic coercion including arbitrary export controls and overcapacity. The meeting took place on the sidelines of the G20 foreign ministers' meeting.
summary.zh_hant: 日本、美國、澳洲及印度四國外長今日在美國亞特蘭大舉行「四方安全對話」外長會議，並發表共同聲明。聲明以中國為念，就恣意的出口管制及產能過剩等經濟脅迫表達深刻關切。會議在二十國集團外長會議場邊舉行。
summary.zh_hans: 日本、美国、澳洲及印度四国外长今日在美国亚特兰大举行「四方安全对话」外长会议，并发表共同声明。声明以中国为念，就恣意的出口管制及产能过剩等经济胁迫表达深刻关切。会议在二十国集团外长会议场边举行。

title.en: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17 billion in cash-and-stock deal
title.zh_hant: DoorDash 斥資 170 億美元收購 Instacart　每股作價 65 美元
title.zh_hans: DoorDash 斥资 170 亿美元收购 Instacart　每股作价 65 美元

summary.en: DoorDash announced on Thursday that it has agreed to acquire grocery delivery rival Instacart for $65 per share, an equity value of about $17 billion, in a definitive agreement approved by both companies' boards. At least 75 per cent of the consideration will be paid in cash, with DoorDash stock capped at 25 per cent; the price represents a 26 per cent premium to Instacart's October 22 closing price. DoorDash said it will keep the Instacart brand, app and enterprise technology products, and the two companies will continue to operate separately until the deal closes, expected toward the end of 2027 or in the first half of 2028. The combination pairs DoorDash's restaurant-delivery network with Instacart's grocery platform as delivery consolidation accelerates against rivals such as Uber, Amazon and Walmart.
summary.zh_hant: DoorDash 於星期四宣布，已同意以每股 65 美元、總值約 170 億美元收購雜貨外送對手 Instacart，交易已獲兩間公司董事會批准。代價至少七成半以現金支付，DoorDash 股票佔比上限為四分一；作價較 Instacart 於 10 月 22 日的收市價溢價 26%。DoorDash 表示會保留 Instacart 品牌、應用程式及企業技術產品，交易完成前兩間公司會繼續獨立營運，預計於 2027 年底或 2028 年上半年完成交割。這宗合併將 DoorDash 的餐飲外送網絡與 Instacart 的雜貨平台結合，應對 Uber、Amazon 及 Walmart 等對手的競爭。
summary.zh_hans: DoorDash 于星期四宣布，已同意以每股 65 美元、总值约 170 亿美元收购杂货外送对手 Instacart，交易已获两间公司董事会批准。代价至少七成半以现金支付，DoorDash 股票占比上限为四分之一；作价较 Instacart 于 10 月 22 日的收市价溢价 26%。DoorDash 表示会保留 Instacart 品牌、应用程序及企业技术产品，交易完成前两间公司会继续独立营运，预计于 2027 年底或 2028 年上半年完成交割。这宗合并将 DoorDash 的餐饮外送网络与 Instacart 的杂货平台结合，应对 Uber、Amazon 及 Walmart 等对手的竞争。

title.en: Amazon, Intel tumble after earnings as AI spending worries investors
title.zh_hant: Amazon 及 Intel 業績後急挫　市場憂慮 AI 開支燒錢
title.zh_hans: Amazon 及 Intel 业绩后急挫　市场忧虑 AI 开支烧钱

summary.en: Amazon shares fell more than 6% in after-hours trading on Thursday after the e-commerce giant's third-quarter results missed Wall Street expectations, with revenue of $201.9 billion up 12% and earnings per share of $1.89. Its cloud arm AWS grew 39% to $46 billion, the fastest pace in nearly five years, but investors balked at negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion as the company reaffirmed plans to spend about $220 billion this year, mostly on AI infrastructure. Intel fared worse: third-quarter revenue rose 21% to $16.5 billion, but weak fourth-quarter guidance of $15 billion to $16 billion sent the stock down as much as 20% after hours. The selloff, which also dragged Nasdaq futures lower, capped a bruising week for tech after Alphabet's own spending-fuelled slide.
summary.zh_hant: Amazon 星期四收市後公布第三季業績，收入 2019 億美元、按年增長 12%，每股盈利 1.89 美元，雙雙遜於華爾街預期，股價盤後急跌逾 6%。雲業務 AWS 收入大增 39% 至 460 億美元，創近五年最快增速，但公司維持全年約 2200 億美元資本開支（主要投向 AI 基建），過去 12 個月自由現金流轉為負 424 億美元，令投資者卻步。Intel 更慘：第三季收入按年升 21% 至 165 億美元，但第四季指引僅 150 至 160 億美元，遠遜預期，股價盤後最多跌兩成。連同早前 Alphabet 的急跌，科技股迎來難熬一週，納指期貨亦受壓。
summary.zh_hans: Amazon 星期四收市后公布第三季业绩，收入 2019 亿美元、按年增长 12%，每股盈利 1.89 美元，双双逊于华尔街预期，股价盘后急跌逾 6%。云业务 AWS 收入大增 39% 至 460 亿美元，创近五年最快增速，但公司维持全年约 2200 亿美元资本开支（主要投向 AI 基建），过去 12 个月自由现金流转为负 424 亿美元，令投资者却步。Intel 更惨：第三季收入按年升 21% 至 165 亿美元，但第四季指引仅 150 至 160 亿美元，远逊预期，股价盘后最多跌两成。连同早前 Alphabet 的急跌，科技股迎来难熬一周，纳指期货亦受压。

title.en: Russian drone strike on Dnipro train station kills at least 14
title.zh_hant: 俄羅斯無人機襲擊第聶伯羅火車站　至少 14 人死亡
title.zh_hans: 俄罗斯无人机袭击第聂伯罗火车站　至少 14 人死亡

summary.en: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a crowded platform at the main railway station in Dnipro, Ukraine, on Thursday, killing at least 14 people as a commuter train prepared to depart for Zaporizhzhia, Ukrainian officials said. At least 14 more were wounded, including an 11-year-old boy, in what authorities called one of the deadliest single strikes on Ukrainian passenger rail this year. Five more people were killed in daytime strikes elsewhere — two teenage girls in Chernihiv and three in an apartment building in Kremenchuk. President Volodymyr Zelensky posted images of the aftermath and called on the United States, Europe and the G7 to tighten sanctions, while a fragile six-day humanitarian truce in the Kherson region held elsewhere.
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭官員表示，俄羅斯一架噴射式無人機星期四擊中第聶伯羅中央火車站一個擠滿乘客的月台，當時一班開往扎波羅熱的通勤列車正準備出發，至少 14 人死亡。另有至少 14 人受傷，包括一名 11 歲男童，是今年針對烏克蘭客運鐵路最致命的單一襲擊之一。同日其他地區的日間襲擊再造成 5 人死亡，包括車尼希夫兩名十幾歲少女及克列緬丘格一幢住宅大樓 3 人。總統澤連斯基公開現場相片，呼籲美國、歐洲及七國集團收緊對俄制裁；與此同時，赫爾松地區為期六天的人道主義停火仍在維持。
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰官员表示，俄罗斯一架喷射式无人机星期四击中第聂伯罗中央火车站一个挤满乘客的月台，当时一班开往扎波罗热的通勤列车正准备出发，至少 14 人死亡。另有至少 14 人受伤，包括一名 11 岁男童，是今年针对乌克兰客运铁路最致命的单一袭击之一。同日其他地区的日间袭击再造成 5 人死亡，包括切尔尼戈夫两名十几岁少女及克列缅丘格一幢住宅大楼 3 人。总统泽连斯基公开现场相片，呼吁美国、欧洲及七国集团收紧对俄制裁；与此同时，赫尔松地区为期六天的人道主义停火仍在维持。

title.en: PAG to buy 51% stake in Evergrande Property Services for HK$4.03 billion
title.zh_hant: PAG 擬 40.26 億元收購恒大物業 51% 股權　成新控股股東
title.zh_hans: PAG 拟 40.26 亿元收购恒大物业 51% 股权　成新控股股东

summary.en: China Evergrande plans to sell a roughly 51% stake in Evergrande Property Services to alternative investment firm PAG for HK$4.026 billion, making PAG the new controlling shareholder. PAG will also make a general offer to other shareholders at HK$0.8359 per share, about 29.5% below Wednesday's closing price. The company says it will stay listed with no major changes to its operations, subject to regulatory approval.
summary.zh_hant: 中國恒大公布，計劃向另類投資公司 PAG 出售恒大物業約 51% 股權，總代價 40.26 億港元，PAG 將成為恒大物業新控股股東。PAG 同時向其他股東提出全面收購，每股作價 0.8359 元，較周三收市價折讓近三成。恒大物業表示交易完成後會維持上市地位，業務營運暫無重大變動；交易仍待監管機構批准。
summary.zh_hans: 中国恒大公布，计划向另类投资公司 PAG 出售恒大物业约 51% 股权，总代价 40.26 亿港元，PAG 将成为恒大物业新控股股东。PAG 同时向其他股东提出全面收购，每股作价 0.8359 元，较周三收市价折让近三成。恒大物业表示交易完成后会维持上市地位，业务营运暂无重大变动；交易仍待监管机构批准。

title.en: North Korea fires around 10 ballistic missiles off east coast, Seoul says
title.zh_hant: 北韓向東部海域發射約 10 枚彈道導彈　首爾稱射程約 250 公里
title.zh_hans: 北韩向东部海域发射约 10 枚弹道导弹　首尔称射程约 250 公里

summary.en: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said North Korea fired around 10 short-range ballistic missiles from near Wonsan on its east coast at about 12:30pm Thursday, each flying roughly 250km into the eastern waters. Japan's defence ministry also detected the suspected launches, saying the projectiles fell outside Japan's exclusive economic zone. Seoul's presidential National Security Office held an emergency meeting; it was Pyongyang's first ballistic missile test since October 12 and its more than 10th weapons test this year.
summary.zh_hant: 韓國聯合參謀本部表示，北韓於星期四中午約 12 時半，從東岸元山一帶向東部海域發射約 10 枚短程彈道導彈，每枚飛行約 250 公里。日本防衛省亦偵測到疑似彈道導彈發射，指物體落在日本專屬經濟區之外。韓國總統府國家安全室召開緊急會議評估局勢；這是北韓自 10 月 12 日以來再次試射導彈，今年已超過 10 次。
summary.zh_hans: 韩国联合参谋本部表示，北韩于星期四中午约 12 时半，从东岸元山一带向东部海域发射约 10 枚短程弹道导弹，每枚飞行约 250 公里。日本防卫省亦侦测到疑似弹道导弹发射，指物体落在日本专属经济区之外。韩国总统府国家安全室召开紧急会议评估局势；这是北韩自 10 月 12 日以来再次试射导弹，今年已超过 10 次。

title.en: Mainland woman jailed 9 months for smuggling 71,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes
title.zh_hant: 內地女旅客走私 7.1 萬支未完稅香煙　判監 9 個月罰款 2,000 元
title.zh_hans: 内地女旅客走私 7.1 万支未完税香烟　判监 9 个月罚款 2,000 元

summary.en: A 27-year-old Mainland woman who flew into Hong Kong from Bangkok was intercepted at Hong Kong International Airport yesterday, with about 71,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes found in her personal baggage. The haul had an estimated market value of $320,000 and a duty potential of about $240,000. She was sentenced today at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts to nine months' imprisonment and fined $2,000. Customs said the custodial sentence carries a strong deterrent effect, and reminded the public that importing, possessing or dealing in duty-not-paid cigarettes carries a maximum penalty of a $2 million fine and seven years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hant: 一名 27 歲內地女旅客昨日由泰國曼谷飛抵香港，在香港國際機場被海關截查，行李內搜出約 7.1 萬支未完稅香煙，市值約 32 萬元，應課稅款約 24 萬元。她今日在西九龍裁判法院被判監 9 個月及罰款 2,000 元。海關表示判刑具相當阻嚇作用，反映罪行嚴重性；並提醒市民，進口、管有、處理、售賣或購買未完稅香煙均屬違法，最高可罰款 200 萬元及監禁 7 年。
summary.zh_hans: 一名 27 岁内地女旅客昨日由泰国曼谷飞抵香港，在香港国际机场被海关截查，行李内搜出约 7.1 万支未完税香烟，市值约 32 万元，应课税款约 24 万元。她今日在西九龙裁判法院被判监 9 个月及罚款 2,000 元。海关表示判刑具相当阻吓作用，反映罪行严重性；并提醒市民，进口、管有、处理、售卖或购买未完税香烟均属违法，最高可罚款 200 万元及监禁 7 年。

image_caption: 海關檢獲的未完稅香煙。（政府新聞處）

title.en: 10th Hong Kong-Shanghai financial co-operation meeting held in Shanghai; MOU signed on dispute resolution
title.zh_hant: 滬港金融合作第十次工作會議上海舉行　簽備忘錄加強金融糾紛調解合作
title.zh_hans: 沪港金融合作第十次工作会议上海举行　签备忘录加强金融纠纷调解合作

summary.en: The 10th Working Meeting of Hong Kong-Shanghai Financial Co-operation was held in Shanghai today. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui led Hong Kong's financial regulators in talks with Shanghai counterparts, led by Li Junjie of the Shanghai Office for Advancing International Financial Center Development, on market connectivity, cross-boundary Renminbi business, commodities, gold and futures markets, insurance and talent exchanges. Hui witnessed the signing of an MOU between Hong Kong's Financial Dispute Resolution Centre and its Shanghai counterpart to promote alternative dispute resolution for financial disputes. Hui also met the new chairman of the Shanghai Gold Exchange, Guo Dayong, during the visit.
summary.zh_hant: 第十屆滬港金融合作工作會議今日在上海舉行。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇率領本港金融監管機構代表，與上海市推進國際金融中心建設辦公室主任李俊傑等上海方面代表，商討加強兩地金融市場互聯互通、跨境人民幣業務、商品黃金期貨市場、保險合作及人才交流。許正宇見證香港金融糾紛調解中心與上海金融消費糾紛調解中心簽署合作備忘錄，推動金融糾紛替代性爭議解決機制。訪滬期間，許正宇亦會晤上海黃金交易所新任理事長郭大勇。
summary.zh_hans: 第十届沪港金融合作工作会议今日在上海举行。财经事务及库务局局长许正宇率领本港金融监管机构代表，与上海市推进国际金融中心建设办公室主任李俊杰等上海方面代表，商讨加强两地金融市场互联互通、跨境人民币业务、商品黄金期货市场、保险合作及人才交流。许正宇见证香港金融纠纷调解中心与上海金融消费纠纷调解中心签署合作备忘录，推动金融纠纷替代性争议解决机制。访沪期间，许正宇亦会晤上海黄金交易所新任理事长郭大勇。

image_caption: 滬港金融合作第十次工作會議今日在上海舉行。（政府新聞處）

title.en: New yearbook "Hong Kong 2025" goes on sale, priced at $440, featuring Kai Tak Sports Park on cover
title.zh_hant: 新年刊《香港 2025》今日開售　封面主打啟德體育園　定價 440 元
title.zh_hans: 新年刊《香港 2025》今日开售　封面主打启德体育园　定价 440 元

summary.en: The government's latest yearbook, "Hong Kong 2025", went on sale today at $440, with the online version available on yearbook.gov.hk. The publication reviews life in Hong Kong in 2025 across the administration, legislature, economy and society. The cover illustration features Kai Tak Sports Park, the largest sports infrastructure project ever commissioned in Hong Kong, which also headlines "Home of Mega Events", one of the yearbook's 10 photo sections. Copies are available at the online Government Bookstore and the Information Services Department's Publications Sales Unit in North Point.
summary.zh_hant: 政府新年刊《香港 2025》今日開售，售價 440 元，網上版同步上載至 yearbook.gov.hk。年刊綜述 2025 年香港在行政、立法、經濟及社會各方面的面貌。封面插圖為香港歷來最大型體育基建項目啟德體育園；全書 10 個圖片專輯之一「盛事之都」亦以體育園為主題。讀者可經網上政府書店或新聞處位於北角的刊物銷售組購買。
summary.zh_hans: 政府新年刊《香港 2025》今日开售，售价 440 元，网上版同步上载至 yearbook.gov.hk。年刊综述 2025 年香港在行政、立法、经济及社会各方面的面貌。封面插图为香港历来最大型体育基建项目启德体育园；全书 10 个图片专辑之一「盛事之都」亦以体育园为主题。读者可经网上政府书店或新闻处位于北角的刊物销售组购买。

image_caption: 新年刊《香港 2025》今日開售，封面為啟德體育園。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Strive and Rise Programme opens fifth-cohort recruitment: 4,000 places, $5,000 start-up grant each
title.zh_hant: 「共創明『Teen』計劃」第五期今起招募　4,000 名額每人 5,000 元啟動資金
title.zh_hans: 「共创明『Teen』计划」第五期今起招募　4,000 名额每人 5,000 元启动资金

summary.en: The Strive and Rise Programme today began recruiting 4,000 mentees for its fifth cohort. Led by an interdepartmental task force under the Chief Secretary for Administration, the programme pairs underprivileged junior secondary students with volunteer mentors through a tripartite government-business-community collaboration, offering a one-year intensive foundation training. Each mentee receives $5,000 in start-up financial support, and graduates automatically join the programme's alumni association. Eligible students may apply through their schools or the NGOs assisting the programme.
summary.zh_hant: 「共創明『Teen』計劃」今日起招募第五期 4,000 名學員。計劃由政務司司長領導的跨部門專責小組制定推行，透過政、商、民三方協作，為基層初中生配對義務友師，提供為期一年密集式基礎培訓。每名學員可獲 5,000 元啟動資金，完成培訓後自動成為校友會會員。合資格學生可經學校或協助推行計劃的非政府機構報名。
summary.zh_hans: 「共创明『Teen』计划」今日起招募第五期 4,000 名学员。计划由政务司司长领导的跨部门专责小组制定推行，透过政、商、民三方协作，为基层初中生配对义务友师，提供为期一年密集式基础培训。每名学员可获 5,000 元启动资金，完成培训后自动成为校友会会员。合资格学生可经学校或协助推行计划的非政府机构报名。

title.en: Heated water at 30 public swimming pools from November 8
title.zh_hant: 康文署 30 個公眾泳池 11 月 8 日起供應暖水
title.zh_hans: 康文署 30 个公众泳池 11 月 8 日起供应暖水

summary.en: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced today that 30 public swimming pools under its management will provide heated water from November 8, so swimmers can keep swimming through the winter. Details of opening arrangements and weekly cleaning schedules are available on the department's website.
summary.zh_hant: 康樂及文化事務署今日宣布，轄下 30 個公眾游泳池將於 11 月 8 日起供應暖水，方便市民在冬季繼續游泳。各泳池開放安排及每周清潔時間詳情，可查閱康文署網頁。
summary.zh_hans: 康乐及文化事务署今日宣布，辖下 30 个公众游泳池将于 11 月 8 日起供应暖水，方便市民在冬季继续游泳。各泳池开放安排及每周清洁时间详情，可查阅康文署网页。

title.en: HKMAO commentary hails Hong Kong government's accountability over Wang Fuk Court fire
title.zh_hant: 港澳辦「港澳平」發文　肯定特區政府嚴肅追責問責　展現擔當勇氣
title.zh_hans: 港澳办「港澳平」发文　肯定特区政府严肃追责问责　展现担当勇气

summary.en: The Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office published a commentary under the byline "Gang Ao Ping" today, endorsing the Hong Kong government's handling of the Wang Fuk Court fire. It said the government's public apology, criminal prosecutions, administrative accountability and the political responsibility taken by officials were serious, fair and proportionate, fully demonstrating a responsible government's courage. The article noted 99.3% of affected owners have accepted the government's buyout offer, and said the building-maintenance loopholes exposed by the fire are deep-rooted institutional problems accumulated over years that can only be fixed through thorough systemic reform.
summary.zh_hant: 中央港澳辦、國務院港澳辦今日發表署名「港澳平」文章，肯定特區政府就大埔宏福苑火災向公眾道歉，並按獨立委員會報告作出刑事追責、行政問責及政治責任承擔。文章形容三個層面的追責問責嚴肅認真、實事求是、責罰相適，充分體現負責任政府的擔當和勇氣。文章又指，已有 99.3% 宏福苑業主接受政府收購方案；火災暴露的樓宇維修制度漏洞及監管權責不清，屬長期積累的體制深層次問題，必須「刮骨療傷」深化系統性改革才能根治。
summary.zh_hans: 中央港澳办、国务院港澳办今日发表署名「港澳平」文章，肯定特区政府就大埔宏福苑火灾向公众道歉，并按独立委员会报告作出刑事追责、行政问责及政治责任承担。文章形容三个层面的追责问责严肃认真、实事求是、责罚相适，充分体现负责任政府的担当和勇气。文章又指，已有 99.3% 宏福苑业主接受政府收购方案；火灾暴露的楼宇维修制度漏洞及监管权责不清，属长期积累的体制深层次问题，必须「刮骨疗伤」深化系统性改革才能根治。

title.en: Immigration Department arrests 10 in territory-wide anti-illegal worker operations
title.zh_hant: 入境處全港反非法勞工行動拘 10 人　8 名疑似黑工包括持擔保書者
title.zh_hans: 入境处全港反非法劳工行动拘 10 人　8 名疑似黑工包括持担保书者

summary.en: The Immigration Department mounted a series of territory-wide anti-illegal worker operations from October 23 to 29, including joint operations with the Police, the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. Officers raided restaurants, flats under renovation and massage parlours, arresting eight suspected illegal workers — all women aged 25 to 63, two of whom held recognisance forms barring them from employment — as well as a 63-year-old woman suspected of employing them and a 26-year-old male overstayer. The department warned that breaching a condition of stay is an offence and that visitors are not allowed to take any employment in Hong Kong, paid or unpaid.
summary.zh_hant: 入境事務處於 10 月 23 日至 29 日展開一連串全港反非法勞工行動，包括與警務處、食物環境衞生署及康樂及文化事務署的聯合行動，代號分別為「暮光」、「冠軍」及「愕然」。行動中突擊搜查多個目標地點，包括食肆、裝修中單位及按摩院，共拘捕 8 名疑似非法勞工（均為 25 至 63 歲女子，其中兩人持不准僱用工作的擔保書）、一名 63 歲疑聘用黑工的女子，以及一名 26 歲逾期逗留男子。入境處發言人強調，任何人違反逗留條件即屬違法，訪客不論有薪或無薪均不得在港工作。
summary.zh_hans: 入境事务处于 10 月 23 日至 29 日展开一连串全港反非法劳工行动，包括与警务处、食物环境卫生署及康乐及文化事务署的联合行动，代号分别为「暮光」、「冠军」及「愕然」。行动中突击搜查多个目标地点，包括食肆、装修中单位及按摩院，共拘捕 8 名疑似非法劳工（均为 25 至 63 岁女子，其中两人持不准雇用工作的担保书）、一名 63 岁疑聘用黑工的女子，以及一名 26 岁逾期逗留男子。入境处发言人强调，任何人违反逗留条件即属违法，访客不论有薪或无薪均不得在港工作。

title.en: Customs seizes suspected endangered live bird at Lo Wu; 70-year-old man intercepted
title.zh_hant: 海關羅湖截七旬漢　行李搜出疑瀕危物種活雀鳥
title.zh_hans: 海关罗湖截七旬汉　行李搜出疑濒危物种活雀鸟

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs yesterday seized a live bird of a suspected scheduled endangered species, with an estimated market value of about HK$4,000, at the Lo Wu Control Point. Officers intercepted a 70-year-old local male passenger at the arrival hall and found the bird in his personal baggage; Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department officers preliminarily identified it as an endangered species regulated under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species. The case has been handed to the AFCD for follow-up. Under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, offenders face a maximum fine of HK$10 million and 10 years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關昨日（10 月 29 日）在羅湖管制站截查一名 70 歲本地男旅客時，在其個人行李內搜出一隻懷疑屬附表瀕危物種的活雀鳥，估計市值約 4,000 元。漁農自然護理署人員到場初步鑑定，確認該雀鳥屬《瀕危野生動植物種國際貿易公約》附錄所列、受《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》規管的瀕危物種，案件已轉交漁護署跟進調查。根據條例，任何人非法進出口或管有瀕危物種標本，一經定罪最高可判罰款 1,000 萬元及監禁 10 年，標本會被沒收。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关昨日（10 月 29 日）在罗湖管制站截查一名 70 岁本地男旅客时，在其个人行李内搜出一只怀疑属附表濒危物种的活雀鸟，估计市值约 4,000 元。渔农自然护理署人员到场初步鉴定，确认该雀鸟属《濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约》附录所列、受《保护濒危动植物物种条例》规管的濒危物种，案件已转交渔护署跟进调查。根据条例，任何人非法进出口或管有濒危物种标本，一经定罪最高可判罚款 1,000 万元及监禁 10 年，标本会被没收。

image_caption: 海關檢獲的懷疑瀕危物種活雀鳥。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Customs seizes 8,000kg of duty-not-paid manufactured tobacco at Shenzhen Bay
title.zh_hant: 海關深圳灣破走私製成煙草案　檢 8,000 公斤市值 5,340 萬
title.zh_hans: 海关深圳湾破走私制成烟草案　检 8,000 公斤市值 5,340 万

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs yesterday detected a duty-not-paid manufactured tobacco smuggling case at the Shenzhen Bay Control Point, seizing about 8,000 kilograms of manufactured tobacco with an estimated market value of HK$53.4 million and a duty potential of about HK$32 million. Acting on intelligence, officers intercepted an inbound medium goods vehicle declared to be carrying plastic films and carton sealing tapes, and found about 400 boxes of unmanifested, duty-not-paid manufactured tobacco inside. A 55-year-old male local driver was arrested. Customs said the case is still under investigation and further arrests are not ruled out.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關昨日（10 月 29 日）在深圳灣管制站偵破一宗未完稅製成煙草走私案，檢獲約 8,000 公斤未完稅製成煙草，估計市值約 5,340 萬元，應課稅款約 3,200 萬元。海關根據情報分析，截查一輛報稱載有膠片及封箱膠紙的入境中型貨車，經檢查後發現車上藏有約 400 箱未列艙單的未完稅製成煙草，以及少量其他未申報貨物。一名 55 歲本地男司機被捕。海關表示案件仍在調查中，不排除再有人被捕。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关昨日（10 月 29 日）在深圳湾管制站侦破一宗未完税制成烟草走私案，检获约 8,000 公斤未完税制成烟草，估计市值约 5,340 万元，应课税款约 3,200 万元。海关根据情报分析，截查一辆报称载有胶片及封箱胶纸的入境中型货车，经检查后发现车上藏有约 400 箱未列舱单的未完税制成烟草，以及少量其他未申报货物。一名 55 岁本地男司机被捕。海关表示案件仍在调查中，不排除再有人被捕。

image_caption: 海關在深圳灣檢獲的未完稅製成煙草。（政府新聞處）

title.en: Government proposes criminalising bid-rigging in building maintenance projects after Wang Fuk Court report
title.zh_hant: 宏福苑火災調查報告建議　政府倡立法刑事化樓宇維修圍標
title.zh_hans: 宏福苑火灾调查报告建议　政府倡立法刑事化楼宇维修围标

summary.en: Acting on the report of the Independent Committee on the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, the Security Bureau and the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau — joined by the Police, the ICAC and the Competition Commission — today announced a proposal to criminalise bid-rigging in building maintenance and renovation projects, alongside enhanced anti-bid-rigging measures. The committee's report found bid-rigging in major maintenance projects to be a serious problem in Hong Kong, with people of suspicious backgrounds, including triad groups, manipulating tender results and colluding with consultants, professionals and contractors in corruption and fraud. The government will pursue reform through a three-pronged approach: legislative amendments, law-enforcement co-ordination and frontline prevention.
summary.zh_hant: 就大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會的報告，保安局與商務及經濟發展局今日（10 月 30 日）聯同警務處、廉政公署及競爭事務委員會，公布建議將樓宇維修及翻新工程的圍標行為刑事化，並加強打擊圍標的措施。委員會報告指出，本港大型樓宇維修工程圍標問題嚴重，有可疑背景人士（包括三合會）操控投標結果，並與顧問、專業人士及承建商勾結，涉及貪污及其他欺詐行為。政府將循三方面推進改革：修訂法例、加強執法協調，以及前線預防，全方位嚴厲打擊樓宇維修圍標。
summary.zh_hans: 就大埔宏福苑火灾独立委员会的报告，保安局与商务及经济发展局今日（10 月 30 日）联同警务处、廉政公署及竞争事务委员会，公布建议将楼宇维修及翻新工程的围标行为刑事化，并加强打击围标的措施。委员会报告指出，本港大型楼宇维修工程围标问题严重，有可疑背景人士（包括三合会）操控投标结果，并与顾问、专业人士及承建商勾结，涉及贪污及其他欺诈行为。政府将循三方面推进改革：修订法例、加强执法协调，以及前线预防，全方位严厉打击楼宇维修围标。

title.en: Eight applications received for ride-hailing service licences; qualified list due this year
title.zh_hant: 網約車平台牌照收 8 宗申請　運輸署料年內公布合資格名單
title.zh_hans: 网约车平台牌照收 8 宗申请　运输署料年内公布合资格名单

summary.en: The Transport Department announced today that the application period for ride-hailing service licences closed at noon, with eight applications received — which the department described as a positive industry response. An assessment committee comprising representatives from the Transport and Logistics Bureau, the Digital Policy Office and the Transport Department will assess the applications in detail, covering fleet management, booking platform services, service commencement plans, customer service, operating experience, financial capability and due-diligence plans to ensure vehicle owners and drivers comply with the owner-driver binding requirement. The committee will recommend to the Commissioner for Transport, with the list of qualified platforms expected to be announced within this year.
summary.zh_hant: 運輸署今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，網約車服務牌照申請期於今日中午截止，共收到 8 宗申請，署方形容業界反應正面。由運輸及物流局、數字政策辦公室及運輸署代表組成的評審委員會，將詳細評審各申請，包括車隊管理、預約平台服務、服務開展計劃、服務承諾、客戶服務、營運網約車平台經驗、財政能力及資本投資，以及確保車主和司機遵守「車主司機綁定」要求的盡職審查計劃等。委員會將向運輸署署長提出建議，目標於今年內公布合資格平台名單。
summary.zh_hans: 运输署今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，网约车服务牌照申请期于今日中午截止，共收到 8 宗申请，署方形容业界反应正面。由运输及物流局、数字政策办公室及运输署代表组成的评审委员会，将详细评审各申请，包括车队管理、预约平台服务、服务开展计划、服务承诺、客户服务、营运网约车平台经验、财政能力及资本投资，以及确保车主和司机遵守「车主司机绑定」要求的尽职审查计划等。委员会将向运输署署长提出建议，目标于今年内公布合资格平台名单。

title.en: 1,115 Election Committee nominations ruled valid; 856 vie for 723 seats on November 22
title.zh_hant: 選委會界別分組選舉 1,115 人提名有效　856 人爭 723 席
title.zh_hans: 选委会界别分组选举 1,115 人提名有效　856 人争 723 席

summary.en: The Candidate Eligibility Review Committee has determined that the nominations of 1,115 candidates for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections are valid, the Registration and Electoral Office announced today. Of these, 856 validly nominated candidates from 31 contested subsectors will compete for 723 seats at the polls on November 22. The 31 contested subsectors span commercial, industrial, professional and grassroots sectors, including finance, real estate and construction, tourism, technology and innovation, and representatives of area committees of Hong Kong, Kowloon and the New Territories.
summary.zh_hant: 選舉事務處今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，候選人資格審查委員會已裁定 2026 年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉的 1,115 名候選人提名有效。其中 856 名有效提名候選人來自 31 個有競逐的界別分組，將於 11 月 22 日競逐 723 個議席。31 個有競逐的界別分組涵蓋商界、工業界、專業界及基層界別，包括金融界、地產及建造界、旅遊界、科技創新界，以及港九及新界分區委員會、地區撲滅罪行委員會及地區防火委員會委員的代表等。
summary.zh_hans: 选举事务处今日（10 月 30 日）宣布，候选人资格审查委员会已裁定 2026 年选举委员会界别分组一般选举的 1,115 名候选人提名有效。其中 856 名有效提名候选人来自 31 个有竞逐的界别分组，将于 11 月 22 日竞逐 723 个议席。31 个有竞逐的界别分组涵盖商界、工业界、专业界及基层界别，包括金融界、地产及建造界、旅游界、科技创新界，以及港九及新界分区委员会、地区扑灭罪行委员会及地区防火委员会委员的代表等。

title.en: Hang Seng closes up 1.46% at 23,294 as oil stocks rally, tech names diverge
title.zh_hant: 港股收市升 1.46% 報 23,294 點　石油股強、智譜瀉 9%
title.zh_hans: 港股收市升 1.46% 报 23,294 点　石油股强、智谱泻 9%

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks closed higher across the board on Friday, with the Hang Seng Index up 1.46% at 23,294.42 points, the Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.29% and the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index up 1.37%. Tech stocks were mixed: Meituan and Xiaomi rose more than 3% while Lenovo fell over 7%. Oil stocks outperformed, with PetroChina up more than 5% after reporting third-quarter net profit of 51.84 billion yuan, up 21.6% year on year. Tingyi also rose more than 5%. Software stocks were weak: Zhipu plunged more than 9% after Google's overnight 12.64% plunge — its biggest single-day drop since listing, wiping out nearly US$500 billion in market value.
summary.zh_hant: 港股三大指數今日收市集體上漲。截至收盤，恒生指數漲 1.46%，報 23,294.42 點；恒生科技指數漲 0.29%；國企指數漲 1.37%。盤面上科網股漲多跌少，美團、小米漲超 3%，聯想跌超 7%；石油股走強，中石油漲超 5%，該公司日前公布第三季歸母淨利潤 518.4 億元，同比增長 21.6%；食品股中康師傅漲超 5%；應用軟件板塊低迷，智譜跌超 9%。隔夜谷歌股價收跌 12.64%，創 2004 年上市以來最大單日跌幅，市值單日蒸發近 5,000 億美元。
summary.zh_hans: 港股三大指数今日收市集体上涨。截至收盘，恒生指数涨 1.46%，报 23,294.42 点；恒生科技指数涨 0.29%；国企指数涨 1.37%。盘面上科网股涨多跌少，美团、小米涨超 3%，联想跌超 7%；石油股走强，中石油涨超 5%，该公司日前公布第三季归母净利润 518.4 亿元，同比增长 21.6%；食品股中康师傅涨超 5%；应用软件板块低迷，智谱跌超 9%。隔夜谷歌股价收跌 12.64%，创 2004 年上市以来最大单日跌幅，市值单日蒸发近 5,000 亿美元。

title.en: Intel shares plunge about 20% after hours as weak Q4 guidance overshadows Q3 beat
title.zh_hant: 英特爾 Q4 財測遠遜預期　盤後股價慘崩兩成
title.zh_hans: 英特尔 Q4 财测远逊预期　盘后股价惨崩两成

summary.en: US chip giant Intel reported third-quarter results on Thursday that beat expectations — revenue of US$16.51 billion, up 21% from a year earlier, and adjusted earnings per share of 52 cents versus the 40 cents analysts expected — but issued a weak outlook that sent its shares crashing about 20% after hours. Intel guided fourth-quarter revenue of US$15–16 billion and adjusted EPS of about 25 cents, far below consensus estimates of US$17.1 billion and 43 cents. Its client computing and physical AI business saw revenue fall 5% year on year to US$8.1 billion amid soft PC demand, while data-centre and AI revenue surged 78% to US$7.3 billion on AI demand.
summary.zh_hant: 美國晶片大廠英特爾於 29 日公布第三季財報，營收與獲利均優於市場預期：營收達 165.1 億美元，略高於預期的 165 億美元，較去年同期的 137 億美元成長 21%；調整後每股盈餘 52 美分，高於分析師預期的 40 美分。然而公司對本季提出偏弱財測，拖累股價盤後崩跌約兩成。英特爾預期第四季營收介乎 150 億至 160 億美元、調整後 EPS 約 25 美分，遠不及分析師預期的 171 億美元營收與 43 美分 EPS。分部表現方面，客戶端運算與實體 AI 業務第三季營收年減 5% 至 81 億美元；資料中心與 AI 業務則受惠 AI 需求，年增 78% 達 73 億美元。
summary.zh_hans: 美国芯片大厂英特尔于 29 日公布第三季财报，营收与获利均优于市场预期：营收达 165.1 亿美元，略高于预期的 165 亿美元，较去年同期的 137 亿美元成长 21%；调整后每股盈余 52 美分，高于分析师预期的 40 美分。然而公司对本季提出偏弱财测，拖累股价盘后崩跌约两成。英特尔预期第四季营收介乎 150 亿至 160 亿美元、调整后 EPS 约 25 美分，远不及分析师预期的 171 亿美元营收与 43 美分 EPS。分部表现方面，客户端运算与实体 AI 业务第三季营收年减 5% 至 81 亿美元；资料中心与 AI 业务则受惠 AI 需求，年增 78% 达 73 亿美元。

image_caption: 英特爾標誌。（工商時報）

title.en: FCC moves to bar Chinese carriers from US phone numbers; Beijing vows to respond
title.zh_hant: FCC 擬禁中資電信商接取美國電話號碼　外交部：堅決反對
title.zh_hans: FCC 拟禁中资电信商接取美国电话号码　外交部：坚决反对

summary.en: The US Federal Communications Commission announced on Thursday that it will vote on November 19 on a proposal to bar China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom and some IP service providers from directly accessing US telephone numbers, in a bid to curb scam-related robocalls. IP providers using equipment from Huawei, ZTE and other firms on the FCC's national-security blacklist would also fall under the ban, and from December 2028 all Chinese laboratories would be barred from testing electronic products destined for the US market. At a regular press briefing on Friday, Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said the US was overstretching the concept of national security and abusing state power to suppress Chinese companies, adding that China firmly opposes and strongly deplores the move and will take necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests.
summary.zh_hant: 美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）周四宣布，將於 11 月 19 日就一項提案進行表決，禁止中國移動、中國電信、中國聯通以及一些 IP 服務商直接接取美國的電話號碼，以遏阻與詐騙相關的自動語音電話。使用華為、中興通訊等 FCC 國安黑名單企業設備的 IP 服務商亦將納入禁令；此外，FCC 將於 2028 年 12 月起禁止所有中國實驗室測試輸美的電子產品。外交部發言人郭嘉昆今日在例行記者會回應，美方泛化國家安全概念、濫用國家力量，無理打壓中國企業，中方對此表示堅決反對、強烈不滿，將採取必要措施，堅定維護自身正當合法權益。
summary.zh_hans: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）周四宣布，将于 11 月 19 日就一项提案进行表决，禁止中国移动、中国电信、中国联通以及一些 IP 服务商直接接取美国的电话号码，以遏阻与诈骗相关的自动语音电话。使用华为、中兴通讯等 FCC 国安黑名单企业设备的 IP 服务商亦将纳入禁令；此外，FCC 将于 2028 年 12 月起禁止所有中国实验室测试输美的电子产品。外交部发言人郭嘉昆今日在例行记者会回应，美方泛化国家安全概念、滥用国家力量，无理打压中国企业，中方对此表示坚决反对、强烈不满，将采取必要措施，坚定维护自身正当合法权益。

image_caption: 外交部發言人郭嘉昆主持例行記者會資料圖片。（外交部網站／北京日報）

title.en: Spain's first report on high-speed train crash: collision speed put at 160-200 km/h; toll rises to 69
title.zh_hant: 西班牙高鐵相撞首份報告：時速估 160 至 200 公里　死亡人數升至 69
title.zh_hans: 西班牙高铁相撞首份报告：时速估 160 至 200 公里　死亡人数升至 69

summary.en: Spain's independent rail accident investigation body on Thursday published its first report on the high-speed train collision near Toledo. The report estimates that the Renfe train was travelling at 160 to 200 km/h when it hit the stationary Iryo train, pending analysis of the on-board recorders. Carriage 8 of the Renfe train embedded itself into carriage 1 of the Iryo train, with both overturning; the Iryo train's rear three carriages fell into the embankment. The report notes a signalling-system failure that began at 8:31am, forcing control-centre staff and drivers to communicate by telephone, and stresses the investigation is at an early stage and it is too early to determine the exact cause. The latest official count puts the death toll at 69, with 50 injured still in hospital.
summary.zh_hant: 西班牙鐵路、海事和民用航空事故和事件技術調查獨立行政機構當地時間 10 月 29 日在其網站公布托萊多省高鐵事故首份報告。報告估計，西班牙國家鐵路公司（Renfe）旗下列車與停下的伊爾約（Iryo）公司列車相撞時，時速在 160 至 200 公里之間，具體數據尚待審查車載記錄儀。報告顯示，Renfe 列車的 8 號車廂嵌入 Iryo 列車的 1 號車廂，兩節車廂翻覆；Iryo 列車除前兩節車廂外其餘全部脫軌，尾部三節車廂墜入路堤。報告指出，信號系統故障始於上午 8 時 31 分，列車在沒有信號系統干預下運行，控制中心與司機須以電話溝通；調查尚處初期，斷定確切原因為时尚早。最新統計顯示事故已造成 69 人遇難，仍有 50 名傷者在各大醫院住院治療。
summary.zh_hans: 西班牙铁路、海事和民用航空事故和事件技术调查独立行政机构当地时间 10 月 29 日在其网站公布托莱多省高铁事故首份报告。报告估计，西班牙国家铁路公司（Renfe）旗下列车与停下的伊尔约（Iryo）公司列车相撞时，时速在 160 至 200 公里之间，具体数据尚待审查车载记录仪。报告显示，Renfe 列车的 8 号车厢嵌入 Iryo 列车的 1 号车厢，两节车厢翻覆；Iryo 列车除前两节车厢外其余全部脱轨，尾部三节车厢坠入路堤。报告指出，信号系统故障始于上午 8 时 31 分，列车在没有信号系统干预下运行，控制中心与司机须以电话沟通；调查尚处初期，断定确切原因为时尚早。最新统计显示事故已造成 69 人遇难，仍有 50 名伤者在各大医院住院治疗。

title.en: Cathay Pacific says 53,000 bookings affected as travel tech supplier Amadeus is breached
title.zh_hant: 國泰第三方系統商 Amadeus 疑遭入侵　5.3 萬宗預訂資料或外洩
title.zh_hans: 国泰第三方系统商 Amadeus 疑遭入侵　5.3 万宗预订资料或外泄

summary.en: Cathay Pacific said on Thursday that its travel technology supplier Amadeus had reported unauthorised access to its systems between August 2023 and September 2026, affecting about 53,000 Cathay-related bookings. The data accessed mainly comprised booking reference numbers, passenger names and flight details, with a smaller number of cases also involving contact emails, phone numbers, travel document details and frequent flyer numbers. Cathay stressed its own systems and operations were unaffected, that there is currently no evidence of financial data being accessed or of misuse, and that it has notified the privacy regulator and will contact affected customers individually. Japan Airlines reported about 92,000 affected records and ANA about 37,800; Korean Air and Asiana were also hit. IT experts warned the incident is a supply-chain risk and urged travellers to watch out for phishing scams.
summary.zh_hant: 國泰航空今日（30 日）表示，接獲全球旅遊科技供應商 Amadeus 通報，指其系統於 2023 年 8 月至 2026 年 9 月期間，遭未獲授權人士利用系統帳戶的登入憑證存取旅遊訂位紀錄，約 5.3 萬宗與國泰相關的預訂資料受影響。資料主要包括預訂參考編號、乘客姓名及航班資料，小部分個案另涉電郵、電話、旅遊證件及飛行常客計劃號碼。國泰強調自身系統及營運未受影響，暫無證據顯示財務資料外洩或資料被濫用，已通報私隱專員公署並會個別通知受影響客戶。日航約 9.2 萬宗、全日空約 3.78 萬宗資料亦受影響，大韓航空及韓亞航空同告中招。資訊科技界人士提醒，事件屬典型供應鏈風險，市民須提防釣魚詐騙。
summary.zh_hans: 国泰航空今日（30 日）表示，接获全球旅游科技供应商 Amadeus 通报，指其系统于 2023 年 8 月至 2026 年 9 月期间，遭未获授权人士利用系统账户的登录凭证存取旅游订位纪录，约 5.3 万宗与国泰相关的预订资料受影响。资料主要包括预订参考编号、乘客姓名及航班资料，小部分个案另涉电邮、电话、旅游证件及飞行常客计划号码。国泰强调自身系统及营运未受影响，暂无证据显示财务资料外泄或资料被滥用，已通报隐私专员公署并会个别通知受影响客户。日航约 9.2 万宗、全日空约 3.78 万宗资料亦受影响，大韩航空及韩亚航空同告中招。资讯科技界人士提醒，事件属典型供应链风险，市民须提防钓鱼诈骗。

title.en: Binance confirms about US$6.3 billion stolen in hack, analysts point to North Korea
title.zh_hant: 幣安約 63 億美元加密貨幣被盜　分析公司指向北韓黑客
title.zh_hans: 币安约 63 亿美元加密货币被盗　分析公司指向北韩黑客

summary.en: Binance has confirmed that about US$6.3 billion of crypto assets were affected in its latest security incident, potentially the largest cryptocurrency heist on record, with around US$3 billion already frozen on-chain. Several blockchain analytics firms told CNN and CNBC they attribute the theft to North Korea's state-backed TraderTraitor group with "high confidence"; Binance did not comment directly on the link and said it is working with law enforcement. Its preliminary investigation suggests the attack began with a compromised engineer's laptop that let the attacker reach a service container and submit unauthorised withdrawal transactions; no evidence of private key leaks has been found. Binance pledged to cover all losses with its SAFU fund and company funds, suspended deposits and withdrawals during the security review, and expects withdrawals to resume in about 45 hours.
summary.zh_hant: 全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安確認，今次安全事件影響約 63 億美元資產，或成歷來最大宗加密貨幣盜竊案，約 30 億美元已在鏈上凍結。多間區塊鏈分析公司向 CNN 及 CNBC 表示，以「高度信心」把案件歸咎於北韓國家支持的黑客組織 TraderTraitor；幣安未有直接評論，只稱正與執法部門合作。初步調查指攻擊始於一名工程師被入侵的筆記型電腦，黑客藉此進入服務容器提交未經授權的提款交易；幣安稱未發現錢包私鑰外洩證據，承諾以 SAFU 基金及公司資金承擔全部損失。平台在安全檢查期間一度暫停存提款，幣安預計約 45 小時後恢復提款。
summary.zh_hans: 全球最大加密货币交易所币安确认，今次安全事件影响约 63 亿美元资产，或成历来最大宗加密货币盗窃案，约 30 亿美元已在链上冻结。多间区块链分析公司向 CNN 及 CNBC 表示，以「高度信心」把案件归咎于北韩国家支持的黑客组织 TraderTraitor；币安未有直接评论，只称正与执法部门合作。初步调查指攻击始于一名工程师被入侵的笔记型电脑，黑客藉此进入服务容器提交未经授权的提款交易；币安称未发现钱包私钥外泄证据，承诺以 SAFU 基金及公司资金承担全部损失。平台在安全检查期间一度暂停存提款，币安预计约 45 小时后恢复提款。

title.en: MUJI app breach may expose 27.26 million customer records as Japanese firms report hacks
title.zh_hant: 無印良品 App 疑外洩 2,726 萬條客戶資料　日本多間企業同日通報遭黑客入侵
title.zh_hans: 无印良品 App 疑外泄 2,726 万条客户资料　日本多间企业同日通报遭黑客入侵

summary.en: Ryohin Keikaku, the operator of MUJI, said on Thursday that its official MUJI app had been illegally accessed, potentially exposing up to about 27.26 million customer records, including email addresses, dates of birth and gender, with former members also affected; credit card information, names, addresses and phone numbers were not involved. The company said no misuse had been confirmed so far and warned customers to watch out for spoof emails; the disclosure came during the "MUJI Week" sale period. On the same day, beef-bowl chain Matsuya said its app management system had been breached, potentially exposing up to 2.38 million customer records. Japan's NICT noted that at least some of the recent wave of breaches are linked to "A2B" (app-to-backend) attack techniques targeting servers behind Android apps.
summary.zh_hant: 營運無印良品的日本良品計劃今日（30 日）公布，官方 MUJI App 遭外部非法存取，最多約 2,726 萬條客戶資料可能外洩，包括電郵地址、出生日期及性別，已退會用戶亦受影響；信用卡資料、姓名、地址及電話則不在其列，公司暫未發現資料被濫用，呼籲提防冒名電郵。公布正值「無印良品週間」促銷期。同日牛丼連鎖店松屋亦公布，其 App 管理系統遭入侵，最多約 238 萬人資料外洩。日本情報通信研究機構（NICT）指出，近期一連串事件至少部分與針對 Android App 後端系統的「A2B」攻擊手法有關。
summary.zh_hans: 营运无印良品的日本良品计划今日（30 日）公布，官方 MUJI App 遭外部非法存取，最多约 2,726 万条客户资料可能外泄，包括电邮地址、出生日期及性别，已退会用户亦受影响；信用卡资料、姓名、地址及电话则不在其列，公司暂未发现资料被滥用，呼吁提防冒名电邮。公布正值「无印良品周」促销期。同日牛丼连锁店松屋亦公布，其 App 管理系统遭入侵，最多约 238 万人资料外泄。日本情报通信研究机构（NICT）指出，近期一连串事件至少部分与针对 Android App 后端系统的「A2B」攻击手法有关。

title.en: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Captain Picard and X-Men's Professor X, dies at 86
title.zh_hant: 「畢凱艦長」派崔克·史都華逝世　終年 86 歲
title.zh_hans: 「毕凯舰长」派崔克·史都华逝世　终年 86 岁

summary.en: British actor Patrick Stewart died at his home in Los Angeles on Wednesday at the age of 86. His family announced the news on Thursday via his official social media accounts, saying he had been on a "brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia, with his wife Sunny Ozell by his side; his longtime spokesperson Kelly Bush Novak confirmed his illnesses had not previously been disclosed. Born in 1940 into a working-class family in Mirfield, Yorkshire, Stewart became a celebrated Shakespearean stage actor before finding global fame in middle age as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in "Star Trek: The Next Generation" and Professor Charles Xavier in the "X-Men" films. He was knighted in 2010, and tributes poured in on social media, including from the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences. He is reported to have completed filming on the upcoming "Avengers: Doomsday".
summary.zh_hant: 英國傳奇演員派崔克·史都華（Patrick Stewart）於美國時間星期三（28 日）在洛杉磯家中逝世，終年 86 歲。家屬昨日透過其官方社交帳號公布消息，指他經歷「短暫而令人心痛的」阿茲海默症及路易氏體失智症病程，離世時妻子 Sunny Ozell 陪伴在側；長期發言人 Kelly Bush Novak 證實，他生前並未公開病情。史都華 1940 年生於約克郡米爾菲爾德的工人家庭，以莎劇舞台成名，中年憑《星空奇遇記：銀河飛龍》的畢凱艦長及《變種特攻》系列的 X 教授紅遍全球，2010 年獲英女王封爵。美國影藝學院等在社交平台致哀；據報他生前已拍畢將於今秋上映的《復仇者聯盟：末日之戰》。
summary.zh_hans: 英国传奇演员派崔克·史都华（Patrick Stewart）于美国时间星期三（28 日）在洛杉矶家中逝世，终年 86 岁。家属昨日透过其官方社交账号公布消息，指他经历「短暂而令人心痛的」阿兹海默症及路易氏体失智症病程，离世时妻子 Sunny Ozell 陪伴在侧；长期发言人 Kelly Bush Novak 证实，他生前并未公开病情。史都华 1940 年生于约克郡米尔菲尔德的工人家庭，以莎剧舞台成名，中年凭《星空奇遇记：银河飞龙》的毕凯舰长及《变种特攻》系列的 X 教授红遍全球，2010 年获英女王封爵。美国影艺学院等在社交平台致哀；据报他生前已拍毕将于今秋上映的《复仇者联盟：末日之战》。

title.en: Abby Choi murder trial day 27: Kwong Kau pleads guilty to preventing lawful burial
title.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案第 27 日審訊　鄺球改認阻止合法埋葬屍體罪
title.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案第 27 日审讯　邝球改认阻止合法埋葬尸体罪

summary.en: The High Court trial over the murder of Abby Choi reached its 27th day on Friday with a turn: Kwong Kau, the victim's former father-in-law, changed his plea to guilty on the charge of preventing the lawful burial of a body, while continuing to deny murder. Kwong Chi (the ex-husband) and Kwong Kong-kit (the ex-brother-in-law) had already pleaded guilty to the same count; the murder charges against all three continue to be tried. After the judge gave directions to the jury, the prosecution continued playing CCTV footage showing that Kwong Kong-kit and Kwong Kau had bought large quantities of items — including plastic boxes, a meat grinder, knives, ropes, an electric saw and soup pots — in the two weeks before the killing. The trial continues on Monday.
summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳遇害案今日（30 日）在高等法院踏入第 27 日審訊出現轉折：死者前家翁鄺球就被控的「阻止合法埋葬屍體」罪改為認罪，但繼續否認謀殺罪。死者前夫鄺港智及前大伯鄺港傑早前已承認同一控罪，三人否認的謀殺罪繼續受審。法官向陪審團作出指引後，控方續播放多段閉路電視片段，顯示案發前約兩周，鄺港傑及鄺球分別購入膠箱、絞肉機、刀、麻繩、電鋸、湯煲等大量物品。案件下周一續審。
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤遇害案今日（30 日）在高等法院踏入第 27 日审讯出现转折：死者前家翁邝球就被控的「阻止合法埋葬尸体」罪改为认罪，但继续否认谋杀罪。死者前夫邝港智及前大伯邝港杰早前已承认同一控罪，三人否认的谋杀罪继续受审。法官向陪审团作出指引后，控方续播放多段闭路电视片段，显示案发前约两周，邝港杰及邝球分别购入胶箱、绞肉机、刀、麻绳、电锯、汤煲等大量物品。案件下周一续审。

title.en: At least 68 killed as high-speed train hits stationary train in Spain
title.zh_hans: 西班牙高铁撞上停定列车　至少 68 人死亡
title.zh_hant: 西班牙高鐵撞上停定列車　至少 68 人死亡

summary.en: At least 68 people died when a Renfe high-speed train ran into a stationary Iryo train near Urda in central Spain on Wednesday morning, in Europe's deadliest rail accident since 2013. The transport minister said the Renfe service had been authorised to proceed despite a red signal caused by a computer communications failure, and an erroneous decision was then taken to restart it. About 80 people were injured, 15 of them very seriously, and the death toll was expected to rise as rescuers searched the wreckage. It is the second fatal high-speed crash on the same Madrid-Andalusia line this year, after 46 people died in January.
summary.zh_hans: 西班牙中部乌尔达附近星期三早上发生高铁相撞，一列 Renfe 高铁撞上停定的 Iryo 列车，至少 68 人死亡，是欧洲自 2013 年以来最严重的铁路事故。交通大臣表示，电脑通讯故障触发红灯信号，但 Renfe 列车获准继续行驶，之后又错误决定重新开车。约 80 人受伤，其中 15 人伤势非常严重，救援人员仍在残骸搜救，死亡人数预料会再上升。这是同一条马德里至安达卢西亚高铁线今年第二宗致命事故，今年 1 月的事故造成 46 人死亡。
summary.zh_hant: 西班牙中部烏爾達附近星期三早上發生高鐵相撞，一列 Renfe 高鐵撞上停定的 Iryo 列車，至少 68 人死亡，是歐洲自 2013 年以來最嚴重的鐵路事故。交通大臣表示，電腦通訊故障觸發紅燈信號，但 Renfe 列車獲准繼續行駛，之後又錯誤決定重新開車。約 80 人受傷，其中 15 人傷勢非常嚴重，救援人員仍在殘骸搜救，死亡人數預料會再上升。這是同一條馬德里至安達盧西亞高鐵線今年第二宗致命事故，今年 1 月的事故造成 46 人死亡。

title.en: Fed holds rates at 3.75–4% as inflation stays elevated
title.zh_hans: 联储局维持利率 3.75 至 4 厘　通胀仍然高企
title.zh_hant: 聯儲局維持利率 3.75 至 4 厘　通脹仍然高企

summary.en: The US Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.75 to 4 per cent on Wednesday, after raising rates in September for the first time in three years. The decision was taken by a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissenting in favour of a quarter-point rise. The Fed said inflation remains elevated and that gathering more information would help determine the policy stance needed for a timely return to its 2 per cent target. US consumer prices rose 3.7 per cent year on year in September, and markets are now watching whether rates rise again in December.
summary.zh_hans: 美国联储局星期三维持基准利率不变，介乎 3.75 至 4 厘，之前 9 月才加息，是三年来首次。决议以 10 票对 2 票通过，理事库克及克利夫兰联储总裁哈马克持异议，主张加息四分一厘。联储局表示通胀仍然高企，需要累积更多数据，才能判断如何令通胀及时回落至 2% 目标。美国 9 月消费物价按年升 3.7%，市场现时注视 12 月会否再加息。
summary.zh_hant: 美國聯儲局星期三維持基準利率不變，介乎 3.75 至 4 厘，之前 9 月才加息，是三年來首次。決議以 10 票對 2 票通過，理事庫克及克利夫蘭聯儲總裁哈馬克持異議，主張加息四分一厘。聯儲局表示通脹仍然高企，需要累積更多數據，才能判斷如何令通脹及時回落至 2% 目標。美國 9 月消費物價按年升 3.7%，市場現時注視 12 月會否再加息。

title.en: Wang Fuk Court fire inquiry findings expected as early as Thursday, sources say
title.zh_hans: 消息指宏福苑大火调查报告最快星期四公布　料推立法打击围标
title.zh_hant: 消息指宏福苑大火調查報告最快星期四公布　料推立法打擊圍標

summary.en: The government will release the findings of the independent committee probing last November's deadly fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po as soon as Thursday, according to sources. Chief Executive John Lee and other principal officials are expected to explain a package of reforms at a press conference, with briefings planned over two consecutive days. A steering committee led by the Chief Secretary will follow up the report's recommendations, and sources say the government will legislate to criminalise bid-rigging in building maintenance works, amend the Buildings Ordinance, toughen penalties and strengthen verification and inspections in place of industry self-regulation.
summary.zh_hans: 消息指，政府最快星期四公布调查去年 11 月大埔宏福苑致命大火的独立委员会报告结论。行政长官李家超及多名主要官员将举行记者会交代一篮子改革，未来两日连续见记者详细讲解。消息又指，政府将成立由政务司司长领导的督导委员会，跟进报告建议，并会立法将楼宇维修工程围标刑事化、修订《建筑物条例》、加重罚则，以及以政府主导的核查及巡查取代业界自我监管。
summary.zh_hant: 消息指，政府最快星期四公布調查去年 11 月大埔宏福苑致命大火的獨立委員會報告結論。行政長官李家超及多名主要官員將舉行記者會交代一籃子改革，未來兩日連續見記者詳細講解。消息又指，政府將成立由政務司司長領導的督導委員會，跟進報告建議，並會立法將樓宇維修工程圍標刑事化、修訂《建築物條例》、加重罰則，以及以政府主導的核查及巡查取代業界自我規管。

title.en: HKT opens Innovation & Technology Centre and AI Exchange in the Loop
title.zh_hans: HKT 河套创新科技中心及 AI 交易所正式开幕
title.zh_hant: HKT 河套創新科技中心及 AI 交易所正式開幕

summary.en: HKT has officially opened its Innovation & Technology Centre and AI Exchange in the Loop, in the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park. Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong officiated at the opening ceremony. The initiative marks a further step in HKT's support for Hong Kong's innovation and technology and industrial development through network infrastructure, while laying the groundwork for future cross-boundary data flows in the Greater Bay Area and supporting the Northern Metropolis development.
summary.zh_hans: HKT 位于港深创新及科技园河套区的创新科技中心及 AI 交易所正式开幕，由创新科技及工业局局长孙东主持开幕仪式。HKT 表示，新设施是透过网络基建支持香港创科及工业发展的进一步举措，并为大湾区未来跨境数据流动奠定基础，同时支持北部都会区发展。
summary.zh_hant: HKT 位於港深創新及科技園河套區的創新科技中心及 AI 交易所正式開幕，由創新科技及工業局局長孫東主持開幕儀式。HKT 表示，新設施是透過網絡基建支持香港創科及工業發展的進一步舉措，並為大灣區未來跨境數據流動奠定基礎，同時支持北部都會區發展。
