title.en: Chris Tang inspects reopened Huanggang Port, praises smooth cross-border clearance
title.zh_hant: 鄧炳強視察重開後皇崗口岸　讚「合作查驗、一次放行」暢順
title.zh_hans: 邓炳强视察重开后皇岗口岸　赞「合作查验、一次放行」畅顺

summary.en: Secretary for Security Chris Tang visited the reopened Huanggang Port today to inspect operations ahead of the first long holiday. He said passenger and traveller clearance was broadly smooth, with orderly public-transport connections and pick-up/drop-off arrangements, and overall operations running well. Tang was particularly pleased with the new "co-location, single clearance" model, saying residents found the new port building spacious with ample counters and fast crossings, and he thanked disciplined services and government premises service ambassadors for staying on duty during the holidays.
summary.zh_hant: 保安局局長鄧炳強今日視察重開後的皇崗口岸，迎接首個長假期。他表示市民及旅客出入境大致暢順，公共交通接駁和上落客安排有序，整體運作良好。鄧炳強特別滿意「合作查驗、一次放行」新模式，指市民普遍認為口岸大樓寬敞、櫃檯充足、過關快捷，並感謝紀律部隊及政府產業署服務大使在假日堅守崗位。
summary.zh_hans: 保安局局长邓炳强今日视察重开后的皇岗口岸，迎接首个长假期。他表示市民及旅客出入境大致畅顺，公共交通接驳和上落客安排有序，整体运作良好。邓炳强特别满意「合作查验、一次放行」新模式，指市民普遍认为口岸大楼宽敞、柜台充足、过关快捷，并感谢纪律部队及政府产业署服务大使在假日坚守岗位。

title.en: Li Qiang visits Uzbekistan, urges deeper energy and AI cooperation
title.zh_hant: 李強訪問烏茲別克　籲加強能源與 AI 等領域合作
title.zh_hans: 李强访问乌兹别克　吁加强能源与 AI 等领域合作

summary.en: Premier Li Qiang visited Uzbekistan, arriving in Tashkent on the afternoon of the 17th for meetings with President Mirziyoyev and Prime Minister Aripov. Li urged both sides to firmly support each other's core interests and deepen cooperation in energy, artificial intelligence and other fields, while ensuring the high-quality implementation of the landmark Belt and Road project, the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway. Mirziyoyev said Uzbekistan-China relations had entered a "golden era", and the two sides signed cooperation documents covering trade, education, customs, health, poverty alleviation, e-commerce, climate and media.
summary.zh_hant: 國務院總理李強訪問烏茲別克，17 日下午抵達塔什干，先後會見總統米爾濟約耶夫及總理阿里波夫。李強呼籲雙方堅定支持彼此核心利益，深化能源、人工智能等領域合作，並確保「一帶一路」標誌性工程中吉烏鐵路高質量實施。米爾濟約耶夫表示烏中關係迎來「黃金時代」，雙方簽署經貿、教育、海關、衛生、減貧、電商、氣候、媒體等多項合作文件。
summary.zh_hans: 国务院总理李强访问乌兹别克，17 日下午抵达塔什干，先后会见总统米尔济约耶夫及总理阿里波夫。李强呼吁双方坚定支持彼此核心利益，深化能源、人工智能等领域合作，并确保「一带一路」标志性工程中吉乌铁路高质量实施。米尔济约耶夫表示乌中关系迎来「黄金时代」，双方签署经贸、教育、海关、卫生、减贫、电商、气候、媒体等多项合作文件。

title.en: Former Guangxi political advisory vice-chairman Huang Ribo under probe for suspected duty violations
title.zh_hant: 廣西政協原副主席黃日波涉嚴重職務違法　正接受國家監委監察調查
title.zh_hans: 广西政协原副主席黄日波涉严重职务违法　正接受国家监委监察调查

summary.en: The website of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission announced today that Huang Ribo, former vice-chairman of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region's political advisory body, is suspected of serious duty violations and is under investigation by the National Supervisory Commission. Born in July 1958 in Jingxi, Guangxi, Huang holds a PhD in bioengineering from the University of Reading and previously served as a professor at Guangxi University and president of the Guangxi Academy of Sciences. He served as Guangxi CPPCC vice-chairman in 2008, Guangxi vice-governor in 2013, and returned as Guangxi CPPCC vice-chairman and chairman of the Guangxi Association for Science and Technology in 2018.
summary.zh_hant: 中央紀委國家監委網站今日發布消息，廣西壯族自治區政協原副主席黃日波涉嫌嚴重職務違法，正接受國家監委監察調查。黃日波 1958 年 7 月生，廣西靖西人，英國里丁大學生物工程理學博士，曾任廣西大學教授及廣西科學院院長。他曾於 2008 年任廣西政協副主席、2013 年任廣西政府副主席，2018 年再任廣西政協副主席兼自治區科協主席。
summary.zh_hans: 中央纪委国家监委网站今日发布消息，广西壮族自治区政协原副主席黄日波涉嫌严重职务违法，正接受国家监委监察调查。黄日波 1958 年 7 月生，广西靖西人，英国里丁大学生物工程理学博士，曾任广西大学教授及广西科学院院长。他曾于 2008 年任广西政协副主席、2013 年任广西政府副主席，2018 年再任广西政协副主席兼自治区科协主席。

title.en: ChaBaiDao suspended by Hong Kong SFC over suspected IPO manipulation
title.zh_hant: 茶百道涉 IPO 人為操縱　遭香港證監會緊急停牌
title.zh_hans: 茶百道涉 IPO 人为操纵　遭香港证监会紧急停牌

summary.en: Bubble-tea brand ChaBaiDao, listed for two and a half years, has been suspended from trading by the Hong Kong SFC over suspected IPO manipulation. On 13 October the SFC suspended its shares under section 8(1) of the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules, saying its IPO may have been artificially manipulated to create a false impression of demand, with trading to stay suspended while the investigation continues. The probe involves two suspicious groups, with assets totalling HK$4.379 billion; ChaBaiDao says it is urgently seeking legal advice and that its operations remain normal.
summary.zh_hant: 上市兩年半的新茶飲品牌茶百道因涉嫌 IPO 操縱，被香港證監會緊急停牌。證監會 10 月 13 日依《證券及期貨（在證券市場上市）規則》第 8(1) 條暫停其股份交易，指其首次公開招股可能曾被人为操縱，以營造股份需求的非真實表象，調查期間暫停交易。調查涉及兩個可疑集團，涉案資產規模達 43.79 億港元；茶百道稱正緊急尋求法律意見，業務營運維持正常。
summary.zh_hans: 上市两年半的新茶饮品牌茶百道因涉嫌 IPO 操纵，被香港证监会紧急停牌。证监会 10 月 13 日依《证券及期货（在证券市场上市）规则》第 8(1) 条暂停其股份交易，指其首次公开招股可能曾被人为操纵，以营造股份需求的非真实表象，调查期间暂停交易。调查涉及两个可疑集团，涉案资产规模达 43.79 亿港元；茶百道称正紧急寻求法律意见，业务营运维持正常。

title.en: OpenAI pushes into humanoid robots, with the AI "brain" as core focus, Altman says
title.zh_hant: OpenAI 發力人形機器人研發　奧特曼：AI「大腦」才是核心突破口
title.zh_hans: OpenAI 发力人形机器人研发　奥特曼：AI「大脑」才是核心突破口

summary.en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman disclosed in a podcast interview that the company is pushing into humanoid-robot development, with the core effort on the intelligent "brain" that drives the robot rather than its hardware appearance. Altman explained that real-world facilities and tools are designed around the human body, so humanoid designs fit human living and working spaces best. OpenAI has begun hiring across motion control, actuator control and embodied-AI training, and Altman predicts an impressive demo prototype could arrive in 2027, though real-world deployment is still years away.
summary.zh_hant: 據 Engadget 報道，OpenAI 行政總裁奧特曼在播客訪談中披露，公司正布局人形機器人研發，核心攻關方向是驅動機器人的智能「大腦」而非外觀硬件。奧特曼解釋，現實設施工具均圍繞人體形態設計，人形方案更能適配人類生活工作空間。公司已啟動相關人才招聘，涵蓋運動控制、執行器控制、實體 AI 訓練等範疇；奧特曼預判 2027 年有望推出效果亮眼的演示樣機，但真正公開應用還需數年。
summary.zh_hans: 据 Engadget 报道，OpenAI 行政总裁奥特曼在播客访谈中披露，公司正布局人形机器人研发，核心攻关方向是驱动机器人的智能「大脑」而非外观硬件。奥特曼解释，现实设施工具均围绕人体形态设计，人形方案更能适配人类生活工作空间。公司已启动相关人才招聘，涵盖运动控制、执行器控制、实体 AI 训练等范畴；奥特曼预判 2027 年有望推出效果亮眼的演示样机，但真正公开应用还需数年。

title.en: Damai refutes rumor of Xiao Zhan concert front-row tickets selling for 250,000 yuan
title.zh_hant: 大麥通報「肖戰演唱會第一排門票25萬元」不實　編造者正被依法處理
title.zh_hans: 大麦通报「肖战演唱会第一排门票25万元」不实　编造者正被依法处理

summary.en: Ticketing platform Damai issued a statement today refuting viral claims that front-row tickets for Xiao Zhan's concert were being resold for 250,000 yuan. After an investigation with the authorities, a person surnamed Wang was found to have fabricated the "250,000-yuan front row" claim without any tickets to attract attention, and is now being dealt with according to law. Damai stressed that the concert will enforce mandatory real-name verification, that any form of "ticket swapping" for entry is strictly banned, and that all so-called internal or scalped tickets circulating online are false.
summary.zh_hant: 大麥今日發布聲明，指社交平台出現「肖戰演唱會第一排門票 25 萬元」等不實信息。經職能部門核查，涉事人員王某某在無任何票源的情況下故意編造虛假信息以吸引關注，目前正被依法處理。大麥強調演出現場實行強制實名核驗，嚴禁任何形式「錯票」入場，所有網傳內部票、黃牛票均為虛假信息。
summary.zh_hans: 大麦今日发布声明，指社交平台出现「肖战演唱会第一排门票 25 万元」等不实信息。经职能部门核查，涉事人员王某某在无任何票源的情况下故意编造虚假信息以吸引关注，目前正被依法处理。大麦强调演出现场实行强制实名核验，严禁任何形式「错票」入场，所有网传内部票、黄牛票均为虚假信息。

title.en: Hong Kong LegCo uses AI to analyse 450,000 words of lawmakers' speeches; "talent" tops keyword list
title.zh_hant: 立法會首用 AI 分析議員45萬字發言　「人才」居十大熱門議題之首
title.zh_hans: 立法会首用 AI 分析议员45万字发言　「人才」居十大热门议题之首

summary.en: The Legislative Council Secretariat has used AI for the first time to analyse all members' speeches in major motion debates, distilling about 450,000 words of verbatim records into a top-ten keyword list. LegCo president Starry Lee Wai-king published the results on social media on 17 October, with "talent" mentioned by 77 members to top the list, followed by "Northern Metropolis" (71) and "innovation and technology" (70). The verbatim records were produced with the smart transcription system "Smart Listen", and the overview will be submitted to the government for reference.
summary.zh_hant: 立法會秘書處首次利用人工智能分析全體議員在大型議案辯論中的發言，從約 45 萬字逐字紀錄整理出十大熱門關鍵詞。立法會主席李慧琼昨日在社交平台公布結果，「人才」獲 77 位議員提及居首，其次為「北部都會區」71 人及「創科／科研／研發」70 人。分析所用的逐字紀錄由智慧謄錄系統「智識聽」編製，概覽將提交特區政府參考。
summary.zh_hans: 立法会秘书处首次利用人工智能分析全体议员在大型议案辩论中的发言，从约 45 万字逐字纪录整理出十大热门关键词。立法会主席李慧琼昨日在社交平台公布结果，「人才」获 77 位议员提及居首，其次为「北部都会区」71 人及「创科／科研／研发」70 人。分析所用的逐字纪录由智慧誊录系统「智识听」编制，概览将提交特区政府参考。

title.en: GBA commissioner wraps up London visit, promotes Greater Bay Area opportunities
title.zh_hant: 大灣區專員結束倫敦四天行程 推介大灣區機遇及香港優勢
title.zh_hans: 大湾区专员结束伦敦四天行程 推介大湾区机遇及香港优势

summary.en: Commissioner for the Development of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Pamela Lam, has concluded a four-day visit to London covering talent recruitment, business promotion, cultural industries and youth development. She briefed British business groups on Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan, the Northern Metropolis and the Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong innovation zone. The GBA Office says it will keep promoting GBA opportunities through overseas visits and Economic and Trade Offices.
summary.zh_hant: 粵港澳大灣區發展專員林雅雯完成四日倫敦訪問後返港。訪問涵蓋招攬人才、經貿推廣、文化產業及青年發展，她向英國商界及團體介紹香港首份五年計劃、北部都會區和河套深港科技創新合作區等機遇。大灣區辦公室表示，將繼續透過外訪及海外經貿辦推介大灣區機遇。
summary.zh_hans: 粤港澳大湾区发展专员林雅雯完成四日伦敦访问后返港。访问涵盖招揽人才、经贸推广、文化产业及青年发展，她向英国商界及团体介绍香港首份五年计划、北部都会区和河套深港科技创新合作区等机遇。大湾区办公室表示，将继续透过外访及海外经贸办推介大湾区机遇。

title.en: HK new-home sales hit HK$191.56b in first nine months, a record high
title.zh_hant: 首9個月一手成交逾1900億元創新高 貨尾盤佔近六成
title.zh_hans: 首9个月一手成交逾1900亿元创新高 货尾盘占近六成

summary.en: Hong Kong's first-hand residential sales in the first nine months of 2026 totalled about HK$191.56 billion, up about 30.6% year on year and a record for the period since the First-hand Residential Properties Sales Ordinance took effect, according to Centaline research. Unsold inventory from 2025 or earlier accounted for about HK$114.21 billion (59.6%), while new launches contributed about HK$77.34 billion (40.4%), concentrated in units under HK$10 million. Kai Tak led by district with about HK$28.03 billion in inventory sales.
summary.zh_hant: 據香港置業資料研究部綜合一手住宅物業銷售資訊網資料，今年首九個月一手成交金額錄約1,915.6億元，較去年同期約1,467.3億元上升約30.6%，創一手銷售條例以來的同期新高。其中2025年或以前推售的貨尾盤錄約1,142.1億元，佔約59.6%；全新盤約773.4億元，佔約40.4%，集中於1,000萬元或以下的中細價物業。地區方面，貨尾盤成交以啟德最多，涉資約280.3億元。
summary.zh_hans: 据香港置业资料研究部综合一手住宅物业销售资讯网资料，今年首九个月一手成交金额录约1,915.6亿元，较去年同期约1,467.3亿元上升约30.6%，创一手销售条例以来的同期新高。其中2025年或以前推售的货尾盘录约1,142.1亿元，占约59.6%；全新盘约773.4亿元，占约40.4%，集中于1,000万元或以下的中细价物业。地区方面，货尾盘成交以启德最多，涉资约280.3亿元。

title.en: Cost-of-living protests sweep France, Italy, Belgium and Portugal; 1,200+ arrested in France
title.zh_hant: 歐洲多國爆發反物價示威 法國逾1200人被捕
title.zh_hans: 欧洲多国爆发反物价示威 法国逾1200人被捕

summary.en: Large protests against rising living costs swept several European countries on Saturday. In France, student-led demonstrations grew into nationwide rallies; Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said more than 1,200 people were arrested and at least 150 police officers injured, with masked protesters clashing with police in Paris, Marseille, Lyon and Lille. Police also clashed with demonstrators in Milan, Bologna, Brussels and Liège, while tens of thousands marched in Lisbon over low wages and a housing crisis. In Tirana, Albania saw a fifth day of anti-government protests.
summary.zh_hant: 歐洲多國周六爆發反生活成本示威。法國由高中生發起的抗議演變成全國示威，總理勒科爾尼指全國超過1,200人被捕、至少150名警員受傷；巴黎、馬賽、里昂及里爾有蒙面示威者與警方衝突，並洗劫商店。義大利米蘭、波隆那，比利時布魯塞爾、列日亦爆發警民衝突；葡萄牙里斯本數萬人遊行抗議低薪及住房危機；阿爾巴尼亞首都地拉那則連續第五天反政府示威。
summary.zh_hans: 欧洲多国周六爆发反生活成本示威。法国由高中生发起的抗议演变成全国示威，总理勒科尔尼指全国超过1,200人被捕、至少150名警员受伤；巴黎、马赛、里昂及里尔有蒙面示威者与警方冲突，并洗劫商店。意大利米兰、波隆那，比利时布鲁塞尔、列日亦爆发警民冲突；葡萄牙里斯本数万人游行抗议低薪及住房危机；阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那则连续第五天反政府示威。

title.en: Lianxun Instruments (688808) plans H-share listing in Hong Kong
title.zh_hant: 聯訊儀器擬發行H股赴港上市 深化全球化布局
title.zh_hans: 联讯仪器拟发行H股赴港上市 深化全球化布局

summary.en: STAR Market-listed Lianxun Instruments (688808) disclosed on October 17 that it plans to issue H-shares and list on the main board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The company said the move would deepen its global strategy, raise its international brand profile, enhance overseas financing capacity and optimise its capital structure, with timing to be chosen within 24 months of shareholder approval. As of October 16 close, its shares stood at RMB 1,200 with a market capitalisation of about RMB 182.3 billion.
summary.zh_hant: 科創板上市公司聯訊儀器（688808）10月17日披露，擬發行H股並在香港聯交所主板掛牌上市，以深化全球化戰略布局、提升國際品牌形象及增強境外融資能力，將在股東會決議有效期內選擇適當時機完成。截至10月16日收市，聯訊儀器股價報人民幣1,200元，總市值約1,823億元。
summary.zh_hans: 科创板上市公司联讯仪器（688808）10月17日披露，拟发行H股并在香港联交所主板挂牌上市，以深化全球化战略布局、提升国际品牌形象及增强境外融资能力，将在股东会决议有效期内选择适当时机完成。截至10月16日收市，联讯仪器股价报人民币1,200元，总市值约1,823亿元。

title.en: Sugon unveils 'Sugon 8000' top-10 frontier application achievements
title.zh_hant: 中科曙光發佈「曙光8000」十大前沿應用成果
title.zh_hans: 中科曙光发布「曙光8000」十大前沿应用成果

summary.en: Sugon unveiled ten frontier application achievements of the 'Sugon 8000' supercomputer at the 2026 CCF National High Performance Computing Academic Conference on October 18. The achievements span astronomy, earth science, life science, materials simulation and engineering R&D — from micro-particles to the macro-universe — with key advances in simulation scale, computation precision and application timeliness, several of them claimed global firsts.
summary.zh_hant: 中科曙光10月18日在2026年全國高性能計算學術大會（CCF HPC 2026）發佈「曙光8000」十大前沿應用成果，覆蓋天文學、地球科學、生命科學、材料模擬及工程研發等多個領域，從微觀粒子到宏觀宇宙的科學探索，相關成果在模擬規模、計算精度及應用時效等方面取得關鍵進展，多項實現「全球首次」突破。
summary.zh_hans: 中科曙光10月18日在2026年全国高性能计算学术大会（CCF HPC 2026）发布「曙光8000」十大前沿应用成果，覆盖天文学、地球科学、生命科学、材料模拟及工程研发等多个领域，从微观粒子到宏观宇宙的科学探索，相关成果在模拟规模、计算精度及应用时效等方面取得关键进展，多项实现「全球首次」突破。

title.en: Tropical storm 薔琵 crosses Guam; HKO says HK hot and dry for Chung Yeung Festival
title.zh_hant: 熱帶氣旋「薔琵」橫過關島 重陽節天晴炎熱最高31度
title.zh_hans: 热带气旋「蔷琵」横过关岛 重阳节天晴炎热最高31度

summary.en: The Hong Kong Observatory says tropical storm 薔琵 will cross Guam today and move toward waters east of Luzon early next week, but its subsequent track is uncertain — it could head toward the southeastern China coast or turn north toward the Ryukyu Islands and the East China Sea. Its outer subsiding air will bring generally fine, hot weather to South China later in the week. For the Chung Yeung Festival, Hong Kong will be hot and dry with a high of about 31°C in urban areas (1–2 degrees higher in the New Territories); the yellow fire danger warning is in force.
summary.zh_hant: 天文台表示，熱帶氣旋「薔琵」今日橫過關島一帶，本周初至中期移向呂宋以東海域，其後路徑存在變數，有機會移向中國東南沿岸，亦可能轉向偏北移向琉球群島至東海。本周後期「薔琵」外圍下沉氣流將為華南帶來大致晴朗及高溫天氣。重陽節本港市區最高氣溫約31度，新界再高一兩度，早上局部地區有一兩陣微雨，天文台已發出黃色火災危險警告。
summary.zh_hans: 天文台表示，热带气旋「蔷琵」今日横过关岛一带，本周初至中期移向吕宋以东海域，其后路径存在变数，有机会移向中国东南沿岸，亦可能转向偏北移向琉球群岛至东海。本周后期「蔷琵」外围下沉气流将为华南带来大致晴朗及高温天气。重阳节本港市区最高气温约31度，新界再高一两度，早上局部地区有一两阵微雨，天文台已发出黄色火灾危险警告。

title.en: China Mobile Hong Kong builds city's first U6GHz network, laying groundwork for 6G
title.zh_hant: 中國移動香港建成全港首個 U6GHz 網絡 為 6G 發展奠基
title.zh_hans: 中国移动香港建成全港首个 U6GHz 网络 为 6G 发展奠基

summary.en: China Mobile Hong Kong has become the first carrier in the city to deploy an Upper 6GHz (U6GHz) network, completing tests and verification at its Mong Kok flagship store. The new spectrum can be aggregated with existing bands to deliver download speeds above 3Gbps, improving connectivity in congested areas. Hong Kong auctioned 6/7GHz spectrum in November 2024 — the world's first such auction for public mobile use — and China Mobile Hong Kong secured 100MHz of contiguous spectrum, positioning the rollout as a stepping stone toward 6G.
summary.zh_hant: 中國移動香港宣布率先喺香港實現 U6GHz（Upper 6GHz）網絡，並喺旺角旗艦店完成網絡測試同驗證，成為全港首家開拓呢個頻段流動應用嘅電訊商。新增頻譜可同現有頻段做頻譜聚合，實現 3Gbps 以上下載速率，改善繁忙區域上網體驗。香港早喺 2024 年 11 月完成全球首個 6/7GHz 頻譜拍賣，中移動香港投得 100MHz 連續頻譜，今次部署為未來 6G 商用累積經驗。
summary.zh_hans: 中国移动香港宣布率先在香港实现 U6GHz（Upper 6GHz）网络，并在旺角旗舰店完成网络测试和验证，成为全港首家开拓该频段移动应用的电讯商。新增频谱可与现有频段做频谱聚合，实现 3Gbps 以上下载速率，改善繁忙区域上网体验。香港早在 2024 年 11 月完成全球首个 6/7GHz 频谱拍卖，中移动香港投得 100MHz 连续频谱，此次部署为未来 6G 商用积累经验。

source.name: 北京青年報（經新浪新聞）

title.en: Scammer calls security chief Tang Ping-keung posing as official; he replies: 'I'm on the 10th floor, come find me'
title.zh_hant: 騙徒扮保安局官員致電鄧炳強 鄧：「我喺10樓，你過嚟搵我」
title.zh_hans: 骗徒扮保安局官员致电邓炳强 邓：「我在10楼，你过来找我」

summary.en: Security Secretary Tang Ping-keung revealed on October 15 that he himself received a scam call from someone posing as a Security Bureau officer, who claimed he had broken mainland law and ordered him to report to the 10th floor of the government headquarters. Tang asked which unit the caller was from and told him he was already on the 10th floor, inviting the scammer to come over. He warned the public that such fake-official calls aim to steal personal data or trick people into transferring money, and stressed the bureau never calls demanding payments or office visits.
summary.zh_hant: 保安局局長鄧炳強 10 月 15 日喺社交平台分享，自己都收到假冒保安局人員嘅詐騙電話，對方聲稱佢涉嫌觸犯內地法律，叫佢到政府總部 10 樓協助調查。鄧炳強即場反問對方所屬組別，直言自己此刻就喺 10 樓，叫騙徒直接過嚟搵佢。佢藉此提醒市民，呢類假官員來電目的多為套取個人資料或誘導轉帳，保安局絕唔會致電要求市民繳款或到辦公室協助調查，遇可疑來電務必冷靜核實。
summary.zh_hans: 保安局局长邓炳强 10 月 15 日在社交平台分享，自己也收到假冒保安局人员的诈骗电话，对方声称他涉嫌触犯内地法律，叫他到政府总部 10 楼协助调查。邓炳强当场反问对方所属组别，直言自己此刻就在 10 楼，叫骗徒直接过来找他。他借此提醒市民，这类假官员来电目的多为套取个人资料或诱导转账，保安局绝不会致电要求市民缴款或到办公室协助调查，遇可疑来电务必冷静核实。

title.en: Paul Chan meets Thai deputy PM in Bangkok to deepen trade and financial ties
title.zh_hant: 陳茂波曼谷晤泰國副總理 探討深化經貿金融合作
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波曼谷晤泰国副总理 探讨深化经贸金融合作

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan continued his Bangkok visit on October 17, meeting Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas to discuss deepening economic and financial cooperation. The two sides explored connecting Thai foreign direct investment with Hong Kong's capital markets, with Chan saying Hong Kong could serve local firms with full-range financing support and deepen regulatory cooperation between the two securities markets. Chan thanked his counterpart for attending the APEC finance ministers' meeting in Hong Kong on October 20 and invited him to January's Asian Financial Forum.
summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波 10 月 17 日上午繼續泰國曼谷訪問行程，同泰國副總理兼財政部長會面，就進一步加強兩地經貿同金融合作交換意見。雙方探討深化合作，促進當地外來直接投資同香港資本市場對接；陳茂波話香港可發揮國際金融中心優勢，為當地企業提供全方位投融資支持，亦樂意深化兩地證券市場規管合作。佢亦感謝對方將出席 10 月 20 日喺香港舉行嘅亞太經合組織財長會議，並邀請對方明年 1 月嚟港出席亞洲金融論壇。
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波 10 月 17 日上午继续泰国曼谷访问行程，与泰国副总理兼财政部长会面，就进一步加强两地经贸和金融合作交换意见。双方探讨深化合作，促进当地外来直接投资与香港资本市场对接；陈茂波说香港可发挥国际金融中心优势，为当地企业提供全方位投融资支持，也乐意深化两地证券市场规管合作。他亦感谢对方将出席 10 月 20 日在香港举行的亚太经合组织财长会议，并邀请对方明年 1 月来港出席亚洲金融论坛。

title.en: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017, promising 'wish-style programming'
title.zh_hant: DeepSeek 推出 V4.1-Flash-1017 「許願式編程」成現實
title.zh_hans: DeepSeek 推出 V4.1-Flash-1017 「许愿式编程」成现实

summary.en: DeepSeek announced on October 17 that V4.1 Flash has been updated to V4.1-Flash-1017, with the web, app and API all switched to the new model. Trained with self-feedback reinforcement learning, the model posts higher benchmark scores — Terminal-Bench 4.0 up from 31.2 to 42.3 and DeepSWE v1.1 from 74.2 to 77.0 — and can build complete projects from scratch with minimal prompting, enabling more 'wish-style' programming requests. DeepSeek also opened Search and Fetch APIs to developers, each priced at 5 yuan per 1,000 successful calls.
summary.zh_hant: DeepSeek 10 月 17 日宣布，V4.1 Flash 已更新至 V4.1-Flash-1017 版本，官方網頁端、App 同 API 已同步切換做新模型。新模型採用基於自反饋嘅強化學習訓練，多項基準測試有提升，包括 Terminal-Bench 4.0 由 31.2 升至 42.3、DeepSWE v1.1 由 74.2 升至 77.0；從零開始構建完整項目嘅能力亦增強，支援更多「許願式」編程任務。DeepSeek 同日向開發者開放 Search 同 Fetch API，每千次成功請求各收費 5 元人民幣。
summary.zh_hans: DeepSeek 10 月 17 日宣布，V4.1 Flash 已更新至 V4.1-Flash-1017 版本，官方网页端、App 和 API 已同步切换为新模型。新模型采用基于自反馈的强化学习训练，多项基准测试有提升，包括 Terminal-Bench 4.0 由 31.2 升至 42.3、DeepSWE v1.1 由 74.2 升至 77.0；从零开始构建完整项目的能力亦增强，支持更多「许愿式」编程任务。DeepSeek 同日向开发者开放 Search 和 Fetch API，每千次成功请求各收费 5 元人民币。

title.en: Kenya confirms four new Ebola cases, bringing total to seven
title.zh_hant: 肯亞伊波拉確診增至 7 宗 包括 3 名醫護人員
title.zh_hans: 肯尼亚伊波拉确诊增至 7 宗 包括 3 名医护人员

summary.en: Kenya's health ministry announced four new Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) cases on October 17, raising the total to seven — including three health workers who treated the country's first patient and a male relative of the index case who died. All four new patients were already in quarantine when symptoms appeared, marking Kenya's first known local transmission. The ministry said 128 of 130 contacts (98.5%) had been traced and quarantined, with no evidence of community spread; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo strain.
summary.zh_hant: 肯亞衛生部 10 月 17 日宣布新增 4 宗伊波拉（Bundibugyo 病毒株）確診，累計升至 7 宗，包括 3 名曾醫治首宗個案嘅醫護人員，以及首名死者嘅男性親屬。4 名新增患者確診前已喺隔離中，係肯亞境內首次出現本地傳播。衛生部話已追蹤並隔離 130 名接觸者中嘅 128 名（98.5%），暫無證據顯示病毒喺社區傳播；Bundibugyo 病毒株目前尚無獲批疫苗或療法。
summary.zh_hans: 肯尼亚卫生部 10 月 17 日宣布新增 4 宗伊波拉（Bundibugyo 病毒株）确诊，累计升至 7 宗，包括 3 名曾医治首宗个案的医护人员，以及首名死者的男性亲属。4 名新增患者确诊前已在隔离中，是肯尼亚境内首次出现本地传播。卫生部说已追踪并隔离 130 名接触者中的 128 名（98.5%），暂无证据显示病毒在社区传播；Bundibugyo 病毒株目前尚无获批疫苗或疗法。

source.name: 新京報貝殼財經（經新浪新聞）

title.en: Beijing trials AI traffic-signal system, cutting congestion by about 19%
title.zh_hant: 北京紅綠燈變聰明 「AI 信控系統」試點緩塞
title.zh_hans: 北京红绿灯变聪明 「AI 信控系统」试点缓塞

summary.en: Beijing residents have noticed the city's traffic lights getting 'smarter': red lights no longer stay on when the crossing is empty, and green lights arrive sooner. It is the pilot 'AI intelligent signal control system', which uses dynamic timing to create green waves — trial intersections saw overall speeds rise about 21% and congestion fall about 19%. Using cameras, radar and navigation data with a multimodal large model as its 'brain', the system shifts from fixed cycles to 'lights watching cars'; of the city's 12,000 signals, 7,900 are already connected.
summary.zh_hant: 唔少北京市民發現市區紅綠燈變得「聰明」：交叉方向無車時紅燈唔再死亮，綠燈嚟得更及時，部分路段甚至可連過多個綠燈。呢個係北京試點嘅「AI 智能信控系統」，透過動態調整實現綠波通行，試點路口整體車速提升約 21%，擁堵指數下降約 19%。系統透過路口鏡頭、雷達同導航數據感知車流，再以多模態大模型做「大腦」即時調整配時，由「車看燈」變成「燈看車」。全市約 1.2 萬個信號燈中，已有 7,900 個實現聯網。
summary.zh_hans: 不少北京市民发现市区红绿灯变得「聪明」：交叉方向无车时红灯不再死亮，绿灯来得更及时，部分路段甚至可连过多个绿灯。这个是北京试点的「AI 智能信控系统」，透过动态调整实现绿波通行，试点路口整体车速提升约 21%，拥堵指数下降约 19%。系统透过路口摄像头、雷达和导航数据感知车流，再以多模态大模型做「大脑」即时调整配时，由「车看灯」变成「灯看车」。全市约 1.2 万个信号灯中，已有 7,900 个实现联网。

title.en: Zhou Xun wins Best Actress at Busan film festival for 'Loneliness'
title.zh_hant: 周迅憑《初次嚐到寂寞》奪釜山電影節最佳演員獎
title.zh_hans: 周迅凭《初次尝到寂寞》夺釜山电影节最佳演员奖

summary.en: Zhou Xun won Best Actress at the 31st Busan International Film Festival for 'Loneliness', becoming the first Chinese-language actress to take the prize since Busan became an A-list festival. Already the first among her generation's 'grand dames' to complete a Grand Slam of China's three major acting awards, Zhou fills a gap in international honors with this win. Last year Shu Qi won Busan's Best Director for 'Girl'; she returned this year as a closing-ceremony guest presenter. Li Danfeng also won Busan's Artistic Contribution award for the same film.
summary.zh_hant: 周迅憑電影《初次嚐到寂寞》獲得第 31 屆釜山國際電影節最佳演員獎，成為釜山電影節升格 A 類後首位華語影后。周迅早已係「大花」中首位攞齊「三金」大滿貫嘅演員，今次填補咗佢喺國際大獎上嘅缺憾。去年舒淇憑導演處女作《女孩》喺釜山獲最佳導演獎，今年重返釜山擔任閉幕頒獎嘉賓。李丹楓亦憑同一套戲獲藝術貢獻獎。
summary.zh_hans: 周迅凭电影《初次尝到寂寞》获得第 31 届釜山国际电影节最佳演员奖，成为釜山电影节升格 A 类后首位华语影后。周迅早已是「大花」中首位拿齐「三金」大满贯的演员，此次填补了她在国际大奖上的缺憾。去年舒淇凭导演处女作《女孩》在釜山获最佳导演奖，今年重返釜山担任闭幕颁奖嘉宾。李丹枫亦凭同一套戏获艺术贡献奖。

title.en: Anthropic pitches Congress its own AI safety bill with high bar for halting models
title.zh_hant: Anthropic 向國會議員推銷自家 AI 安全法案草案
title.zh_hans: Anthropic 向国会议员推销自家 AI 安全法案草案

summary.en: Anthropic has been quietly sharing its own draft AI safety bill with members of the US Congress. The draft sets a high bar: the government could halt a model only when it poses an imminent risk of killing or seriously injuring more than 50 people or causing more than $1 billion in damage, and only from bioweapons, loss of control or cyberattacks. Frontier models would face independent evaluators registered with the Commerce Department, which could ask a D.C. federal judge to order a suspension; other agencies would be barred from acting alone. The bill would also override some state AI laws, including California's.
summary.zh_hant: Anthropic 私下向美國國會議員推銷一份自家起草嘅 AI 安全法案草案。草案規定，只有當模型喺生物武器、模型失控或網絡攻擊三類風險之一造成「可預見、迫切」威脅、足以導致逾 50 人死傷或逾 10 億美元損失時，政府先可以出手。前沿模型須接受向商務部註冊嘅獨立評估員定期審查；商務部可向華盛頓特區聯邦法官申請叫停模型，其他部門一律唔准自行叫停。草案亦會凌駕部分州級 AI 法例，包括加州。
summary.zh_hans: Anthropic 私下向美国国会议员推销一份自家起草的 AI 安全法案草案。草案规定，只有当模型在生物武器、模型失控或网络攻击三类风险之一造成「可预见、迫切」威胁、足以导致逾 50 人死伤或逾 10 亿美元损失时，政府才可以出手。前沿模型须接受向商务部注册的独立评估员定期审查；商务部可向华盛顿特区联邦法官申请叫停模型，其他部门一律不准自行叫停。草案亦会凌驾部分州级 AI 法例，包括加州。

title.en: Trump waives Russia sanctions and tariffs days before new law takes effect
title.zh_hant: 特朗普簽行政命令暫緩對俄制裁及關稅
title.zh_hans: 特朗普签行政命令暂缓对俄制裁及关税

summary.en: President Trump signed an executive order waiving many sanctions, restrictions and duties just days before they were to take effect under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, certifying the move as in the US national interest. The legislation, which Trump signed in mid-September, would have imposed tariffs of up to 100% within 30 days on goods from the five largest importers of Russian crude oil or gas. Trump has been warming toward Russia while publicly criticizing Ukraine's President Zelenskiy, including suggesting Ukraine needs a new leader.
summary.zh_hant: 特朗普簽署行政命令，喺格雷厄姆《制裁俄羅斯及伊朗法案》生效前幾日，暫停其中多項制裁、限制同關稅，聲稱符合美國國家利益。該法案 9 月由國會通過、特朗普本人簽署，原定對俄羅斯原油或天然氣五大買家徵收最高 100% 關稅。特朗普近日立場親俄，多次公開批評烏克蘭總統澤連斯基，甚至話烏克蘭「係時候換總統」。
summary.zh_hans: 特朗普签署行政命令，在格雷厄姆《制裁俄罗斯及伊朗法案》生效前几日，暂停其中多项制裁、限制和关税，声称符合美国国家利益。该法案 9 月由国会通过、特朗普本人签署，原定对俄罗斯原油或天然气五大买家征收最高 100% 关税。特朗普近日立场亲俄，多次公开批评乌克兰总统泽连斯基，甚至说乌克兰「是时候换总统」。

title.en: White House press secretary Zacharia out after just five days
title.zh_hant: 白宮新聞秘書扎卡利亞上任僅五日被勸退
title.zh_hans: 白宫新闻秘书扎卡利亚上任仅五日被劝退

summary.en: White House officials confirmed that new press secretary Katie Zacharia is leaving after just five days on the job. President Trump said he had suggested she reconsider whether the role was right for her: 'Katie, is this job for you?' Her first and only briefing answered just three questions before ending, drawing widespread criticism, and her legal credentials — including calling herself an 'attorney' without having passed the bar — came under scrutiny. Her tenure was shorter even than Anthony Scaramucci's 11 days in 2017.
summary.zh_hant: 白宮官員證實，新任白宮新聞秘書扎卡利亞（Katie Zacharia）上任僅五日便離職。特朗普公開話曾建議她重新考慮係咪適合呢份工：「凱蒂，這份工作適合你嗎？」扎卡利亞首次、亦係唯一一次記者會只答咗三條問題就結束，表現備受批評；她自稱「attorney」嘅法律資歷亦遭質疑。任期比 2017 年任職 11 日嘅斯卡拉穆奇更短，創白宮新聞秘書最短命紀錄。
summary.zh_hans: 白宫官员证实，新任白宫新闻秘书扎卡利亚（Katie Zacharia）上任仅五日便离职。特朗普公开说曾建议她重新考虑是否适合这份工：「凯蒂，这份工作适合你吗？」扎卡利亚首次、也是唯一一次记者会只答了三条问题就结束，表现备受批评；她自称「attorney」的法律资历亦遭质疑。任期比 2017 年任职 11 日的斯卡拉穆奇更短，创白宫新闻秘书最短命纪录。

title.en: Three-Body Universe CEO reveals 'Da Shi' spinoff is about to start filming
title.zh_hant: 三體宇宙CEO透露衍生劇《三體：大史》即將開拍
title.zh_hans: 三体宇宙CEO透露衍生剧《三体：大史》即将开拍

summary.en: Three-Body Universe CEO Zhao Jilong revealed at a salon of the 3rd 30°N Science Fiction Film Week in Xiangshan, Ningbo, that the spinoff 'The Three-Body Problem: Da Shi' — an original story built around Shi Qiang, played by Yu Hewei in the first season — is about to start filming, with director Yang Lei's original team returning. He also said a second TV season and a film version of 'The Three-Body Problem' are in the works.
summary.zh_hant: 第三屆北緯30°科幻電影周喺浙江寧波象山舉行主題沙龍，三體宇宙CEO趙驥龍透露，圍繞于和偉飾演嘅史強一角創作嘅原創故事《三體：大史》即將開拍，由《三體》第一部導演楊磊原班人馬打造。趙驥龍同時提到，《三體》電視劇第二部同電影版亦喺籌備中，會傾盡全力慢慢打磨。
summary.zh_hans: 第三届北纬30°科幻电影周在浙江宁波象山举行主题沙龙，三体宇宙CEO赵骥龙透露，围绕于和伟饰演的史强一角创作的原创故事《三体：大史》即将开拍，由《三体》第一部导演杨磊原班人马打造。赵骥龙同时提到，《三体》电视剧第二部和电影版亦在筹备中，会倾尽全力慢慢打磨。

title.en: US FY2026 budget deficit hits $1.99 trillion, a five-year high
title.zh_hant: 美國2026財年預算赤字達1.99萬億美元 創五年新高
title.zh_hans: 美国2026财年预算赤字达1.99万亿美元 创五年新高

summary.en: The US Treasury reported a fiscal 2026 budget deficit of $1.99 trillion, up $217 billion from a year earlier — a five-year high and the third largest in US history. The main drivers were record debt-servicing costs ($1.36 trillion, up 12%), higher Social Security and defense spending, and a Supreme Court ruling invalidating many of Trump's tariffs, forcing $145 billion in refunds and pushing net tariff revenue down 11% to about $173 billion. The deficit-to-GDP ratio rose to 6.2%.
summary.zh_hant: 美國財政部公布，2026財年預算赤字達1.99萬億美元，按年增加2,170億美元，創五年新高，亦係美國歷史上第三高。主因係償債支出創新高（1.36萬億美元，增12%）、社安同國防開支增加，加上最高法院裁定特朗普部分關稅無效，政府須退還1,450億美元關稅，令關稅淨收入跌11%至約1,730億美元。赤字佔GDP比率升至6.2%。
summary.zh_hans: 美国财政部公布，2026财年预算赤字达1.99万亿美元，按年增加2170亿美元，创五年新高，亦是美国历史上第三高。主因是偿债支出创新高（1.36万亿美元，增12%）、社安和国防开支增加，加上最高法院裁定特朗普部分关税无效，政府须退还1450亿美元关税，令关税净收入跌11%至约1730亿美元。赤字占GDP比率升至6.2%。

title.en: John Lee mourns passing of former NPC deputy Ng Hong-mun
title.zh_hans: 吴康民辞世 李家超致哀
title.zh_hant: 吳康民辭世 李家超致哀

summary.en: Former Hong Kong deputy to the National People's Congress Ng Hong-mun has passed away, and Chief Executive John Lee today expressed his sorrow and extended his deepest condolences to his family. Lee said Ng served as an NPC deputy for over 30 years from the 1970s and held key roles including member of the Preparatory Committee of the HKSAR and Hong Kong Affairs Adviser, making important contributions to Hong Kong's smooth return to the motherland and its long-term stability and prosperity. Ng was also a veteran educator who served as Principal and Supervisor of Pui Kiu Middle School, and was awarded the Grand Bauhinia Medal in 1998.
summary.zh_hans: 前港区全国人大代表吴康民辞世，行政长官李家超今日表示哀悼，并向其家人致以深切慰问。李家超形容，吴康民自上世纪70年代起担任全国人大代表超过30年，曾任香港特区筹委会委员及港事顾问，为香港顺利回归及长期繁荣稳定作出重要贡献。吴康民多年来担任培侨中学校长及校监，致力爱国教育事业，于1998年获颁大紫荆勋章。
summary.zh_hant: 前港區全國人大代表吳康民辭世，行政長官李家超今日表示哀悼，並向其家人致以深切慰問。李家超形容，吳康民自上世紀70年代起擔任全國人大代表超過30年，曾任香港特區籌委會委員及港事顧問，為香港順利回歸及長期繁榮穩定作出重要貢獻。吳康民多年來擔任培僑中學校長及校監，致力愛國教育事業，於1998年獲頒大紫荊勳章。

title.en: Huanggang Port sees 19,000 outbound passengers in two hours, up over 800%
title.zh_hans: 皇岗口岸今午出境逾1.9万人次 较旧口岸同期升逾8倍
title.zh_hant: 皇崗口岸今午出境逾1.9萬人次 較舊口岸同期升逾8倍

summary.en: The Security Bureau said outbound passenger flow at Huanggang Port surged from around 11am today, prompting the Immigration Department to open all clearance channels and counters at the L5 departure hall. Around 19,000 passengers departed for the Mainland via Huanggang Port between noon and 2pm, up 835% compared with the same period previously at Huanggang Port/Lok Ma Chau Control Point. The busiest hour between 1pm and 2pm alone recorded 9,728 outbound trips, a rise of 899%. Crowd diversion measures on L2 were lifted by 2.10pm, and the authorities advised the public to plan journeys in advance and consider using other boundary control points.
summary.zh_hans: 保安局表示，皇岗口岸今日上午11时起出境人流急增，入境处随即开放离境大堂5楼全部通道及柜台疏导。中午12时至下午2时，约1.9万人次经皇岗口岸离境前往内地，较皇岗口岸及落马洲管制站旧年同期大增835%。其中下午1时至2时的繁忙一小时内，更录得9,728人次出境，升幅达899%。下午2时10分已解除2楼人潮管制措施，当局呼吁市民提早规划行程，考虑使用其他管制站离境。
summary.zh_hant: 保安局表示，皇崗口岸今日上午11時起出境人流急增，入境處隨即開放離境大堂5樓全部通道及櫃枱疏導。中午12時至下午2時，約1.9萬人次經皇崗口岸離境前往內地，較皇崗口岸及落馬洲管制站舊年同期大增835%。其中下午1時至2時的繁忙一小時內，更錄得9,728人次出境，升幅達899%。下午2時10分已解除2樓人潮管制措施，當局呼籲市民提早規劃行程，考慮使用其他管制站離境。

title.en: Anita Mui ashes theft case may see breakthrough as Man Tsu-en claims suspect identified
title.zh_hans: 梅艳芳骨灰被盗案疑有突破 文隽引述消息指锁定寺庙清洁工“阿强”
title.zh_hant: 梅艷芳骨灰被盜案疑有突破 文雋引述消息指鎖定寺廟清潔工「阿強」

summary.en: Veteran filmmaker Man Tsu-en revealed on his online channel today that the theft of the late diva Anita Mui's ashes may have seen a breakthrough. Citing a message from Eva, chairwoman of the fan club "Fong Sum Wui", he said police enhanced blurry surveillance footage and, with the help of a tour coach's dashcam, spotted a man surnamed "Ah Keung" in a temple cleaner's uniform behaving suspiciously, and found that he had already left Hong Kong for Southeast Asia shortly after the incident. Police have not yet formally confirmed the development. Man Tsu-en speculated that the sudden death of Mui's mother Tam Mei-kam on August 30 this year may have disrupted the thief's plan to demand ransom.
summary.zh_hans: 资深电影人文隽今日在其网上频道透露，已故天后梅艳芳骨灰被盗案疑出现新突破。据歌迷会“芳心荟”会长Eva提供的消息，警方透过影像修复技术，结合旅游巴行车记录仪片段，发现一名身穿寺庙清洁工制服、被称为“阿强”的男子形迹可疑，并发现他在案发后不久已离港前往东南亚。不过警方至今未正式公布案件进展，相关消息仍有待官方证实。文隽推测，梅艳芳母亲覃美金今年8月底离世，可能打乱了盗窃者勒索赎金的计划。
summary.zh_hant: 資深電影人文雋今日在其網上頻道透露，已故天后梅艷芳的骨灰被盜案疑出現新突破。據歌迷會「芳心薈」會長Eva提供的消息，警方透過影像修復技術，結合旅遊巴行車記錄儀片段，發現一名身穿寺廟清潔工制服、被稱為「阿強」的男子形跡可疑，並發現他在案發後不久已離港前往東南亞。不過警方至今未正式公布案件進展，相關消息仍有待官方證實。文雋推測，梅艷芳母親覃美金今年8月底離世，可能打亂了盜竊者勒索贖金的計劃。

title.en: FEHD reminds public to follow rules when dining out with dogs during Halloween
title.zh_hans: 食环署提醒万圣节携狗外出用膳须守法依规
title.zh_hant: 食環署提醒萬聖節攜狗外出用膳須守法依規

summary.en: With Halloween approaching, the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department today reminded members of the public who plan to dine out with their dogs to first confirm whether the restaurant is licensed to allow dogs, and to comply with the relevant laws. More than 990 restaurants are currently permitted to admit dogs, and their operators must ensure the premises meet licence conditions and legal requirements. Since the measure took effect on July 9, the FEHD has mounted 20 prosecutions against non-permitted restaurants and seven against dog owners who took dogs into non-permitted premises, along with four prosecutions over dogs not being kept on leash properly at permitted restaurants.
summary.zh_hans: 万圣节将至，食环署今日提醒市民，如计划携狗外出用膳，应预先确认该食肆是否获准容许狗只进入，并遵守相关法例。现时全港有超过990间食肆持有容许狗只进入的准许，相关食肆负责人须确保处所符合牌照条件及法例要求。署方透露，容许狗只进入获准食肆的措施自今年7月9日实施以来，已就违规食肆提出20宗检控，并就违规携狗进入非获准食肆的人士提出7宗检控，另有4宗涉及获准食肆内未妥善牵引狗带。
summary.zh_hant: 萬聖節將至，食環署今日提醒市民，如計劃攜狗外出用膳，應預先確認該食肆是否獲准容許狗隻進入，並遵守相關法例。現時全港有超過990間食肆持有容許狗隻進入的准許，相關食肆負責人須確保處所符合牌照條件及法例要求。署方透露，容許狗隻進入獲准食肆的措施自今年7月9日實施以來，已就違規食肆提出20宗檢控，並就違規攜狗進入非獲准食肆的人士提出7宗檢控，另有4宗涉及獲准食肆內未妥善牽引狗帶。

title.en: Patrick Dunn admits joining Freemasons and reveals two entry requirements
title.zh_hans: 邓梓峰亲认加入共济会 揭入会两大条件
title.zh_hant: 鄧梓峰親認加入共濟會 揭入會兩大條件

summary.en: Hong Kong artiste Patrick Dunn, 64, has openly admitted that he has joined the Knights Templar of the Freemasons. The news broke after writer Wan Hoi ran into Dunn, dressed in a white robe and a red cross cap, at a Knights Templar thanksgiving service at St John's Cathedral in Central yesterday, and shared their photo on social media. Wan Hoi later deleted the photo, saying he had received a request from senior Freemasons conveyed through a friend. When approached by the media, Dunn calmly confirmed his membership, describing himself as still a junior member, and revealed that the two basic entry requirements are genuine enthusiasm for the organisation and basic English communication skills.
summary.zh_hans: 64岁艺人邓梓峰大方承认自己已加入共济会圣殿骑士团。事缘作家云海昨日在中环圣约翰座堂出席共济会圣殿骑士团感恩弥撒时，巧遇身穿白袍、头戴红十字礼帽的邓梓峰，并将合照上载社交平台；其后云海称收到共济会高层经朋友转达不满，随即删除照片。邓梓峰接受传媒查询时坦然承认身份，形容自己“仍然系好Junior”，并透露入会关键在于个人是否有热诚，以及具备基本英语沟通能力。
summary.zh_hant: 64歲藝人鄧梓峰大方承認自己已加入共濟會聖殿騎士團。事緣作家雲海昨日在中環聖約翰座堂出席共濟會聖殿騎士團感恩彌撒時，巧遇身穿白袍、頭戴紅十字禮帽的鄧梓峰，並將合照上載社交平台；其後雲海稱收到共濟會高層經朋友轉達不滿，隨即刪除照片。鄧梓峰接受傳媒查詢時坦然承認身份，形容自己「仍然係好Junior」，並透露入會關鍵在於個人是否有熱誠，以及具備基本英語溝通能力。

title.en: Microsoft pulls out of UK data centre deal with Nscale, Telegraph reports
title.zh_hans: 微软退出与 Nscale 的英国数据中心合作协议
title.zh_hant: 微軟退出與 Nscale 的英國數據中心合作協議

summary.en: Microsoft has terminated its agreement with British cloud provider Nscale for a data centre in Loughton, Essex, Britain's Telegraph newspaper reported on Sunday. Microsoft is one of Nscale's two largest customers, and the loss comes as the Nvidia-backed firm prepares a US listing. The report said the project had suffered repeated delays, with the national grid not expected to supply power to the site until the 2030s.
summary.zh_hans: 《电讯报》报道，微软已终止与英国云端服务商 Nscale 就埃塞克斯劳顿数据中心的合作协议。微软是 Nscale 两大客户之一，这间获英伟达支持的公司上月刚申请在美国上市。报道指项目多次延期，电网方面告知要到 2030 年代才能接通供电。
summary.zh_hant: 《電訊報》報道，微軟已終止與英國雲端服務商 Nscale 就埃塞克斯勞頓數據中心的合作協議。微軟是 Nscale 兩大客戶之一，這間獲英偉達支持的公司上月剛申請在美國上市。報道指項目多次延期，電網方面告知要到 2030 年代才能接通供電。

title.en: DeepSeek announces pricing for API web search and fetch: 5 yuan per 1,000 successful calls
title.zh_hans: DeepSeek 公布 API 网页搜索与抓取收费　每千次成功请求 5 元
title.zh_hant: DeepSeek 公布 API 網頁搜索與抓取收費　每千次成功請求 5 元

summary.en: DeepSeek announced that its API now supports web search and page fetch, billed per request at 5 yuan per 1,000 successful calls. Calls made through server-side tools in DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code and Codex are currently free and will start being billed from 00:00 on 1 November 2026. The two endpoints use DeepSeek's own search engine to provide real-time web content for agents and retrieval applications.
summary.zh_hans: DeepSeek 发布公告，指其 API 现已支持网页搜索与抓取，按请求次数收费，单价为每 1000 次成功请求 5 元。目前用户在 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、Codex 通过 Server 端工具调用的 Search／Fetch 接口暂未计费，将于 2026 年 11 月 1 日零时起收费。两项接口均采用 DeepSeek 自研搜索引擎，为 Agent 与检索应用提供实时网页内容。
summary.zh_hant: DeepSeek 發布公告，指其 API 現已支持網頁搜索與抓取，按請求次數收費，單價為每 1000 次成功請求 5 元。目前用戶在 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、Codex 透過 Server 端工具調用的 Search／Fetch 接口暫未計費，將於 2026 年 11 月 1 日零時起收費。兩項接口均採用 DeepSeek 自研搜索引擎，為 Agent 與檢索應用提供實時網頁內容。

title.en: Nine firms including Broadcom and Verizon block tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE
title.zh_hans: Broadcom、Verizon 等 9 间公司反对 OKXICE 代币化交易其股票
title.zh_hant: Broadcom、Verizon 等 9 間公司反對 OKXICE 代幣化交易其股票

summary.en: Nine US-listed companies, including Broadcom, Verizon, CoreWeave and UnitedHealth Group, have filed formal objections to stop tokenized versions of their shares trading on OKXICE, a joint venture between OKX and Intercontinental Exchange. Nasdaq also said it would opt out of having its own shares tokenized on the venue. Under the SEC's five-year innovation exemption, a timely objection legally blocks the venue from offering the company's stock. Despite the objections, the market cap of tokenized stocks has grown from about $680 million at the start of the year to roughly $3.5 billion by mid-October.
summary.zh_hans: 9 间美国上市公司，包括 Broadcom、Verizon、CoreWeave 及 UnitedHealth Group，已正式反对 OKXICE 将其股票代币化交易。OKXICE 是 OKX 与洲际交易所合资的交易平台；纳斯达克亦表明不会让自家股票在该平台被代币化。根据美国证监会的五年创新豁免机制，公司及时提出反对便可依法阻止平台上架其股票。尽管有反对声音，代币化股票总市值已由年初约 6.8 亿美元升至 10 月中旬约 35 亿美元。
summary.zh_hant: 9 間美國上市公司，包括 Broadcom、Verizon、CoreWeave 及 UnitedHealth Group，已正式反對 OKXICE 將其股票代幣化交易。OKXICE 是 OKX 與洲際交易所合資的交易平台；納斯達克亦表明不會讓自家股票在該平台被代幣化。根據美國證監會的五年創新豁免機制，公司及時提出反對便可依法阻止平台上架其股票。儘管有反對聲音，代幣化股票總市值已由年初約 6.8 億美元升至 10 月中旬約 35 億美元。

title.en: ST Juewei and *ST Sitong to remove risk warning caps on 20 October
title.zh_hans: ST 绝味、*ST 四通 10 月 20 日摘帽　明停牌一日
title.zh_hant: ST 絕味、*ST 四通 10 月 20 日摘帽　明停牌一日

summary.en: Two A-share companies will have their risk warnings removed on 20 October. ST Juewei (603517) said its shares will be suspended for one day on 19 October and resume trading the next day without the 'other risk warning', changing its name back to Juewei Food. The company had been capped for over a year after failing to record franchise store renovation revenue from 2017 to 2021. Separately, *ST Sitong (603838) will also suspend trading on 19 October and resume on 20 October with its delisting risk warning removed, after the Shanghai Stock Exchange approved its application on 16 October.
summary.zh_hans: 两间 A 股公司将于 10 月 20 日摘帽。ST 绝味（603517）公告，公司股票将于 10 月 19 日停牌一日，10 月 20 日起复牌并撤销其他风险警示，证券简称变更为绝味食品。公司曾因 2017 至 2021 年未确认加盟门店装修业务收入而被处罚，戴帽已超过一年。*ST 四通（603838）亦将于 10 月 19 日停牌，10 月 20 日复牌并撤销退市风险警示，上交所已于 10 月 16 日批准申请。
summary.zh_hant: 兩間 A 股公司將於 10 月 20 日摘帽。ST 絕味（603517）公告，公司股票將於 10 月 19 日停牌一日，10 月 20 日起復牌並撤銷其他風險警示，證券簡稱變更為絕味食品。公司曾因 2017 至 2021 年未確認加盟門店裝修業務收入而被處罰，戴帽已超過一年。*ST 四通（603838）亦將於 10 月 19 日停牌，10 月 20 日復牌並撤銷退市風險警示，上交所已於 10 月 16 日批准申請。

source.name: 新浪财经（每日经济新闻）

title.en: US AI stocks slump: CoreWeave down over 25% in a week as inflation fears weigh on tech
title.zh_hans: 美股 AI 股重挫　CoreWeave 一周大跌逾 25%
title.zh_hant: 美股 AI 股重挫　CoreWeave 一週大跌逾 25%

summary.en: US technology shares fell sharply on Friday, with the Nasdaq dropping 2.14%. A US diesel shortage pushed WTI crude futures above $99 a barrel, lifting inflation expectations and pressuring tech valuations. Cloud computing firm CoreWeave fell nearly 12% on Friday and more than 25% over the week. Separately, consultancy Gartner estimates that AI service providers could spend nearly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone, with the industry facing over $3.5 trillion in impairment risk by 2030 if expected revenues fall short.
summary.zh_hans: 美股科技股周五重挫，纳斯达克指数下跌 2.14%。美国柴油短缺刺激 WTI 原油期货升穿 99 美元，通胀预期升温压制科技股估值。云计算服务商 CoreWeave 周五大跌近 12%，一周累计跌幅逾 25%。另有咨询机构 Gartner 预测，AI 服务商仅 2026 年在 AI 基建上的支出便接近 1 万亿美元，若收入不及预期，到 2030 年行业或面临逾 3.5 万亿美元的减值风险。
summary.zh_hant: 美股科技股週五重挫，納斯達克指數下跌 2.14%。美國柴油短缺刺激 WTI 原油期貨升穿 99 美元，通脹預期升溫壓制科技股估值。雲計算服務商 CoreWeave 週五大跌近 12%，一週累計跌幅逾 25%。另有諮詢機構 Gartner 預測，AI 服務商僅 2026 年在 AI 基建上的支出便接近 1 萬億美元，若收入不及預期，到 2030 年行業或面臨逾 3.5 萬億美元的減值風險。

title.en: Iran says supertanker struck naval mine in Strait of Hormuz
title.zh_hant: 伊朗話有艘超級油輪喺霍爾木茲海峽撞到水雷
title.zh_hans: 伊朗称一艘超级油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷

summary.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said a supertanker carrying more than two million barrels of crude oil struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian claim has not been independently confirmed by other parties. Separately, the British Navy's maritime watchdog UKMTO reported one or two vessels came under attack in the central Persian Gulf on Friday, with one ship apparently hit by rocket-propelled grenades fired from a small boat. No one was reported injured in the incidents.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗革命衛隊聲稱，有艘載住超過二百萬桶原油嘅超級油輪喺霍爾木茲海峽撞到水雷。不過呢個講法暫時未有獨立證實。另一方面，英國海軍嘅海事監察機構 UKMTO 話，星期五波斯灣中部有一至兩艘船遇襲，其中一艘疑似俾細艇發射嘅火箭推進榴彈打中。事件中暫時冇人受傷嘅報告。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗革命卫队声称，一艘载有超过二百万桶原油的超级油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷。不过这一说法暂未得到独立证实。另一方面，英国海军的海事监察机构 UKMTO 表示，周五波斯湾中部有一至两艘船只遇袭，其中一艘疑似被小艇发射的火箭推进榴弹击中。事件中暂无人员受伤的报告。

title.en: Huanggang crossing braces for first holiday rush with over 100,000 daily crossings expected
title.zh_hant: 皇崗口岸迎首個假期人流高峰 預計每日過境超過十萬人次
title.zh_hans: 皇岗口岸迎首个假期人流高峰 预计每日过境超过十万人次

summary.en: The revamped Huanggang border crossing is preparing for its first holiday travel rush, with daily passenger journeys expected to exceed 100,000 over the Chung Yeung Festival long weekend. Security Secretary Chris Tang said the crossing handled about 92,000 passenger journeys on Friday, after around 80,000 a day from Monday to Thursday. He said operations had generally run smoothly, with clearance under the new co-location and joint-inspection arrangements usually taking less than five minutes. Authorities will open all automated and manual channels when needed and have deployed extra staff at the public transport interchange to manage passenger flow.
summary.zh_hant: 完成改造嘅皇崗口岸準備迎接首個假期人流高峰，重陽節長假期預計每日過境人次超過十萬。保安局局長鄧炳強話，口岸星期五錄低約九萬二千人次出入，星期一至四每日就有約八萬人次。佢話新嘅「一地兩檢」安排下，過關一般唔使五分鐘，整體運作順暢。當局會喺有需要時開晒所有自動同人手通道，仲加派人手喺公共交通交匯處疏導人流。
summary.zh_hans: 完成改造的皇岗口岸准备迎接首个假期人流高峰，重阳节长假期预计每日过境人次超过十万。保安局局长邓炳强表示，口岸周五录得约九万二千人次出入，周一至周四每日约八万人次。他说新的「一地两检」安排下，过关一般不用五分钟，整体运作顺畅。当局会在有需要时开完全部自动和人手通道，并加派人手在公共交通交汇处疏导人流。

title.en: Hong Kong police arrest two men over HK$1.7 million in Kowloon break-ins
title.zh_hant: 警方拘兩漢涉九龍連環爆竊 損失總值約170萬元
title.zh_hans: 警方拘两男涉九龙连环爆窃 损失总值约170万港元

summary.en: Hong Kong police have arrested two men suspected of a series of night-time break-ins across Kowloon over the past three months, with reported losses of about HK$1.7 million. Officers moved in on Thursday, detaining a 54-year-old mainland Chinese man in Sham Shui Po and a 34-year-old Hong Kong resident in Tsim Sha Tsui. The arrests followed an investigation into a burglary in which four flats at a private residential block on Farm Road in Kowloon City were targeted, with more than HK$100,000 in cash, watches and credit cards taken. Police said the pair are being probed over at least six linked cases since July and further arrests have not been ruled out.
summary.zh_hant: 警方拘捕咗兩名男子，涉嫌過去三個月喺九龍多區連環夜間爆竊，報稱損失總值約一百七十萬元。探員星期四收網，分別喺深水埗拘捕一名五十四歲內地男子，同喺尖沙咀拘捕一名三十四歲香港居民。案件起因係九龍城農圃道一個私人屋苑有四個單位被爆竊，損失超過十萬元現金、手錶同信用卡。警方話，兩人涉嫌同至少六宗自七月以嚟嘅連環爆竊案有關，唔排除再有人被捕。
summary.zh_hans: 警方拘捕了两名男子，涉嫌过去三个月在九龙多区连环夜间爆窃，报称损失总值约一百七十万港元。探员周四收网，分别在深水埗拘捕一名五十四岁内地男子，以及在尖沙咀拘捕一名三十四岁香港居民。案件起因是九龙城农圃道一个私人屋苑有四个单位被爆窃，损失超过十万港元现金、手表和信用卡。警方表示，两人涉嫌与至少六宗自七月以来的连环爆窃案有关，不排除再有人被捕。

title.en: First mainland yachts arrive in Hong Kong under new southbound scheme
title.zh_hant: 首批廣東遊艇南下抵港 遊艇經濟新計劃啟動
title.zh_hans: 首批广东游艇南下抵港 游艇经济新计划启动

summary.en: The first batch of five yachts from Guangdong province has arrived in Hong Kong under a new cross-boundary southbound scheme launched on Friday, as the city positions itself as a premier yachting hub in Asia. Under the scheme, Guangdong yachts no longer need to secure a berth at a private yacht club or marina before entering Hong Kong and can instead use five designated anchorage areas. Acting Financial Secretary Michael Wong said Hong Kong is pushing ahead with four new yacht clubs at the airport, Lamma Island, Aberdeen and Hung Hom, providing over 1,100 new berths, about 30 percent more than current capacity. About 270 mainland yacht captains have completed the required training to operate in Hong Kong waters.
summary.zh_hant: 首批五艘嚟自廣東省嘅遊艇，喺星期五啟動嘅新跨境南下計劃下抵達香港，標誌香港發展亞洲遊艇中心邁出新一步。新計劃下，廣東遊艇唔使事先喺私人遊艇會或碼頭訂位，可以直接使用五個指定碇泊區。署理財政司司長黃偉綸話，機場、南丫島、香港仔同紅磡四個新遊艇會正推進落實，提供超過一千一百個新泊位，比現有容量多約三成。約二百七十名內地遊艇船長已經完成喺香港水域駕駛所需嘅培訓同考試。
summary.zh_hans: 首批五艘来自广东省的游艇，在周五启动的新跨境南下计划下抵达香港，标志着香港发展亚洲游艇中心迈出新一步。新计划下，广东游艇无需事先在私人游艇会或码头订位，可直接使用五个指定锚泊区。署理财政司司长黄伟纶表示，机场、南丫岛、香港仔和红磡四个新游艇会正推进落实，提供超过一千一百个新泊位，比现有容量多约三成。约二百七十名内地游艇船长已经完成在香港水域驾驶所需的培训和考试。

title.en: Hang Seng Index closes up 124 points as Lenovo surges 8 percent
title.zh_hant: 恒指收升124點 聯想飆升8%帶領科技股向上
title.zh_hans: 恒指收升124点 联想飙升8%带领科技股向上

summary.en: Hong Kong shares ended higher on Friday, with the Hang Seng Index gaining 124.11 points, or 0.52 percent, to close at 24,186.83 as technology stocks led the advance. The Hang Seng TECH Index rose 1.16 percent to 4,108.24, while the biotech index climbed 1.19 percent. Lenovo Group was the standout mover, jumping 8.01 percent to HK$28.06. Alibaba gained 2.26 percent to HK$108.80, while Xiaomi slipped 1.55 percent to HK$26.66. Main Board turnover reached HK$178.2 billion, with southbound Stock Connect flows recording HK$42.31 billion through Shanghai Connect and HK$23.1 billion through Shenzhen Connect.
summary.zh_hant: 港股星期五收市向上，恒指升一百二十四點，即係百分之零點五二，收報二萬四千一百八十六點，科技股帶頭造好。恒生科技指數升百分之一點一六，收報四千一百零八點；生物科技指數亦升近百分之一點二。聯想集團係全日焦點，飆升百分之八點零一，收報二十八個零六。阿里巴巴升百分之二點二六，小米就跌百分之一點五五。主板成交一千七百八十二億元，滬深港通南向成交分別錄得四百二十三億同二百三十一億元。
summary.zh_hans: 港股周五收市向上，恒指升一百二十四点，即百分之零点五二，收报二万四千一百八十六点，科技股带头造好。恒生科技指数升百分之一点一六，收报四千一百零八点；生物科技指数亦升近百分之一点二。联想集团是全日焦点，飙升百分之八点零一，收报二十八点零六。阿里巴巴升百分之二点二六，小米则跌百分之一点五五。主板成交一千七百八十二亿港元，沪深港通南向成交分别录得四百二十三亿和二百三十一亿港元。
