summary.en: China's foreign ministry announced that Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi will attend the seventh summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia in Baku, Azerbaijan on the 15th as President Xi Jinping's special representative. He will also visit Azerbaijan, Croatia, Montenegro and Bulgaria from the 14th to the 20th.
summary.zh_hans: 外交部宣布，中共中央政治局委员、外长王毅将作为国家主席习近平特别代表，出席15日在阿塞拜疆巴库举行的亚信第七次峰会，并于14日至20日访问阿塞拜疆、克罗地亚、黑山和保加利亚。
summary.zh_hant: 外交部宣布，中共中央政治局委員、外長王毅將作為國家主席習近平特別代表，出席15日在阿塞拜疆巴庫舉行的亞信第七次峰會，並於14日至20日訪問阿塞拜疆、克羅地亞、黑山和保加利亞。

title.en: 93-year-old woman dies after suspected assault in Kai Tak; domestic helper arrested for murder
title.zh_hans: 启德93岁婆婆疑被袭亡　外佣涉谋杀被捕
title.zh_hant: 啟德93歲婆婆疑被襲亡　外傭涉謀殺被捕

summary.en: A 93-year-old woman in Kai Tak died after a suspected assault, and police have classified the case as murder, arresting a foreign domestic helper. Police said the victim was struck about 20 times in a short period, including being stomped on the abdomen.
summary.zh_hans: 启德一名93岁婆婆疑被袭死亡，警方列作谋杀案处理，拘捕一名外籍家庭佣工。警方指死者在短时间内被击打约20次，包括被踩腹部。
summary.zh_hant: 啟德一名93歲婆婆疑被襲死亡，警方列作謀殺案處理，拘捕一名外籍家庭傭工。警方指死者在短時間內被擊打約20次，包括被踩腹部。

title.en: South Korea says North Korea fired several ballistic missiles toward eastern waters
title.zh_hans: 韩军指朝鲜向东部海域发射数枚弹道导弹
title.zh_hant: 韓軍指朝鮮向東部海域發射數枚彈道導彈

summary.en: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said North Korea fired several ballistic missiles toward its eastern waters, flying more than 900 kilometres. It is the North's first missile launch from the Pyongyang area since August 20.
summary.zh_hans: 韩国联合参谋本部指，朝鲜向东部海域发射数枚弹道导弹，飞行900公里以上。这是朝鲜自8月20日以来首次从平壤一带发射导弹。
summary.zh_hant: 韓國聯合參謀本部指，朝鮮向東部海域發射數枚彈道導彈，飛行900公里以上。這是朝鮮自8月20日以來首次從平壤一帶發射導彈。

title.en: New Huanggang Port on day one: Hongkongers praise 'fast and smooth' clearance; student says it felt like a mall
title.zh_hans: 新皇岗口岸直击｜港人大赞过关「快靓正」　中六生：以为系商场
title.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸直擊｜港人大讚過關「快靚正」　中六生：以為係商場

summary.en: On the first day of the new Huanggang Port's co-location arrangement, Hong Kong crossers praised the noticeably faster clearance, with one secondary-six student remarking the facility felt like a shopping mall. The "one inspection, one release" model drew positive early reactions from travellers.
summary.zh_hans: 新皇岗口岸实施「合作查验、一次放行」首日，过关港人大赞流程「快靓正」，有中六学生形容口岸大楼「以为系商场」。新通关模式获旅客正面评价。
summary.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸實施「合作查驗、一次放行」首日，過關港人大讚流程「快靚正」，有中六學生形容口岸大樓「以為係商場」。新通關模式獲旅客正面評價。

title.en: Abby Choi murder case: defence claims defendant was a successful businessman; victim's mother scoffs in court
title.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案｜辩方指邝港智生意成功　蔡母庭上驳斥
title.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案｜辯方指鄺港智生意成功　蔡母庭上駁斥：乜新鮮蘿蔔皮唔好吹啦

summary.en: In the ongoing trial over the murder of Abby Choi, the defence claimed defendant Kwong Kong-chi had been successful in business, prompting the victim's mother to dismiss the claim angrily in court. The high-profile case continues to draw wide public attention in Hong Kong.
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤谋杀案今日续审，辩方指被告邝港智生意成功，死者母亲在庭上激动驳斥。这宗备受社会关注的案件继续审讯，庭内外气氛紧张。
summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳謀殺案今日續審，辯方指被告鄺港智生意成功，死者母親在庭上激動駁斥。這宗備受社會關注的案件繼續審訊，庭內外氣氛緊張。

title.en: Chinese desalination plant cuts 60% of energy use by turning waste brine into industrial salt
title.zh_hans: 中国海水淡化厂将废卤水转化工业用盐　能耗大减六成
title.zh_hant: 中國海水化淡廠將廢鹵水轉化工業用鹽　能耗大減六成

summary.en: A Chinese desalination plant has cut energy consumption by about 60% by converting waste brine into industrial salt, marking a significant advance in making desalination cheaper and greener. The technology turns a disposal problem into a valuable product while lowering operating costs.
summary.zh_hans: 一家中国海水淡化厂通过将废弃卤水转化为工业用盐，能耗减少约六成，成为降低淡化成本及推动绿色发展的重要突破。该技术化废为宝，在减少排放的同时降低运营成本。
summary.zh_hant: 一家中國海水化淡廠透過將廢棄鹵水轉化為工業用鹽，能耗減少約六成，成為降低化淡成本及推動綠色發展的重要突破。該技術化廢為寶，在減少排放的同時降低營運成本。

title.en: Four-vehicle crash including three buses on Tsing Kwai Highway disrupts airport-bound traffic
title.zh_hans: 葵涌青葵公路4车相撞包括3部巴士　往机场方向交通受阻
title.zh_hant: 葵涌青葵公路4車相撞包括3部巴士　往機場方向交通受阻

summary.en: Four vehicles, including three buses, collided on Tsing Kwai Highway in Kwai Chung, disrupting traffic in the airport-bound direction. At least one person was injured in the crash.
summary.zh_hans: 葵涌青葵公路发生4车相撞意外，包括3部巴士，往机场方向交通受阻。意外中至少一人受伤。
summary.zh_hant: 葵涌青葵公路發生4車相撞意外，包括3部巴士，往機場方向交通受阻。意外中至少一人受傷。

title.en: Shares in Malaysia's Genting tumble by the most in 28 years
title.zh_hans: 马来西亚云顶集团股价急泻　创28年来最大跌幅
title.zh_hant: 馬來西亞雲頂集團股價急瀉　創28年來最大跌幅

summary.en: Shares in Malaysian conglomerate Genting fell by their largest margin in 28 years, a major development for the regional gaming and hospitality giant. The plunge marks one of the sharpest single-day sell-offs in the group's history.
summary.zh_hans: 马来西亚综合企业云顶集团股价急泻，录得28年来最大单日跌幅。这间博彩及酒店业巨头的股价重挫，成为区内商界重大事件。
summary.zh_hant: 馬來西亞綜合企業雲頂集團股價急瀉，錄得28年來最大單日跌幅。這間博彩及酒店業巨頭的股價重挫，成為區內商界重大事件。

title.en: Saudi capital's airport hit by fresh Houthi strike a day after deadly attack
title.zh_hans: 沙特首都机场再遭胡塞袭击　距致命空袭仅隔一日
title.zh_hant: 沙特首都機場再遭胡塞襲擊　距致命空襲僅隔一日

summary.en: Riyadh's main airport was hit by another Houthi strike on Monday, just a day after an attack that killed 12 people. The Houthis said their military campaign would continue until Saudi Arabia stops its own strikes, raising fears of further escalation in the region.
summary.zh_hans: 沙特首都利雅得主要机场周一再遭胡塞武装袭击，距上一次造成12人死亡的空袭仅隔一天。胡塞方面称，除非沙特停止自身军事打击，否则行动将持续，外界忧虑地区局势进一步升级。
summary.zh_hant: 沙特首都利雅得主要機場周一再遭胡塞武裝襲擊，距上一次造成12人死亡的空襲僅隔一天。胡塞方面稱，除非沙特停止自身軍事打擊，否則行動將持續，外界憂慮地區局勢進一步升級。

title.en: China sanctions foreign ministers of Taiwan's diplomatic allies Paraguay and Belize in first-ever move
title.zh_hans: 史上首次　中国宣布制裁台湾邦交国巴拉圭、伯利兹外长
title.zh_hant: 史上首次　中國宣布制裁台灣邦交國巴拉圭、伯利茲外長

summary.en: Beijing announced sanctions against the foreign ministers of Paraguay and Belize, two of Taiwan's remaining diplomatic allies — the first time mainland China has sanctioned senior officials of Taiwan's diplomatic partners. The move marks a sharp escalation in cross-strait diplomatic pressure.
summary.zh_hans: 北京宣布制裁台湾邦交国巴拉圭及伯利兹的外交部长，为大陆史上首次制裁台湾邦交国高官。此举被视为两岸外交战的重大升级。
summary.zh_hant: 北京宣布制裁台灣邦交國巴拉圭及伯利茲的外交部長，為大陸史上首次制裁台灣邦交國高官。此舉被視為兩岸外交戰的重大升級。

title.en: Three women arrested over apm mall fight; mainland defendant allowed to leave Hong Kong
title.zh_hans: apm三女子涉打架被捕　内地女被告获准离港不设附加条件
title.zh_hant: apm三女子涉打架被捕　內地女被告獲准離港不設附加條件

summary.en: Three women were arrested over an alleged fight at apm mall in Kwun Tong. A mainland Chinese defendant asked the court for permission to leave Hong Kong, and the magistrate granted it without additional bail conditions.
summary.zh_hans: 三名女子涉在观塘apm商场打架被捕。一名内地女被告向法庭申请离港，裁判官在没有附加保释条件下批准。
summary.zh_hant: 三名女子涉在觀塘apm商場打架被捕。一名內地女被告向法庭申請離港，裁判官在沒有附加保釋條件下批准。

title.en: 37-year-old suspected illegal worker found dead at Mai Po fish pond; hirer arrested
title.zh_hans: 米埔鱼塘黑工倒毙｜37岁冷气技工陈尸鱼塘　雇主涉雇用黑工被捕
title.zh_hant: 米埔魚塘黑工倒斃｜37歲冷氣技工陳屍魚塘　僱主涉僱用黑工被捕

summary.en: A 37-year-old air-conditioning technician, believed to be an illegal worker, was found dead at a fish pond in Mai Po. Police arrested the man who hired him on suspicion of employing illegal workers; neighbours said the deceased had been seen feeding fish by the pond.
summary.zh_hans: 一名37岁冷气技工在米埔鱼塘被发现倒毙，怀疑为非法劳工。警方拘捕涉案雇主，涉嫌雇用非法劳工。邻居表示曾见死者在鱼塘边喂鱼。
summary.zh_hant: 一名37歲冷氣技工在米埔魚塘被發現倒斃，懷疑為非法勞工。警方拘捕涉案僱主，涉嫌僱用非法勞工。鄰居表示曾見死者在魚塘邊餵魚。

title.en: Goldman Sachs: AI trade shifting from hardware to applications; market hungry for the 'next AI story'
title.zh_hans: 高盛：AI交易从硬件转向应用　市场迫切渴望「下一个AI故事」
title.zh_hant: 高盛：AI交易從硬件轉向應用　市場迫切渴望「下一個AI故事」

summary.en: Goldman Sachs strategists said in a recent macro podcast that the AI investment trade is shifting from hardware toward applications, with the market eagerly searching for the "next AI story". The comments reflect growing investor focus on monetising artificial intelligence.
summary.zh_hans: 高盛策略师在最新宏观播客中表示，AI投资交易正从硬件转向应用层面，市场迫切渴望寻找「下一个AI故事」。言论反映投资者日益关注人工智能的商业化变现。
summary.zh_hant: 高盛策略師在最新宏觀播客中表示，AI投資交易正從硬件轉向應用層面，市場迫切渴望尋找「下一個AI故事」。言論反映投資者日益關注人工智能的商業化變現。

title.en: Over 5,000 travellers use revamped Huanggang crossing in its first two hours
title.zh_hans: 新皇岗口岸开通首两小时　逾5000人次使用
title.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸開通首兩小時　逾5000人次使用

summary.en: The rebuilt Huanggang border crossing opened smoothly on Monday morning, serving more than 5,000 travellers in its first two hours. Officials described the launch as satisfactory, with the new "cooperative inspection, single release" clearance model cutting crossing times from around 30 minutes to about five.
summary.zh_hans: 重建后的新皇岗口岸今早开通，首两小时已有逾5000人次使用，运作畅顺。口岸采用「合作查验、一次放行」新通关模式，将过关时间由原来约30分钟大幅缩短至约5分钟。
summary.zh_hant: 重建後的新皇崗口岸今早開通，首兩小時已有逾5000人次使用，運作暢順。口岸採用「合作查驗、一次放行」新通關模式，將過關時間由原來約30分鐘大幅縮短至約5分鐘。

title.en: Hong Kong's 'AI city brain' could begin testing in next typhoon season, says Eric Chan
title.zh_hans: 陈国基：香港「AI城市大脑」有望下个风季测试
title.zh_hant: 陳國基：本港「AI城市大腦」有望下個風季測試

summary.en: Hong Kong's planned "AI city brain" system could undergo testing during next year's typhoon season, Chief Secretary Eric Chan said. The platform aims to use artificial intelligence to coordinate emergency responses and strengthen the city's resilience against extreme weather.
summary.zh_hans: 政务司司长陈国基表示，香港计划中的「AI城市大脑」系统有望于下一个风季开始测试。该平台旨在运用人工智能协调应急反应，提升城市应对极端天气的能力。
summary.zh_hant: 政務司司長陳國基表示，本港計劃中的「AI城市大腦」系統有望於下一個風季開始測試。該平台旨在運用人工智能協調應急反應，提升城市應對極端天氣的能力。

title.en: China's CXMT unveils key progress on chip structure pursued by Samsung and SK Hynix
title.zh_hans: 长鑫存储芯片结构技术获关键进展　三星、SK海力士同路竞逐
title.zh_hant: 長鑫存儲晶片結構技術獲關鍵進展　三星、SK海力士同路競逐

summary.en: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT has unveiled key progress on a chip structure technology that Samsung and SK Hynix are also pursuing, signalling a narrowing gap in the memory chip race. The advance underscores China's push to close the gap with global leaders in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary.zh_hans: 中国存储芯片厂商长鑫存储（CXMT）宣布在三星、SK海力士亦正攻关的芯片结构技术上取得关键进展，显示中外存储芯片技术差距正在收窄。这项进展凸显中国追赶全球半导体龙头的努力。
summary.zh_hant: 中國記憶體晶片廠商長鑫存儲（CXMT）宣布在三星、SK海力士亦正攻關的晶片結構技術上取得關鍵進展，顯示中外記憶體晶片技術差距正在收窄。這項進展凸顯中國追趕全球半導體龍頭的努力。

title.en: China's first batch of national parks delivers five-year ecological report card
title.zh_hans: 首批国家公园交出五年生态答卷　标志性物种种群显著增长
title.zh_hant: 首批國家公園交出五年生態答卷　標誌性物種種群顯著增長

summary.en: The National Forestry and Grassland Administration released a five-year report card for China's first batch of national parks, saying ecosystems keep improving and flagship species such as Siberian tigers and Hainan gibbons have seen significant population growth.
summary.zh_hans: 国家林草局公布首批国家公园设立五年成果，生态环境持续改善，东北虎、海南长臂猿等标志性物种种群显著增长。
summary.zh_hant: 國家林草局公布首批國家公園設立五年成果，生態環境持續改善，東北虎、海南長臂猿等標誌性物種種群顯著增長。

title.en: New Huanggang Port officially opens with "joint inspection, one release" clearance; Chan Kwok-ki inspects operation
title.zh_hans: 新皇岗口岸正式启用实施“一地两检”式新通关模式　陈国基到场视察
title.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸正式啟用　實施「合作查驗、一次放行」新通關模式　陳國基到場視察

summary.en: The rebuilt Huanggang Port opened at 6:30am, implementing the new "joint inspection, one release" clearance model. Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki and security chief Tang Ping-keung inspected the operation and said it ran smoothly, with all immigration counters opened to let officers get familiar with the new flow.
summary.zh_hans: 重建后的皇岗口岸今晨6时30分正式启用，实施“合作查验、一次放行”全新通关模式。政务司司长陈国基与保安局局长邓炳强到场视察，称整体运作畅顺，已开放全部出入境柜位，让人员熟习运作。
summary.zh_hant: 重建後的新皇崗口岸今晨6時30分正式啟用，實施「合作查驗、一次放行」全新通關模式。政務司司長陳國基與保安局局長鄧炳強到場視察，稱整體運作暢順，已開放全部出入境櫃位，讓人員熟習運作。

source.url: https://www.stheadline.com/society/3624894/銀髮經濟長者求職者三年增至近萬人-團體促更多就業支援善用銀髮人力

title.en: Elderly job seekers nearly triple to 10,000 in three years; group urges more support for silver labour
title.zh_hans: 银发经济︱长者求职者三年增至近万人　团体促更多就业支援
title.zh_hant: 銀髮經濟︱長者求職者三年增至近萬人　團體促更多就業支援

summary.en: The number of elderly job seekers has nearly tripled to about 10,000 over three years. A welfare group called for more employment support to make better use of silver labour as the population ages.
summary.zh_hans: 长者求职者三年增至近万人，几乎是三年前的三倍。有团体促请政府提供更多就业支援，善用银发人力。
summary.zh_hant: 長者求職者三年增至近萬人，幾乎是三年前的三倍。有團體促請政府提供更多就業支援，善用銀髮人力。

title.en: Weekend sales at 10 major estates edge up but stay in single digits
title.zh_hans: 过去周末十大屋苑成交宗数略回升　仍处单位数
title.zh_hant: 過去周末十大屋苑成交宗數略回升　仍處單位數

summary.en: Transactions at Hong Kong's 10 major housing estates edged up slightly over the past weekend but remained in single digits, indicating the second-hand property market is still quiet.
summary.zh_hans: 过去周末十大屋苑成交宗数略有回升，但仍处单位数，反映二手楼市交投依然淡静。
summary.zh_hant: 過去周末十大屋苑成交宗數略有回升，但仍處單位數，反映二手樓市交投依然淡靜。

title.en: Airstrike hits Sudan gold mine near Egyptian border, killing 72 miners
title.zh_hans: 苏丹北部金矿遇袭　已致72名矿工死亡
title.zh_hant: 蘇丹北部金礦遇襲　已致72名礦工死亡

summary.en: A Sudanese civil society group said a gold mine in the North Wadi area near the Egyptian border was hit by a large-scale airstrike on 10 October, killing 72 miners. The statement accused the Egyptian air force; Egypt and Sudan have not responded. Sudan's civil war, now in its fourth year, has killed at least 59,000 people.
summary.zh_hans: 苏丹一个民间组织发表声明称，北部靠近埃及边境北瓦迪地区一处金矿10日遭遇大规模空袭，造成72名矿工死亡。声明指责埃及空军，埃及与苏丹官方均未回应。苏丹内战已持续三年多，造成至少5.9万人死亡。
summary.zh_hant: 蘇丹一個民間組織發表聲明稱，北部靠近埃及邊境北瓦迪地區一處金礦10日遭遇大規模空襲，造成72名礦工死亡。聲明指責埃及空軍，埃及與蘇丹官方均未回應。蘇丹內戰已持續三年多，造成至少5.9萬人死亡。

title.en: "Huanggang shuttle bus" runs final service after nearly 30 years as new port opens

title.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸︱「皇巴士」今晨開出尾班車　服務近30年落幕

summary.en: The cross-boundary "Huanggang shuttle bus" (皇巴士) ran its final service this morning after nearly 30 years, bowing out as the new Huanggang Port opens. Security chief Tang Ping-keung and bus fans gathered to bid it farewell.
summary.zh_hans: 服务近30年的皇岗跨境直通巴士“皇巴士”今晨开出尾班车，随新皇岗口岸启用正式落幕。保安局局长邓炳强及多名巴士迷到场道别。

title.en: Paul Chan's blog: hardware to boost "internal connectivity", mega events to drive "external outreach"

title.zh_hant: 陳茂波發表網誌：硬件加強「內聯」　盛事促進「外通」

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan wrote in his blog that hardware improvements such as the new Huanggang Port clearance, together with mega events including Hong Kong hosting its first APEC finance ministers' meeting, will further cement Hong Kong's status as an international finance and trade hub — hardware to strengthen "internal connectivity", events to promote "external outreach".
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波发表网志，指新皇岗口岸通关等硬件完善，加上香港首办APEC财长会议等盛事，将进一步彰显香港国际金融与商贸枢纽地位——硬件加强“内联”、盛事促进“外通”。

title.en: Shenzhou-23 crew advances microgravity experiments and docking training aboard space station
title.zh_hans: 神二十三乘组坚守岗位　完成多项交会对接训练
title.zh_hant: 神二十三乘組堅守崗位　完成多項交會對接訓練

summary.en: The Shenzhou-23 crew aboard China's space station maintained the regenerative life-support system and advanced multiple space experiments including microgravity physical science, while completing rendezvous and docking training.
summary.zh_hans: 神舟二十三号航天员乘组在中国空间站开展再生生保系统维护，推进微重力物理科学等多项太空实验，并完成多项交会对接训练。
summary.zh_hant: 神舟二十三號航天員乘組在中國空間站開展再生生保系統維護，推進微重力物理科學等多項太空實驗，並完成多項交會對接訓練。

title.en: Pentagon revises US casualty figures in US-Iran conflict upward, reigniting controversy
title.zh_hans: 美国防部上调美伊战事美军伤亡人数　修订续惹争议
title.zh_hant: 美國防部上調美伊戰事美軍傷亡人數　修訂續惹爭議

summary.en: The US Department of Defense updated its casualty database to show 21 US military personnel killed and 865 wounded in the US-Iran conflict. The revision, following earlier accusations that figures were underreported, has renewed controversy over the Pentagon's casualty accounting.
summary.zh_hans: 美国国防部更新伤亡数据库，显示美伊战事中美军已有21人死亡、865人受伤。此前官方数据被指低报，今次修订再引外界质疑五角大楼伤亡统计的透明度。
summary.zh_hant: 美國國防部更新傷亡數據庫，顯示美伊戰事中美軍已有21人死亡、865人受傷。此前官方數據被指低報，今次修訂再引外界質疑五角大樓傷亡統計的透明度。

title.zh_hant: 葉玉如強調科大參與北都大學城　着重科研成果轉化

summary.en: HKUST president Nancy Ip said in an interview that the university's participation in the Northern Metropolis university town will focus on translating research outcomes into practical applications. She added that HKUST has recruited more than 160 outstanding scholars since 2022.
summary.zh_hans: 科大校长叶玉如接受专访时强调，科大参与北都大学城将着重科研成果转化。她表示，科大自2022年起已延聘逾160名优秀学者。
summary.zh_hant: 科大校長葉玉如接受專訪時強調，科大參與北都大學城將着重科研成果轉化。她表示，科大自2022年起已延聘逾160名優秀學者。

title.en: Tim Cook visits China for first time since stepping down as Apple CEO, pledges bigger Guangdong push

title.zh_hant: 卸任蘋果CEO後首訪華　庫克稱將加碼廣東業務

summary.en: Tim Cook made his first visit to China since stepping down as Apple CEO, saying Apple will step up its business in Guangdong. During the trip he visited Guangzhou, including the set of a Wing Chun-themed short film shot on the iPhone 18 Pro.
summary.zh_hans: 卸任苹果CEO后的库克首次访华，表示苹果将加码广东业务。期间他到访广州，包括探班一部以iPhone 18 Pro拍摄的咏春题材短片。
summary.zh_hant: 卸任蘋果CEO後的庫克首次訪華，表示蘋果將加碼廣東業務。期間他到訪廣州，包括探班一部以iPhone 18 Pro拍攝的詠春題材短片。

title.en: Zelensky: Ukraine's leader should be chosen by Ukrainians; holding elections now is very difficult
title.zh_hans: 泽连斯基：乌克兰领导人应由乌国人民决定　现时举行选举很难
title.zh_hant: 澤連斯基：烏克蘭領導人應由烏國人民決定　現時舉行選舉很難

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded to US President Donald Trump's suggestion that Ukraine should change its leader, saying the country's leader should be decided by the Ukrainian people. He said holding elections under wartime conditions would be extremely difficult, but one could be considered if Russia agreed to a 60-day ceasefire.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基回应美国总统特朗普有关乌克兰应更换领导人的言论，表示乌领导人应由乌克兰人民决定。他指在战争状态下举行选举极具困难，但若俄方同意停火60天，可考虑举办选举。
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基回應美國總統特朗普有關烏克蘭應更換領導人的言論，表示烏領導人應由烏克蘭人民決定。他指在戰爭狀態下舉行選舉極具困難，但若俄方同意停火60天，可考慮舉辦選舉。

title.en: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire; Zelensky says Ukraine will agree if Russia does
title.zh_hans: 特朗普称俄乌同意能源停火　泽连斯基指若俄方同意乌方亦会同意
title.zh_hant: 特朗普稱俄烏同意能源停火　澤連斯基指若俄方同意烏方亦會同意

summary.en: US President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy ceasefire. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded that Ukraine would agree if Russia does. The exchange comes as US-Ukraine ties strain over Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and Trump's remarks about a leadership change in Kyiv.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意实施能源停火。乌克兰总统泽连斯基回应指，若俄方同意，乌方亦会同意。双方表态之际，美乌关系因乌军袭击俄炼油厂及特朗普有关更换乌领导人的言论而趋紧张。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普表示，俄羅斯和烏克蘭已同意實施能源停火。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基回應指，若俄方同意，烏方亦會同意。雙方表態之際，美烏關係因烏軍襲擊俄煉油廠及特朗普有關更換烏領導人的言論而趨緊張。

title.en: Boat capsizes off Djibouti killing at least 139, dozens missing
title.zh_hans: 载305人船只吉布提沿海翻沉　至少139死84人失踪
title.zh_hant: 載305人船隻吉布提沿海翻沉　至少139死84人失蹤

summary.en: A boat carrying 305 people capsized off the coast of Djibouti, killing at least 139 people including children, with 84 others still missing. Search and rescue operations are ongoing; the cause of the accident is under investigation.
summary.zh_hans: 一艘载有305人的船只在非洲吉布提沿海翻沉，至少139人死亡，包括儿童，另有84人仍然失踪。搜救工作仍在进行，事故原因有待调查。
summary.zh_hant: 一艘載有305人的船隻在非洲吉布提沿海翻沉，至少139人死亡，包括兒童，另有84人仍然失蹤。搜救工作仍在進行，事故原因有待調查。

title.en: IMF and World Bank annual meetings to open in Bangkok; Thailand steps up security

title.zh_hant: IMF和世銀年會將在曼谷舉行　泰國加強安保和城市保障

summary.en: The 2026 annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group will be held in Bangkok, Thailand from October 12 to 18. The Thai government has stepped up security, transport and city operations to support the week-long event, which is expected to draw finance officials and delegates from around the world.
summary.zh_hans: 2026年国际货币基金组织和世界银行集团年会将于10月12日至18日在泰国曼谷举行。泰国政府已全面加强安保、交通及城市运行保障，迎接为期一周、汇聚全球财经官员与代表的这场盛会。
summary.zh_hant: 2026年國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行集團年會將於10月12日至18日在泰國曼谷舉行。泰國政府已全面加強安保、交通及城市運行保障，迎接為期一周、匯聚全球財經官員與代表的這場盛會。

title.en: Garden's 700-student sandwich event ends in chaos as parents push and tear door handle
title.zh_hans: 嘉顿700名小学生制三文治活动酿混乱　家长推撞「扯爆门」
title.zh_hant: 嘉頓700名小學生製三文治活動釀混亂　家長推撞「扯爆門」

summary.en: Garden's sandwich-making record attempt with 700 primary school students at a Wan Chai school on October 11 descended into chaos at dismissal time, with parents pushing and shoving and a door handle torn off. The organizer apologized and said it would seriously review the crowd-control arrangements.
summary.zh_hans: 嘉顿11日在湾仔一间学校举办700名小学生制作三文治挑战纪录活动，散场时家长推撞，一度「扯爆门」，场面混乱。主办方就事件致歉，表示会认真检讨人流安排。
summary.zh_hant: 嘉頓11日在灣仔一間學校舉辦700名小學生製作三文治挑戰紀錄活動，散場時家長推撞，一度「扯爆門」，場面混亂。主辦方就事件致歉，表示會認真檢討人流安排。

title.en: Woman hit in hand by steel ball in Tai Po; police treat case as wounding
title.zh_hans: 大埔女子遭钢珠击中左手　警列伤人追缉凶徒
title.zh_hant: 大埔女子遭鋼珠擊中左手　警列傷人追緝兇徒

summary.en: A 31-year-old woman was struck in the left hand by an 8mm steel ball while walking near Wan Tau Tong Estate in Tai Po on the evening of October 11, and was sent to hospital. Police are treating the case as wounding and are hunting for the culprit; the source of the steel ball is under investigation.
summary.zh_hans: 一名31岁女子11日晚上在大埔运头塘邨附近行经时，左手被一颗8毫米钢珠击中受伤，送院治理。警方将案件列作伤人，正追缉凶徒，并调查钢珠来源。
summary.zh_hant: 一名31歲女子11日晚上在大埔運頭塘邨附近行經時，左手被一顆8毫米鋼珠擊中受傷，送院治理。警方將案件列作傷人，正追緝兇徒，並調查鋼珠來源。

title.en: Magnitude-6.1 earthquake hits Solomon Islands
title.zh_hans: 所罗门群岛发生6.1级地震
title.zh_hant: 所羅門群島發生6.1級地震

summary.en: A magnitude-6.1 earthquake struck the Solomon Islands at 22:07 Hong Kong time on October 11, at a depth of 10 kilometres, according to the German Research Centre for Geosciences. No casualties or tsunami warnings have been reported so far.
summary.zh_hans: 据德国地球科学研究中心测定，10月11日香港时间22时07分，所罗门群岛发生6.1级地震，震源深度10公里。目前未有伤亡或海啸预警报告。
summary.zh_hant: 據德國地球科學研究中心測定，10月11日香港時間22時07分，所羅門群島發生6.1級地震，震源深度10公里。目前未有傷亡或海嘯預警報告。

title.en: Magnitude-6.2 earthquake hits Papua New Guinea
title.zh_hans: 巴布亚新几内亚发生6.2级地震
title.zh_hant: 巴布亞新幾內亞發生6.2級地震

summary.en: A magnitude-6.2 earthquake struck near Panguna, Papua New Guinea at 22:07 Hong Kong time on October 11, at a depth of 53.5 kilometres, according to the US Geological Survey. There are no immediate reports of casualties.
summary.zh_hans: 据美国地质调查局测定，10月11日香港时间22时07分，巴布亚新几内亚潘古纳附近发生6.2级地震，震源深度53.5公里。暂未有伤亡报告。
summary.zh_hant: 據美國地質調查局測定，10月11日香港時間22時07分，巴布亞新幾內亞潘古納附近發生6.2級地震，震源深度53.5公里。暫未有傷亡報告。

title.en: Zheng becomes first home player to win China Open
title.zh_hans: 郑钦文勇夺中国网球公开赛冠军　创本土球手历史
title.zh_hant: 鄭欽文勇奪中國網球公開賽冠軍　創本土球手歷史

summary.en: Zheng Qinwen defeated Mirra Andreeva 7-5, 6-4 in the China Open final on October 11, becoming the first home player to win the tournament. It is also her first WTA 1000 title.
summary.zh_hans: 郑钦文11日在中国网球公开赛决赛以7:5、6:4击败安德列娃，成为赛事创办以来首位夺冠的中国球手，亦是她首个WTA 1000级别冠军。
summary.zh_hant: 鄭欽文11日在中國網球公開賽決賽以7:5、6:4擊敗安德列娃，成為賽事創辦以來首位奪冠的中國球手，亦是她首個WTA 1000級別冠軍。

title.en: Floods in north-central Nepal destroy homes and bridges; dozens rescued

title.zh_hant: 尼泊爾中北部洪水沖毀民房橋樑　數十人獲救

summary.en: Floods in north-central Nepal destroyed dozens of homes and two bridges, leaving at least five people missing. Dozens have been rescued, including one foreign national, as relief operations continue.
summary.zh_hans: 尼泊尔中北部发生洪水，冲毁数十间民房及两座桥梁，至少5人失踪。救援人员已救出数十人，包括一名外国人，救援工作仍在进行。
summary.zh_hant: 尼泊爾中北部發生洪水，沖毀數十間民房及兩座橋樑，至少5人失蹤。救援人員已救出數十人，包括一名外國人，救援工作仍在進行。

title.en: Xinhua reviews decade of Healthy China initiative
title.zh_hans: 习近平引领健康中国建设　人均预期寿命达79.25岁
title.zh_hant: 習近平引領健康中國建設　人均預期壽命達79.25歲

summary.en: Xinhua published a feature reviewing the Healthy China initiative, highlighting 2025 health indicators including average life expectancy of 79.25 years. The report summarizes a decade of healthcare reforms and public health campaigns.
summary.zh_hans: 新华社11日发表长篇报道，回顾「健康中国」建设历程，提到2025年全国人均预期寿命达79.25岁等指标，总结十年来医疗改革及公共卫生工作的进展。

title.en: Doolittle Raiders descendants reunite with girl from 84-year-old photo
title.zh_hans: 84年前老照片小女孩与杜立特行动飞行员后人见面
title.zh_hant: 84年前老照片小女孩與杜立特行動飛行員後人見面

summary.en: Six representatives of the Doolittle Raiders descendants association met in Shangrao, Jiangxi with Guan Dongxiang, the little girl in an 84-year-old photo taken by a rescued US pilot. The reunion recalls the Chinese villagers who risked their lives to rescue American airmen in 1942.
summary.zh_hans: 6名杜立特行动飞行员后人代表在江西上饶，与84年前老照片中的小女孩管冬香见面。当年中国村民冒生命危险营救迫降的美军飞行员，这段历史至今仍被传颂。
summary.zh_hant: 6名杜立特行動飛行員後人代表在江西上饒，與84年前老照片中的小女孩管冬香見面。當年中國村民冒生命危險營救迫降的美軍飛行員，這段歷史至今仍被傳頌。

title.en: Huanggang Port opening ceremony held; John Lee says it will deepen Greater Bay Area integration
title.zh_hant: 皇崗口岸開通儀式舉行　李家超指將推動大灣區深度融合
title.zh_hans: 皇岗口岸开通仪式举行　李家超指将推动大湾区深度融合

summary.en: The opening ceremony for the redeveloped Huanggang Port was held at the port's joint inspection building on October 11, with Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee and Guangdong official Huang Chuping attending. The new port opens at 6:30 am on October 12 with the innovative "collaborative inspection, one-time clearance" model and 24-hour service. Lee said the new port will greatly improve the clearance experience and drive deeper Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area integration.
summary.zh_hant: 皇崗口岸開通儀式11日在皇崗口岸聯檢大樓舉行，行政長官李家超、廣東省人大常委會主任黃楚平出席並致辭。新口岸將於10月12日上午6時半正式開通運行，實施「合作查驗、一次放行」新通關模式，提供24小時通關服務。李家超指新口岸是港深首個採用創新通關模式的陸路口岸，將大幅提升通關體驗，進一步推動粵港澳大灣區深度融合。
summary.zh_hans: 皇岗口岸开通仪式11日在皇岗口岸联检大楼举行，行政长官李家超、广东省人大常委会主任黄楚平出席并致辞。新口岸将于10月12日上午6时半正式开通运行，实施「合作查验、一次放行」新通关模式，提供24小时通关服务。李家超指新口岸是港深首个采用创新通关模式的陆路口岸，将大幅提升通关体验，进一步推动粤港澳大湾区深度融合。

title.en: Pope Leo XIV to undergo surgery for lung nodule
title.zh_hant: 教宗良十四世肺部發現結節　將接受手術切除
title.zh_hans: 教宗良十四世肺部发现结节　将接受手术切除

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV revealed during a Sunday prayer at St. Peter's Square that a recent medical check-up found a small nodule in his lung. The 71-year-old pontiff will undergo surgery within days to remove it; the Vatican says there is no sign of spread and he is expected to need about a week of rest afterwards.
summary.zh_hant: 教宗良十四世在梵蒂岡聖伯多祿廣場主持主日祈禱時透露，最近一次身體檢查發現肺部有小型結節。71歲的教宗將於未來幾天接受手術切除，梵蒂岡指暫無擴散跡象，預計術後需休養約一星期。
summary.zh_hans: 教宗良十四世在梵蒂冈圣伯多禄广场主持主日祈祷时透露，最近一次身体检查发现肺部有小型结节。71岁的教宗将于未来几天接受手术切除，梵蒂冈指暂无扩散迹象，预计术后需休养约一星期。

title.en: CCTV features China's ecological progress in Beautiful China campaign
title.zh_hans: 守护绿水青山　共绘美丽中国新画卷
title.zh_hant: 守護綠水青山　共繪美麗中國新畫卷

summary.en: CCTV's feature reports on China's ecological conservation achievements, from pollution control to national park development, under the Beautiful China campaign. The report highlights improved air and water quality across the country.
summary.zh_hans: 央视新闻11日推出专题报道，总结中国生态文明建设成果，包括污染防治攻坚及国家公园建设，指全国空气和水质持续改善，共绘「美丽中国」新画卷。
summary.zh_hant: 央視新聞11日推出專題報道，總結中國生態文明建設成果，包括污染防治攻堅及國家公園建設，指全國空氣和水質持續改善，共繪「美麗中國」新畫卷。

title.en: Lishui launches global imaging event tracing photography's evolution
title.zh_hans: 从大画幅到掌心　浙江丽水办「遇鉴」全球影像盛会
title.zh_hant: 從大畫幅到掌心　浙江麗水辦「遇鑒」全球影像盛會

summary.en: Lishui, Zhejiang launched the "遇鉴" global imaging event, showcasing photography's evolution from large-format cameras to smartphone cameras. Photographers and imaging brands from around the world are taking part.
summary.zh_hans: 浙江丽水举办「遇鉴」全球影像活动，展示摄影从大画幅相机到智能手机的发展历程，吸引全球摄影师及影像品牌参与。
summary.zh_hant: 浙江麗水舉辦「遇鑒」全球影像活動，展示攝影從大畫幅相機到智能手機的發展歷程，吸引全球攝影師及影像品牌參與。

title.en: Hong Kong Cycling Festival draws over 6,000 participants across events
title.zh_hant: 香港單車節今日舉行　逾6000人參與各項目
title.zh_hans: 香港单车节今日举行　逾6000人参与各项目

summary.en: The Hong Kong Cycling Festival held on October 11 attracted more than 6,000 participants across its various races and activities, according to RTHK.
summary.zh_hant: 今日舉行的香港單車節吸引逾6,000人參與各項賽事與活動。
summary.zh_hans: 今日举行的香港单车节吸引逾6,000人参与各项赛事与活动。

title.en: Wang Huning meets Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man in Beijing
title.zh_hant: 王滬寧在北京會見越南國會主席陳青敏
title.zh_hans: 王沪宁在北京会见越南国会主席陈青敏

summary.en: CPPCC Chairman Wang Huning met Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man in Beijing on October 11. Wang said China is willing to work with Vietnam to advance mutually beneficial cooperation under the "six mores" overall goal and build a China-Vietnam community with a shared future. Tran said Vietnam firmly upholds the one-China policy and its National Assembly is willing to deepen exchanges with China.
summary.zh_hant: 全國政協主席王滬寧11日在北京會見越南國會主席陳青敏。王滬寧表示，中方願同越方按「六個更」總體目標，高質量推進各領域互利合作，推進中越命運共同體建設。陳青敏表示，越南堅定奉行一個中國政策，越南國會願同中方加強交流，促進越中命運共同體建設。
summary.zh_hans: 全国政协主席王沪宁11日在北京会见越南国会主席陈青敏。王沪宁表示，中方愿同越方按「六个更」总体目标，高质量推进各领域互利合作，推进中越命运共同体建设。陈青敏表示，越南坚定奉行一个中国政策，越南国会愿同中方加强交流，促进越中命运共同体建设。

title.en: AI founder Li Di: a sub-20-person team with 76 AI agents makes one-person companies a reality
title.zh_hant: 明日新程創始人李笛：不足20人團隊配76個AI員工　一人公司不再是概念
title.zh_hans: 明日新程创始人李笛：不足20人团队配76个AI员工　一人公司不再是概念

summary.en: Li Di, founder of AI firm Mingri Xincheng, says his team of fewer than 20 people works alongside 76 AI agents. He argues that the core advantage of this model is high resilience: when the smallest unit of an organisation is agile enough, it can adapt quickly to external change, and AI-empowered structures greatly extend each person's value-creation cycle. A "one-person company", he says, may become the foundation of how work is done in the future.
summary.zh_hant: 明日新程創始人李笛表示，其不到20人的團隊配備了76個AI Agent協同工作。他認為這種模式的核心優勢在於高彈性：當組織的最小單元足夠敏捷，就能快速適應外部環境變化；而AI賦能的組織架構，令經驗與「體力」不再此消彼長，極大延長每個人的價值創造周期。「一人公司」不再只是概念，更可能是未來工作方式的底層變革。
summary.zh_hans: 明日新程创始人李笛表示，其不到20人的团队配备了76个AI Agent协同工作。他认为这种模式的核心优势在于高弹性：当组织的最小单元足够敏捷，就能快速适应外部环境变化；而AI赋能的组织架构，令经验与「体力」不再此消彼长，极大延长每个人的价值创造周期。「一人公司」不再只是概念，更可能是未来工作方式的底层变革。

title.en: After Daegu mall ceiling collapse, opposition blames President Lee Jae-myung's response
title.zh_hant: 大邱商場天花坍塌　在野黨指控總統李在明應對不力
title.zh_hans: 大邱商场天花坍塌　在野党指控总统李在明应对不力

summary.en: After a ceiling collapse at a shopping mall in Daegu, South Korea on October 10, opposition parties have accused President Lee Jae-myung of a weak response. The incident left dozens with minor injuries.
summary.zh_hant: 南韓大邱市一間商場昨日發生天花坍塌事故後，在野黨指控總統李在明應對不力。事故造成數十人受輕傷。
summary.zh_hans: 韩国大邱市一间商场昨日发生天花坍塌事故后，在野党指控总统李在明应对不力。事故造成数十人受轻伤。

title.en: Hong Kong flag-raising ceremony draws over 1,000 participants at Golden Bauhinia Square
title.zh_hant: 香港升旗隊總會舉行大型升旗禮 近千人參與
title.zh_hans: 香港升旗队总会举行大型升旗礼 近千人参与

summary.en: The Association of Hong Kong Flag-guards held a large-scale flag-raising ceremony themed "Salute to the National Flag" at Golden Bauhinia Square on October 11. More than 83 Hong Kong schools and organisations took part, with nearly 1,100 teachers, students and group representatives attending.
summary.zh_hant: 香港升旗隊總會11日在金紫荊廣場舉行主題為「向國旗敬禮」的大型升旗禮，逾83所香港學校和機構參與，近1,100名師生及團體代表出席儀式。
summary.zh_hans: 香港升旗队总会11日在金紫荆广场举行主题为「向国旗敬礼」的大型升旗礼，逾83所香港学校和机构参与，近1,100名师生及团体代表出席仪式。

title.en: Redeveloped Huanggang Port opens October 12; security chief confident of smooth operation
title.zh_hant: 皇崗口岸重建10月12日開通 鄧炳強料運作暢順
title.zh_hans: 皇岗口岸重建10月12日开通 邓炳强料运作畅顺

summary.en: The redeveloped Huanggang Port opens at 6:30 am on October 12. Secretary for Security Chris Tang said over a hundred tests have been completed and expressed confidence the crossing will be safe, smooth and efficient.
summary.zh_hant: 重建後的皇崗口岸將於10月12日早上6時半開通。保安局局長鄧炳強表示已完成逾百項測試，有信心口岸運作安全、暢順及高效。
summary.zh_hans: 重建后的皇岗口岸将于10月12日早上6时半开通。保安局局长邓炳强表示已完成逾百项测试，有信心口岸运作安全、畅顺及高效。

title.en: Swine fever outbreak hits pig farm in Japan's Gunma Prefecture
title.zh_hant: 日本群馬縣有豬場爆發豬瘟疫情
title.zh_hans: 日本群马县有猪场爆发猪瘟疫情

summary.en: An outbreak of swine fever has been confirmed at a pig farm in Gunma Prefecture, Japan, and authorities have taken disease-control measures.
summary.zh_hant: 日本群馬縣一處豬場爆發豬瘟疫情，當局已採取防疫措施。
summary.zh_hans: 日本群马县一处猪场爆发猪瘟疫情，当局已采取防疫措施。

title.en: Bar Association backs overall direction of Building Management Ordinance reform
title.zh_hant: 大律師公會原則上支持修訂《建築物管理條例》整體方向
title.zh_hans: 大律师公会原则上支持修订《建筑物管理条例》整体方向

summary.en: The government plans to amend the Building Management Ordinance following the Wang Fuk Court fire to reduce bid-rigging risks. The Bar Association said it supports tightening maintenance-procurement and proxy-voting rules in principle, but has reservations about restricting who may hold proxies.
summary.zh_hant: 政府計劃在宏福苑火災後修訂《建築物管理條例》，減低圍標風險。大律師公會表示，原則上支持收緊維修採購及授權票規定的整體方向，但對限制可獲授權人士的建議有所保留。
summary.zh_hans: 政府计划在宏福苑火灾后修订《建筑物管理条例》，减低围标风险。大律师公会表示，原则上支持收紧维修采购及授权票规定的整体方向，但对限制可获授权人士的建议有所保留。

title.en: IELTS exams abruptly cancelled two days in a row in mainland China, reportedly due to technical failure
title.zh_hant: 內地雅思考試突連續兩天取消 傳因技術故障
title.zh_hans: 内地雅思考试突连续两天取消 传因技术故障

summary.en: IELTS exams run by the British Council were abruptly cancelled across large parts of mainland China on October 10 and 11. The official notice attributed the disruption mainly to technical failure, leaving large numbers of candidates' travel and study plans in disarray.
summary.zh_hant: 由英國文化教育協會主辦的雅思考試，於10日及11日連續兩天在中國內地大範圍突發取消。官方通報指主要因技術故障所致，大量考生的行程與升學計劃大受影響。
summary.zh_hans: 由英国文化教育协会主办的雅思考试，于10日及11日连续两天在中国内地大范围突发取消。官方通报指主要因技术故障所致，大量考生的行程与升学计划大受影响。

title.en: Academician Ge Junbo elected president-elect of the World Heart Federation
title.zh_hant: 中科院院士葛均波當選世界心臟聯盟候任主席
title.zh_hans: 中科院院士葛均波当选世界心脏联盟候任主席

summary.en: The World Congress of Cardiology closed in Rio de Janeiro on October 10 local time, where Chinese Academy of Sciences academician Ge Junbo was elected president-elect of the World Heart Federation (WHF).
summary.zh_hant: 世界心臟病學大會於當地時間10日在巴西里約熱內盧閉幕，中國科學院院士葛均波成功當選世界心臟聯盟（WHF）候任主席。
summary.zh_hans: 世界心脏病学大会于当地时间10日在巴西里约热内卢闭幕，中国科学院院士葛均波成功当选世界心脏联盟（WHF）候任主席。

title.en: Renhe mega-bridge on Xi'an–Chongqing high-speed railway nears completion
title.zh_hant: 峽谷中建60層「摩天大樓」 西渝高鐵任河特大橋將合龍
title.zh_hans: 峡谷中建60层「摩天大楼」 西渝高铁任河特大桥将合龙

summary.en: The Renhe extra-large bridge on the Xi'an–Chongqing high-speed railway is less than 3 metres from final closure, expected by the end of this month. The bridge's towering piers, likened to a 60-storey skyscraper rising from the canyon, mark a key milestone for the cross-regional line.
summary.zh_hant: 西渝高鐵任河特大橋距離最終合龍不足3米，預計本月底完成。這座在峽谷中如60層「摩天大樓」般拔地而起的大橋，是這條跨區域高鐵線的重要里程碑。
summary.zh_hans: 西渝高铁任河特大桥距离最终合龙不足3米，预计本月底完成。这座在峡谷中如60层「摩天大楼」般拔地而起的大桥，是这条跨区域高铁线的重要里程碑。

title.en: National Day holiday sees 826 million domestic trips, tourism revenue up
title.zh_hant: 十一黃金週8.26億人次出遊 文旅消費升溫
title.zh_hans: 十一黄金周8.26亿人次出游 文旅消费升温

summary.en: Citing Ministry of Culture and Tourism data, the National Day holiday saw 826 million domestic trips and 73.84 billion yuan in tourism revenue. On a comparable daily-average basis, trips and spending rose 6.3% and 4.3% respectively, as the industry shifts from chasing visitor "traffic" to retaining visitors.
summary.zh_hant: 據文化和旅遊部數據，國慶假期全國國內出遊達8.26億人次，旅遊花費7,383.75億元；按可比口徑日均計算，人次及花費分別增長6.3%和4.3%，文旅經濟正從「流量」轉向「留量」。
summary.zh_hans: 据文化和旅游部数据，国庆假期全国国内出游达8.26亿人次，旅游花费7,383.75亿元；按可比口径日均计算，人次及花费分别增长6.3%和4.3%，文旅经济正从「流量」转向「留量」。

title.en: UN chief condemns Houthi attack on Riyadh airport; at least 12 dead, over 300 injured
title.zh_hant: 聯合國秘書長譴責胡塞襲擊沙特機場 至少12死逾300傷
title.zh_hans: 联合国秘书长谴责胡塞袭击沙特机场 至少12死逾300伤

summary.en: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres strongly condemned the Houthi attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. Reports put the toll at at least 12 dead and over 300 injured; the airport suspended operations while the US weighs joining strikes against the Houthis.
summary.zh_hant: 聯合國秘書長古特雷斯強烈譴責也門胡塞武裝襲擊沙特利雅得哈立德國王國際機場。報道指事件造成至少12死逾300傷，機場暫停運作，美國正評估參與打擊胡塞武裝。
summary.zh_hans: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯强烈谴责也门胡塞武装袭击沙特利雅得哈立德国王国际机场。报道指事件造成至少12死逾300伤，机场暂停运作，美国正评估参与打击胡塞武装。

title.en: US forces disable cargo ship attempting to breach naval blockade in Gulf of Oman
title.zh_hant: 貨船企圖突破海上封鎖 在阿曼灣遭美軍擊停
title.zh_hans: 货船企图突破海上封锁 在阿曼湾遭美军击停

summary.en: A Panama-flagged commercial vessel, the MV Ocean Molica, ignored warnings and attempted to breach the US naval blockade of Iran. US forces struck it with precision weapons in the Gulf of Oman, destroying its propulsion and leaving it dead in the water.
summary.zh_hant: 一艘無視警告、企圖突破美軍對伊朗海上封鎖的巴拿馬旗商用貨船 MV Ocean Molica，在阿曼灣遭美軍以精確制導武器打擊，推進系統被毀停航。
summary.zh_hans: 一艘无视警告、企图突破美军对伊朗海上封锁的巴拿马旗商用货船 MV Ocean Molica，在阿曼湾遭美军以精确制导武器打击，推进系统被毁停航。

title.en: Nine dead including pregnant woman and children in Pennsylvania shooting
title.zh_hant: 美國賓夕凡尼亞州槍擊案 9死包括孕婦幼童
title.zh_hans: 美国宾夕法尼亚州枪击案 9死包括孕妇幼童

summary.en: A mass shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania left nine people dead after a 45-year-old man shot seven relatives and one friend at home before taking his own life. The victims included two young children and a woman eight months pregnant.
summary.zh_hant: 美國賓夕凡尼亞州伊利市發生嚴重槍擊案，一名45歲男子在住所槍殺7名親屬及1名友人後吞槍自殺，死者包括兩名幼童及一名懷孕8個月的孕婦。
summary.zh_hans: 美国宾夕法尼亚州伊利市发生严重枪击案，一名45岁男子在住所枪杀7名亲属及1名友人后吞枪自杀，死者包括两名幼童及一名怀孕8个月的孕妇。

title.en: Restaurant Group Receives Over 30 Powder-Laced Threat Letters; 3 Arrested Over HK$1m Renovation Dispute
title.zh_hans: 餐饮集团收逾30封「粉末恐吓信」追100万工程费　装修公司3人被捕
title.zh_hant: 餐飲集團收逾30封「粉末恐嚇信」追100萬工程費　裝修公司3人被捕

summary.en: A catering group recently received over 30 threat letters laced with white powder, printed with skull patterns and marked "poisonous"; tests showed the powder was flour. The case stems from a renovation fee dispute worth over HK$1 million with a renovation company, and police arrested three people in an ambush operation on 9 October for suspected criminal intimidation.
summary.zh_hans: 一间餐饮集团近日收到逾30封夹杂白色粉末的恐吓信，附骷髅头图案及「有毒」字样，经化验粉末为面粉。事件源于与装修公司逾100万元工程费纠纷，警方10月9日埋伏拘捕3人，涉嫌刑事恐吓。

summary.en: AI-generated legal filings are flooding courts around the world and adding to judges' workloads. Hong Kong legal scholar 毛樂禮 has called for clear guidelines so that self-representation does not turn into an AI-driven "arms race", and so courts can properly manage unreliable AI-drafted documents.
summary.zh_hant: 全球法院正被 AI 生成的法律文件淹沒，加重法官負擔。香港法律學者毛樂禮促請推出清晰指引，避免自辯演變成 AI「軍備競賽」，讓法庭能妥善處理不盡可靠的 AI 代寫訟文。

US President Trump said he had been briefed and is evaluating whether the United States should join Saudi Arabia in military action against the Houthis.

summary.en: Panama declared a state of emergency after a magnitude 7.5 earthquake struck Friday afternoon, damaging buildings and infrastructure and injuring at least 27 people. The government set up a dedicated coordination committee and relief collection points; no Chinese citizens were reported among the casualties.

summary.en: Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was reportedly attacked by Yemen's Houthi rebels, with foreign media reporting dozens injured, five of them in intensive care. The airport has halted all flights, with several airlines suspending services to Riyadh; Saudi officials have not yet responded. The US, UK and other embassies have warned citizens to avoid the airport.
summary.zh_hans: 沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得哈立德国王国际机场怀疑遭受也门胡塞武装袭击，多间外电报道多人受伤，其中五人在深切治疗部留医。机场已无航班升降，多间航空公司暂停来往利雅得的航班；沙特官方暂时未有回应。美国、英国等多国驻沙特大使馆警告公民避开利雅得国际机场。
summary.zh_hant: 沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得哈立德國王國際機場懷疑遭受也門胡塞武裝襲擊，多間外電報道多人受傷，其中五人在深切治療部留醫。機場已無航班升降，多間航空公司暫停來往利雅得的航班；沙特官方暫時未有回應。美國、英國等多國駐沙特大使館警告公民避開利雅得國際機場。

title.en: South African Figures Exchange Views on CPC's Governance Experience in Pretoria
title.zh_hans: 南非人士交流研讨中国共产党治国理政经验
title.zh_hant: 南非人士交流研討中國共產黨治國理政經驗

summary.en: A seminar themed "Reading Group on Governance: China's Practice and China-Africa Cooperation" was held in Pretoria, South Africa's administrative capital, where South African political, academic and business figures exchanged views on the Communist Party of China's governance experience and China-Africa relations.
summary.zh_hans: 以「治国理政读书会：中国实践与中非合作」为主题的研讨活动在南非行政首都比勒陀利亚举行。南非政界、学界及商界人士围绕中国共产党治国理政经验与中非关系等议题展开交流。
summary.zh_hant: 以「治國理政讀書會：中國實踐與中非合作」為主題的研討活動在南非行政首都比勒陀利亞舉行。南非政界、學界及商界人士圍繞中國共產黨治國理政經驗與中非關係等議題展開交流。

title.en: Foreign Ministry: No Reports of Chinese Casualties in Panama Earthquake So Far
title.zh_hans: 外交部：暂无中国公民在巴拿马地震中伤亡报告
title.zh_hant: 外交部：暫無中國公民在巴拿馬地震中傷亡報告

summary.en: A magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck Panama followed by multiple aftershocks. A Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson expressed condolences to Panama's government and disaster-hit people in response to media questions, and confirmed that no casualties among Chinese nationals had been reported so far.
summary.zh_hans: 巴拿马发生7.6级强烈地震并引发多次余震，中国外交部发言人在答记者问时向巴拿马政府与灾区人民表达慰问，并证实截至目前暂未收到中国公民在地震中的伤亡报告。
summary.zh_hant: 巴拿馬發生7.6級強烈地震並引發多次餘震，中國外交部發言人在答記者問時向巴拿馬政府與災區人民表達慰問，並證實截至目前暫未收到中國公民在地震中的傷亡報告。

source.name: 香港01
source.url: https://www.hk01.com/即時娛樂/60398347/梅艷芳骨灰驚爆被盜-歌迷會於生忌發文呼籲尋找-讓梅姐早日回家

title.en: Anita Mui's Ashes Reported Stolen; Fan Club Appeals for Help on Her Birthday
title.zh_hans: 梅艳芳骨灰惊爆被盗　歌迷会于生忌发文呼吁寻找
title.zh_hant: 梅艷芳骨灰驚爆被盜　歌迷會於生忌發文呼籲尋找

summary.en: On what would have been Anita Mui's 63rd birthday (Oct 10), the Anita Mui International Fan Club announced that her ashes, interred at Po Lin Monastery on Lantau Island, were discovered missing during a visit on July 18, and appealed for information to help bring her "home". Local media confirmed the fan club's announcement.
summary.zh_hans: 10月10日是已故天后梅艳芳63岁冥寿，梅艳芳国际歌迷会发文公布，指今年7月18日去拜祭时，发现安放于大屿山宝莲禅寺的骨灰不翼而飞，呼吁知情者提供线索，「让梅姐早日回家」。歌迷会的公布已获本港媒体确认报道。
summary.zh_hant: 10月10日是已故天后梅艷芳63歲冥壽，梅艷芳國際歌迷會發文公布，指今年7月18日去拜祭時，發現安放於大嶼山寶蓮禪寺的骨灰不翼而飛，呼籲知情者提供線索，「讓梅姐早日回家」。歌迷會的公布已獲本港媒體確認報道。

title.en: Fire Services Seize Car Suspected of Illegal Refuelling, Tracing Those Involved
title.zh_hans: 消防处截获怀疑用作非法加油私家车　正追查涉案人士
title.zh_hant: 消防處截獲懷疑用作非法加油私家車　正追查涉案人士

summary.en: The Fire Services Department seized a private car suspected of being used for illegal refuelling at a Shek Kip Mei Estate car park, finding a large container capable of holding about 1,000 litres of fuel plus refuelling tools, and is tracing those involved. It is the fourth public housing estate car park found with illegal fuel decanting activity, following Fung Tak, Tsz Lok and Ming Tak estates.
summary.zh_hans: 消防处在石硖尾邨停车场截获一辆怀疑用作非法加油的私家车，搜出一个可储存约1千公升燃油的大型容器及一批入油工具，正追查涉案人士。处方表示，今次是继凤德邨、慈乐邨及明德邨后，再有公屋停车场发现非法燃油转注活动，提醒切勿参与、协助或光顾任何非法燃油转注活动。
summary.zh_hant: 消防處在石硤尾邨停車場截獲一輛懷疑用作非法加油的私家車，搜出一個可儲存約1千公升燃油的大型容器及一批入油工具，正追查涉案人士。處方表示，今次是繼鳳德邨、慈樂邨及明德邨後，再有公屋停車場發現非法燃油轉注活動，提醒切勿參與、協助或光顧任何非法燃油轉注活動。

title.en: Gunman Kills Nine in Pennsylvania Residential Shooting Before Apparent Suicide
title.zh_hans: 美国无差别枪击　枪手扫射宾州伊利市住宅区酿9死
title.zh_hant: 美國無差別槍擊　槍手掃射賓州伊利市住宅區釀9死

summary.en: A gunman opened fire in a residential neighbourhood in Erie, Pennsylvania, barricaded himself inside a house and faced off with police for hours. Nine people, including two children and the suspected shooter — apparently dead by suicide — were killed. Police say the motive is unknown and the incident no longer poses a threat to public safety.
summary.zh_hans: 美国宾州北部伊利市发生重大枪击事件，枪手在住宅区持枪扫射后反锁屋内，与警方对峙长达数小时，据报已有9人死亡，包括2名孩童，疑犯被发现时已死亡，疑似开枪自戕。警方指枪手作案动机未明，认为事件不再对公共安全构成威胁。
summary.zh_hant: 美國賓州北部伊利市發生重大槍擊事件，槍手在住宅區持槍掃射後反鎖屋內，與警方對峙長達數小時，據報已有9人死亡，包括2名孩童，疑犯被發現時已死亡，疑似開槍自戕。警方指槍手作案動機未明，認為事件不再對公共安全構成威脅。

title.en: China and France Hold Strategic Dialogue; Wang Yi Pledges Continued Strategic Communication
title.zh_hans: 中法举行战略对话　王毅指愿与法方保持战略沟通增进战略互信
title.zh_hant: 中法舉行戰略對話　王毅指願與法方保持戰略溝通增進戰略互信

summary.en: Wang Yi, director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, and French presidential foreign affairs adviser Emmanuel Bonne held the 28th China-France strategic dialogue, discussing deeper strategic cooperation. Wang said China is willing to maintain strategic communication and build mutual trust with France, and the two sides also exchanged views on the Ukraine crisis and the Middle East situation.
summary.zh_hans: 中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅与法国总统外事顾问博纳举行第28次中法战略对话，讨论深化战略合作。王毅说中方愿与法方落实两国元首共识，保持战略沟通、增进战略互信；双方并就乌克兰危机、中东局势深入交换意见。
summary.zh_hant: 中共中央政治局委員、中央外辦主任王毅與法國總統外事顧問博納舉行第28次中法戰略對話，討論深化戰略合作。王毅說中方願與法方落實兩國元首共識，保持戰略溝通、增進戰略互信；雙方並就烏克蘭危機、中東局勢深入交換意見。

title.en: Hong Kong Police Bust Transnational Prostitution Ring in Human Trafficking Crackdown, 16 Arrested
title.zh_hans: 香港警方捣破跨国非法卖淫集团涉贩运人口　拘捕16人
title.zh_hant: 警方搗破跨國非法賣淫集團涉販運人口　拘捕16人

summary.en: Hong Kong police arrested 16 people after a two-day operation in Tsim Sha Tsui and Tuen Mun dismantled a transnational prostitution ring suspected of human trafficking. Officers seized about HK$18 million in cash and froze another HK$5 million in suspected crime proceeds; 12 suspects have been charged and will appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on Monday.
summary.zh_hans: 香港警方在尖沙咀及屯门展开一连两日打击有组织卖淫行动，捣破一个涉嫌贩运人口的跨国非法卖淫集团，共拘捕16名男女。行动中检获约1800万元现金，并冻结户口内约500万元怀疑犯罪得益；其中12人已被落案起诉，星期一在九龙城裁判法院提堂。
summary.zh_hant: 警方在尖沙咀及屯門展開一連兩日打擊有組織賣淫行動，搗破一個涉嫌販運人口的跨國非法賣淫集團，共拘捕16名男女。行動中檢獲約1800萬元現金，並凍結戶口內約500萬元懷疑犯罪得益；其中12人已被落案起訴，星期一在九龍城裁判法院提堂。

title.en: Over 100 Million Voters Removed in India Electoral Roll Revision, Sparking Mass Protests
title.zh_hans: 印度选举委员会修订选民名册致逾亿人被除名　触发大规模示威
title.zh_hant: 印度選舉委員會修訂選民名冊致逾億人被除名　觸發大規模示威

summary.en: India's election commission removed 130 million voters from electoral rolls during a revision, triggering days of mass protests. Opposition groups called Saturday demonstrations in New Delhi and elsewhere, demanding the chief election commissioner's resignation; the government denies disenfranchising voters, saying the revision removes duplicate, ineligible or deceased entries.
summary.zh_hans: 印度选举委员会修订选民名册，导致1亿3千万名选民被除名，触发连日大规模示威。多个反对派组织星期六号召民众在首都新德里等地示威，要求首席选举专员辞职；印度政府否认褫夺民众投票权，解释修订是要删除重复、不合资格或已去世的选民登记。
summary.zh_hant: 印度選舉委員會修訂選民名冊，導致1億3千萬名選民被除名，觸發連日大規模示威。多個反對派組織星期六號召民眾在首都新德里等地示威，要求首席選舉專員辭職；印度政府否認褫奪民眾投票權，解釋修訂是要刪除重覆、不合資格或已去世的選民登記。

title.en: Over 2,100 teenagers arrested for criminal offences in first 8 months, up 23% year-on-year
title.zh_hant: 今年首8個月逾2100名青少年涉刑事罪被捕　按年升23%
title.zh_hans: 今年首8个月逾2100名青少年涉刑事罪被捕　按年升23%

summary.en: Police announced that over 2,100 teenagers were arrested for criminal offences in the first eight months of this year, a 23% increase year-on-year. Police said the trend of youth crime deserves attention and called for stronger preventive efforts.
summary.zh_hant: 警務處公布，今年首8個月共有超過2100名青少年因刑事罪行被捕，按年上升23%。警方表示青少年犯罪趨勢值得關注，呼籲各界加強預防工作。
summary.zh_hans: 警务处公布，今年首8个月共有超过2100名青少年因刑事罪行被捕，按年上升23%。警方表示青少年犯罪趋势值得关注，呼吁各界加强预防工作。

title.en: NY Fed study: tariffs turn expected price drops into hikes across 67 product categories
title.zh_hant: 紐約聯儲銀行研究：67類商品「應跌反升」　關稅通脹壓力料持續至2027年
title.zh_hans: 纽约联储银行研究：67类商品「应跌反升」　关税通胀压力料持续至2027年

summary.en: A New York Fed study found that tariffs pushed prices higher across 67 product categories, with goods expected to fall nearly 1% instead rising by an average of 2.9 percentage points. Electronics, apparel and home-improvement goods were hit hardest, and each percentage-point rise in the average tariff rate lifts consumer prices by about 0.25 points a year later.
summary.zh_hant: 紐約聯邦儲備銀行發表研究指出，受關稅影響，67類商品價格不跌反升，原本預計下跌近1%的商品平均升高2.9個百分點。重災區包括電子與家電、服裝鞋類等；平均關稅率每升1個百分點，消費物價一年後約升0.25個百分點，價格上漲壓力料持續至2027年。
summary.zh_hans: 纽约联邦储备银行发表研究指出，受关税影响，67类商品价格不跌反升，原本预计下跌近1%的商品平均升高2.9个百分点。重灾区包括电子与家电、服装鞋类等；平均关税率每升1个百分点，消费物价一年后约升0.25个百分点，价格上涨压力料持续至2027年。

title.en: Record Chinese presence at Paris Motor Show as brands' European market share hits 10.7%
title.zh_hant: 巴黎車展中國品牌參展創新高　約20個品牌規模倍增　歐洲市佔升至10.7%
title.zh_hans: 巴黎车展中国品牌参展创新高　约20个品牌规模倍增　欧洲市占升至10.7%

summary.en: The 91st Paris Motor Show opens next week with about 20 Chinese automakers exhibiting, a record high and double the scale of the previous edition, including BYD, Chery and Aito. Chinese brands' European market share reached 10.7% in the second quarter, far above 5.7% a year earlier, as Europe debates new tariffs on Chinese plug-in hybrids while seeking Chinese EV technology.
summary.zh_hant: 第91屆巴黎車展下周開幕，約20個中國汽車品牌參展，創歷史新高，規模是上一屆的兩倍，包括比亞迪、奇瑞、問界等。中國品牌今年第二季在歐洲市佔達10.7%，遠高於一年前的5.7%；歐洲一邊討論對中國插電式混能車加徵關稅，一邊又尋求中國電動車技術合作。
summary.zh_hans: 第91届巴黎车展下周开幕，约20个中国汽车品牌参展，创历史新高，规模是上一届的两倍，包括比亚迪、奇瑞、问界等。中国品牌今年第二季在欧洲市占达10.7%，远高于一年前的5.7%；欧洲一边讨论对中国插电式混能车加征关税，一边又寻求中国电动车技术合作。

title.en: China Coast Guard patrols waters off Diaoyu Islands on Oct 10
title.zh_hant: 中國海警廈門艦編隊10月10日在釣魚島及其附屬島嶼領海內維權巡航
title.zh_hans: 中国海警厦门舰编队10月10日在钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿领海内维权巡航

summary.en: The China Coast Guard announced that a Xiamen-based fleet conducted a rights-protection patrol in the territorial waters of the Diaoyu Islands and their affiliated islets on Oct 10. Beijing described the operation as a lawful patrol carried out in accordance with the law.
summary.zh_hant: 中國海警公布，海警廈門艦編隊10月10日在釣魚島及其附屬島嶼領海內開展維權巡航。中方稱這是依法開展的維權巡航活動。
summary.zh_hans: 中国海警公布，海警厦门舰编队10月10日在钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿领海内开展维权巡航。中方称这是依法开展的维权巡航活动。

title.en: 127 arrested as police bust non-Chinese loan shark syndicate charging up to 3,700% interest
title.zh_hant: 警方搗破非華裔高利貸集團拘127人　向同鄉放貸年利率高達3700厘
title.zh_hans: 警方捣破非华裔高利贷集团拘127人　向同乡放贷年利率高达3700厘

summary.en: Police smashed a non-Chinese criminal syndicate and arrested 127 people. The group allegedly lent money at usurious rates to fellow countrymen, with annual interest rates reaching as high as 3,700%, in what police described as organised loan sharking.
summary.zh_hant: 警方搗破一個非華裔犯罪集團，共拘捕127人。該集團涉嫌向同鄉放高利貸，年利率高達3700厘，涉及有組織高利貸活動。
summary.zh_hans: 警方捣破一个非华裔犯罪集团，共拘捕127人。该集团涉嫌向同乡放高利贷，年利率高达3700厘，涉及有组织高利贷活动。

title.en: Brazil sues Shell subsidiary for over US$100 million in flood damages
title.zh_hant: 巴西起訴殼牌子公司　索賠上億美元洪災損失　屬氣候訴訟新案例
title.zh_hans: 巴西起诉壳牌子公司　索赔上亿美元洪灾损失　属气候诉讼新案例

summary.en: Brazil has filed a lawsuit against a Shell subsidiary seeking over US$100 million in compensation for flood-related losses. The case centres on corporate climate responsibility and is seen as a new example of climate litigation.
summary.zh_hant: 巴西方面就洪災損失向殼牌一間子公司提起訴訟，索賠金額超過一億美元。案件涉及企業氣候責任，被視為氣候訴訟的新案例。
summary.zh_hans: 巴西方面就洪灾损失向壳牌一间子公司提起诉讼，索赔金额超过一亿美元。案件涉及企业气候责任，被视为气候诉讼的新案例。

title.en: Hurricane Isaiah weakens after Florida landfall; over 430,000 lose power
title.zh_hant: 颶風伊薩亞斯登陸美國佛州後迅速減弱　逾43萬戶停電
title.zh_hans: 飓风伊萨亚斯登陆美国佛州后迅速减弱　逾43万户停电

summary.en: Hurricane Isaiah made landfall in Florida before weakening rapidly, causing widespread power outages affecting more than 430,000 customers. Forecasters warned of severe weather across the southeastern United States.
summary.zh_hant: 颶風伊薩亞斯在美國佛羅里達州登陸後迅速減弱，登陸期間造成廣泛停電，影響超過43萬戶。氣象部門預計美國東南部將有惡劣天氣。
summary.zh_hans: 飓风伊萨亚斯在美国佛罗里达州登陆后迅速减弱，登陆期间造成广泛停电，影响超过43万户。气象部门预计美国东南部将有恶劣天气。

title.en: Joel Chan switches to one-show-a-year TVB deal, backs Joe Chung's return to 'Come Home Love'
title.zh_hant: 袁文傑自爆主動改簽「一年一騷」部頭約　撐周嘉洛回歸《三代同糖》救亡
title.zh_hans: 袁文杰自爆主动改签「一年一骚」部头约　撑周嘉洛回归《三代同糖》救亡

summary.en: Actor Joel Chan revealed in an interview that he proactively asked TVB to switch him from a management contract to a one-show-a-year deal, hoping to step out of his comfort zone. He also expressed support for Joe Chung and other former cast members returning to 'Come Home Love: Three Generations' to boost ratings.

summary.en: Defense ministry spokesperson Chen Xi issued a statement on military-related issues, criticising Japan's ruling authorities for accelerating "re-militarisation" and seeking to breach the Three Non-Nuclear Principles, warning that "new militarism" is threatening regional peace and stability.
summary.zh_hant: 國防部新聞發言人陳曦就涉軍問題發布消息，批評日本執政當局加快「再軍事化」進程、企圖突破「無核三原則」，稱「新型軍國主義」正威脅地區和平穩定。

title.en: Magnitude 7.6 earthquake hits Panama; hotel collapses, 27 injured

title.zh_hans: 巴拿马发生7.6级地震　一酒店坍塌致27人受伤

summary.en: A magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck Panama, collapsing a hotel; witnesses said people were trapped. Twenty-seven people were injured and buildings were damaged in several areas. The Chinese embassy in Panama said no Chinese casualties had been reported.
summary.zh_hant: 巴拿馬發生7.6級強震，一間酒店倒塌，目擊者稱有人員被困；另有27人受傷、多地建築受損。中國駐巴使館表示暫無中方人員傷亡報告。
summary.zh_hans: 巴拿马发生7.6级强震，一间酒店倒塌，目击者称有人员被困；另有27人受伤、多地建筑受损。中国驻巴使馆表示暂无中方人员伤亡报告。

title.en: South African jurist Navi Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
title.zh_hant: 2026年諾貝爾和平獎揭曉　南非法學家皮萊膺殊榮
title.zh_hans: 2026年诺贝尔和平奖揭晓　南非法学家皮莱膺殊荣

summary.en: The Norwegian Nobel Committee has awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize to South African jurist Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, recognizing her lifelong campaign to promote peace and strengthen international law. Pillay, 85, served as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights from 2008 to 2014 and as a judge at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and the International Criminal Court.
summary.zh_hant: 挪威諾貝爾委員會宣布，將2026年諾貝爾和平獎授予南非法學家納維·皮萊，表彰她畢生推動和平與強化國際法的貢獻。85歲的皮萊曾於2008至2014年擔任聯合國人權事務高級專員，亦曾任盧旺達問題國際刑事法庭及國際刑事法院法官。
summary.zh_hans: 挪威诺贝尔委员会宣布，将2026年诺贝尔和平奖授予南非法学家纳维·皮莱，表彰她毕生推动和平与强化国际法的贡献。85岁的皮莱曾于2008至2014年担任联合国人权事务高级专员，亦曾任卢旺达问题国际刑事法庭及国际刑事法院法官。

More than 100 A1-group prospective buyers arrived to select flats; the figure reflects attendance, not sales completed.

title.en: US homeland security chief hits back at NYC mayor over 'dangerous' anti-ICE remarks
title.zh_hant: 穆林回擊曼達尼　批其針對移民及海關執法局言論危險
title.zh_hans: 穆林回击曼达尼　批其针对移民及海关执法局言论危险

summary.en: US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin has accused New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani of making 'dangerous' remarks demanding that federal immigration agents end operations in the city. The row follows an ICE operation in the Bronx in which 28-year-old Oscar Bergal was shot; a senior ICE official said officers fired because they felt unsafe when the man's vehicle accelerated.
summary.zh_hant: 美國國土安全部長穆林批評紐約市長曼達尼要求聯邦移民執法人員撤出紐約市的言論「危險」。事件源於移民及海關執法局人員在布朗克斯槍擊28歲男子奧斯卡·貝爾加爾，執法部門指人員在車輛加速時感到不安全才開槍。
summary.zh_hans: 美国国土安全部长穆林批评纽约市长曼达尼要求联邦移民执法人员撤出纽约市的言论「危险」。事件源于移民及海关执法局人员在布朗克斯枪击28岁男子奥斯卡·贝尔加尔，执法部门指人员在车辆加速时感到不安全才开枪。

title.en: UAE says Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash passenger jet into Israeli airport
title.zh_hant: 阿聯酋稱迪拜航空副機師曾計劃駕機撞向以色列機場
title.zh_hans: 阿联酋称迪拜航空副机师曾计划驾机撞向以色列机场

summary.en: UAE authorities say an Omani co-pilot of a Flydubai passenger jet planned a suicide attack to crash the aircraft into an Israeli airport, describing it as a premeditated act of terrorism. Investigators said the co-pilot, who was influenced by the September 11 attacks, had formed the idea of using a plane as a weapon, and the plot was uncovered and thwarted.
summary.zh_hant: 阿聯酋當局指，一名迪拜航空客機的阿曼籍副機師曾計劃發動自殺式襲擊，將飛機撞向以色列機場，屬預謀恐怖襲擊。調查指該副機師受911事件影響，萌生以飛機作武器的念頭，陰謀被揭破並挫敗。
summary.zh_hans: 阿联酋当局指，一名迪拜航空客机的阿曼籍副机师曾计划发动自杀式袭击，将飞机撞向以色列机场，属预谋恐怖袭击。调查指该副机师受911事件影响，萌生以飞机作武器的念头，阴谋被揭破并挫败。

title.en: Teenager airlifted from Lion Rock after falling ill on hike

title.zh_hans: 狮子山少女远足发冷呕吐　直升机救起送院

summary.en: Police received a report at around 6:50am that a teenage girl felt unwell while hiking on Lion Rock with friends. The Government Flying Service dispatched a helicopter to airlift her to the Wan Chai heliport, from where an ambulance took her to Ruttonjee Hospital.
summary.zh_hant: 警方早上約6時50分接報，有少女與友人在獅子山遠足期間身體不適，出現發冷嘔吐。政府飛行服務隊派直升機將她救起送往灣仔直升機坪，再由救護車轉送律敦治醫院治理。
summary.zh_hans: 警方早上约6时50分接报，有少女与友人在狮子山远足期间身体不适，出现发冷呕吐。政府飞行服务队派直升机将她救起送往湾仔直升机坪，再由救护车转送律敦治医院治理。

title.en: UK-Israel row deepens as London downgrades Jerusalem consulate
title.zh_hant: 英以外交爭端升級　英國駐耶路撒冷領館降級
title.zh_hans: 英以外交争端升级　英国驻耶路撒冷领馆降级

summary.en: The UK-Israel diplomatic row has escalated, with Britain saying it will downgrade its nearly 200-year-old consulate in Jerusalem. London said it does not accept that Israel has the right to unilaterally shut the consulate, while Israel dismissed the British move as an attack on its sovereignty.
summary.zh_hant: 英以外交爭端升級，英國表示將把擁有近200年歷史的駐耶路撒冷領事館降級。倫敦稱不接受以色列有權單方面關閉領館，以色列則批評英方舉動是對其主權的攻擊。
summary.zh_hans: 英以外交争端升级，英国表示将把拥有近200年历史的驻耶路撒冷领事馆降级。伦敦称不接受以色列有权单方面关闭领馆，以色列则批评英方举动是对其主权的攻击。

title.en: CUHK study finds 40% of students feel lonely; professor calls for more campus gathering spaces
title.zh_hant: 研究揭學生孤獨比例達四成　大學活動減少　教授盼增聚腳點建信任
title.zh_hans: 研究揭学生孤独比例达四成　大学活动减少　教授盼增聚脚点建信任

summary.en: A Chinese University of Hong Kong study shows 40% of students consider themselves lonely, while about 34% of young people aged 18 to 29 report loneliness, well above the global level of around 20%. A professor said the campus atmosphere has not recovered since the pandemic and called for more gathering spots and teacher-student interaction to build trust and ease loneliness.
summary.zh_hant: 中大研究顯示學生自評孤獨比例達四成，18至29歲年輕人孤獨比率約34%，高於全球約20%水平。教授指疫情後校園氛圍未恢復，盼增設聚腳點及加強師生交流，以建立信任紓緩孤獨感。
summary.zh_hans: 中大研究显示学生自评孤独比例达四成，18至29岁年轻人孤独比率约34%，高于全球约20%水平。教授指疫情后校园氛围未恢复，盼增设聚脚点及加强师生交流，以建立信任纾缓孤独感。

title.en: Magnitude 6.9 aftershock strikes Panama after earlier powerful quake

title.zh_hans: 巴拿马强震后再发生6.9级地震

summary.en: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck Panama, hours after an earlier powerful quake in the region that the US Geological Survey measured at magnitude 7.7. Reports carried no immediate word of major damage or casualties from the strong aftershock.
summary.zh_hant: 巴拿馬在早前強烈地震後再發生6.9級地震，此前一次震級據美國地質調查局測定為7.7級。報道指餘震在數小時後發生，暫未接獲重大傷亡或損毀報告。
summary.zh_hans: 巴拿马在早前强烈地震后再发生6.9级地震，此前一次震级据美国地质调查局测定为7.7级。报道指余震在数小时后发生，暂未接获重大伤亡或损毁报告。

title.en: Dow closes up 423 points as telecom shares slump on SpaceX spectrum deal
title.zh_hant: 道指高收423點　電訊股下挫
title.zh_hans: 道指高收423点　电讯股下挫

summary.en: US stocks rose across the board, with the Dow closing at 51,654, up 423 points or 0.8%; the Nasdaq gained 0.6% and the S&P 500 added 46 points. For the week, all three benchmarks rose, with the Nasdaq up for a fourth straight week, while news of SpaceX's spectrum acquisition sent T-Mobile plunging more than 13%.
summary.zh_hant: 美股三大指數上升，道指收報51654點，升423點（+0.8%）；納指升0.6%，標普500指數升46點。全週計三大指數均升，納指連升4週；SpaceX達成收購頻譜資產協議的消息拖累電訊股，T-Mobile急挫逾13%。
summary.zh_hans: 美股三大指数上升，道指收报51654点，升423点（+0.8%）；纳指升0.6%，标普500指数升46点。全周计三大指数均升，纳指连升4周；SpaceX达成收购频谱资产协议的消息拖累电讯股，T-Mobile急挫逾13%。

title.zh_hans: 金价高收逾1%　曾升穿4200美元

title.en: Oil prices rise as hurricane forces shutdown of over 70% of US offshore crude output
title.zh_hant: 油價上升　颶風逼近令美國關閉更多原油產能
title.zh_hans: 油价上升　飓风逼近令美国关闭更多原油产能

summary.en: International oil prices rose as a hurricane approached the northern Gulf of Mexico, forcing oil companies to shut more than 70% of US offshore crude production. Brent crude closed at US$104.72 a barrel, up 0.4%, while New York WTI settled at US$91.85, up nearly 0.4%.
summary.zh_hant: 颶風逼近墨西哥灣北部，迫使油公司關閉超過七成美國離岸原油產能，國際油價上升。布蘭特期油收報每桶104.72美元，升0.4%；紐約期油收報91.85美元，升近0.4%。

title.zh_hans: 银主盘专家教路低价必有因　计数不只「平市价几多」　揭银主去货压力渐升

summary.en: A property strategist says about 778 repossessed flats are on sale across Hong Kong, with a median listing time of 214 days; 86% of units whose prices were adjusted had been cut, by a median of 13.6%. Banks widened negotiation room and raised commissions in the third quarter, signalling growing pressure on repossessed-property sellers to clear stock.

title.en: European stocks close up around 1% or more; Deutsche Telekom dives nearly 8%
title.zh_hant: 歐股高收近1%或以上　德電信急跌近8%
title.zh_hans: 欧股高收近1%或以上　德电信急跌近8%

summary.en: European stocks closed higher, with Germany's DAX up 1.1% at 25,087, France's CAC up about 1% at 7,803 and Britain's FTSE 100 up about 1.1% at 10,552. SpaceX's deal to acquire US low-band spectrum dragged European telecom shares down, with Deutsche Telekom plunging nearly 8% for its biggest one-day drop in over three years.

summary.zh_hans: 欧洲股市高收，德国DAX指数升1.1%收报25087点，法国CAC指数升约1%收报7803点，英国富时100指数升约1.1%收报10552点。SpaceX达成收购美国低频段频谱协议拖累欧洲电讯股，德国电信急跌近8%，创逾3年最大单日跌幅。

title.en: Trump says Russia will supply diesel to ease prices; US Treasury issues sanctions waiver
title.zh_hant: 特朗普稱俄羅斯將供應柴油以緩解油價
title.zh_hans: 特朗普称俄罗斯将供应柴油以缓解油价

summary.en: US President Donald Trump said Vladimir Putin agreed that Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tonnes of diesel to American and global markets, with further shipments to follow, to bring prices down. The US Treasury issued a temporary license permitting the deals, which would otherwise be barred under sanctions imposed on Moscow since its 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普稱俄羅斯總統普京同意即時向美國及全球市場供應逾30萬噸柴油，之後再增加供應，以壓低油價。美國財政部已發出臨時許可，豁免相關交易受2022年俄烏戰爭以來對俄制裁的限制。
